article.articleHeadline: 福州男子确诊三种病毒性疾病！医生：不要熬夜
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fuzhou man diagnosed with three viral infections! Doctor: Don't stay up late.
article.articleSummary: In Fuzhou, Fujian Province, a 43-year-old entrepreneur (alias Ah Qiang) developed three sequential viral infections in three months due to marked immune suppression from prolonged overnight work and stress. In March he was diagnosed with ophthalmic herpes zoster (Varicella-Zoster virus) presenting with eye-area burning, vesicles around the eyelids, photophobia and tearing, attributed to reactivation along the ophthalmic branch of the trigeminal nerve. After partial recovery, he then suffered herpetic pharyngitis caused by enteroviruses with high fever and painful swallowing, followed by vestibular neuritis due to herpes simplex virus involving the inner ear vestibular nerve, causing severe vertigo and gait instability. An ENT physician, Dr. Liang Yonghui, emphasizes that midlife immune decline plus sleep deprivation allows viruses to attack in sequence. He advises shingles vaccination for those over 40 and cautions that health must be protected to sustain work performance.

triage.headline_ja: 福州男子確診3種ウイルス性疾患！医者：徹夜するな
triage.triage_reason: 単一患者の臨床事例報告であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生ではない。異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクはいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は福州在住の43歳起業家が3ヶ月間に複数のウイルス感染症（帯状疱疹、ヘルペス咽頭炎、前庭神経炎）を患った個別臨床事例の医学的解説である。感染症の集団発生、異常な増加、公衆衛生危機を示唆する要素は認められない。個人の免疫低下と生活習慣（睡眠不足）に関連した医学的ニュースの性質であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 一旦被咬伤就是Ⅲ级暴露！携带大量病毒！现在正是高峰期
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Bite Constitutes Level-3 Exposure! Carrying a Large Amount of Virus! Now Is the Peak Season.
article.articleSummary: In Jiangxi Province, China, a 9-year-old boy named Xiao Qiang was brought to the rabies prevention clinic at Jiangxi Provincial Women’s and Children’s Medical Center, Honggutan Campus, after a bat scratched his leg during cycling. Bat bites are classified as a Level-3 (highest) exposure, requiring immediate rabies vaccination and passive immunization. The hospital emphasizes a three-step response: (1) rinse and disinfect the wound with soap water or a mild alkaline cleaner under running water for at least 15 minutes, then apply povidone-iodine or medical alcohol; (2) seek medical care within 24 hours, no later than 48 hours, at a rabies outpatient clinic or emergency department; (3) inform clinicians of the bat exposure details (time, location, bat condition) to guide risk assessment for rabies virus and other pathogens. Bat activity peaks June–August, often at dusk; home precautions include screens, sealing gaps, and reducing roosting opportunities.

triage.headline_ja: 一度かまれたら第Ⅲ級暴露！大量のウイルスを保有！現在は高いピーク時期
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の個別患者事例報告で重症度の懸念あり。ただし国内対応の医療ガイダンス記事であり、集団発生やアウトブレイク指標に乏しく、国際的懸念の証拠が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は江西省での個別の狂犬病曝露事例（小児のコウモリによる引っ掻き傷）と医療現場での対応ガイダンスに焦点を当てている。集団発生やエピデミック兆候ではなく、季節的なリスク啓発記事。WPRO基準の「重症度」に該当（狂犬病は致死性高い）が、患者数1名で確定アウトブレイクではない。続報で複数例や地域集積が報告された場合はPICKUPへ昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: 5 إجراءات لحماية مسافري الدولة من "إيبولا" أبرزها المشورة الطبية والإبلاغ بتاريخ السفر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five measures to protect the country’s travelers from Ebola, the most notable of which are medical advice and reporting the date of travel.
article.articleSummary: Five preventive measures for travelers have been outlined by the UAE Ministry of Health and Prevention to reduce Ebola risk from Bundibugyo ebolavirus, noting no licensed vaccine for this strain. The guidance urges travelers to check latest travel advisories, follow destination-specific health instructions, maintain good personal hygiene, avoid contact with the sick, monitor health during and after travel, seek medical advice promptly if symptoms arise, and report travel dates to healthcare providers. The World Health Organization has declared the current outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though global health risk remains low; the outbreak is concentrated in parts of the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Ebola is a viral illness with incubation 2–21 days, beginning with fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pains, and later vomiting, diarrhea, sore throat, and abdominal pain; severe cases can involve bleeding, organ failure, or shock. No UAE cases reported; surveillance remains high.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱から国の旅行者を保護するための5つの措置、医学的助言と旅行日時報告が最も重要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEICの宣言と複数国での発生確認により、シグナルトリアージの基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラ発生は「Democratic Republic of CongoおよびUgandaの一部に集中している」と明記されているが、対象国リストはDRCのみに限定される。UAEは発生地域に含まれていますが、記事本体ではUAE症例報告なし（surveillance高い）と記述されており、UAE国内での実際の患者発生は確認されていません。WHO PHEICの宣言により、IHR基準及びWPRO基準すべてで該当あり。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: Thêm 71 ca nhiễm Ebola mới trong 24 giờ, Congo cảnh báo dịch đang lây lan rất nhanh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 71 more Ebola cases in the last 24 hours, the Democratic Republic of the Congo warns that the outbreak is spreading rapidly.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ebola Bundibugyo strain) reports 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths since the May 15 start. In the last 24 hours, 71 new infections: 65 in Ituri province and 6 in North Kivu, with cases confirmed across 17 of Ituri's 36 health zones, 7 in North Kivu, and 1 in South Kivu; spillover cases identified in Uganda. As of 2026-06-06, the outbreak is spreading rapidly in northeastern Congo amid fragile health infrastructure and ongoing conflict. WHO and Africa CDC regard this as the fourth largest Ebola outbreak on record. On June 5, WHO Director‑General Tedros announced a US$518 million six‑month plan to combat Ebola, calling for sustained funding and political commitment to help Congo and Uganda control transmission and to strengthen border screening and preparedness for other countries.

triage.headline_ja: 過去24時間で71件の新たなエボラ感染を確認、コンゴ民主共和国は感染拡大が非常に急速であると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常・予想外な事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。WHO事務局長による国際支援計画発表など社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）による重大な流行。過去24時間で71例の新規確認、累計452確認例82死亡。ウガンダへの越境事例確認。WHO事務局長が6ヶ月間5億1,800万米ドルの対策計画を発表。記事サマリーにウガンダの越境事例記載があるが、発生地域の主体はDRCであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : le bilan monte à 452 cas confirmés, dont 82 décès (officiel)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: the tally has risen to 452 confirmed cases, including 82 deaths (official).
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola virus disease: 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths; 71 new cases and 21 deaths on June 4 in Ituri and North Kivu, indicating rapid community transmission of Bundibugyo ebolavirus. 258 patients are in isolation or hospital; 8 recovered. Contact tracing remains weak: 4,766 contacts under surveillance, 2,755 seen (57.8%). Key response challenges include reluctance for post-mortem sampling, insufficient Ebola treatment centers, weak contact follow-up, shortages of essential medicines, lack of infection prevention/control materials in North Kivu, weak alerting, and a $21.5 million funding gap. The outbreak began mid-May in the DRC and Uganda; Uganda reports 3 new cases (total 19). Africa CDC and WHO launched a continental plan to mobilize $518 million for June–November 2026 to bolster preparedness and response.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ：確認症例が452件に増加、死亡者82人（公式）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された多数の死亡者、急速なコミュニティ伝播、国際的な拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、および国際的な公衆衛生対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの発生を主題としており、ウガンダでの症例も報告されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。エボラ出血熱は非常に高い致死率を示す感染症であり、急速な伝播、弱い接触者追跡、複数の対応上の課題が記載されている。Africa CDCとWHOは大規模な資金調達計画（5億1,800万ドル）を立ち上げており、国際的な対応が活発化している。

article.articleHeadline: WHO và CDC châu Phi công bố kế hoạch lớn ứng phó Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC announce a major plan to respond to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: June 6, 2026 — The WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Africa CDC unveiled an Ebola response plan for June–November 2026, prioritizing emergency coordination, surveillance, testing, infection prevention and control, treatment, and community engagement. The plan comes as Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo widens. DR Congo’s Ministry of Health says a funeral team was attacked in Katana, South Kivu, 30 km north of Bukavu, under AFC/M23 rebel control, forcing them to abandon coffins; locals later handled the bodies, increasing transmission risk. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, there have been 363 cases and 62 deaths, across 17 of 36 health zones in Ituri, with cases also in North and South Kivu. IOM is establishing 30 health checkpoints across three provinces; IFRC has shipped 300 burial supplies to Bunia. In Rwampara, Ituri, 32 contacts completed 21-day follow-up with negative results, and a Goma patient is nearing discharge.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDCがエボラ出血熱対応の大規模計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中のアウトブレイク（363例、62死亡）でIHR基準3項目以上に該当し、複数州での感染拡大と国際的対応が進行中であることから、シグナルとして認識し、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言されたDRC内のエボラアウトブレイク。記事ではイトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州の17保健地区で363例、62死亡が報告されており、セキュリティ懸念（M23反乱勢力支配地域での葬儀チーム襲撃）、遺体処理時の感染拡大リスク、地域固有の課題が明記されている。WHOとアフリカCDCが大規模対応計画を6月発表しており、IOMおよびIFRCも支援活動中。国際的な対応レベルが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Sube a 452 número de casos de ébola confirmados en RD del Congo, con 82 decesos, según informes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 452, with 82 deaths, according to reports.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths, with 71 new cases (including 21 deaths) reported on 4 June in Ituri and North Kivu, signaling rapid, ongoing community transmission of the Bundibugyo strain. A total of 258 patients remain in isolation or hospital care, with 8 recoveries. Contact tracing remains a major challenge: among 4,766 contacts under follow-up across three provinces, only 2,755 have been observed (57.8%). Key gaps include resistance to post-mortem sampling, insufficient standardized Ebola treatment capacity, fragile contact tracing, shortages of essential medicines, inadequate infection prevention supplies in North Kivu, and a $21.5 million funding deficit. Uganda reports 3 new Ebola cases for a total of 19. The Africa CDC and WHO launched a continental plan to mobilize $518 million for June–November 2026 to bolster preparedness and response across African countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認症例が452件に増加、82人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準でも5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は国際的に最重要な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国での発生、急速な地域内伝播、高い死亡率、国際的支援の必要性が認識されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの3新規症例報告も記述されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCのエボラ流行である。Bundibugyo株による急速な地域内伝播、接触者追跡の困難性（57.8%の観察率のみ）、$21.5百万のファンディングギャップが報告されている。Africa CDCとWHOが2026年6月～11月に$518百万の動員計画を発表。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫与非疾控启动超5亿美元埃博拉疫情防控计划_中国经济网 -- -- 国家经济门户
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and non-CDC agencies launch over $500 million Ebola outbreak prevention and control plan
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) and Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) launched a $518 million Ebola outbreak prevention and control plan to tackle Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Announced June 5, 2026, the initiative runs from June–November 2026 and aims to mobilize governments, partners, and communities for unified action, covering emergency coordination, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control (IPC), clinical care, research, and logistics. As of June 3, 2026, 34 health workers have been infected, with 7 fatalities and 6 recoveries. The plan seeks rapid detection, enhanced preparedness, and coordinated response to save lives and protect neighboring regions, addressing frontline healthcare pressures and reinforcing cross-border collaboration to curb Bundibugyo ebolavirus transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）とアフリカ疾病予防管理センター（Africa CDC）が5億ドル以上のエボラ感染症予防・管理計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での同時流行、医療従事者の感染死亡、$518百万規模の国際的対応計画立案により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダは明記されていないが、「Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda」と見出し翻訳に明示されており、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、実際の verified_locations は DRC のみとなります。ウガンダ（1814991）は当該リストに存在しないため、検証対象外です。本イベントは2026年6月5-6日時点での WHO/Africa CDC による大規模国際対応計画であり、既に確認症例（34名感染、7名死亡）を伴う活動中の流行状況を反映しています。

article.articleHeadline: CDC: El brote de ébola podría superar los 20.000 casos en tres meses sin medidas urgentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CDC: The Ebola outbreak could surpass 20,000 cases in three months without urgent measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa could exceed 20,000 cases and 4,000 deaths within three months if urgent, large-scale public health interventions are not implemented, CDC warns. Without swift measures to curb transmission, the current outbreak could reach the magnitude of West Africa's 2014-2016 epidemic, which recorded over 28,000 cases and >11,000 deaths. The World Health Organization had declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. As of Thursday, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths, per CDC. In neighboring Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths were reported through Friday. The article focuses on ongoing outbreak status and reinforces the need for intensified response, without detailing transmission sources or lab confirmations beyond the numbers.

triage.headline_ja: CDC：緊急対策がなければ3ヶ月以内にエボラ感染者数が20,000人を超える可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、WHOが既に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言しており、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが著しく高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病のアフリカでの流行。DRCで確認された452例と82死亡、ウガンダで19例と2死亡が報告されている。記事サマリーの主題はアフリカ全域での流行に言及しているが、検証可能な具体的なデータはDRCとウガンダに限定されている。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。アンゴラ（3351879）については記事サマリーで具体的な言及がないため除外。WHOが既に5月17日に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言しており、極めて高い優先度でRRA進行が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 世衛與非洲疾控中心啟動伊波拉疫情防控計劃
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC launch Ebola outbreak prevention and control plan.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC launched an Ebola outbreak prevention and control plan to address Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The plan aims to raise $518 million for June through November to bolster national preparedness, strengthen case finding, and enable rapid detection and response to the outbreak. Africa CDC Director Kasaye said the plan will support affected countries and protect neighboring regions. As of June 3, cumulative infections among health workers stood at 34, with 7 deaths and 6 recoveries. The initiative focuses on accelerating readiness and containment across affected and neighboring countries. The article, edited by Xu Jingxuan, originally appeared on Hong Kong Radio (RTHK).

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）とアフリカ疾病対策センター（Africa CDC）がエボラ出血熱の流行防止・制御計画を始動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国での発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが認められる。同時にWPRO基準も複数該当し、WHO・Africa CDCによる公式対応計画の始動により国際的・社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC とウガンダでのエボラ（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）発生と防止対策が述べられている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。医療従事者34例の感染、7死亡、6回復が記録されており、重症度が高い。WHO と Africa CDC による公式計画立案と 5.18 億ドルの資金調達目標は高い国際的関心を示す。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. warns Europe to step up Ebola screening ahead of World Cup
article.articleSummary: Central Africa Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no known treatment or vaccine. WHO reports 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths in Congo, plus 15 confirmed cases and one death in Uganda. As the World Cup 2026 approaches (June 11 onwards in the U.S., Canada and Mexico), the U.S. urges Europe to adopt similar travel measures; no EU ban planned. A 30-day CDC order suspends entry of foreign nationals who were in DRC, South Sudan, or Uganda within 21 days; visa issuances paused for those travelers. Diplomats are to coordinate precautions and share responses. The U.S. has spent over $200 million on outbreak response, including enhanced airport screenings, border controls, contact tracing, health clinics, and a Kenya quarantine center for exposed Americans.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がワールドカップに向けてエボラ出血熱スクリーニング強化を欧州に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の確認された流行（344確定例、60死亡）、国際的な移動制限措置の実施、ワールドカップという大規模国際イベント開催に伴う国際的な懸念。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストにない為含めない。記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国を中心として言及。米国、カナダ、メキシコはワールドカップ開催地であり、発生地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。スーダン南部はサマリー内で渡航制限対象地として言及されるが、確認された流行地は DRC と Uganda である。

article.articleHeadline: 孔繁毅稱甲型及乙型流感呈上升趨勢　是否達高峰尚待觀察
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kong Fan-yi says Influenza A and Influenza B are on an upward trend; whether they have peaked remains to be seen.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and B are rising in Hong Kong, with no clear peak yet. Influenza A/H3 is currently dominant, and infections among elderly and children at Mary Hospital have increased. Other upper-respiratory infections such as SARS-CoV-2 and rhinovirus occur sporadically, but influenza remains the main concern. The infectious-disease chief attributes the rise to waning community immunity and urges vaccination for those not yet inoculated, along with diligent hand hygiene, staying home when unwell, and wearing a mask when going out. He notes COVID-19 has become endemic; while small outbreaks occur, severe cases are lower than before. Hong Kong has not seen a large outbreak for a year; the virus, largely Omicron BA.2, mutates slowly, and immunity from vaccines and past infection remains strong. He recommends the elderly, care-home residents, the immunocompromised, and those with chronic diseases receive a COVID-19 vaccine every six months.

triage.headline_ja: 孔繁毅氏がA型およびB型インフルエンザが上昇傾向にあると述べ、ピークに達したかは依然として観察が必要
triage.triage_reason: 香港でのインフルエンザA/B型の上昇傾向は異常性を示すが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当なし。スクリーニング基準では異常性が認められるが、重症度や国際的拡大リスクに関する具体的情報が不足しており、続報の注視が適切。
triage.notes: 香港（China に含む）でのインフルエンザA/B型の上昇傾向が報告されている。高齢者と小児での感染増加、ワクチン接種の推奨など公衆衛生対応が行われており、政府・公開討論での関心も高い。ただし死亡や重症例の具体的数値、国際的拡大の兆候に関する情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Belgische infectioloog in Oost-Congo: 'Weinig paniek of bezorgdheid' bij ebola-uitbraak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belgian infectious-disease specialist in eastern Congo: 'Not much panic or concern' during the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo centered on Bunia and Rampara, involving the Bundibugyo variant. There is no vaccine for this variant yet. Diagnostics use GeneXpert PCR with 1–2 hour results, but no cassettes exist for Bundibugyo, forcing testing to restart. On the ground, contact tracing is limited and quarantine assets are scarce; many cases have no clear link to known infections, suggesting the outbreak is larger than detected. Rampara drew attention after May 21 riots when a patient died in hospital and families could not claim bodies due to contagion risk. Ward conditions are austere: beds and fluids are limited; patients endure severe pain, dehydration, and bleeding in some cases. Ebola-cubes with transparent walls are being rolled out to enable care while preserving family contact; WHO and NGO Alima are engaging communities to counter rumors and expand isolation capacity.

triage.headline_ja: ベルギーの感染症専門医が東コンゴからレポート：『エボラ感染症の流行で大きなパニックや懸念は見られない』
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が確認され、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の臨床的特徴（Bundibugyo変異株、ワクチンなし）、国際拡大リスク（接触追跡の限界）、渡航制限リスクがあり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ流行は東コンゴ（DRC）のBunia及びRamparaを中心としていることが明確。Bangladesh及びRājshāhi Divisionは発生地域に含まれているが、記事本文ではDRCの流行が主題であり、バングラデシュでの発生は報告されていないため除外。Bundibugyo変異株はワクチン未対応、診断キット不足、接触追跡の限界が存在し、公開情報以上の症例数の可能性がある点が懸念される。社会不安（5月21日の暴動）と医療施設の限界的状況が確認されており、WHO及びAlima NGOの支援活動が展開中。

article.articleHeadline: U.s. Warns Europe To Step Up Ebola Screening Ahead Of World Cup
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa prompts the United States to press Europe to tighten screening ahead of the World Cup. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 344 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded with 60 deaths; in neighboring Uganda, 15 confirmed cases and 1 death. The Bundibugjo (Bundibugyo) strain has no vaccine or widely available cure, complicating containment. The United States has issued a 30-day CDC order suspending entry of foreign nationals who have recently traveled through DRC, South Sudan, or Uganda within 21 days of planned U.S. arrival, and visa issuance for such travelers has been paused. Washington urged European capitals to adopt similar travel measures to prevent imported or exported cases as FIFA hosts matches across the United States, Canada, and Mexico; Congo’s World Cup squad is based in Houston. Ongoing surveillance is pressured by funding shifts and reduced WHO support.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ワールドカップ開催に向けてエボラ出血熱スクリーニング強化をヨーロッパに警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の中央アフリカでの複数国での発生（DRC、ウガンダで計359例、61死亡）により、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の懸念が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度と流行しやすさが確認される。国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）での国際的人的移動を通じた伝播リスクが実在する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはHouston、Texas、United States、Canada、Mexicoなど複数国が含まれるが、サマリーの主題は中央アフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ）でのエボラ発生イベントであり、米国・カナダ・メキシコはワールドカップ開催地としての言及のみ。実際の発生は対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。Bundibugyo株のワクチン・治療法不在と資金削減によるWHO支援減少が管理可能性を低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情加速扩散 国际社会加大援助力度
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo accelerates; the international community steps up aid.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Bundibugyo-type Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo accelerates, with 71 new confirmed cases reported in the past 24 hours, raising total to 452 cases and 82 deaths as of June 5, 2026. Of the new cases, 65 are in Ituri Province and 6 in North Kivu, indicating rapid community transmission. The World Health Organization launched a six-month Ebola response plan worth $518 million to coordinate international funding and resources. Africa CDC welcomed Pandemic Fund emergency financing of $220.6 million to support Congo and neighboring Uganda and to bolster regional preparedness. China contributed humanitarian aid and plans to deploy a medical expert group to the DRC. In positive development, the first Ebola-infected patients in this wave have recovered and been discharged from hospital.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情が加速拡散、国際社会が援助力度を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準に4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo型エボラ出血熱の急速な感染拡大（452例、82死亡）、重症度と予想外の加速、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及）、国際支援と渡航制限のリスクを伴う。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの波及言及（neighboring Uganda）がありますが、疫情の主発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは「準備体制強化対象」として触れられているのみです。発生地域リストに226074（Uganda）が含まれていますが、記事の主題はDRCのエボラ疫情拡大であるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めます。中国は援助提供国であり、疫情発生地ではありません。

article.articleHeadline: Mỹ phát cảnh báo mới về dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. issues a new warning about the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: June 5, 2026: CDC warned that without strong interventions the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) could rival West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis, which sickened about 28,000 and killed over 11,000. Responses may need to scale to that level to identify, isolate, and treat more patients; models show four feasible intervention scenarios from 20% to 95% isolation. If isolation remains low and no other measures are taken, there is a 65% chance cases exceed 20,000 within three months. The outbreak was declared May 15 in northeastern DRC, with Bundibugyo, a rare strain likely circulating earlier. WHO data report 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths across three provinces, centered in Ituri (about 90% of cases, 76% of deaths). Uganda reports 16 cases and 1 death; 7 DRC and 2 Ugandan patients have recovered. A funding appeal seeks $518 million over six months from WHO/AFRO and partners.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ出血熱流行に関する新たな警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全てに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行は重大な公衆衛生危機であり、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの確認症例）と国際支援の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUganda（対象国外）およびAngola（対象国外）も含まれているが、記事サマリーによるとウガンダは16症例と1死亡の確認のみで、主流行地はDRCのIturi州である。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。公開日時が2026年という将来日付となっているため、データソースの信頼性確認を推奨。エボラ出血熱は高致命率（CFR約17%）、飛沫感染リスク、医療資源逼迫の危険性から、フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجيل 71 إصابة جديدة بفيروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records 71 new Ebola virus cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 71 new confirmed Ebola cases in the last 24 hours, elevating the total to 452 since the Bundibugyo strain outbreak was declared on May 15. The Ministry of Health documented 82 deaths. The update, issued from Kinshasa, confirms ongoing transmission with laboratory-confirmed infections. The article provides no details on symptoms, transmission chains, or infection sources, and does not mention vaccination campaigns or imported/exported cases. The Bundibugyo strain is identified as a rare Ebola variant, with the outbreak remaining active as of the report date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルスの新規患者71人を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、稀なBundibugyo株による活動中のアウトブレイクである。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当し、迅速なフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 稀なBundibugyo株による急速な症例増加（5月15日以降452例、24時間で71例新規確認）、82人の死亡報告。Kinshasa での活動中の伝播。国際的な公衆衛生の危機として認識される。ワクチン接種キャンペーンや輸入/輸出症例に関する詳細情報が不足しているため、追加情報の収集が重要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجيل 71 إصابة جديدة بفيروس إيبولا - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records 71 new Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, Kinshasa reported 71 new laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in the past 24 hours, increasing the total confirmed infections to 452 since the Bundibugyo strain outbreak was declared on May 15. The death toll reached 82. Data come from the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ministry of Health, reflecting an ongoing outbreak of the rare Bundibugyo lineage of Ebola. No further details on transmission routes, clinical symptoms, or imported/exported cases are provided in the report. The update underscores continued surveillance and daily reporting by national health authorities as the outbreak persists within the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で新たなエボラ出血熱72例を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、致死性の高い感染症の急速な増加を示す明確なシグナル。短期間に確認例が452例に達し死亡者82例、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo系統の希少な株による発生。24時間で71例の新規確認、総数452例、死亡者82例（致死率約18%）。2026年5月15日に宣言された同一アウトブレイク。キンシャサ（DRC首都）での発生確認は国際的波及リスクが特に高い。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: تحذير من مراكز سي دي سي بشأن إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning from CDC Centers regarding Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has escalated to 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths in DRC, with 16 cases including 1 death in neighbouring Uganda; recoveries are 7 in DRC and 2 in Uganda. The outbreak, announced on May 15 in North-East DRC, involves the Bundibugyo strain believed circulating earlier. It has spread across three provinces, with Ituri province as the epicenter, accounting for 90% of confirmed cases and 76% of deaths. The World Health Organization notes the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) killed over 11,000. Warnings that, without strong health interventions, models indicate an outbreak of this size is possible. The CDC’s Friday report outlines scenarios to aid preparedness rather than to incite fear. Authorities urge robust health measures to slow transmission and prevent a larger spread.

triage.headline_ja: CDCセンターからエボラに関する警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行でIHR基準3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）。DRCで381確認例と64死亡、隣国ウガンダでも16例1死亡が報告されており、緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際の発生地域はDRCおよび隣国ウガンダ。Bluedot APIが提示した「発生地域」にはシエラレオネ、リベリア、ギニアが含まれているが、これらは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較参照のみで、現在の発生地ではない。対象国リスト内ではDRC（203312）のみが実際の現在の発生国であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを列挙。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: In a town at the center of eastern Congo's Ebola outbreak, patients arrive too late
article.articleSummary: Mongbwalu, a town in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, is at the center of an Ebola outbreak where patients are arriving too late for treatment. The town has been the hardest hit, yet authorities face intense resistance from residents. A tent Ebola treatment center was burned, and the hospital was attacked when young people demanded the bodies of their kin. The hostility has hampered outbreak response, limiting timely care, containment, and risk communication. No case counts or lab-confirmation details are provided in this report. Published 2026-06-06, the piece highlights the peril of delayed care and community violence in the ongoing Ebola response in eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴのエボラ流行中心地の町で、患者が治療に間に合わない状況
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認事例が報告されており、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高く、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。国際的な公衆衛生懸念がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高致死率の危険な病原体であり、東部DRCでの流行は国際的な懸念事項。記事ではエボラ治療センターの焼却と病院への襲撃による対応の混乱が報告されており、管理可能性に大きな課題あり。具体的な患者数や確認数は記載されていないが、流行の進行中であることは明確。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Records 71 New Ebola Cases
article.articleSummary: On 06 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 71 new confirmed Ebola cases within 24 hours, lifting the total to 452 since the Bundibugyo strain outbreak was declared on 15 May. The Congolese Ministry of Health also recorded 82 deaths. The update confirms ongoing transmission of the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain across the country, with data released from Kinshasa. No further details are provided on affected districts, patient demographics, laboratory confirmation specifics, infection sources, or public health measures. The figures indicate a persistent outbreak requiring continued surveillance and response across affected regions in the DRC. Imported/exported case details are not disclosed in this brief.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国が71件の新規エボラ確認症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例増加（71例/24h、累計452例）、高い致命率（82死亡）、稀なブンディブギョ株の継続的な伝播が確認され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株は稀な亜種であり、進化的監視の観点からも重要。キンシャサでの発生は人口密集地での蔓延リスクを示唆。現在の症例増加速度（71例/24h）と累積死亡数82名は継続的な高度な流行動態を反映。CEPR/EBSのフルRRA実施が緊急に必要。

article.articleHeadline: 孔繁毅稱流感個案呈上升趨勢 籲高危人士盡快接種疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kong Fanyi says influenza cases are on the rise, urging high-risk individuals to get vaccinated as soon as possible.
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, influenza A and influenza B infections are rising in Hong Kong. Professor Kong Fanyi of the University of Hong Kong's Department of Internal Medicine says elderly and child cases are increasing, with Queen Mary Hospital noting more patients in these groups. The trend may reflect a peak not yet reached, but overall influenza activity is up. He explains that previously there were few cases, and population immunity has begun to wane, leading to a higher number of infections in May and June. Vaccination remains urgently recommended, especially for high-risk individuals, with vaccines expiring at the end of June. Unvaccinated people should get immunized promptly, as vaccination can provide protection in the coming months. The public is also advised to maintain good personal hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 孔繁毅稱流感個案呈上升趨勢 籲高危人士盡快接種疫苗
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA・B型の香港での上昇傾向を報告。公衆衛生への影響は軽度～中等度であるが、高危機グループ（高齢者・小児）への流行の兆候があり、情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港での季節性インフルエンザ上昇報告。IHR基準は満たさないが、WPROスクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当。既知の季節パターンであり緊急性は低いが、高齢者・小児への影響が増加している点を注視。ワクチン接種キャンペーンが進行中。国際的拡大リスクは現時点で不明。

article.articleHeadline: Tỷ lệ tử vong tới 90%, Ebola có thể lây khi ngồi gần người nhiễm trên máy bay?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fatality rate up to 90%, could Ebola be transmitted when sitting near an infected person on a plane?
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola virus disease in several African countries raise concern about possible introduction into Vietnam, with the fatality rate reported up to 90%. The article mentions a claim that Ebola could be transmitted by sitting near an infected person on an airplane. Vietnamese infectious-disease experts say the risk of a Covid-19-scale pandemic is very low, advising against panic, while noting vigilance for cross-border importation remains prudent. The report, dated 06/06/2026 08:46 and attributed to Văn Hiền of Nhà báo và Công luận, underscores ongoing Ebola activity in Africa and frames the threat as limited rather than a looming, large-scale outbreak in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率90%まで上昇、エボラ出血熱は飛行機内で感染者の近くに座った場合に感染する可能性があるのか？
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラ出血熱の発生は深刻だが、ベトナムへの導入リスクについては専門家が「パンデミックのリスクは非常に低い」と評価している。検証地域内でのアウトブレイク発生ではなく、報道・啓発記事の性質が強い。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカでのエボラ出血熱発生をベトナム向けメディアが報道したもので、ベトナム国内でのアウトブレイク発生ではない。ベトナムの感染症専門家は『パンデミックリスクは非常に低い』と評価し、越境流入への警戒継続を勧告している。IHR基準3項目該当・WPRO基準3項目該当だが、実際の国内流行ではなく予防的情報提供・啓発の性質であり、情報不足も多いため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Mauritius limits entry of foreigners following Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan prompts Mauritius to impose a temporary entry ban on foreign nationals who traveled to, transited through, or stayed in these countries in the past 21 days. Mauritian citizens and residents with valid work, residence, occupation, business, or student permits may enter but must undergo a mandatory 21-day quarantine if they visited the affected countries in the prior three weeks. Entry screening and risk assessment will be conducted at points of entry; travelers with symptoms will be isolated and clinically assessed. The government also delayed the 18th U.S.-Africa Business Summit, originally planned for July. The Ebola outbreak was declared in the DRC and Uganda on May 15, with the WHO classifying it as a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行を受けてモーリシャスが外国人の入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラは重篤な公衆衛生上の影響があり、複数国での同時流行は異常で、国際的拡大リスクが高く、すでに渡航制限が実施されている。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行を記述しているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれる。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。モーリシャスはアフリカだが対象国リストに含まれない。米国での実際の発症報告は記事中に明示されていないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月15日）により、公衆衛生上の国際的懸念が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 孔繁毅指近日流感個案呈上升趨勢　達高峰否尚待觀察 (09:48) - 20260606
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kong Fan-yi says recent influenza cases are on an upward trend; whether a peak will be reached remains to be seen (09:48) - 20260606.
article.articleSummary: June 6, 2026 — Prof. Kong Fan-yi, head of Infectious Diseases at The University of Hong Kong, says Hong Kong's influenza activity is rising, with both influenza A and B increasing. Influenza A is dominated by H3; infections among children and the elderly have risen, including at St. Mary's Hospital. He attributes this to waning immunity about six months after seasonal vaccination and says whether a peak has been reached remains uncertain. He urges high-risk groups—older adults, residents of elderly care homes, the immunocompromised, and people with chronic diseases—to receive a COVID-19 vaccine every six months, maintain hygiene, wear masks outside, and rest at home when unwell. Health authorities consider SARS-CoV-2 endemic; severe cases decline with waves, but high-risk individuals should vaccinate. Hand-foot-mouth disease activity is up, with 17 outbreaks in the first five days last week, mainly in kindergartens and primary schools; emphasize soap and water, not alcohol sanitizer.

triage.headline_ja: 孔繁毅指近日流感個案呈上升趨勢　達高峰否尚待觀察（香港の流感個案が上昇傾向を示しており、ピークに達しているかは不確定）
triage.triage_reason: 香港における流感（A型・B型）と手足口病の活動が上昇中だが、現時点で重篤な健康影響や国際的な拡大の具体的根拠が不足。情報の進展を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 香港は中国(1814991)に含まれる。複数の呼吸器系感染症（COVID-19, Influenza A/B, Enterovirus 71）の同時検出だが、サマリーでは流感と手足口病の活動上昇が主体。現在のところ死亡や重篤症例の報告は記載されていない。季節性インフルエンザとしての上昇傾向は報告されているが、公衆衛生への深刻な影響の程度は不明。WPRO基準3項目に該当するため、WATCHとして後続情報を監視する。

article.articleHeadline: In Congo 71 nuovi casi di Ebola nelle ultime 24 ore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 71 new Ebola cases in the last 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported 71 new confirmed Ebola cases in the last 24 hours, according to the Congolese Ministry of Health via the Wam agency. The total confirmed cases reach 452 since the outbreak of the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain was declared on 15 May, with 82 deaths to date. The brief provides no geographic breakdown within the country or details on symptoms or transmission sources. All figures are laboratory-confirmed through national surveillance channels, underscoring ongoing transmission of the Bundibugyo strain in the DRC. No information is given on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで24時間以内にエボラの新規症例71件が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の確認された流行で、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株は稀な株であり、5月15日に宣言された流行が継続中。過去24時間の71件の新規症例および累計452確認症例は高い送信速度を示唆している。DRC内での地理的分布情報は記事に記載されていないが、流行が確認地域内で拡大している。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は高い。

article.articleHeadline: In Congo 71 nuovi casi di Ebola nelle ultime 24 ore - Notizie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 71 new Ebola cases in the last 24 hours - News
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 71 new confirmed Ebola cases in the last 24 hours, raising the total to 452 cases since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, linked to the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. The death toll reached 82. Data from the Congolese Ministry of Health, cited by the WAM news agency, confirms ongoing transmission within the country as of June 6, 2026. The report provides no details on clinical symptoms, transmission chains, laboratory confirmation methods beyond the overall case counts, or sources of infection. There is no mention of imported or exported cases. The outbreak remains centered in the DRC; authorities have not disclosed containment measures in this brief update.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで過去24時間に71例の新規エボラ症例 - ニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを伴う。現在進行中の複数地域での伝播を示す452例の流行。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な株）による流行。2026年5月15日に宣言され、6月6日時点で452例、82例の死亡。含有状況に関する詳細情報が不足しており、今後の拡大動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: أميركا تخصص 38 مليون دولار إضافية لمكافحة "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States allocates an additional $38 million to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: US allocates an additional $38 million to Ebola response, bringing total direct funding to over $200 million, as CDC warns the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak could reach the scale of Africa’s 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed more than 11,000, if strong public health measures are not implemented. The funding supports a rapid, comprehensive response in collaboration with CDC, DRC, and Uganda. WHO reports 344 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 60 deaths globally, while the DRC Health Ministry tallies 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths since the outbreak began, including 71 new cases in the last 24 hours (65 in Ituri, 6 in North Kivu); Uganda also has confirmed cases. Americans exposed will be quarantined in Kenya at a facility under construction. WHO and Africa CDC unveiled a six-month, $518 million plan to contain the outbreak and bolster border surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ対策に追加3800万ドルを配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。エボラウイルス病の多国間発生で国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラウイルス病（EVD）がDRC、ウガンダで確認されたことを明確に述べている。DRCはIturi州で71件の新規患者を含む452確認症例を報告。米国、ケニア、ウガンダは対応国として挙げられているが、疾患の原発生地はDRCである。2014-2016年西アフリカエボラ流行（11,000人以上死亡）との比較により、深刻性が強調されている。WHOおよびアフリカCDCによる518百万ドルの6ヶ月計画が発表されており、国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC, WHO announce joint response plan to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Joint response plan by Africa CDC and WHO to counter ongoing Bundiguyo Ebola outbreak in Africa aims to strengthen health systems and cross-border collaboration to slow transmission; notes no vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of May 15, 2026, WHO confirms 381 cases and 64 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and 16 cases with 1 death in Uganda, with earlier estimates of over 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 suspected deaths under discussion. U.S. CDC warns the outbreak could reach tens of thousands of cases if isolation is insufficient (about 20%), while higher isolation (70%) could keep 90-day cases under 10,000 (roughly a 5% risk). The plan seeks $518 million to fund surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and care, clinical services, logistics, and health-system support to prepare for, rapidly detect, and respond to the outbreak, emphasizing cross-border action.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCとWHOがエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへの共同対応計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBVアウトブレイク）は深刻な公衆衛生影響（381確定例、64死亡）、国際的拡大リスク（既にUgandaに波及、数千～数万例の推定リスク）を示しており、迅速なRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、サマリーでは'DRC and Uganda'と記載され両国での発生が明記されている。ただし対象国リストではDRC(203312)のみに該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Uganda(対象外)での16確定例・1死亡も記事で報告されており、国際的波及の証拠となっている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）はワクチン未利用のため、管理が困難であり、518百万ドルの資金動員を要求している。

article.articleHeadline: In Congo 71 nuovi casi di Ebola nelle ultime 24 ore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 71 new Ebola cases in the last 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 71 new confirmed Ebola cases were reported in the last 24 hours, raising Bunia in Ituri province’s outbreak to 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths since the epidemic began. The outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO on 17 May and is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus, for which there are currently no approved specific treatments or vaccines, though clinical candidate vaccines are in development. Three Ebola treatment centers are operating in Bunia with a combined capacity of 80 beds, as health authorities and WHO coordinate the response. The report indicates ongoing transmission and case management challenges in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで過去24時間に71人の新規エボラ患者が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の活発な流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、WHO PHEIC宣言済み、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限リスクを有する。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス流行。過去24時間で71人の新規患者確認、累計452人の確認患者と82人の死亡。治療センターは80床の容量で対応中だが、ケース管理に課題あり。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC, WHO announce joint response plan to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Joint Africa CDC–WHO response plan targets the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundiguyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, aiming to raise $518 million to strengthen health systems, cross-border collaboration, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and care, clinical services, logistics, and maintenance of essential health services to rapidly detect and respond and slow transmission. As of June 5, 2026, DRC reports 381 cases and 64 deaths; Uganda reports 16 cases and 1 death. Earlier estimates of >1,000 suspected cases and ~250 suspected deaths are under discussion, with some officials backing off estimates per BBC reporting. U.S. CDC analysis suggests that without isolating about 20% of infections, the outbreak could exceed 20,000 cases in three months; with 70% isolation, the outbreak may stay under 10,000 cases with a ~5% chance of exceeding that. There is currently no vaccine for Bundiguyo Ebola virus.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC・WHO、エボラ感染症の流行に対する共同対応計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの重大な流行であり、複数国への拡大、国際的支援の必要性が明確。スクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明記されているのはDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダでのエボラ流行。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。米国CDC分析を含む国際的な関心が高く、ワクチン未開発のBundiguyo Ebola virusの新規流行であり、18週間で20,000例超に達する可能性が示唆されている。520百万ドルの資金調達を目指す大規模対応計画が発表されている。

article.articleHeadline: 孔繁毅稱有望本年底針對伊波拉本迪布焦病毒株疫苗面世
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kong Fanyi says there is hope that by the end of this year a vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus will be released
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are experiencing a new round of Ebola outbreaks. Hong Kong’s infectious diseases expert Kong Fanyi, director of the Department of Infectious Diseases, says Hong Kong faces a low infection risk; a vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus is hoped to be released by year end, with antiviral drugs already in clinical trials. The outbreaks in DRC and Uganda underline a 21-day incubation. Hong Kong has no direct flights to the affected countries, and border screening with travel and medical history questionnaires is in place to reduce risk. Early Ebola symptoms mimic common upper respiratory infection (fever, headache); two to three weeks later, severe complications may include multiorgan failure and internal/external bleeding. Citizens are urged to avoid travel to the affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: 孔繁毅稱有望本年底針對伊波拉本迪布焦病毒株疫苗面世
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規アウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）が確認され、IHR基準のうち「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「重症度」に該当。ワクチン開発進捗に関する社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIに含まれている対象国ではないため verified_locations から除外。香港はChina(1814991)に含める。記事はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク、香港でのリスク評価、およびワクチン開発進捗を主題としている。21日間の潜伏期間、致命率の高さ、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性により、全WPROMスクリーニング基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Bangka Perpanjang Status KLB Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangka Extends Malaria Outbreak Status
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreak status extended in Bangka Regency, Belinyu District, Indonesia, after a significant rise in cases. The extraordinary malaria outbreak (KLB) remains in effect, with Pantai Batu Atap and Pantai Bubus beaches identified as epicenters. Latest data show 107 residents confirmed with malaria; some have recovered, others remain under treatment and medical monitoring. To accelerate detection and containment, the Bangka Regency government maintains surveillance posts, screens residents and tin sand miners operating in the affected areas, and tightens mobility checks at entry/exit points around the two beaches. The objective is to interrupt transmission, enable faster treatment, and prevent new cases from spreading to areas outside Belinyu. The decision was announced by Regent Fery Insani on June 5, 2026, and continues through ongoing monitoring of the affected zone.

triage.headline_ja: バンカ地域がマラリア流行状態を延長
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バンカ地域でマラリア流行（KLB）が確認され、感染者107人、複数ビーチが感染源として特定されている。国内における異常・予想外の事象であり、重症度と管理対応の複雑性が認められることからシグナルとしてピックアップ。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、インドネシア・バンカ県ベリニュ地区で確認されたマラリア流行。政府による継続的な監視体制、スクリーニング、入出域管理など対応措置が実施されている。感染者107人、複数治療中とのこと。流行性疾患（WPRO基準5項目全て該当）及びIHR基準2項目以上該当。

article.articleHeadline: 專家指近日流感宗數呈上升趨勢　 是否達高峰程度仍尚待觀察
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts say the number of influenza strains has risen recently; whether it has reached peak levels remains to be seen.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Hong Kong has risen, with children and the elderly more affected and A(H3) as the dominant strain. The rise may reflect waning immunity about six months after the seasonal vaccination program; whether it has peaked remains uncertain. COVID-19 remains endemic globally; waves tend to yield fewer severe cases, and the virus appears weaker. HFMD is more active in Hong Kong, with 17 outbreaks in the first five days of last week, >90% in kindergartens and primary schools. Infected children should rest at home; soap-and-water handwashing is essential, as alcohol sanitizers may not kill the virus. Ebola outbreaks occur every one to two years in Central Africa; transmission is via close contact, often linked to bushmeat. Hong Kong has no direct flights there; risk is low, but travel avoidance is advised.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家は最近のインフルエンザ症例数が上昇傾向を示していると指摘　ピーク水準に達したかどうかはまだ観察が必要
triage.triage_reason: 複数の疾患（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、HFMD、エボラ）が言及されているが、香港でのインフルエンザ活動上昇は季節的変動の範囲内、中央アフリカのエボラは香港との接続性が低く、直接的な国際的緊急性は限定的と判断。情報不足を含め経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は香港でのインフルエンザ活動上昇（季節的）と、中央アフリカでの周期的なエボラ発生を言及しているが、香港は中国に含める。中央アフリカは対象国でないため除外。COVID-19とHFMDも言及されているが、香港での地域レベルの活動であり、IHRまたはWPRO基準2つ以上の明確な該当なし。社会的関心はあるが、既知の季節的パターン。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫与非疾控启动超5亿美元埃博拉疫情防控计划
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and non-CDC launch over $500 million Ebola outbreak prevention and control plan.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC launched a $518 million Ebola outbreak prevention and control plan to address Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The funding, planned for June–November 2026, aims to help African nations prevent, prepare, rapidly detect, and respond to the epidemic, with coordinated actions across governments, partners, and communities. The program covers emergency coordination, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, research, and logistics to strengthen outbreak readiness. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya emphasized a unified continental response to save lives and support affected countries and neighboring regions. As of June 3, 2026, 34 frontline health workers have been infected, including 7 deaths and 6 recoveries.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDCが5億ドル超のエボラ出血熱流行防止対策計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス属）のアウトブレイク、死亡例あり、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、貿易・渡航制限の可能性が高い。WHOとアフリカCDCが5億ドル超の大規模対応計画を立案しており、公開情報として既に国際的に広がっている段階。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでBundibugyo ebolavirus（希少型）のアウトブレイクが明記されており、DRCで確認。Ugandaが発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、サマリー上では「DRCとUganda」との表記にとどまり、Ugandaでの具体的な症例記述がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。ただしWHO/Africa CDCの公式発表による大規模対応計画であり、複数国への波及を想定した対応と判断。ウイルス性出血熱の中でもエボラは最高リスク病原体であり、即座にフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO launches US$518m plan to contain major Ebola outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo (Bundibugyo strain) escalates: 71 new confirmed cases in 24 hours, mostly in Ituri province (65 cases) with 6 more in North Kivu; spreads across 17 of Ituri's 36 health zones, plus zones in North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda reports transmission. Testing delays due to defective Bundibugyo detection, leading to delayed confirmation and isolation. Public mistrust and attacks on burial teams and treatment centres hinder response. WHO has received three armored vehicles from the UN peacekeeping mission to assist operations in high-risk areas. The WHO/Africa CDC's US$518 million emergency plan aims to contain the outbreak and prevent wider regional or global spread, with donors pledging US$315.8 million so far, short of needs. Cross-border spread to Central and East Africa is a concern.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが、アフリカの大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク封じ込めために5億1800万米ドルの計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク、急速な症例増加（24時間で71例）、複数国への越境拡大、医療体制への攻撃による対応困難、WHOが5億ドル規模の緊急計画を発動しており、国際的対応が必要な急性危機。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの伝播も言及されているが、具体的な症例報告がないため verified_locations には含めない。南スーダンなども越境拡大リスクとして懸念されているが、確認された発生は DRC のみ。エボラ Bundibugyo 株は比較的稀であり、検査機器の障害による遅延確認が悪化要因。社会不信による埋葬チームへの攻撃は対応の重大な阻害要因。WHO と Africa CDC による国際的対応枠組みが既に構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's confirmed Ebola cases rise to 452, with 82 deaths: Govt
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths as of 6 June 2026, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. Ituri and North Kivu provinces recorded 71 new confirmed cases on 4 June, including 21 deaths, indicating ongoing community transmission. A total of 258 patients are in isolation or hospital care; eight have recovered. Contact tracing is lagging: 4,766 contacts under follow-up, 2,755 seen (57.8%). Response gaps include resistance to post-mortem swabbing, limited treatment capacity, weak contact tracing, medicine shortages, inadequate infection-prevention supplies in North Kivu, and a $21.5 million funding shortfall. Uganda added three new cases (cumulative 19). Africa CDC and WHO launched a $518 million continental Ebola preparedness plan for June–November to help countries detect and respond to Bundibugyo-related outbreaks. Twenty-four health workers have been infected (note: 34 reported earlier) with 7 deaths and 6 recoveries. Major operational challenges include lack of strain-specific countermeasures and weak health systems.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定症例が452件に増加、82人の死亡：政府発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つすべて該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。また複数のWPRO基準も満たし、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ確定症例452件、死亡82人を主題としており、ウガンダでの3例の新規症例も記述されているがウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。Bundibugyo株による流行、コミュニティ伝播の継続、重大な対応ギャップ（接触者追跡の遅れ、治療能力不足、資金不足など）が明記されており、国際的な協力体制（Africa CDC、WHO）が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: نماذج عدة ممكنة لتطوره.. تحذير من احتمال تفشي إيبولا على نطاق واسع | التلفزيون العربي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Several possible models for its progression... Warning of the possibility of an Ebola outbreak on a large scale | Al Arabiya TV
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri and spilling from North Kivu in the east, risks reaching the scale seen in 2014–2016 West Africa if actions to slow transmission are not taken. The CDC warned that, without strong interventions, an outbreak of this size is possible. WHO data show 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths in the DRC, with 16 cases and 1 death in Uganda; recoveries include 7 in the DRC and 2 in Uganda. The spread involves the Bundibugyo strain; Ituri accounts for about 90% of confirmed cases and 76% of deaths. The outbreak was first announced on May 15 in northern DRC. WHO previously declared this Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though it did not meet all criteria; Tedros emphasized that, despite no licensed vaccine or treatment, good clinical care offers some hope.

triage.headline_ja: 複数の想定される進展パターン…エボラの大規模流行の可能性について警告 | アルアラビーヤTV
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のDRC（対象国）での確認事例と死亡者、ウガンダへの波及が報告されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO公衆衛生上の国際的関心事態宣言済みであり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのIturi州での主要な流行、ウガンダへの波及、Bundibugyo株による感染を報告。WHOは既に公衆衛生上の国際的関心事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。対象国リストではDRC(203312)のみが主題として確認される。アンゴラはBluedot APIが付与した地域だが、サマリー内では言及されていないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Κίνδυνος μεγαλύτερης κρίσης από το 2014
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DR Congo: Risk of a bigger crisis than in 2014.
article.articleSummary: CDC warns that, without urgent decisive action, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) could reach dimensions comparable to or exceeding the 2014–2016 West Africa crisis. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is neither approved specific therapy nor vaccine, underpins this outbreak declared on May 15 in northeastern DRC—the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country. WHO notes 381 laboratory-confirmed cases in DRC with 64 deaths; Uganda reports 16 cases and 1 death, with seven recoveries in DRC and two in Uganda. Ebola has caused at least 15,000 African deaths over five decades, with fatality rates from 25% to 90%. The most deadly DRC outbreak occurred 2018–2020 (≈2,300 deaths, ~3,500 cases). CDC models, based on infections and isolations, indicate worst-case scenarios for rapid, strong public health response to prevent further spread into the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱：2014年よりも大きな危機のリスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（致死率25-90%、過去に15,000人以上の死亡）、予想外の高致死株の出現、国際的拡大のリスク（ウガンダでの確認、西アフリカ2014-2016年危機との比較言及）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）も記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事の主要な主題はDRCでのエボラ発生。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法がない新興リスク。CDCの警告により国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Arua wants special Ebola response fund
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, Arua City Ebola Taskforce seeks more than Sh220 million to strengthen its response to the Ebola outbreak, citing shortages in transport, PPEs, and welfare support for frontline health workers and suspected Ebola patients in isolation. At Task Force meeting, officials warned that response efforts are hampered by funding delays and limited external support. Martin Oyoku, Head of Case Management at Oli Health Centre IV, said teams have operated for three weeks without dedicated funding. Alfred Driwale, Commissioner of Health Services for Institutional and Human Resources Development at the Ministry of Health, acknowledged funding challenges but urged local governments to maximize available resources as the ministry mobilises additional support. Gaps include inadequate PPEs for surveillance teams, limited diagnostic and sample collection materials, and lack of transport to investigate alerts. Officials also flagged limited cross-border coordination with the Democratic Republic of Congo, despite Arua’s proximity to border.

triage.headline_ja: Arua wants special Ebola response fund（アルアが特別なエボラ対応資金を要望）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外のイベント、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。DRCとの国境地域での発生であり、越境リスクが明示されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダ北部（Arua市）でのエボラ発生で、DRCとの国境地域での越境感染リスクが明示されている。資金不足による対応能力の低下、PPE不足、診断材料不足などの管理可能性の課題が報告されており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Triệu chứng ban đầu khi mắc Ebola dễ nhầm với các bệnh do virus khác
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early symptoms of Ebola infection are easily mistaken for other viral infections.
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains a low risk for Vietnam, which has had no cases amid a current Africa outbreak. The virus spreads only through direct contact with bodily fluids of a symptomatic patient and is not airborne, with transmission unlikely in public spaces unless fluids are involved. Vietnam maintains strict border surveillance and emphasizes that people incubating the disease without symptoms are not contagious. Early Ebola symptoms mimic common viral infections, including fever, headache, myalgia, fatigue, and sore throat; progression can include vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, bleeding. A key diagnostic trigger is recent travel to an Ebola-affected area within 21 days; travelers with such exposure should seek medical care and disclose travel history. Early detection, isolation, and infection-control measures in hospitals are critical to prevent spread. The article raises questions about vaccines/treatment, but provides no confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染の初期症状は他のウイルス感染症と混同しやすい
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムではエボラ感染者がなく、記事はアフリカでの発生に対する一般的な啓発・教育内容であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはVietnamが含まれているが、記事サマリーを精査するとベトナムでの実際のエボラ発生は報告されていない。記事の主題はアフリカでの感染症発生に対するベトナムの一般向け啓発・教育であり、感染症イベントの発生を示すものではない。対象国リストに含まれるVietnamであっても、実際の発生地として検証されないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: CEbola có thể bị nhầm với sốt xuất huyết, cúm: Chuyên gia cảnh báo dấu hiệu cần lưu ý
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola can be mistaken for dengue fever and flu: experts warn of signs to watch out for.
article.articleSummary: Ebola can mimic dengue fever and influenza; initial symptoms include high fever, headache, fatigue, diarrhea, and muscle pain, with progression to vomiting, abdominal pain, rash, and bleeding. Because symptoms overlap with many infections, epidemiologic history—particularly travel from Ebola-affected regions within the past 21 days—is critical for detection. Vietnam currently has very low risk and has not recorded any Ebola cases; surveillance at international borders helps flag suspects. Ebola spreads only through direct contact with blood or body fluids of symptomatic patients, not via air. Incubation-stage individuals are not infectious. Early detection, isolation, and strict infection control are essential to prevent spread. Hospitals in Vietnam, including Bach Mai and the National Institute of Infectious Diseases, are conducting drills and applying the “2-5-30” protocol: 2 minutes for symptom and travel screening, 5 minutes to isolate, 30 minutes to activate full response. Vaccines and monoclonal antibody therapies exist and improve outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱はデング熱とインフルエンザと誤認される可能性がある：専門家が注視すべき兆候を警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるエボラ出血熱の啓発・準備状況についての記事であり、現在の実際の発生報告はない。ただしエボラ、デング熱、インフルエンザの複合言及とベトナムの国境監視強化により、監視対象として継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のエボラ発生ではなく、ベトナムにおけるエボラ対策の啓発・準備に関する内容。記事サマリーで「ベトナムは現在非常にリスクが低く、エボラ症例を記録していない」と明示されている。ただし、複数の危険度の高い感染症（エボラ、デング熱、インフルエンザ）への言及、国際国境での監視強化、医療機関での対応訓練実施が報告されているため、WPROスクリーニング基準で「epidemic_prone」および「manageability」に該当する。現時点では公式発生報告がないため「PICKUP」には至らず、継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ запускает программу на $518 млн для борьбы со вспышкой Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO launches a $518 million program to combat the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization (WHO) and Africa CDC launched a six‑month, $518 million plan to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with preparations for neighboring states. The outbreak is the fourth‑largest on record, with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in DR Congo and 19 cases with 2 deaths in Uganda. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, and diagnostic challenges persist, as tests do not always detect this strain promptly and results can take days to a week. The plan emphasizes strengthened border health controls, expanded testing, and readiness of medical services. Donors had pledged about $315.8 million by early June, well short of the required funding; WHO had previously labeled the crisis and sought $115 million for the next three months.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが5億1800万ドルの計画を立ち上げてエボラウイルス感染症の流行に対抗
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は公衆衛生上の影響が極めて重大で、国際的拡大リスクがあり、国際的対応が既に動員されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC（対象国）での主要な感染流行が確認される（452確診例、82死亡例）。ウガンダも記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo ebolavirus株、診断困難性、国境を越えた準備検討など重大なリスク要因が複数存在。WHOが既に大規模国際対応計画を発動している極めて高優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: DR Congo Reports 452 Confirmed Cases and 82 Deaths Amid Rapid Community Transmission
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths as of the ministry report. On June 4, 71 new cases and 21 deaths were recorded in Ituri and North Kivu, signaling rapid community transmission of the Bundibugyo strain. About 258 patients are in isolation or hospital care; eight have recovered. Contact tracing remains weak: of 4,766 contacts under follow-up across three provinces, 2,755 have been seen (follow-up rate 57.8%). Major challenges include resistance to post-mortem swabbing, insufficient standardized treatment capacity, shortages of essential medicines, inadequate infection-prevention supplies in North Kivu, poor alert reporting, and a funding gap of $21.5 million. Uganda reports three additional Ebola cases (cumulative 19). Africa CDC and WHO launched a continental preparedness and response plan to raise $518 million for June–November. To date, 34 health workers are infected (7 deaths, 6 recovered).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生：コンゴ民主共和国が452例の確定患者と82人の死亡を報告、急速なコミュニティ伝播の中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：エボラウイルスは高い死亡率と重篤性（深刻な公衆衛生影響）、急速なコミュニティ伝播は異常・予期しない状況、ウガンダでの症例報告と弱い接触者追跡から国際的拡大リスク高、渡航・貿易制限のリスク。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告（19例累計）があるが、記事の主題はDRC発生のエボラ出血熱であり、DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo strain による急速なコミュニティ伝播、弱い接触者追跡（57.8%のみ確認）、医療従事者の感染（34名中7名死亡）、$21.5百万の資金ギャップなど、複数の管理可能性の課題が存在。Africa CDC と WHO が $518 million の対応計画を立案。

article.articleHeadline: 孔繁毅指流感宗數呈上升　未確定是否到達高峰 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kong Fanyi says the number of influenza cases is on the rise; it has not yet been confirmed whether a peak has been reached | am730
article.articleSummary: 6 June 2026, Hong Kong: influenza cases are rising, with children and the elderly most affected; influenza A, mainly H3, is circulating. Peak timing remains unconfirmed. Vaccination began about six months ago, and immunity is waning; unvaccinated high-risk individuals are urged to vaccinate. COVID-19 is considered endemic; each wave has a lower share of severe cases as the virus weakens. High-risk groups should receive vaccination every six months; there has been no major outbreak for a year, and Omicron BA.2 remains common, with overall immunity keeping infections milder than influenza. Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) is rising, with 17 outbreaks in the first five days of last week, mostly in kindergartens and primary schools; children are most affected and usually recover within a week. Africa continues to experience sporadic Ebola outbreaks in Central and West Africa; transmission is low, and there are no direct Hong Kong flights, keeping local risk minimal.

triage.headline_ja: 孔繁毅が流感の症例数が増加していることを指摘。ピークに達したかどうかはまだ確定していない
triage.triage_reason: 複数の疾患が言及されているが、主題はインフルエンザの季節的上昇であり、現在のところ重度の患者数や死亡報告は記載されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザの季節的上昇がホンコンで発生していることを主題としている。複数の疾患（インフルエンザA H3、COVID-19、手足口病、エボラ）が提及されているが、エボラについてはアフリカでのスポラディック発生であり、ホンコンへの直接リスクは最小限と述べられている。重症度や死亡例に関する具体的情報が記事サマリーに含まれていないため、スクリーニング基準での確実な評価が困難。香港の記事であるため中国（GeoNames ID 1814991）を verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Αυξάνονται τα κρούσματα του ιού Έμπολα στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus cases are increasing in Congo
article.articleSummary: June 6, 2026 — Ebola virus disease outbreaks are escalating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Government data show 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths to date, with 71 new cases confirmed in the last 24 hours. The ongoing transmission pattern is underscored by these figures. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention warns that, in the absence of robust interventions, the Congo Ebola outbreak could reach dimensions similar to or larger than the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016. This underscores the need for immediate public health action. The report does not specify infection sources or any imported/exported case details.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの感染者がコンゴで増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な感染拡大は最優先度のシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にUSAとAngolaを含めているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC内のエボラ流行である。DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。452確定症例、82死亡、直近24時間で71新規患者という急速な感染拡大が確認されており、CDCは2014-2016西アフリカ流行規模の警告を発出している。緊急性極高。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en África podría sumar 20,000 casos sin fuertes medidas sanitarias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa could reach 20,000 cases without strong sanitary measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could reach 20,000+ cases unless infected people are rapidly isolated to curb transmission, according to CDC modeling. Scenarios span about 10,000 to over 20,000 cases, with the worst-case approaching the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (over 11,000 deaths, ~28,000 cases). As of late May, roughly 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths have been reported, with many infections likely undiagnosed. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are no specific treatments or vaccines. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May. Violence and displacement in DR Congo, from M23 rebels and Allied Democratic Forces (an ISIS affiliate), complicate the response. U.S. travel bans apply to visitors who have been in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days, with health screening at four airports. If about 50 deaths and ~20% isolation by late May, most models project ≥20,000 cases and ~4,000 deaths in three months; higher isolation could push cases toward ~10,000, though higher deaths could worsen outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ出血熱流行は強力な衛生対策がなければ20,000件の症例に達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施済み）。WHO PHEIC宣言、大規模流行シナリオ、複数国での感染確認がある。
triage.notes: 記事は主にコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ流行を中心に論じており、ウガンダや南スーダンへの拡大リスク言及や米国の渡航禁止も言及されているが、検証可能な実際の発生地はDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo ebolavirus、高い死亡率、治療法・ワクチンなし、治安悪化（M23反乱軍など）による対応困難など、重大な懸念要因が多数存在。

article.articleHeadline: Dvojica istraživača optužena su za navodni pokušaj krijumčarenja virusa mpoxa kroz zračnu luku Detroit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two researchers have been charged in connection with an alleged attempt to smuggle the monkeypox virus through Detroit's airport.
article.articleSummary: Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, scientists at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Montana, have been charged by U.S. federal prosecutors with attempting to smuggle vials containing deactivated monkeypox virus (mpox) into the United States. The duo were detained at Detroit Metropolitan Airport after returning from a research trip to the Republic of the Congo. The indictment alleges they carried the samples without the necessary approvals and in violation of customs procedures. Although the virus in the samples was inactive, authorities stress that strict rules govern the transfer of biological materials across borders. The FBI led the investigation, with participation from HHS-OIG. Special Agent Marcus L. Sykes underscored that deliberate attempts to conceal and smuggle biological materials jeopardize public trust. The scientists are due to appear in federal court in Montana, facing up to five years in prison if convicted.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の研究者がデトロイト空港を通じた猿痘ウイルス密輸の疑いで起訴
triage.triage_reason: 本件は密輸事件であり、実際の感染症の流行・集団発生ではない。ウイルスは不活性化され、公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威は存在しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は犯罪事件（生物学的物質の違法な密輸）に関するもので、感染症の流行・集団発生ではない。DRCは記事内で研究出張先として言及されているが、感染症イベントの発生地ではなく、事件の背景情報に過ぎない。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Update Ebola 2026: Mengenal Gejala dan Langkah Pencegahan yang Perlu Diketahui
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Update 2026: Understanding the Symptoms and Preventive Measures You Should Know.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Update 2026 reports outbreaks of Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Ebola, caused by viruses in the Orthoebolavirus group, is a severe disease with about 50% case fatality, though rates vary by outbreak. It spills over from wildlife—fruit bats, primates—to humans, after which human-to-human transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; people are not contagious before symptoms. By early June 2026, hundreds of cases and dozens of deaths have been reported in DRC and Uganda. There are no licensed vaccines or specific treatments approved for the Bundibugyo strain. WHO and local governments are expanding contact tracing, laboratory testing, and community education. Prevention centers on avoiding contact with sources of infection; WHO recommends steps including contact tracing, lab testing, and public education.

triage.headline_ja: Ebola Update 2026: 症状と実施すべき予防措置を理解する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言したEbola (Bundibugyo strain)の多国間アウトブレイク。数百例の症例と数十人の死亡が報告されており、ヒト-ヒト感染が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとUgandaでのアウトブレイクが報告されているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、50%程度の致命率、ワクチン・特異的治療がない状況、複数国での確認、ヒト-ヒト感染の確認など、複数の重大なシグナルが存在。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉疫情或以史上最大规模爆发　美国疾控中心促加强干预
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak could become the largest in history; U.S. CDC urges stronger interventions.
article.articleSummary: US CDC urges stronger public-health interventions to curb the Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda, warning it could rival the 2014–2016 West Africa crisis, which infected over 28,000 and killed more than 11,000. Current data show 381 confirmed DR Congo cases and 64 deaths across three provinces, centered in Ituri Province (about 90% of cases, 76% of deaths). Uganda reports 16 cases and 1 death; seven DR Congo patients and two Ugandan patients have recovered. The outbreak was declared in mid-May in the northeast and involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus. WHO and the African Union estimate US$518 million needed over the next six months to fight the outbreak in DRC and its neighbors. CDC models include four intervention scenarios (isolation and treatment 20–95%); at a low isolation level with no other measures, there is a 65% chance of exceeding 20,000 cases in three months. The models are tools to guide action, not predictions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が過去最大規模の可能性；米国CDCが強化された対策を促促
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（381確認症例、死亡率高）、異常/予想外な大規模流行、複数国への国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、国際支援が急務（5.18億米ドル必要）。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行について述べているが、対象国リストはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国は検査室やCDC本部の言及であり、実際の流行地ではないため除外。2014-2016年西アフリカ危機との比較、モデリング結果（低隔離シナリオで3ヶ月以内に20,000症例超の65%確率）から緊急対応の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا تخصص 38 مليون دولار إضافية لمكافحة فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States allocates an additional $38 million to combat the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: United States allocates an additional $38 million to Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo, bringing total direct funding to over $200 million. The World Health Organization reports 344 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths in the current DRC outbreak. The U.S. says the funds support a rapid, comprehensive response and is coordinating with the CDC, DRC authorities, and Uganda; spending details were not disclosed. The CDC warns that, without strong public health measures, this outbreak could rival or surpass the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016. Some Americans exposed to Ebola will be quarantined in Kenya at a facility under construction. This evolving situation highlights ongoing international efforts to contain Ebola transmission in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラウイルス対策に追加38百万ドルを配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。エボラは極めて高い重症度（致死率高い）と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはAngola、Kenya、Ugandaも列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのエボラ発生と米国の資金提供。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ケニアでの隔離施設言及は米国からの曝露者管理であり、ケニアでのアウトブレイク発生ではないため除外。344確認症例、60死亡という具体的データあり、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行規模のリスク言及あり。極めて高いリスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: Public urged to get jabs as flu cases spike
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases are rising in Hong Kong, with both influenza A (H3) and influenza B circulating. A 17-year-old with severe influenza B developed pneumonia and shock and is in critical condition; he was unvaccinated. Hospitals report increased flu admissions among children and the elderly. Experts say the surge may not have peaked yet, and the current vaccine batch expires at the end of June 2026, urging unvaccinated individuals to get jabs before then. The elderly with chronic diseases are advised to wear masks in crowded places and use hand sanitizers. Covid-19 remains endemic and generally mild, with the latest NB.1.8.1 variant being close to the LP.8.1 vaccine candidate; overall, few severe Covid-19 cases are reported. Vulnerable groups should vaccinate regularly, noting the next influenza batch arrives in Q4 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザの症例が急増する中、市民にワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 香港および中国におけるインフルエンザA/B症例の上昇が報告され、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常・予想外」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、現在のところ情報が限定的であり、国際的拡大やIHR基準2つ以上の該当が確認されないため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は香港のインフルエンザ症例上昇であるが、対象国リストに「香港Special Administrative Region」は明示されていないため、China(1814991)に含めて検証。IHR基準は4つ中2つ該当、WPRO基準は5つ中4つ該当するシグナル特性を示す。ただし現段階では地域限定的であり、国際的拡大リスク情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定として続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تحذر من انتشار سريع لإيبولا وتؤكد تسجيل 71 إصابة جديدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo warns of rapid Ebola spread and confirms 71 new cases.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo confirms 71 new Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) cases in 24 hours, taking the total confirmed to 452 and deaths to 82 since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Infections are concentrated in Ituri province in the northeast (65 cases) and North Kivu (6), the largest daily tally of this wave and the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in Congo’s history. Uganda has confirmed cases as well. The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus unveiled a six-month, $518 million plan to fight Ebola, calling for funding and political commitment. The plan, developed with Africa CDC, aims to help DR Congo and Uganda contain the outbreak and boost preparedness elsewhere through enhanced surveillance and border testing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラの急速な拡大を警告し、71件の新規感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大と多国間での確認事例により、国際的健康上の脅威として認識される。WHOも$518百万の対応計画を発表しており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の急速な拡大。24時間で71件の新規確認、累計452件確認、死亡82件。Ituri州に集中（65件）。ウガンダでも確認されているが、記事の主要対象国はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO総長が6ヶ月間$518百万の対応計画を発表。

article.articleHeadline: US Adds $38 Million to Ebola Response as CDC Says Outbreak 'Largest on Record'
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda escalates to the largest on record. As of June 4, DRC reports 452 cases and 82 deaths; Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths (plus 1 probable case and 1 probable death) by June 5. The Bundibugyo virus, one of four orthoebolaviruses, has no vaccine and treatment remains supportive; common symptoms include fever, severe headache, vomiting, extreme weakness, abdominal pain, nosebleeds, and vomiting blood. The outbreak was first detected among healthcare workers. The United States has added $38 million to Ebola response, bringing total direct funding to over $200 million. CDC projects could exceed 20,000 cases in three months if only about 20% of cases isolate within two days; longer scenarios exist. On May 18, travel screening and entry restrictions were imposed, rerouting air travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan to four airports (IAD, ATL, IAH, JFK). No U.S. cases have been confirmed, and the exposed American healthcare worker treated in Germany remains stable; high-risk contacts relocated and asymptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ対応に3,800万ドル追加 CDCが「過去最大の集団発生」と発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスによる過去最大規模の集団発生で、複数国での急速な感染拡大、米国を含む国際的スクリーニング導入、WHOが深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念を表明する状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、米国、ドイツ）での状況を記載しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダ、南スーダン、米国、ドイツは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。過去最大規模の集団発生、ワクチンなし、3ヶ月で20,000例超の予測、国際的な渡航制限実施など極めて深刻な状況を示唆。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）の実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）伊波拉疫情扩散 累计确诊增至452起
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo spreads; total confirmed cases rise to 452.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the current Ebola outbreak has reached 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths as of June 4. Ituri and North Kivu provinces reported 71 new confirmed cases on June 4, indicating ongoing community transmission. A total of 258 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, with 8 recoveries. Response efforts face multiple challenges: some communities are not cooperating with sampling of the deceased, treatment centers lack standardized capacity, contact tracing coverage is low, medicines and protective gear are in short supply, and funding gaps persist. On June 5, the World Health Organization and Africa CDC announced a joint USD 518 million Ebola outbreak containment plan to address cases in the DRC and Uganda. Uganda’s health ministry reported 3 new confirmed Ebola cases on June 5, bringing its total to 19 with 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情が拡散 累計確診者数が452件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスは重篤な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、DRC・ウガンダでの継続的な感染確認は異常・予想外、国境を越えた拡大リスクと国際的関心の高まりを示唆している。WHO・Africa CDCの合同対応計画発表も確認された。
