triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告（3件、累計19件）も記事に記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ疫情の拡散であり、対象国内での最重要シグナルと判断。全IHR基準・全WPRO基準に該当し、WHO・Africa CDCによる国際的対応計画の発表が確認されたため、直ちにRRA進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática do Congo registra aumento de casos de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records an increase in Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: 71 new Ebola infections were confirmed in the last 24 hours in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, signaling a surge in the current outbreak. In response, the World Health Organization and the African Union unveiled a robust funding plan, allocating 2.6 billion Brazilian reais to intensify control and care efforts. The funds aim to strengthen preventive measures and treatment for those infected in the affected region, and to upgrade local infrastructure to better manage health emergencies. International collaboration is emphasized as crucial to curb the spread of the deadly Ebola virus, with actions extending beyond financial aid to include logistics and technical support for frontline responders working to contain the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ感染の増加を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラは高リスク病原体であり、IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響（4基準中最低3つ該当）と国際的拡大リスクが明確。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性が該当。国際機関（WHO・アフリカ連合）の資金支援と技術支援により国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した『発生地域』にはブラジルが含まれているが、記事サマリーの本題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染増加であり、ブラジルは資金提供（2.6ビリオンブラジルレアイの言及）の文脈にのみ登場。実際の感染イベント発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。24時間で71件の新規感染という具体的数値があり、WHO・アフリカ連合による支援計画が展開されている。高優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Violence Hits Ebola Fight, UN Warns
article.articleSummary: Violence in eastern DR Congo amid an Ebola outbreak: at least 24 civilians were killed in Beni territory, North Kivu, on Tuesday night, prompting fresh displacement. In Masisi, heavy clashes on Wednesday forced more residents to flee, bringing total displacement to about 270,000 as of May. Renewed fighting has restricted humanitarian access in North Kivu and South Kivu, including hostilities in Fizi and Mwenga that involved drones. The UN warns such insecurity could hinder the Ebola response, with Ebola cases reported in North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Since April, partners have provided cash assistance to more than 8,000 people in Beni. The UN calls on all parties to respect international humanitarian law and ensure unimpeded, safe, and sustained humanitarian access.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の暴力がエボラ対策に影響、国連が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。進行中のエボラアウトブレイクと著しい治安悪化により人道支援アクセスが制限され、対応能力に大きな影響が生じている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラアウトブレイク対応中のコンゴ民主共和国（North Kivu、South Kivu州）における暴力激化を主題としている。Bluedot APIが付与した「Fiji」は記事内容と無関係と判断され、verified_locationsから除外した。進行中のエボラ感染の報告と260,000人以上の新規避難民発生により、IHRおよびWPRO両基準で最大評価を示す。国連による国際支援要請と人道アクセス制限のリスク表示から、社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Les As de l'info | L'Ebola sous surveillance en Afrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Aces of the News | Ebola Under Surveillance in Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on May 15, the 17th outbreak in the country, with at least 344 people infected and 60 deaths. In neighboring Uganda, 15 people have tested positive. The region remains under close surveillance as health teams from the World Health Organization work to reach affected areas, hampered by distance, ongoing armed conflict, refugee-camp conditions, and distrust of outsiders. There is no cure; scientists are pursuing a vaccine. Preventive measures emphasize frequent handwashing and avoiding contact with infected individuals. Unlike COVID-19, Ebola cases are typically symptomatic while contagious, aiding containment. Canada is not at risk, but has precautionary measures: travelers arriving from affected countries must self-isolate for 21 days on return. The report underscores ongoing challenges in outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース速報 | アフリカでエボラ熱が監視下に置かれている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な出来事、国際的な懸念あり）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、管理可能性）。コンゴ民主共和国での確認された流行と隣国ウガンダへの拡大により、シグナルとして識別。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: カナダは発生地域として記載されているが、サマリーで「カナダはリスクにない」と明記されており、予防措置の対象国として言及されているのみのため verified_locations から除外。コンゴ民主共和国での17番目のエボラ流行宣言（5月15日）、少なくとも344人感染・60人死亡、ウガンダで15人の陽性確認が記載されている。WHO支援が進行中だが、紛争・難民キャンプ・信頼欠如などにより対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: 米CDC、エボラ出血熱大流行の可能性に危機感示す 隔離・治療レベルが「不十分」なら
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. CDC warns of the potential for a large Ebola virus disease outbreak if isolation and treatment levels are deemed insufficient.
article.articleSummary: CDC warns that without strong public health interventions, an Ebola virus disease outbreak could reach the scale of West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic, which involved more than 28,000 cases and about 11,000 deaths. The projection, published in the MMWR on June 5, is a planning tool, not a forecast, says Jason Asher, director of CDC’s Center for Forecasting and Outbreak Analytics. It models four intervention scenarios with isolation effectiveness ranging from 20% to 95%. If isolation remains inadequate and no other measures are implemented, there is a 65% chance of surpassing 20,000 cases within three months. Satish Pillai, CDC Ebola response manager, notes the total number needing isolation remains opaque and current isolation levels appear low. WHO and Africa CDC on June 6 call for about $518 million over six months to combat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and surrounding countries.

triage.headline_ja: 米CDC、エボラ出血熱大流行の可能性に危機感示す 隔離・治療レベルが「不十分」なら
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は既に発生中であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。国際的な懸念と大規模流行リスクがあり、WHOおよびアフリカCDCが国際支援を要請している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはAngolaも含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCおよび周辺国でのエボラ発生であり、Angolaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外した。CDCとWHOがともに国際的警告と資金支援要請を行っており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo and Uganda report 263 confirmed Ebola cases with 43 deaths | Honolulu Star-Advertiser
article.articleSummary: 263 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with 43 deaths, as of May 30, due to the Bundibugyo virus strain. Over 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation; Bunia in Ituri province, DRC, is among response hubs. This outbreak marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the third-largest since Ebola’s discovery about half a century ago. Health workers report undetected spread for weeks and shortages of basic supplies such as masks. The situation is outpacing the global response. Authorities urge rapid activation of national incident systems and permanent investment in pandemic preparedness. International partners are essential but most effective when aligned with strategies developed by African institutions and governments.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダがエボラウイルス263確定症例と43人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生で、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダの複数国発生）、渡航制限のリスクが明白。即座にフルRRAを実施すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ集団発生。ウガンダはスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。263確定症例、43死亡、1,100以上の疑い例が在来中。Bundibugyo株。グローバル対応能力を超える規模と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spread in central Africa could match 2014 record outbreak, US health officials say
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Central Africa) could reach scales similar to West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (28,000+ cases; >11,000 deaths). CDC modelling as of 2026-06-06 spans scenarios from about 10,000 up to more than 20,000 cases, depending on how quickly infected people are identified and isolated. Current reporting includes about 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths; many infections likely undiagnosed. Transmission occurs via contact with body fluids (vomit, blood, semen). No specific treatments or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo virus. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a global health emergency in May; violence in Congo—armed conflict with M23 rebels and ISIS-affiliated ADF—has driven displacement and hampered response. Higher isolation rates (50–70%) could push cases toward 10,000, but if deaths were larger than late May, outcomes could worsen. Some infections may have begun in February with initial tests targeting a different Ebola virus.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱感染拡大、2014年の記録的流行と同規模に達する可能性があると米保健当局が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当する。既にWHOが5月に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言しており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo エボラウイルスアウトブレイク。記事は2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行（28,000以上の症例、11,000以上の死亡）と同等規模（10,000～20,000症例）に達する可能性を警告。現在400例確認、63死亡。武装紛争による療養体制の混乱と対応困難が懸念される。Bundibugyo種に対する特異的治療法またはワクチンは存在しない。WHOは2026年5月に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: City on alert as third suspected Ebola case emerges
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, Hyderabad's Gandhi Hospital, a designated Ebola isolation facility, is monitoring three suspected Ebola cases. A Sudanese student, Mohammed Yagouch Ahmed, who arrived from Sudan and studied in Hyderabad, was moved to Gandhi Hospital after a fever detected at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport; his close contact is in isolation for screening. Earlier, a 35-year-old Sudanese national who travelled to Hyderabad for knee surgery arrived Thursday with fever and was admitted to the same facility. Blood, urine, and swab samples have been sent to the Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology; results are expected within two days. Ebola Nodal Officer Vamsi Krishna said there are no severe symptoms like vomiting or diarrhoea yet. Officials are screening transit travellers from Africa (Sudan, Congo, Uganda) with a mandatory 21-day quarantine; if tests are negative, cases proceed to home isolation.

triage.headline_ja: 3例目のエボラ疑似患者出現で市が警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際的に極めて重大な感染症であり、複数の疑似患者が確認されている。IHR基準で3項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。インドでのエボラ疑似患者確認は異常かつ予想外であり、シグナル識別の対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドのハイデラバードで3例のエボラ疑似患者が確認されたことを主に述べており、Sudanからの渡航者が関係している。DRCとUgandaはスクリーニング対象地域として言及されているが、実際の発生地ではないため除外。記事で言及されているSudan（対象国リストに含まれず）での発生状況の詳細は不明。インドでのエボラ疑似患者確認は極めて異常なイベントであり、ただちにフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mi az az Ebola? - Mennyire kell félnünk tőle Európában?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Ebola? - How afraid should we be of it in Europe?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is present in the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with the WHO declaring an international public health emergency. Transmission occurs only by direct contact with infected body fluids or contaminated objects; the virus is not airborne. Bats are the natural reservoir, with spillover to wildlife and humans via handling meat. Early symptoms mimic flu: high fever, severe headache, and muscle pains, progressing to severe gastrointestinal symptoms, vomiting, diarrhea, and a non-itchy rash. In severe stages, vascular damage and bleeding can occur, followed by organ failure, delirium, seizures, or coma. Global case fatality averages around 50%, varying by strain (Zaire ~70–90% untreated; Bundibugyo ~25%). Prompt isolation and intensive supportive care can reduce CFR to under 30%; monoclonal antibody therapies may yield 80–90% survival when used early. Travel restrictions for Ugandan and Congolese travelers during the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the US; the short incubation reduces pandemic risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとは何か？ - ヨーロッパではどの程度恐れるべきか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行が記事の主題。対象国での確認あり。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaも含まれているが、対象国リストにはUgandaが含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはリストに含まれ、記事サマリーで明示的にエボラ流行が記載されている。WHOによる国際公衆衛生緊急事態宣言、高い致死率、国際的な渡航制限の実施などが報告されており、フルRRAに進める必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: US adds $38m for Ebola as CDC warns outbreak could match 2014
article.articleSummary: US pledges an additional $38 million for Ebola response, bringing total US funding to over $200 million. The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) outbreak has 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths, with 71 new cases in 24 hours and rapid community transmission anticipated. The Bundibugyo strain triggered a WHO emergency of international concern on May 17, with no approved vaccine or treatment. CDC modeling warns that without strong public health interventions the DRC outbreak could rival or exceed the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic. The US has imposed travel bans on people from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, screens at three US airports, and will quarantine exposed, asymptomatic individuals in a Kenyan facility with third-country transfer if symptoms develop. CDC has about 30 staff in DRC and ~100 in Uganda, plus 13 US treatment centers and ongoing coordination with DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: US adds $38m for Ebola as CDC warns outbreak could match 2014
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）、WPRO基準4項目該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。DRCエボラ流行は WHO緊急宣言済み、2014年西アフリカ流行に匹敵する可能性が指摘されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC がエボラ流行の主要焦点であることを明示。米国は渡航禁止（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）と空港スクリーニングを実施。2026年6月現在、452確定患者、82死亡、24時間で71新規患者。Bundibugyo株によるWHO PHEIC（2026年5月17日）。対象国リストに含まれない Sudan、Angola、Uganda、Kenya、US は verified_locations から除外（DRC が主要焦点）。

article.articleHeadline: الكونجو الديمقراطية تسجل 71 إصابة جديدة بإيبولا خلال يوم واحد وتحذر من تسارع انتشار العدوى - اخبار ليبيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records 71 new Ebola cases in one day and warns of accelerating spread of infection - Libya News.
article.articleSummary: 71 new Ebola virus disease cases were reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the last 24 hours, the highest daily toll since the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak began on May 15, bringing confirmed cases to 452 and deaths to 82. Most new infections (65) occurred in Ituri province in the northeast, with six in North Kivu, marking the largest daily increase of this ongoing outbreak—the seventh in DRC's history. Health authorities warn transmission remains rapid in the two provinces, amid weak health services and security challenges in Ituri. Authorities also confirmed cases across the border in Uganda, expanding regional surveillance needs. In response, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced a six-month plan estimated at $518 million, developed with Africa CDC, to support DRC and Uganda and strengthen cross-border surveillance and border screening, plus preparedness elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国が1日で71人の新規エボラ患者を記録、感染拡大の加速を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大、複数国への越境感染、WHOによる緊急対応宣言があり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ患者確認が記載されているが、ウガンダ（対象国リストに非含有）は越境感染の確認に留まり、主要イベント地はDRC。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。1日71件の新規患者報告、死者82人、WHOが5億18百万ドルの6ヶ月支援計画を発表しており、国際的な関心・支援必要性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: खसरे का कहर! 650 बच्चों की मौत,जाने इसके शुरुआती लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Havoc! 650 Children Die, Know Its Early Symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh is grappling with a severe measles (Rubeola) outbreak, with hundreds of children hospitalized and deaths reported; the headline cites 650 children dead as of June 6, 2026. The World Health Organization has expressed concern. The outbreak spans most districts, intensified after Eid-related travel. Measles is highly contagious and spreads via respiratory droplets from infected persons. Early symptoms include high fever, dry cough, runny nose, red eyes, and white mouth spots, followed by a widespread red rash. The surge is linked to vaccination gaps and low herd immunity, especially among children under five who were not vaccinated on schedule. With a long border with India, authorities monitor cross-border risks, though India’s routine immunization programs provide some protection. Prevention hinges on timely vaccination, hygiene, avoiding crowds, and isolating cases; there is no curative treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹の猛威！650人の子どもが死亡、初期症状について知る
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュで麻疹の大規模流行が発生し、650人の子どもの死亡が報告されている。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当する。WHOが懸念を表明し、インドとの越境リスクも存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはバングラデシュでの麻疹流行を主題としているが、サマリー内でインドが越境リスク対象として明記されており、インドの免疫プログラムが言及されている。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはインドのみ。WHOが懸念を表明しており、国際的な対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία του Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Η τρέχουσα κρίση μπορεί να προσλάβει διαστάσεις μεγαλύτερες από εκείνη του 2014
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: The current crisis could take on dimensions larger than those of 2014.
article.articleSummary: CDC warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could reach sizes comparable to or larger than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic if robust measures are not taken. The northeastern DRC outbreak, the 17th in the country, was declared May 15 and is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment. As of 2026-06-06, lab-confirmed cases total 381 in DRC with 64 deaths; across the border in Uganda, 16 cases and 1 death; 7 recoveries in DRC and 2 in Uganda. Ebola has killed over 15,000 people in Africa over 50 years, with case-fatality ranging 25–90%. The deadliest DRC outbreak (2018–2020) caused about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases. CDC models aim to guide measures to slow spread and emphasize strong response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：現在の危機は2014年のものより大きな規模に達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で死亡率が高く、2014-2016西アフリカ流行規模以上に達する可能性があるため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はワクチンおよび特異的治療法が現在存在しない。累積381確定患者・64死亡（DRC）、ウガンダではボーダー越境で16患者・1死亡が報告されている。CDCモデルによる警告と対応強化の勧告が記事の重点。過去50年間のアフリカでのエボラ死亡数は15,000人以上、致命率25-90%。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: استعدوا للأسوأ، مراكز مكافحة الأمراض الأمريكية تحذر من تفشي "إيبولا" على نطاق واسع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prepare for the worst: the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention warns of a widespread Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: CDC warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could evolve into a widespread health crisis. Models suggest the outbreak may reach dangerous levels without rapid, effective interventions, potentially rivaling or exceeding West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic. Ituri province in eastern DRC is the epicenter, accounting for about 90% of confirmed infections and 76% of deaths. The Bundibugyo strain had circulated before the outbreak was officially announced on May 15. WHO data show 381 confirmed cases in the DRC, with 64 deaths and 7 recoveries; Uganda reports 16 confirmed cases and 1 death, with 2 recoveries. Officials emphasize preparedness and swift public health actions to contain transmission, not alarm, including case isolation and contact tracing. The guidance mirrors measures that helped contain Ebola in West Africa more than a decade ago.

triage.headline_ja: 準備せよ最悪の事態に備えて：米国疾病対策予防センターが「エボラ」の広範な流行について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間での確認事例、高い死亡率、西アフリカ2014-2016年流行に匹敵する可能性、CDC/WHO主導の国際的対応が示唆されており、シグナルとしての重要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行の主題を明確に述べており、Ituri州を震源地としている。Ugandaでの16例の確認は記載されているが、サマリーの中心はDRCの状況分析であり、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリー本文に言及がないため除外。ウガンダは対象国でないため除外。CDC/WHOの公式警告により社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل 71 إصابة جديدة بفيروس إيبولا - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records 71 new Ebola virus infections - Ardu Point
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa reported 71 new Ebola virus infections yesterday, raising the Democratic Republic of the Congo's total confirmed cases to 452 since the May 15 outbreak of a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, with 82 deaths. The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus unveiled a six-month plan totaling $518 million to combat Ebola virus disease, urging fundraising and sustained political commitment. The plan, developed with the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, aims to help DRC and neighboring Uganda contain transmission and assist other countries in preparedness by strengthening surveillance and border testing. The update underscores ongoing transmission and the need for coordinated outbreak response and resource mobilization to stop spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルスの新規感染者71人を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目中4項目該当。エボラウイルスは高い公衆衛生リスク、死亡例あり、WHOが国際対応を開始。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の活発な流行。5月15日から452確認例、82死亡例。キンシャサで急速な症例増加（71例/日）。WHOが5億1800万ドルの6ヶ月計画を発表し、ウガンダを含む国境地域での対応を強化中。ウガンダでの確認は記事サマリーに明記されていないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Traders face big losses after Uganda closes Congo border over Ebola...
article.articleSummary: Uganda closed its western border with the Democratic Republic of Congo at Mpondwe on May 28 to curb cross-border Ebola transmission from Congo’s Ituri outbreak, allowing only emergency, humanitarian, cargo or security movement. Traders report long truck queues; at least seven trucks carrying fish from China to Congo’s Beni and Butembo are stuck. Uganda has confirmed 15 Ebola cases, all linked to the Congo outbreak after some Congolese sought treatment in Kampala before the outbreak was known. Congo’s outbreak is suspected to have infected over 1,000 people; confirmed cases are fewer because many victims die outside hospitals. The WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern but discouraged border closures. Kasese’s isolation center can return results in six hours; 41 samples tested negative recently. Uganda’s Mpondwe border, a major informal export route valued at about $131 million in 2023, may see tighter controls; the Bundibugyo-type Ebola has no vaccines or treatments.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ出血熱の懸念からコンゴとの国境を閉鎖 - 商人が大きな損失に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言したエボラ出血熱の越境流行。確認事例とベストプラクティスに対する逸脱（国境閉鎖）が存在し、継続的なコミュニティリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ地域でのエボラ流行であり、ウガンダへの二次的な波及を扱っている。ウガンダは検出国であるが、発病地はDRCのイトゥリであるため verified_locations はDRC のみとする。WHO がPHEIC宣言済み、ワクチン・治療法なし、1,000人以上が感染した可能性。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला के कंफर्म मामलों की संख्या बढ़कर 452 हुई, 82 लोगों की मौत - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Confirmed cases in Congo rise to 452; 82 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) shows 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths. As of 4 June, Ituri and North Kivu recorded 71 new cases and 21 deaths, signaling rapid community transmission of the Bundibugyo strain. In total, 258 patients are in isolation or hospital care, and eight have recovered. Contact tracing remains weak: of 4,766 contacts monitored across three provinces, only 2,755 have been followed (57.8%). Key challenges include resistance to post-mortem swabbing, insufficient treatment capacity, medicine shortages, lack of infection-prevention supplies in North Kivu, poor alert reporting, and a funding gap of $21.5 million. Uganda reports 3 new Ebola cases, bringing its total to 19. Africa CDC and WHO are planning an Africa-wide response, aiming to mobilize $518 million from June to November. So far, 34 health workers have been infected (7 deaths, 6 recoveries).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ確定患者数が452人に増加、82人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、コンゴでのエボラウイルス感染症の急速な拡大を示している。ウガンダへの越境確認により国際的拡大リスクが現実化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダの3症例にも言及しているが、対象国リストに Uganda は含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。発生地域に Uganda が含まれるのは記事内で越境例として言及されているためだが、シグナル認識には DRC の深刻な状況で十分。弱い接触者追跡（57.8%のみ）、医療容量不足、資金ギャップ 21.5 百万ドルなど管理上の重大な課題が存在。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला के कंफर्म मामलों की संख्या बढ़कर 452 हुई, 82 लोगों की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the number of confirmed Ebola cases rose to 452, with 82 deaths.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola confirmed cases rose to 452 with 82 deaths. A fresh report indicates 71 new confirmed cases on June 4 in Ituri and North Kivu, with 21 deaths, signaling accelerated community transmission of the Bundibugyo strain. As of the report, 258 patients are in isolation or under hospital care, and eight have recovered. Contact tracing remains severely limited: of 4,766 contacts monitored across three provinces, only 2,755 have been followed, a 57.8% follow-up rate. Challenges cited include resistance to post-mortem swabs, inadequate treatment standards, weak contact tracing, medicine shortages, PPE shortages in North Kivu, poor alert reporting, and a funding gap of $21.5 million. Uganda reported three new Ebola cases, total 19. Africa CDC and WHO are coordinating a continent-wide response, aiming to mobilize $518 million (June–November). Overall, 34 health workers have been infected (7 deaths, 6 recoveries).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラの確認症例が452件に増加、82人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。コンゴとウガンダでの多数の死亡、加速する感染力、医療対応能力の限界が確認され、緊急的なRRA実施が必要。

verified_locations.name: Zambia (Uganda referenced as neighboring concern but primary event is DRC; Uganda itself is not in target country list)

triage.notes: Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ対象国確定。記事ではコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生が主題であり、ウガンダの3例は地域拡大リスクとしての参考情報。Bundibugyo株による加速的なコミュニティ伝播、医療対応の深刻な制約（資金ギャップ$21.5百万、PPE不足、接触者追跡57.8%のみ）が確認される。Africa CDCおよびWHOによる大陸規模対応が既に開始されており、国際的関心極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Football, Ebola, and the shaming of a president
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) trigger Hungary to deny entry to President Félix Tshisekedi and detain him at Budapest airport, while his delegation proceeds, exposing perceived double standards in health-based travel controls. The piece notes the DRC’s ongoing Ebola concerns and contrasts the president’s treatment with his brother Christian Tshisekedi’s smoother arrival via Brussels on private jets, underscoring inequities between African leaders and elites. Hungary publicly framed the incident around Ebola as a reason to restrict entry, labeling the DRC as “Ebola country.” The author recalls the 2014 West African Ebola outbreak in Sierra Leone, Guinea, and Liberia to argue that Western nations have used disease anxiety to justify travel bans that function as punishment for poverty. The piece contends the situation reveals selective rules and sovereignty gaps for the powerful vs. the poor.

triage.headline_ja: フットボール、エボラ、そして大統領への恥辱
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクが報告され、国際的な入国制限措置が実施されている。IHR基準では異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限が該当し、WPROスクリーニングでは異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当する。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクが主題で、ハンガリーによる大統領の入国拒否・空港での抑留が主要事例として論じられている。発生地域にはベルギー、ハンガリー、シエラレオネ、リベリア、ギニアが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの発生であり、言及されている過去の2014年西アフリカアウトブレイクは歴史的背景として記述されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला के कंफर्म मामलों की संख्या बढ़कर 452 हुई, 82 लोगों की मौत | DR Congo's confirmed Ebola cases rise to 452, with 82 deaths: Govt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, the number of confirmed Ebola cases rose to 452, with 82 deaths: Govt.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak now shows 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, health ministry reports. On 4 June, 71 new confirmed cases in Ituri and North Kivu were accompanied by 21 deaths, signaling ongoing community transmission of the Bundibugyo strain. About 258 patients are in isolation or hospital care, with 8 recovered. Contact tracing remains weak: of 4,766 monitored contacts across three provinces, only 2,755 (57.8%) were followed up. Major challenges include resistance to post-mortem swabs, insufficient standard of care, PPE shortages in North Kivu, shortages of essential medicines, and a US$21.5 million funding gap. Uganda confirmed three new Ebola cases, totaling 19. Africa CDC and WHO are mobilizing a continental preparedness plan, aiming to raise US$518 million for June–November. So far, 34 health workers have been infected, with 7 deaths and 6 recoveries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ確認症例が452件に増加、82人が死亡：政府発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は国際的に深刻な脅威であり、地域的拡大とウガンダへの越境感染が確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも新規症例（計19例）が確認されているが、記事の主要テーマはDRC内の流行状況。接触者追跡の脆弱性（57.8%のみ追跡）、医療従事者感染（34人）、資金不足（2,150万米ドルのギャップ）など、対応能力の課題が顕著。Bundibugyo株による地域内感染が進行中であり、緊急的なフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: "Καμπανάκι" CDC για την εξάπλωση του Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Πιθανόν να προσλάβει διαστάσεις μεγαλύτερες από εκείνη του 2014
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Alarm bells' from the CDC about the spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: It could take on dimensions larger than those in 2014.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (North Kivu) triggers a CDC warning that without aggressive measures, the epidemic could reach, or exceed, the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa crisis. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no specific vaccine or treatment; most prior outbreaks were due to the Zaire strain with available vaccines. North Kivu declared the outbreak on May 15. WHO epidemiological bulletin reports 381 laboratory-confirmed cases in DRC and 64 deaths; across the border in Uganda, 16 cases and 1 death (7 recoveries in DRC, 2 in Uganda). CDC notes models indicating the proportion infected and in isolation, used to guide countermeasures rather than to alarm. The most deadly DRC outbreak (2018–2020) killed about 2,300 of 3,500 cases, while Ebola has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa over 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の拡大についてCDCから警告：2014年の流行規模を超える可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で肯定的。エボラ出血熱の多国境流行であり、重症度が高く、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク・管理が困難である。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事サマリーで感染者報告（16例、1死亡）があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い危機度を持つイベント。即座にフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）を実施すべき。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases climb to 452 as death toll hits 82
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths, per the latest health ministry situation report. A total of 258 patients are in isolation or receiving hospital care, with 8 recoveries. Authorities confirmed 71 new Ebola cases on Thursday in the Ituri and North Kivu provinces, underscoring rapid and sustained community transmission of the Bundibugyo strain and signaling an ongoing outbreak requiring continued surveillance and response in affected districts. The figures highlight a substantial burden on healthcare facilities and the persistent risk to communities in these regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者が452人に、死者は82人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。確認患者452人、死亡82人の大規模なエボラ流行であり、急速な地域感染、医療施設への重大な負荷、継続的なヒト-ヒト感染リスク、国際的な拡大可能性を示唆している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行。Bundibugyo株による急速な地域内感染が確認されており、継続的な監視と対応が必要とされている。Ituri州とNorth Kivu州での高い新規患者数（6月5日に71人）が報告されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Relations internationales : Maurice reporte le "US-Africa Business Summit" en raison des risques liés à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International Relations: Mauritius postpones the US-Africa Business Summit due to Ebola-related risks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola-related health risks prompt Mauritius to postpone 18th US-Africa Business Summit, planned for July 26–29, due to Ebola spread in Africa. The government emphasizes postponement, not cancellation, and aims to reschedule in 2026. Health concerns also lead Council of Ministers to move SADC Parliamentary Forum's 59th plenary session in Seychelles to virtual format. The Ebola Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) has been declared by the WHO for outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. As of early June, DRC reports 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths (7 recoveries); Uganda reports 15 cases and 1 death. Mauritius imposes travel forms, health declarations, entry bans for foreign nationals with recent stays in affected countries, and a 21-day quarantine for residents. Riambel’s SAJ Recreation Centre becomes the quarantine facility from June 8 to August 7, 2026, under enhanced surveillance by WHO, Africa CDC, and Indian Ocean Commission.

triage.headline_ja: 国際関係：モーリシャスがエボラ関連リスクのため「米国・アフリカビジネスサミット」を延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（PHEIC宣言済み）の国際的広がり、複数国での確定症例と死亡、渡航制限導入、国際会議の延期など、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的懸念を明確に示している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラウイルス病の実際の発生国はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン（Sudan含む）である。対象国リストでは DRC (203312) のみが該当。モーリシャス、セイシェルは影響を受ける国だが発生地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。WHO による PHEIC 宣言済み、複数国での確定症例と死亡報告、国際的な渡航制限・隔離措置の実施により、シグナル性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Traders face big losses after Uganda closes Congo border over Ebola contagion fears
article.articleSummary: Uganda closed its western border with Congo at Mpondwe on May 28 amid fears of cross-border Ebola spread after Congo declared an Ituri outbreak. The Congolese outbreak is suspected to have infected over 1,000 people, though confirmed cases are fewer as many do not reach hospitals. Uganda has 15 confirmed Ebola cases linked to the outbreak, traced to Congolese nationals who sought treatment in Kampala. The Bundibugyo strain, for which vaccines and treatments are ineffective, heightens concern. Border measures slowed cargo, stalled trucks, and left goods—such as plantains and Chinese fish—rotting as queues lengthened. WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern but discouraged border closures. Kasese hosts an isolation center and a lab that can return results in six hours, with 41 samples recently testing negative. Authorities are planning tighter, more systematic cargo controls.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ感染懸念によりコンゴとの国境を閉鎖、商人が大損失を被る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外なアウトブレイク、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限実施）。WHO公式に国際的懸念事項として宣言されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダの対応（国境閉鎖、15確認症例）が記述されているが、Ebola outbreak自体の発生地はコンゴのイトゥリ地域であり、ウガンダはセカンダリケースの発生地である。発生地域リストにはウガンダが含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOが公式にPublic Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)を宣言している重大事象。

article.articleHeadline: Mauritius hadkan kemasukan warga asing susulan wabak Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mauritius restricts the entry of foreign nationals following the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Mauritius bars entry of foreign nationals who have visited, transited through, or stayed in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the previous 21 days, following the Ebola outbreak declared in DRC and Uganda on May 15 and the WHO’s declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Mauritian citizens and foreign residents with valid work, residence, business, or student permits may still enter, but must undergo a mandatory 21-day quarantine if they have visited any of the three countries within the prior three weeks. The policy reflects heightened border controls amid ongoing Ebola transmission in the region, aiming to curb cross-border spread while awaiting further outbreak updates.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行を受けて、モーリシャスが外国人の入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、複数国への波及、渡航制限措置の実施により、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ出血熱の発生地域はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンである。対象国リスト内ではDRC（203312）のみが該当。モーリシャスはエボラ発生地からの入国者に対する防疫措置を講じている国であり、発生地ではないため検証対象地域から除外。WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concern(PHEIC)を宣言している重大な案件。

article.articleHeadline: Flu cases on the rise in Hong Kong as immunity wanes, expert warns
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity is rising in Hong Kong as immunity wanes, with the elderly and children most affected. Waning protection from the seasonal flu vaccine has reduced community immunity, prompting calls for high-risk groups to get vaccinated and practice good hygiene. A severe influenza B case involves a 17-year-old boy with chronic illnesses who is in critical condition with pneumonia and shock; the patient was unvaccinated. Since January, infections with Influenza A and B have rebounded, with Queen Mary Hospital reporting more cases among children and the elderly. It remains to be seen whether this constitutes another influenza peak. The seasonal vaccination program has been underway for about six months, with antibody levels believed to decline over time.

triage.headline_ja: 香港ではインフルエンザの症例が増加中、専門家が免疫低下を警告
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA・Bの活動が香港で上昇しており、スクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、重症度）に複数該当するが、国際的拡大のリスクやWHOへの通知基準を満たす明確な証拠は現在の情報では不明。継続的な動向監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は香港（中国特別行政区）でのインフルエンザ活動の上昇。香港はChina (GeoNames ID 1814991) に含めている。IHR基準は2つ該当（深刻な影響と異常性）し形式的には通知基準を満たすが、地域内の周期的なインフルエンザピークの可能性が高く、国際的拡大リスクの証拠が不足。WPRO基準では4つ該当し、流行しやすい状況と重症度が示唆されるため、WATCHレベルでの継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, in Congo 71 nuovi casi nelle ultime 24 ore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 71 new cases in the last 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 71 new cases in the last 24 hours, signaling an active transmission ongoing in the country. US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention officials warn that, without decisive public health measures, the outbreak could reach the scale of West Africa's 2014-2016 epidemic, which infected more than 28,000 people and caused over 11,000 deaths. The warning appears in the Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report (MMWR) as part of their modeling efforts. Officials emphasize that these projections are planning tools, not forecasts, and stress that containment would require a higher proportion of patients to be identified, isolated, and treated. The article suggests the response may need to be as large in scope as the 2014-2016 outbreak, underscoring urgency for robust interventions. Published 2026-06-06.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱：過去24時間で71例の新規感染者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、エボラウイルス病という致死的感染症の活発な流行がコンゴ民主共和国で継続しており、CDCが2014-2016年西アフリカ流行規模への進展を警告している。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高リスクの感染症。記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国での継続的な流行を明記し、CDCによる公式警告（MMWR）が含まれている。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主題とされていないため verified_locations から除外。過去24時間で71例という高い報告数は活発な伝播を示唆し、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: $518m plan to combat Ebola virus announced by WHO chief Tedros
article.articleSummary: WHO unveils a $518 million six‑month plan to curb the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The outbreak is described as the fourth-largest on record, with 381 confirmed Congo cases and 62 deaths, and 19 Ugandan cases with 2 deaths. The plan emphasizes containment, border screening, and preparedness for other countries, backed by about $315.8 million pledged so far (down from $498 million). The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment or vaccine, and tests initially failed to detect it, with results taking several days to a week. Security risks include mistrust and attacks on burial teams; three UN armored vehicles were provided. Kenya has agreed to host a U.S.-run Ebola quarantine facility in Nanyuki for 50 exposed individuals. The PHEIC was declared earlier in the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHOのテドロス事務局長がエボラウイルス対策に5億1,800万ドル計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な病原体株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株は治療・ワクチンなし、PHEIC既宣言。対象国のDRCで確認済み。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRC（203312）での明確な発生が主題。ウガンダ（対象国外）と国境接触事例、ケニア（Nanyuki）での隔離施設計画が記載されているが、実際の感染症発生はDRCのみ。PHEIC既宣言済みのハイリスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, nuova impennata dei contagi: 71 casi in 24 ore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, new spike in infections: 71 cases in 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with 452 laboratory-confirmed cases and 82 deaths since the outbreak began on May 15, 2026. In the last 24 hours, 71 new infections were reported, raising concerns about wider community transmission in the northeast, especially Ituri province, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu. Ebola Bundibugyo can cause fever and severe hemorrhagic symptoms; transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of infected individuals or corpses. Key control measures include case isolation, contact tracing, public information campaigns, and protection of health workers. The World Health Organization has announced a $518 million plan to bolster the outbreak response and border controls in neighboring countries, with ongoing monitoring to contain and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、新たな感染拡大：24時間で71例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、WHOによる大規模対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行。確定例452例、死亡82例。24時間で71新規感染報告。North Kivu、South Kivu、Ituri州で複数地域での発生確認。WHOが5億1800万ドルの対応計画を発表。隣国への国境管理強化も言及。IHRの4基準全て該当する重大シグナル。DRCは対象国リストに含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: الخطر يتزايد.. تحذيرات أمريكية من احتمال توسع تفشي الإيبولا بوسط إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk is rising... American warnings of the potential expansion of the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Central Africa's Democratic Republic of the Congo is grappling with an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. American health officials warn the outbreak could expand as large as the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016, which killed more than 11,000 and infected over 28,000. The African CDC reported about 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths, with likely additional undiagnosed or unreported cases. US CDC computer-model scenarios project 10,000 to over 20,000 cases, depending on how quickly infected people are identified and isolated. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May. Transmission occurs through contact with body fluids (vomit, blood, semen). There are no vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The outbreak has been complicated by armed conflict in the DRC, including clashes with M23 rebels and ISIS-linked ADF, driving displacement and hindering response. Initial tests suggested a different Ebola virus type earlier in the timeline.

triage.headline_ja: リスクが高まっている...中央アフリカでのエボラ流行拡大の可能性についての米国の警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus によるエボラ流行で、深刻な公衆衛生影響（既に400確認症例、63死亡、予測10,000～20,000症例）、予想外の拡大可能性、国際的拡散リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクがある。WHO が5月に国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC でのエボラ流行が主題。Bluedot API が付与した他の地域（米国、コートジボワール、アンゴラ）はサマリーに明記されていないため除外。DRC は対象国リストに含まれている。武力紛争による対応困難化が管理可能性を低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak worsens in DR Congo as confirmed cases climb and funding gap widens
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. The latest health ministry situation report, as of June 6, 2026, shows rapid community transmission with 71 new confirmed cases on June 4, including 21 deaths, in Ituri and North Kivu provinces. Authorities cite persistent challenges, including weak contact tracing, shortages of medical supplies, and a significant funding gap that hampers response activities. These developments indicate ongoing transmission and strain on the health system, underscoring the need for intensified surveillance, case investigation, isolation, and reinforcement of supplies to control the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が悪化、確認症例数が増加し資金ギャップが拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目に該当。エボラ出血熱は高い重症度と死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、資金不足による対応能力の低下が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の流行は常時監視対象疾患。現在進行中の流行で452確認症例、82死亡、71新規症例/日（6月4日）という急速な増加傾向。Bundibugyo株による感染で、接触者追跡の弱さ、医療用品不足、資金ギャップなどの深刻な対応困難が指摘されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ（ID 203312）、verified_locationsに正しく含める。

article.articleHeadline: Lào Cai chủ động ngừa dịch Lở mồm long móng serotype SAT1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lao Cai Takes Proactive Measures to Prevent Foot-and-Mouth Disease Outbreak of Serotype SAT1.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) serotype SAT1 poses cross-border risk to Vietnam’s Lao Cai Province, a key trade corridor with China. On 5 June, Lao Cai’s Department of Agriculture and Rural Development organized a cross-border disease prevention conference with ILRI and Vietnam’s Institute of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Medicine, under Korea’s MAFRA-funded ICT4Health project (2022–2026) operating in Phu Tho and Lao Cai. The meeting updated on transboundary animal diseases, assessed SAT1 entry risk, and trained local officials in surveillance, sampling, specimen preservation, and transport for diagnosis. Experts stressed Vietnam’s long border and high exposure from cross-border animal movement; SAT1 is not yet detected in Vietnam, though outbreaks have occurred abroad, including China’s Gansu and Xinjiang in early April 2026. A coordination regulation was signed among Lao Cai authorities, Market Management, Border Guard, and border communities to strengthen border controls, information sharing, and rapid response at checkpoints, gates, and markets.

triage.headline_ja: ラオカイ州、SAT1血清型口蹄疫の流行予防に主体的に取り組む
triage.triage_reason: 動物の疾患（口蹄疫）であるが、国際的な越境リスク（China-Vietnam間）が明確であり、SAT1型の検出リスク評価と国境対策が既に実施されている点から、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に複数該当。政府による積極的な予防措置と国際協力の実施が確認される。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は動物疾患（家畜）が主体だが、越境リスクと国際協力の視点から注視対象。SAT1血清型はまだベトナム国内で検出されていないが、中国（甘粛省・新疆地域）では2026年4月に発生が確認されている。国境対策・監視体制の強化が既に開始されており、管理可能性は相応にある。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы: ВОЗ привлечет более $500 млн
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO to raise more than $500 million.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization (WHO) and Africa CDC are mobilizing a continental Ebola readiness and response plan, aiming to raise about $518 million to help African countries prevent, detect, and respond to new cases. The six-month initiative, executed under the One Response framework, will unite governments, partners, and communities to strengthen emergency coordination, disease surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention, and safe treatment, with a focus on protecting vulnerable groups and expanding cross-border cooperation. It complements national plans already in place in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In May, WHO elevated the outbreak risk in the DRC to national- level “very high”; Uganda’s measures have helped contain spread. The DRC reports the first recovery in the current outbreak, with around 1,000 cases and more than 200 deaths so far.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：WHOが5億ドル以上を調達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（1,000例以上、200死以上）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを総合判定。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(Republic of Uganda)は発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国が言及されている。ただし対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。WHOが大規模な資金動員と域内対応枠組み（One Response）を実施中であり、国際的関心と支援ニーズが極めて高い。DRCで現アウトブレイクの初回治癒例が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Στα 452 αυξήθηκαν τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Confirmed Ebola cases rise to 452.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 452 confirmed Ebola cases (Bundibugyo strain) and 82 deaths, with 71 new cases in the last 24 hours. The outbreak could scale to dimensions comparable to or larger than the 2014–16 West Africa epidemic if public health interventions are not sustained. US CDC projections underscore that limited isolation could fuel one of the largest outbreaks on record, and the agency published three reports to mobilize international resources. The United States is increasing funding by about $38 million, bringing total outbreak funding to over $200 million, in coordination with the CDC and authorities in the DRC and Uganda. Washington also states that exposed Americans who are asymptomatic will be quarantined in Kenya at a separately constructed facility for this purpose.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ確認症例が452件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行であり、CDC予測が2014-16年西アフリカ流行規模を示唆。複数国への国際支援動員中。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行。DRCで452確認症例、82死亡。72時間で71新規症例。CDC投影では適切な介入がなければ2014-16年西アフリカ流行（2万8,000以上の症例）に匹敵するか上回る規模に拡大の可能性。米国は$38百万追加資金投入（総額$200百万以上）、ケニアでの米国民隔離施設構築、ウガンダとの国際協力継続中。高度な公衆衛生上の懸念と国際的な危機管理が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Thanh Hóa siết chặt phòng chống dịch bệnh vật nuôi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thanh Hoa tightens measures to prevent livestock diseases.
article.articleSummary: Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam, issued Plan No. 177/KH-UBND (2026–2030) to prevent avian influenza, foot-and-mouth disease, and African swine fever. The plan focuses on enhanced surveillance, rapid diagnosis, vaccination, quarantine, and slaughterhouse controls, plus establishing disease-free zones. Key targets: avian influenza — at least a 30% reduction in outbreaks versus 2019–2025, vaccination of over 70% of poultry, and creation of at least 35 disease-free facilities/areas; foot-and-mouth disease — at least a 30% reduction in outbreaks and animals culled, vaccination of over 70% of livestock, and at least 60 disease-free zones; African swine fever — at least a 30% reduction in outbreaks and pigs culled, and at least 35 disease-free pig-farming zones to meet domestic demand and support export. The plan also promotes biosecurity, risk-based vaccination, capacity building, farmer training, and intersectoral coordination to safeguard food safety and industry growth.

triage.headline_ja: タインホア省が家畜疾病防止対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザ、口蹄疫、アフリカ豚熱に対するベトナムの予防計画であり、既知の疾病への対策強化である。異常な発生を示す新しいシグナルではなく、計画段階の報道のため情報不足。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の家畜疾病（鳥インフルエンザ、口蹄疫、アフリカ豚熱）に対するベトナムの予防計画（2026-2030年）の発表である。新しい感染症の発生報告ではなく、政府による対策強化の公表。実際の流行データは提示されていない。引き続き監視は必要だが、現段階ではフルRRA実施の優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи: ВООЗ залучить понад $500 млн
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO to mobilize more than $500 million.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC will mobilize a continental Ebola readiness and response plan valued at $518 million to help African countries prepare for, detect, and respond to outbreaks. Over six months, the One Response-aligned plan aims to protect vulnerable populations, reinforce cross-border cooperation, and provide governments with rapid outbreak response support, including surveillance, laboratory testing, prevention, and treatment, with community engagement central to tracing contacts and limiting spread. The initiative complements national plans already developed by the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In May, WHO elevated the outbreak risk in the DRC to 'very high' at the national level; Uganda’s measures have helped slow transmission. The DRC has reported around 1,000 cases and over 200 deaths in the current outbreak, including the first recovery.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：WHO が5億ドル以上を動員
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行であり、WHO による大規模資金投入と国際的対応計画が発動されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダの両国が言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれている（ウガンダ は含まれていない）。DRCでの現在の流行は約1,000症例、200以上の死亡が報告されており、WHO がリスク評価を『非常に高い』に引き上げている。国境を越えた協力が強調されているため国際的拡大リスクは明確。

article.articleHeadline: 全球醫藥大戰！減肥神藥成效驚人、伊波拉疫情告急與德州食肉蟲現蹤 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Pharmaceutical War! The miracle weight-loss drug's efficacy is astonishing, the Ebola outbreak is dire, and a carnivorous worm has appeared in Texas — Minshi News Network.
article.articleSummary: On June 6, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows 71 new confirmed cases in a single day, triggering CDC warnings that the outbreak could rival the 2014 West Africa epidemic; WHO activated a $518 million anti-epidemic plan and the United States has provided $38 million to bolster border screening and regional containment. In Texas, La Pryor reports two cases of New World screwworm (Cochliomyia hominivorax), a carnivorous parasite that bores into living tissue, marking the first local occurrence since 1966; USDA is enforcing quarantines to prevent livestock spread. These are the major infectious-disease developments highlighted, reflecting international Ebola response and domestic veterinary/public health risk.

triage.headline_ja: グローバル医薬戦争！減肥神薬の効果が驚異的、エボラ疫情が危機的状況、テキサス州で肉食虫が発生—民視ニュースネットワーク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。DRCでのエボラ爆発的増加は2014年西アフリカ流行に匹敵するリスクを示唆。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはテキサス州（USA）とアンゴラも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのエボラ爆発的増加（1日71例確認、2014年西アフリカ流行との比較言及）。スクリューワーム（肉食虫）はテキサス州で確認されているが、対象国リストに米国は含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはシグナル評価に充分。WHO資金動員($518M)、米国政府支援($38M)により国際的対応が既に激化している。

article.articleHeadline: मैनपाट में पीलिया का कहर! गांव-गांव बीमारी की दस्तक, 3 मौतों से दहशत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaundice ravages Mainpat! Disease knocks on every village; fear after three deaths.
article.articleSummary: Jaundice outbreak in the Mainpat area of Ambikapur, Surguja district, Chhattisgarh, with Narmdapur and Kunia villages reporting over 20 cases and three deaths. Affected individuals experience weakness, fever, vomiting, loss of appetite, and yellowing of eyes and skin. Health authorities have deployed camps in the affected villages for screening and treatment. Water samples were collected from villages and sent to a laboratory to determine the source of infection. Residents are advised to drink clean, boiled water, maintain food hygiene, and seek immediate care for symptoms. Health teams are conducting door-to-door surveys to gather health information. The department is monitoring the situation and will take further action based on laboratory results and outbreak assessment. No official confirmation of the exact cause yet, but contaminated water is identified as a major suspected factor.

triage.headline_ja: マインパットの黄疸猛威！村々に病気が押し寄せ、3人の死亡で恐怖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国内拡大の兆候）。WPRO基準でも5つ全て該当。対象国インドで黄疸アウトブレイク、死亡例3件、複数村での急速な拡大が確認され、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: インドのチャッティスガル州アムビカプール区マインパット地域で黄疸アウトブレイク。ナルマダプル村とクニア村で20例以上、死亡3件。汚染水が感染源と疑われている。原因確定まで待機中だが、公式発表を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果局勢混亂 伊波拉疫情難明朗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chaos in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; Ebola outbreak remains unclear.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains severe, centered in the conflict-affected provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu. In the latest update, Médecins Sans Frontières reports over 65 confirmed cases in the past 24 hours. The World Health Organization has downgraded the number of suspected cases but warns the outbreak remains dangerous, as only about 45% of direct contacts are being traced due to insecurity and limited access. Attacks on Ebola burial teams and general public distrust hinder the response and raise transmission risk. The UN and African Union have launched a six-month emergency plan with funding of NT$16.8 billion to bolster surveillance, laboratory confirmation, and public health measures to prevent further spread. Historically, the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak infected over 28,000 and killed more than 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国の混乱した情勢 エボラ出血熱の流行の見通しが不明確
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は最も重篤な感染症の一つで、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性があり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の流行は過去のケース（西アフリカ2014-2016で28,000以上の感染、11,000以上の死亡）との歴史的比較が示唆されている。現在の流行は紛争地域での安全保障上の課題（埋葬チームへの攻撃、公的不信、接触者追跡率45%以下）が対応を複雑にしており、更なる拡大リスクが懸念される。UN・アフリカ連合が6ヶ月の緊急計画を立案。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل 71 إصابة جديدة بإيبولا وتحذيرات من تفشٍ سريع للمرض - اليوم 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records 71 new Ebola cases and warnings of a rapid outbreak of the disease - Today 24.
article.articleSummary: 71 new confirmed Ebola virus disease cases (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo over the past 24 hours—the highest daily tally of the current outbreak. Breakdown: 65 in Ituri and 6 in North Kivu, bringing total confirmed cases to 452 since the outbreak began on May 15, with 82 deaths. Most infections centered in Ituri, a region with weak health services and security/logistical challenges hampering response. Confirmed cases have also been detected in Uganda, heightening border-spread concerns. In response, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced a six-month emergency plan worth $518 million to support containment in DRC and Uganda, strengthen surveillance and border testing, and mobilize resources and international cooperation to avert a wider regional health threat.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国が71件の新規エボラウイルス病患者を報告し、急速な感染拡大の警告 - 本日24日
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（過去24時間で71例、死者82例）、異常・予想外な急速拡大、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダで確認）、国際的支援・旅行制限のリスク。WHOによる緊急対応と$518M投資が発表されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）での症例確認も記載されているが、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。過去24時間の新規確認数71例は現アウトブレイク中の最高日次数。Bundibugyo ebolavirus種による感染。2026年5月15日の発生開始以降、累計452例、死者82例。Ituriは医療サービスが脆弱で治安・物流上の課題あり。WHOの即応によるグローバル支援体制が構築中。

article.articleHeadline: "Three returnees from Ebola-hit African countries quarantined in Durg": Chhattisgarh Health Minister
article.articleSummary: Three returnees from African Ebola-affected countries were isolated in Durg, Chhattisgarh, and quarantined for 21 days as a precaution; tests showed no infection and no symptoms. Amid ongoing Ebola outbreaks in Congo and Uganda, India’s central government advised avoiding non-essential travel to Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. In Rajasthan, a suspected Ebola case emerged after a Ugandan national arriving in Jaipur from Sharjah developed Ebola-like symptoms; she was admitted to RUHS Hospital in isolation, with samples sent to Pune for testing. Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus is implicated; there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments, and India has reported no confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola cases. Chhattisgarh health officials say hospitals and quarantine facilities are prepared, and a CM helpline was launched to improve public grievance redressal.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ出血熱が流行しているアフリカ諸国からの帰国者3名がチャッティスガル州ドゥルグで隔離」：チャッティスガル州保健相
triage.triage_reason: インドでエボラウイルス感染の疑い事例が報告され、既知のアフリカでの集団発生との関連がある。複数のIHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）を満たし、WHOもPHEIC宣言済みであるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドでのエボラ疑い事例（ウガンダ国籍者、ジャイプール到着後に症状発症）とコンゴ・ウガンダでの既知の集団発生を関連付けている。Bluedot APIが提供した発生地域にはUAEやスーダンも含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はインドでの事例検出であり、DRCは既知の集団発生地として言及されているため両国を verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により国際的な関心も極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Second Suspected Ebola Case Reported in Hyderabad, India
article.articleSummary: Two Sudanese nationals in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, remain under investigation for suspected Ebola Virus Disease as of 2026-06-06. One in his 20s was admitted to Gandhi Hospital after transfer from a private facility and placed in an isolation ward; the other, a 35-year-old traveler flagged during thermal screening at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, had fever on screening but was later reportedly asymptomatic. Neither case has been lab-confirmed; samples have been collected, and close contacts and travel histories are being monitored while investigations continue. Gandhi Hospital has been designated the nodal Ebola surveillance center with dedicated isolation facilities. The alerts accompany a WHO PHEIC declaration over Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda. India’s MoHFW issues travel advisories and strengthens airport screening; officials urge vigilance but say there are no confirmed cases in India.

triage.headline_ja: インドのハイデラバードで疑い例を含むエボラ出血熱の2例が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準4項目該当（異常性、重症度の潜在性、流行可能性、管理可能性）、エボラ出血熱は高リスク病原体であり社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR-Annex2重大事象の典型的疾患。記事ではインド（ハイデラバード）での疑い例報告が主題。DRCおよびウガンダでのBundibugyoエボラ流行に関連するWHO PHEICが同時に宣言されており、国際的な感染症危機管理体制が既に発動されている。インド保健省による空港スクリーニング強化、旅行警告発出、および感染症監視体制の整備が報告されている。現段階では確定例なく疑い例のみだが、エボラ出血熱の病原体特性、致死率、国際的な流行可能性から緊急性は極めて高い。フルRRA実施必須。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉病毒｜孔繁毅：針對病毒株疫苗有望年底推　抗病毒藥展測試
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus | Kong Fanyi: Strain-specific vaccines expected to be rolled out by year-end; antiviral drugs to undergo testing.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and B cases are rising in Hong Kong, with A mainly H3; whether a peak has occurred awaits further observation. Queen Mary Hospital reports increased pediatric and elderly influenza admissions. Waning community immunity and a six-month vaccination campaign underlie the rise; unvaccinated residents are urged to vaccinate, reinforce hygiene, and mask-wear. COVID-19 remains endemic; HK has seen no large outbreaks for a year, with Omicron BA.2 predominance and milder disease than influenza. High-risk groups should get a new COVID-19 vaccine every six months. Hand-foot-mouth disease activity has surged, with 17 outbreaks in the first five days of last week, >90% in childcare centers and primary schools; emphasize soap and water handwashing and staying home when sick. Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda pose very low risk to Hong Kong; incubation 21 days; vaccines against Bundibugyo ebolavirus expected by year-end; antivirals in trials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス | コン・ファンイー：ウイルス株に対応したワクチンは年末までの展開が期待されており、抗ウイルス薬は試験段階へ
triage.triage_reason: 複数の病原体（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、手足口病、エボラ）が混在する記事であり、香港での地元の懸念は高いが、サマリーではエボラについて「香港へのリスクは非常に低い」と明記されている。インフルエンザと手足口病は局地的な季節性問題、エボラは地理的に遠い地域での発生。情報整理と続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが複数の疾患を混在させており、フォーカスが不明確。エボラはDRC/ウガンダで発生しているが、DRCは対象国（203312）に含まれるものの、サマリー上では香港への直接的なリスクは「非常に低い」と評価。香港はChina(1814991)に含める。インフルエンザと手足口病の香港での上昇は局地的な関心事。続報でのエボラの国際的拡大の有無、ワクチン/抗ウイルス薬開発の進捗を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Ανησυχία για ανεξέλεγκτη εξάπλωση του Έμπολα - Κίνδυνος να εξελιχθεί σε μία από τις μεγαλύτερες επιδημίες
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over the uncontrolled spread of Ebola — the risk of it becoming one of the largest epidemics.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) declared May 15 in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with spillover into Uganda. As of June 6, 2026, WHO reports 381 laboratory-confirmed cases in DRC, including 64 deaths; Uganda has 16 confirmed cases and 1 death. Congo recoveries: 7; Uganda recoveries: 2. The Bundibugyo strain is rarer, with no approved vaccine or specific therapy. The US CDC warns the outbreak could match or exceed the scale of West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 11,000 deaths) if public health measures are not rapidly implemented; models show true infections are uncertain and the outbreak remains in early stages. The most severe Ebola outbreak in DRC occurred 2018–2020 with about 3,500 confirmed cases and roughly 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの統制不可能な拡大への懸念 — 最大級の流行の一つへ発展する危険性
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4つすべてに該当：深刻な公衆衛生への影響（381確定患者、64死亡）、異常性（Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療法なし）、国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、渡航・貿易制限リスク。WHO警告により国際的な懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの宣言（2026年5月15日）。ウガンダへの二次感染確認。ワクチンなし、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（11,000死以上）と同等またはそれを超える可能性をCDCが警告。対象国リストにUgandaが含まれていないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC, WHO mobilise $518 million fund for Ebola response plan - Peoples Gazette Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak triggers Africa CDC and WHO to launch a six-month continental preparedness and response plan to mobilise $518 million from June to November 2026. The plan aims to strengthen emergency coordination, disease surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics and essential health services across Africa, with a One Response approach. It complements national responses ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, as authorities intensify operations with Africa CDC, WHO and partners. Ten priority countries will implement rapid detection and response efforts; cross-border screening and coordination are emphasized to limit transmission. With no licensed vaccines or therapeutics for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, the strategy focuses on health-system strengthening while maintaining support for mpox, cholera and measles to protect routine care.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、WHOがエボラ対応計画に5億1800万ドルの資金を動員 - ピープルズ・ガゼット・ナイジェリア
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の多国間アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当（異常性、重症度、持続的曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。社会的・政治的関心も高い（国際機関の大規模資金動員）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクを言及しており、10優先国での対応を記述している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルスの中でも特に高い死亡率を持つ株として知られている。6ヶ月間（2026年6月～11月）の大陸規模対応計画という大規模な公衆衛生介入の実施予定が報道されている。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC, WHO launch $518m Ebola response plan for Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo virus persists in Africa, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda leading the response. Africa CDC and WHO launched a six-month continental preparedness and response plan (June–November 2026) worth $518 million to strengthen early detection, rapid response and health-system resilience. The unified One Response framework coordinates governments, partners and communities across emergency operations, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics and sustaining essential health services. The plan complements national strategies in DRC and Uganda and prioritizes protection of vulnerable groups, cross-border cooperation, and rapid response mechanisms for emerging cases. With no licensed vaccines or therapeutics for Bundibugyo Ebola, emphasis remains on health-system strengthening. Ten priority nations are enhancing surveillance; operations continue in DRC with strengthened entry-point screening and regional solidarity.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC・WHO、アフリカ向けエボラ対応計画に5億1800万ドルを投入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo Ebolaの流行が複数国で進行中、$518Mの大規模対応計画が発動され、国際的に重大な公衆衛生危機である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（民主共和国コンゴ）とウガンダでのエボラ流行を言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。DRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo Ebolaはレアな出血熱で、ワクチン・治療薬が未認可の状況。六ヶ月間の大陸規模対応計画による国際的な関心の高さから、フルRRA実施が必要。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Un singur vaccin, creat cu ajutorul AI, ar putea oferi protecţie împotriva unor familii întregi de virusuri, inclusiv Ebola şi SARS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A single vaccine, created with the help of AI, could provide protection against entire families of viruses, including Ebola and SARS.
article.articleSummary: Universal DNA vaccine based on AI could shield against entire virus families, including coronaviruses and Ebola, using a single administration. Cambridge University and DIOSynVax developed a vaccine targeting Sarbecoviruses by analyzing global genetic sequences and identifying conserved structures. A phase I trial in the UK (49 healthy volunteers, ages 18-50) conducted in Cambridge and Southampton used a DNA vaccine delivered by a high-pressure microfluidic jet, showing safety and an immune response not only to SARS-CoV-2 and SARS but also to bat-origin coronaviruses that could spill over to humans. The study, published in the Journal of Infection, supports further development; phase II will recruit over 200 participants. The aim is broad, cross-species protection that could reduce future pandemics, potentially across Ebola as well, addressing continuous evolution in viruses seen in DRC and Uganda's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: AIで開発された単一ワクチンが、エボラとSARSを含むウイルス科全体に対する保護を提供できる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実際の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではなく、ワクチン開発の科学的進展を扱う報道記事である。DRCとウガンダの過去のエボラ発生は文脈参照のみであり、現在の活発な流行を示唆していない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン開発に関する科学報道であり、現在の感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）を報告していない。DRCおよびウガンダへの言及は歴史的背景提供のためであり、現在の流行を示すものではない。臨床試験は英国で実施されており、対象国に含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Mauritius limits entry of foreigners following Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Mauritius imposes a temporary entry ban on foreign nationals who have travelled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days due to the Ebola outbreak declared in the DRC and Uganda on May 15 and designated a WHO public health emergency of international concern. Mauritian citizens and residents with valid permits may enter but face a mandatory 21-day quarantine if they visited any of the three countries in the prior three weeks. Travellers will undergo screening and risk assessment at entry; symptomatic individuals will be isolated for clinical assessment. The government also urged postponement of the 18th US-Africa Business Summit. Africa CDC and WHO launched a continental Ebola preparedness and response plan to raise $518 million for June–November; 34 health workers have been infected, with 7 deaths and 6 recoveries. Challenges include scarce countermeasures for Bundibugyo, weak health infrastructure, mobility, displacement, and misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に伴いモーリシャスが外国人の入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的流行宣言（WHO PHEIC）、DRC及びウガンダでの確認、複数国への渡航制限実施、国際的な拡大リスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ流行がDRC及びウガンダで宣言された旨が記載されているが、評価対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ列挙。モーリシャスの渡航制限措置はこれらの国からの輸入例防止目的である。PHEIC宣言により国際的懸念は最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تحذر من تسارع انتشار فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo warns of accelerating spread of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 71 new confirmed Ebola infections, bringing the total to 452 cases and 82 deaths from the Bundibugyo strain. Most cases are in Ituri province in the northeast (65 new) with six more in North Kivu, the highest daily count since the current outbreak began. Health authorities warn of rapid, ongoing transmission and caution that without strengthened control and surveillance, spread could widen. The World Health Organization has launched a six-month response plan totaling about $518 million to support containment in the DRC and Uganda and to bolster preparedness in neighboring countries for potential imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスの加速する拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、急速な拡大傾向の異常性、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病の確認事例452例（死亡82例）、日次新規感染数の急増、WHO国際対応計画（5.18億ドル）の発動により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダへの潜在的拡大リスク言及があるが、実際の確認事例・死亡例はDRC（イトゥリ州及びキブ州北部）のみ報告されている。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱、日次新規確認数最高記録（65例/日、イトゥリ州）、WHOの大規模国際対応計画発動により、極めて高いリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Suspectés d'Ebola, cinq détenus de la prison de Bunia testés négatifs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five inmates at Bunia prison suspected of Ebola tested negative.
article.articleSummary: Five inmates at Bunia Central Prison in Ituri, initially suspected of Ebola, were declared negative after laboratory analyses on June 5, 2026. Despite the reassuring result, response teams urge strengthening prevention, including establishing an isolation and transit center inside the prison. The detainees had reportedly escaped after transfer to care facilities, raising concern about potential transmission. Prison director Camille Zonzi welcomed the negative results, saying the prison and detainees are healthy and stressing protection to prevent disease entry. The MONUSCO-supported unit for penitentiary administration reports that protective equipment has been provided and awareness sessions are regularly held for inmates and staff. A coordination framework involving the WHO, MONUSCO, and the ICRC is active at Bunia to reinforce prevention and surveillance. Authorities stress continued vigilance to prevent resurgent suspected cases as Ebola remains monitored in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア刑務所の容疑者5人のエボラ感染疑いは陰性と判明
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは高い公衆衛生上の影響を持つが、本事例は疑い例であり陰性が確認されており、確定症例がない。ただし発生地域がイトゥリ州（エボラ監視下にある地域）であり、継続的な監視体制があるため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本件は疑い例が陰性確認された事例であり、確定患者はない。ただしエボラウイルスは既知感染症で、DRC・イトゥリ州は監視強化地域。刑務所環境での感染リスク、容疑者が脱走した可能性、WHO・MONUSCO・ICRCによる継続的な監視体制が確立されている点を考慮し、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: عالمی ادارہ صحت اور افریقی مرکز کاایبولا کے پھیلاؤ سے نمٹنے کے لیے 518 ملین ڈالر کے مشترکہ منصوبے کا آغاز
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Launch of a joint project worth $518 million by the World Health Organization and Africa CDC to combat the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 6 June 2026, the World Health Organization and Africa CDC launched a $518 million joint program to tackle the alarming spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring countries. Running June–November 2026, the strategy centers on six core areas: emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community awareness. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the operational plan specifies immediate, joint actions to contain the outbreak and reduce the risk of further transmission, including cross-border response and rapid detection, to curb Ebola's spread, aimed at strengthening cross-border surveillance, laboratory capacity, and community engagement to prevent exportation.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関とアフリカCDCがエボラの拡大に対処するための5億1800万ドルの共同プロジェクトを開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラは公衆衛生上の最高リスク疾患であり、DRC内での流行拡大と隣接国への越境リスクが明記されており、国際的な対応体制が既に起動している段階。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患は常に最高レベルのリスク評価対象。記事は進行中の流行とその地域的拡大、および国際機関による大規模な対応体制の立ち上げを報告。隣接国への越境リスクが明示されているが、記事サマリー上で具体的な確認事例が記載されているのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго резко выросло число смертей от вируса Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of deaths from the Ebola virus has risen sharply.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a sharp Ebola uptick. A daily bulletin shows total deaths at 82, up 18 from the previous day, and confirmed infections at 452, up 71. Among the new cases, a large share are women. This marks the largest rise in both deaths and cases since the May outbreak began; reasons remain unclear. Health authorities suggest the surge partly reflects improved access to remote areas of Ituri province, the epicenter, including Mahagi district on the Uganda border, where movement had been hindered by rebel groups. The DRC and Uganda officially declared the outbreak on May 15. African Union health services note that, by scale and severity, this outbreak is the fourth recorded since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスによる死亡者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急激な増加、国境を越えた拡大リスク、国際的な渡航制限の可能性）。エボラ出血熱は高リスク病原体であり、死亡者数と確認症例の急増は重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体。記事ではウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、サマリーではDRCでの急増が主題であり、ウガンダでの確認症例は明記されていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Ituri州およびMahagi地区での局地的な流行が拡大中。2026年5月15日の公式宣言以降、18日間で死亡者数18名増、確認症例71名増という急速な拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: "Three returnees from Ebola-hit African countries quarantined in Durg", says Chhattisgarh Health Minister Shyam Jaiswal
article.articleSummary: Three returnees from African countries are quarantined in Durg, Chhattisgarh, as a 21-day precaution; tests have not confirmed Ebola and no symptoms are reported. The state has reinforced hospital and quarantine facilities, and launched a CM public grievance helpline. Central Government advises avoiding non-essential travel to Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan amid Ebola outbreaks in Africa. The WHO, under IHR, declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. In Rajasthan, a suspected Ebola case involving a Ugandan national arriving from Uganda via Sharjah was admitted to RUHS Hospital in Jaipur; she exhibited Ebola-like symptoms. Samples are being sent to a Pune lab for confirmation. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is associated with high mortality; there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments, and India has not reported a confirmed Bundibugyo case.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ出血熱が流行するアフリカ諸国からの帰国者3名がドゥルグで隔離された」とチャッティスガル州保健大臣シャイアム・ジャイスワル氏が述べた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、およびWPRO基準4つ以上該当（異常/予想外、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。WHOが5月17日に国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日にエボラ出血熱の国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。インドではチャッティスガル州ドゥルグでアフリカ帰国者3名を隔離、ラジャスタン州ジャイプルではウガンダ国籍者の疑い例が入院。Bundibugyo株は高い致死率を示す。サンプル検査は進行中で確定はまだ。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ запрашивает 518 миллионов долларов для сдерживания вспышки лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO seeks $518 million to contain the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO and the Africa CDC launched a joint Ebola response plan and are seeking $518 million to contain the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and prevent regional spread (as of June 6, 2026). The plan, built on 'one plan, one budget, one team,' covers incident management, epidemiological surveillance, laboratory investigations, infection prevention, clinical care, community engagement, research, and logistics. Ebola has 397 confirmed cases and 63 deaths, with over 5,000 contacts being monitored. The case fatality rate is estimated at 15.9%. Eleven countries are at risk of spread. Since the May 15 declaration, the outbreak expanded from one province and three health zones to three provinces and 26 affected health zones. The epicenter is Ituri province, responsible for more than 90% of cases and about 70% of deaths. The funding aims to bolster government leadership, population involvement, and international coordination to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱の流行を抑制するため5億1800万ドルの資金を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例397例、死亡63例、11ヶ国への拡大リスク、および国際的な資金・支援要請により、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州を中心）でのエボラ出血熱の流行を主題とする。2026年5月15日の宣言以来、確認症例397例、死亡63例、5,000人以上が監視中。致命率15.9%。11ヶ国への拡大リスク。WHOとアフリカCDCによる合同対応計画が立案され、国際的支援と資金が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola scare: Chhattisgarh 'fully prepared', 3 African nationals isolated
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease scare in India: Chhattisgarh is fully prepared, with three African nationals quarantined in Durg for 21 days as a precaution; tests have not confirmed the virus and they show no symptoms. Hospitals and quarantine facilities are on high alert, and a new Chief Minister’s public grievance helpline has been launched. A national alert follows Ebola outbreaks in Congo and Uganda; the Central Government advises avoiding non-essential travel to Congo, Uganda and South Sudan. The WHO, under the IHR, declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. A suspected case in Rajasthan involves a Ugandan woman arriving from Sharjah to Jaipur, admitted to RUHS Hospital and isolated, with samples sent to Pune for testing. Ebola (Bundibugyo virus strain) has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; India has not reported a confirmed Bundibugyo case.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖症：チャッティスガルは「完全に準備完了」、アフリカ国籍の3人が隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO PAC（2026年5月17日）宣言済み。複数対象国での関連イベント（DRC、Uganda）と国境での疑似症例検出により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言したエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）に関連するイベント。インド国内で複数州（チャッティスガル、ラージャスターン、マハーラーシュトラ）で疑似症例検出。中央政府が流行国（DRC、Uganda、South Sudan）への旅行制限を勧告。現時点で確定症例なし。国家的アラート状態。

article.articleHeadline: "13 مركزًا طبيًا".. كيف تستعد الولايات المتحدة لتفشي فيروس إيبولا؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "13 Medical Centers" ... How is the United States preparing for an Ebola outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Thirteen US government-funded medical centers have pledged readiness to manage highly infectious diseases, including Ebola, amid ongoing Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC).
