WHO reports 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths in the current outbreak, prompting heightened global surveillance. The US states that asymptomatic Americans exposed to Ebola will be quarantined at a facility being built in Kenya to prevent imported cases. The US Department of Health and Human Services says the national medical network is prepared to treat potential cases, citing hundreds of millions of dollars invested to strengthen outbreak response. Participating centers include the University of Nebraska, Emory University (Atlanta), Bellevue Hospital (New York), and Cedars-Sinai Medical Center (Los Angeles); they must treat at least two viral hemorrhagic fever patients and conduct quarterly drills, with labs and PPE readiness. Kenyan facility protests, at least one fatality, and a court halt on construction are noted.

triage.headline_ja: 「13の医療センター」...アメリカ合衆国はエボラウイルスの流行にどのように備えているか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの現在の流行（DRC：344確認症例、60死亡）と米国の国際的対応準備が報告されており、IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCは対象国であり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが米国の複数の州・都市を発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーから実際の流行発生地はDRCであることが明確。米国は準備対応国であり、ケニアの隔離施設が言及されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの現在進行中の流行と米国の国際的対応準備体制が両立する重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: ABD'den Ebola uyarısı: Tarihin en ölümcül seviyesine ulaşabilir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Ebola Warning: Could Reach History's Deadliest Level.
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, Central Africa Ebola outbreak in the Congo region, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with about 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths to date. CDC computer-modeling suggests cases could climb to 10,000–20,000 and deaths potentially exceed 11,000, echoing the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that infected more than 28,000 and killed over 11,000. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo. WHO declared a global health emergency in May 2026. Ongoing violence — fighting between the Congo government, M23 rebels, and ISIS-linked groups — hampers access for health teams, while hundreds of thousands have been displaced, increasing transmission risk. Some officials say rapid case finding and isolation of 50–70% could halve transmission, but security conditions make this difficult. Projections carry uncertainty; past worst-case models overestimated, but risk remains.

triage.headline_ja: 米国からのエボラ警告：歴史上最も致命的なレベルに達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、エボラウイルス病という極めて重篤な感染症で、既に確認症例400件・死亡63名、モデリングでは10,000-20,000症例および11,000死亡以上に拡大する可能性がある。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念であり、フルのRRA評価が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）での発生を主に述べており、Bundibugyo ebolavirus による新興のエボラ流行。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーに明記されていないため除外。安全保障情勢（政府軍とM23反政府勢力、IS関連グループとの衝突）により対応能力が著しく制約されている点も重大な懸念。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の規模に匹敵または超える可能性が指摘されており、緊急対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola khó trở thành đại dịch như Covid-19, Việt Nam vẫn cần cảnh giác
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is unlikely to become a pandemic like COVID-19, and Vietnam still needs to stay vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is unlikely to become a pandemic like COVID-19, but Vietnam remains vigilant. Vietnam has not recorded any Ebola cases. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with blood or body fluids of a symptomatic patient; asymptomatic individuals are not infectious, aiding containment. The highest risk is contact with blood, saliva, vomit, diarrhea, or other fluids; the virus can persist on contaminated clothing and bedding. Early symptoms mimic infections—fever, headache, myalgia, fatigue, sore throat—progressing after few days to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, or bleeding. Individuals with symptoms and a travel history to or from Ebola-affected regions within 21 days should seek medical evaluation. Vaccines exist and monoclonal antibodies improve outcomes. Vietnam’s readiness includes isolation facilities and updated WHO/MOH guidelines; if a first case occurs, responses focus on early detection, isolation, investigation, and surveillance, not panic. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in the Democratic Republic of Congo near Ebola River.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはCOVID-19のようなパンデミックになりにくい、ベトナムは警戒が必要
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの流行可能性に関する予防的警告であり、ベトナムでの実際の確認症例はない。情報提供的な性質が強く、現時点でのIHR基準達成またはフルRRA実施の閾値には達していないが、対象国での警戒体制確認のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムにおけるエボラ対応への警戒体制について論じたもので、現在の感染症イベントではなく予防的情報提供の性質が強い。ベトナムでは確認症例なし。DRCはエボラ初発地に関する歴史的背景言及のためサマリーに含まれているが、現イベントの主題はベトナムの警戒体制であるため verified_locations にはDRCを含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Chhattisgarh Quarantines 3 From Ebola-Hit Africa
article.articleSummary: June 6, 2026: In Chhattisgarh, three returnees from Ebola-hit African countries are quarantined in Durg for 21 days as a precaution; tests have not confirmed the virus and they are asymptomatic so far. Health Minister Shyam Bihari Jaiswal says hospitals and quarantine facilities are prepared, and a CM helpline for public grievance redressal has been launched. In Rajasthan, a Uganda-origin woman in Jaipur, isolated at RUHS Hospital after arriving from Sharjah, is undergoing Ebola testing with samples sent to Pune. The Central Government advises avoiding non-essential travel to Congo, Uganda and South Sudan. WHO on May 17, 2026 declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) due to Ebola in Congo and Uganda. India has no confirmed cases of Ebola Bundibugyo; the virus causes haemorrhagic fever with high mortality, and no vaccines or specific treatments are approved.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガルh州がエボラ感染アフリカ諸国からの帰国者3名を隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニングで異常性・長期曝露・流行可能性が該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みのEbola outbreakに対応する国境検疫事例であり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドにおける国境検疫事例を主題としており、Ebola Bundibugyo outbreakはコンゴとウガンダで発生。WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。インドは確定患者なし（asymptomatic且つ検査未確認）だが、国境検疫と渡航勧告は既に発動されており、国際的な流行対応フェーズ。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。UgandaやSudanはリスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Three individuals isolated in Chhattisgarh's Durg amid Ebola scare
article.articleSummary: Three individuals from African nations were isolated in Durg, Chhattisgarh, for 21 days as a precaution against Ebola; tests have not confirmed infection and they are asymptomatic. The WHO, under IHR, declared the Congo and Uganda Ebola outbreaks a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026. India’s Central Government advises avoiding non-essential travel to Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Ebola disease is caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain, a viral hemorrhagic fever with high mortality; there are no vaccines or specific treatments approved for Bundibugyo Ebola. India has not reported any confirmed case of Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus as of 2026-06-06.

triage.headline_ja: Chhattisgarh州Durg地区でエボラ危機の中、3名が隔離される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRo基準でも流行しやすさと長期曝露について該当するが、インド国内では感染者確認されておらず、隔離された3名も無症状で検査陰性相当のため現時点ではPICKUPに至らず。ただしコンゴ・ウガンダでのPHEIC宣言およびインドの特異的感染リスク監視状況から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はインド（Chhattisgarh州Durg地区での隔離措置）であるが、根本的な流行はコンゴ・ウガンダで発生。インド国内では確認症例なし、隔離者も無症状。Bundibugyo株による高い致死率とワクチン・治療薬の欠如が深刻度を高める。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）の後続事象として注視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Προειδοποιήσεις ΗΠΑ για μεγαλύτερες διαστάσεις Εμπολα στο Κονγκό από ό,τι το 2014
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US warns of a larger Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo than in 2014.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-06, the U.S. Public Health Service warned that, unless aggressive measures are implemented immediately, the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could reach a size comparable to, or larger than, the 2014–2016 epidemic in Africa. The advisory signals heightened concern that transmission could intensify within the DRC, with potential regional implications if not promptly contained. It calls for rapid public health actions to curb spread, including strengthened surveillance, case finding, contact tracing, isolation, and vaccination where available. The report provides no specific case counts, death tolls, or laboratory-confirmed details, nor does it enumerate exact locations within the DRC. The alert underscores the risk of outbreak escalation if response gaps persist, without citing imported or exported-case specifics.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルス感染症の2014年より大規模な流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全てに該当。米国公衆衛生当局による差し迫った警告として、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米国公衆衛生当局の公式警告であり、DRCでのエボラ流行拡大の差し迫ったリスクを警告。2014-2016年の大流行比較による深刻性評価。Bluedot APIが米国を発生地域として列挙しているが、これは警告元国であり、実際の流行地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: ABD'den Ebola uyarısı: Tarihin en ölümcül seviyesine ulaşabilir - ensonhaber.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US Ebola warning: Could reach history's deadliest level - ensonhaber.com
article.articleSummary: Central Africa faces a escalating Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain). U.S. CDC computer-modeling suggests region could soon exceed 10,000–20,000 cases, potentially nearing the deadliest Western Africa era (2014–2016; over 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths). As of now, roughly 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths have been reported, with many infections likely undiagnosed or unreported. The virus transmits via body fluids and currently has no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. The World Health Organization declared a global health emergency last May. Ongoing violence in the Congo, including clashes with Rwanda-backed M23 rebels and ISIS-linked groups, hampers health teams and drives mass displacement, raising transmission risk. Authorities say 50–70% of cases detected and isolated promptly could roughly halve transmission, but conflict makes this difficult. Past models show uncertainty in projections.

triage.headline_ja: 米国からのエボラ警告：歴史上最も致命的なレベルに達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による中央アフリカでの急速な拡大の可能性、重篤な公衆衛生影響（モデル予測で10,000～20,000例まで増加の可能性）、国際的拡大リスク（USCDCによるモデリング、WHOグローバルヘルスエマージェンシー宣言済み）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがすべて該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な発生地は中央アフリカ地域およびコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。ルワンダはM23反政府勢力との紛争による間接的な関連のみ。対象国リスト内ではDRC（203312）のみが実際のエボラ発生地として確認される。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Bundibugyo strain）は既知の株だが、当該地域での拡大リスク評価とUSCDCのモデリング予測は非常に高いリスク水準を示唆している。2014～2016年の西アフリカ流行（28,000例以上、11,000死亡）と比較される可能性について警告あり。WHOグローバルヘルスエマージェンシー宣言済み（昨年5月）。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجل 71 إصابة جديدة بفيروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records 71 new Ebola virus cases
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 71 new confirmed Ebola virus infections in the last 24 hours, bringing the total confirmed cases to 452 since the outbreak of the rare Bundibugyo strain was announced on 15 May. Deaths reached 82 among confirmed cases. The Ministry of Health continues to report and confirm cases, reflecting ongoing transmission within the country as of 6 June 2026. The update highlights laboratory confirmation by national health authorities; however, the brief does not provide geographic details within DR Congo or information on vaccination campaigns or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国が「エボラ」ウイルスの新規感染者71例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の大規模アウトブレイクで、452例の確定患者と82名の死亡が報告されており、重大な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスの中規模アウトブレイク。過去24時間で71例の新規確定患者、累積452例、死亡82例。継続的な国内感染が報告されており、WHO通知対象病疾患（Ebola Virus Disease）として直ちにRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Tropikalne choroby w Polsce są nieuchronne. Chikungunya do nas dotrze
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tropical diseases in Poland are inevitable. Chikungunya will reach us.
article.articleSummary: Climate change could push chikungunya risk northward; by the century’s end Central Europe, Northeast North America, and East Asia are identified as future hotspots. Chikungunya is a virus transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes (Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus) causing fever, joint and muscle pain, headache, fatigue, nausea, and rash; joint symptoms can persist for months or years. Globally, about 33,000 symptomatic cases and 9 deaths were reported in 2026, with most infections in South America; in Europe and North America cases are mainly travel-related. Zhejiang Chinese Medical University and collaborators, in Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology, used tens of thousands of geolocated mosquito and case observations with 16 IPCC climate scenarios. Aedes albopictus drives over 70% of distribution, enabling establishment in temperate zones like Central Europe as temperatures rise. Recommendations: strengthen vector surveillance, train clinicians, and prepare rapid response plans; some tropical regions may see reduced risk under extreme warming.

triage.headline_ja: ポーランドの熱帯病は避けられない。チクングニアが我々に到達する
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアの気候変動に伴う北方への拡大予測に関する記事。現在の中国での報告ケースは限定的だが、将来リスク評価に基づく科学論文。実際の流行発生ではなく、予測研究・警告記事であり、情報不足のため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は気候変動に伴うチクングニアの将来分布拡大を予測する科学研究に基づいた論説記事。2026年の全世界での報告は約33,000症例・9死亡であり、ほとんどが南米での発生。中国（浙江省、上海）での現在の実際の発生・流行報告は明示されていない。チクングニアは蚊媒介感染症であり流行易性は高いが、現段階では具体的な流行事象ではなく予測・警告性の記事。

article.articleHeadline: Fermeture temporaire de 6 structures sanitaires à Bunia après des cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Temporary Closure of Six Health Facilities in Bunia After Cases
article.articleSummary: Six health facilities in Bunia, Ituri, were temporarily closed on Friday, June 5, after suspected Ebola cases were detected, to allow disinfection and curb transmission. Suspected patients were transferred to designated treatment centers, notably Bunia General Reference Hospital and Rwampara. Among the cases are severe ones, with deaths including three doctors. Patients with other conditions received minimal care before being redirected or sent home, reducing Bunia’s capacity to admit patients and raising concerns among pregnant women seeking care. National and provincial health authorities expect most of the affected facilities to reopen in the coming days after completion of disinfection and implementation of prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでの疑い患者発生後、6つの保健施設が一時閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：医療体制の機能不全と死亡者を含む症例、異常/予想外：疑い患者の発生）。WPRO基準でも3つ以上該当（重症度：死亡者を含む、長期曝露：医療機能喪失による住民への持続的影響、流行しやすさ：ヒト-ヒト感染可能性）。エボラの疑い患者検出は重大なシグナルであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患は最優先度の対象疾患。疑い患者の検出、死亡者（医療従事者を含む）、複数施設の一時閉鎖、医療機能の著しい低下が報告されている。国家・州当局が対応中と記載されており、管理可能性への懸念あり。国際的拡大リスクについては現段階で明記されていないが、エボラの特性上、情報の継続監視が必須。

article.articleHeadline: उत्तराखंड में इबोला वायरस को लेकर स्वास्थ्य विभाग हाई अलर्ट पर, अस्पतालों को विशेष निर्देश - uttarakhand health alert almora hospitals vigilant on ebola threat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health department on high alert in Uttarakhand regarding Ebola virus; hospitals given special instructions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease alert issued in Uttarakhand as Congo and Uganda report rising cases. Almora district hospitals and health centers have been instructed to maintain heightened vigilance, with the base hospital’s microbiology laboratory ready to investigate and test suspected cases. No Ebola case has been reported in Almora to date. Ebola virus disease is a severe, often fatal hemorrhagic fever; typical symptoms include sudden high fever, cough, vomiting, extreme weakness, muscle and joint pains, sore throat, diarrhea, and rash, with internal and external bleeding possible in severe cases. Case fatality can exceed 50%. Transmission is by contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects, not airborne. Suspected samples are to be sent to the National Institute of Virology for testing. There is no specific cure; treatment is supportive. Incubation can be up to 21 days; early medical consultation for suspected cases is advised. Dr. Vikrant Negi and Dr. Kamlesh Joshi stress immediate reporting and vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタラーカンド州でエボラウイルスについての健康警報が発令、病院に特別指示が出される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認地域（DRC、ウガンダ）からの国際的な脅威シグナルとして、インド（ウッタラーカンド州）が予防的警戒を強化している。IHR基準3項目該当（異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインド（ウッタラーカンド州アルモラ地区）での警戒態勢強化に焦点。DRCおよびウガンダでの症例増加が背景だが、実際の患者報告はインド域内にはなし。Bluedot APIはDRC（203312）とウガンダ（226074）も抽出しているが、記事の主題はインドの予防的対応であるため、verified_locationsはIndia のみ。エボラの致死率の高さ（>50%）と国際的関心の高さから、PICKUP判定が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Clinic in DR Congo's Ebola epicenter 'overwhelmed' with patients
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to surge, with Bunia's Elikya clinic overwhelmed by patients amid low supplies. The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri province, which Africa CDC says accounts for about 90% of confirmed cases and 76% of deaths across three provinces. WHO reports 381 confirmed cases in the DRC and 64 deaths. The outbreak was declared on 15 May, and authorities say the Bundibugyo strain—the rare form—may have circulated undetected for some time. Health officials describe a rising phase, with new cases arriving continually and limited acceptance of eradication measures by the population. Response includes communication and awareness efforts to curb transmission and end the outbreak. Ebola is transmitted through close contact and bodily fluids and has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ流行中心地のクリニック『患者で溢れかえっている』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生に深刻な影響を与え、国際的拡大リスク及び渡航制限リスクが高い致命的な疾患である。現在進行中の流行で死亡例も報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の現在進行中の流行。Ituri州が約90%の確定患者と76%の死亡者を占める。381確定患者、64死亡（2026-06-06現在）。医療施設は患者で圧倒され、物資不足と住民による対策への協力不足が報告されている。WHO及びAfrica CDCから継続的な監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : à Bunia, une clinique submergée par l'afflux de patients
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: In Bunia, a clinic overwhelmed by the influx of patients.
article.articleSummary: 6 June 2026 update on the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri province after the May 15 declaration. MSF has set up an Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia and is preparing a larger facility as the initial clinic, Clinic Elikya, becomes overwhelmed with patients. Dr. Yazid Yassin, medical director, reports patients exceeding capacity and limited space. Authorities are pushing for greater community engagement to curb transmission amid rumours and distrust surrounding burial practices, with safe/secure burials a point of tension. The WHO and Africa CDC unveiled a joint plan worth $518 million for June–November to combat Ebola. Current data show 321 laboratory-confirmed cases and 48 deaths in the DRC, reflecting an ongoing outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：ブニアの診療所が患者の急増に圧倒される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：321確定例・48死亡、異常性、国際対応・WHO/Africa CDCの共同計画）、またWPRO基準でも複数該当（重症度・死亡あり、ヒト-ヒト感染、医療体制への圧迫）。フルRRAの実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年6月6日時点のデータ。DRC内Ituri州ブニアが震源地。MSFによる治療センター設置、WHO・Africa CDC共同計画（5億1800万ドル、6月～11月）が発表されている。社会的要因として埋葬慣行への不信・うわさが伝播リスクとなっており、社会動員の必要性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ανησυχία για τον Έμπολα: "Η επιδημία μπορεί να γίνει χειρότερη από αυτή του 2014 με τους 11.000 νεκρούς"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern about Ebola: "The outbreak could be worse than the 2014 outbreak, with 11,000 deaths."
article.articleSummary: US CDC warns that the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could reach a size comparable to, or larger than, the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic unless stringent measures are rapidly implemented. Jason Asher, head of the CDC’s Division of Epidemic Prediction and Analysis, urged urgent actions to slow transmission and prevent the outbreak from attaining that scale. The 2014–2016 outbreak, the worst in history, began in Guinea and spread across West Africa, leaving more than 11,000 deaths according to the World Health Organization. The article emphasizes the risk of explosive growth if containment fails, highlighting the potential for a similar or greater impact. Published 2026-06-06.

triage.headline_ja: エボラへの懸念：「現在の流行は11,000人以上の死亡者を出した2014年の流行より悪くなる可能性がある」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模化リスク、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い重症度と致命率を有し、2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行規模以上の脅威が指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国での現在のエボラ流行が主題であり、CDCが11,000人死亡の2014-2016年西アフリカ流行以上の規模への警告を発している。United States、Guinea、Angolaは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、サマリーの主要な流行地は対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。米国CDCの警告は情報源の所在地であり、実際の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: UP में इबोला वायरस की दस्तक? विदेश से लौटे 95 लोगों की लिस्ट तैयार, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus makes its presence felt in Uttar Pradesh? List of 95 returnees from abroad prepared; Health Department on alert.
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert in Uttar Pradesh, India, as 95 travelers returning from abroad are placed under special surveillance; two returnees—one from Saltowa Block, Basti district (a 22-year-old businessman who flew from Dhaka to Delhi), and another from Baghouli Block, Sant Kabir Nagar district (a migrant who worked in Entebbe, Uganda and returned via Mumbai)—have been placed in home quarantine to curb any potential transmission. Health authorities are monitoring these individuals and coordinating alerts between districts. Globally, the WHO, with Africa CDC, has launched a six-month emergency plan from June to November with a budget of $518 million to fight rising Ebola transmission. In Congo, the 17th Ebola outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain; to date, 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths have been reported, and WHO has declared it an international public health emergency of concern, noting no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州でエボラウイルスの警戒が高まる？海外から帰国した95人のリストが作成され、保健部門がアラート
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当、社会的・政治的関心あり。コンゴでのエボラ流行が公式にPHEICとなっており、インドでの疑似症例発生は重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: コンゴでのエボラ爆発（PHEC宣言済み、Bundibugyo株、381確定例62死亡）に対応して、インドで海外帰国者（ウガンダ経由が含まれる）から疑似症例が報告されたもの。国際的な感染伝播リスクが現実化している段階。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемија еболе у Централној Африци прети да постане највећа до сада
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola Epidemic in Central Africa Threatens to Become the Largest to Date.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Central Africa could become the largest on record. There are no approved vaccines or specific therapies. The WHO unveiled a six-month plan worth $518 million to curb spread in the DRC and Uganda, and to prepare neighboring states. In the DRC, 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths have been reported; 71 new cases were confirmed in one day, signaling rapid spread. The outbreak is centered in Ituri, with cases in North and South Kivu and across the border in Uganda. CDC models warn that, without rapid detection and isolation, total cases could reach up to 20,000. Conflict in eastern DRC, displacement, and distrust of medical teams hinder response, with some patients leaving treatment centers. The worst Ebola outbreak to date was West Africa 2014–2016, with over 28,600 cases and 11,325 deaths; the outbreak may have started in January but was detected in May.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ流行が過去最大となる脅威
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の大規模流行で、DRC と Uganda で数百の確定症例と死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak is centered in DRC (Ituri, North/South Kivu provinces) with cross-border cases in Uganda (not a target country). CDC models warn of up to 20,000 cases without rapid intervention. Conflict, displacement, and medical distrust complicate response. WHO mobilized $518 million 6-month plan. This is a major humanitarian emergency requiring immediate international coordination.

article.articleHeadline: ΗΠΑ Προειδοποιεί για μεγαλύτερες διαστάσεις Έμπολα στο Κονγκό από του 2014
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Warns of a Larger Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Since 2014
article.articleSummary: On 6 June 2026, the U.S. CDC warned that without aggressive measures the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could reach or exceed the size of the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that began in Guinea. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, a rarer form with no specific treatment or vaccine, unlike the Zaïre (Zaire) strain which has a vaccine. WHO's latest bulletin confirms 381 laboratory-confirmed cases in the DRC with 64 deaths; across the northeast border in Uganda there are 16 cases and 1 death, with seven recoveries in the DRC and two in Uganda. Ebola has killed about 15,000 in Africa over 50 years; the deadliest outbreak in the DRC (2018–2020) caused ~2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases. CDC modeling aims to guide preparedness and response.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の大規模流行を警告 - 2014年以来の規模の可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模化、国境を越えた拡大、国際的な渡航・貿易制限リスクがある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギヨウイルス株）の流行で、381例の確認症例と64例の死亡が報告されている。隣国ウガンダでも16例1死亡が確認されている。CDCが2014-2016年の西アフリカエボラ流行（約15,000人死亡）の規模に達する可能性を警告しており、国際的なWHO通知の必須基準を十分に満たしている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当対象国であるためverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Apokaliptični scenarij v Kongu! V zgolj 24 urah čez 70 novih okužb s smrtonosnim virusom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Apocalyptic scenario in the Congo! In just 24 hours, over 70 new infections with a deadly virus.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 71 new Ebola infections were confirmed in the last 24 hours, as of 6 June 2026. Since 15 May, when the outbreak of the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain was declared, total confirmed cases have reached 452 with 82 deaths. Authorities also report over 200 suspected deaths and more than 850 probable infections, concentrated mainly in Ituri province in the northeast, a remote region with weak health infrastructure and armed conflict. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting the outbreak is already the fourth-largest on record. A six-month, $518 million response plan was announced, with the United States pledging about $38 million in new funding, bringing its total to over $200 million. Exposed but asymptomatic U.S. citizens will be quarantined in Kenya, where a facility is under construction. No licensed vaccine or targeted therapy exists; some experimental vaccines are in development. MSF warns of logistical hurdles and the need for rapid testing to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの黙示録的シナリオ！わずか24時間で70以上の致命的ウイルス感染が新たに報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスの大規模集団発生（確定452例、死亡82例、疑い例850以上）、WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern宣言、国際的な資金動員（米国等）と支援体制構築（ケニアの隔離施設）が進行中。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは米国とケニアも発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（Ituri州）での発生である。米国は隔離施設支援国、ケニアは隔離受け入れ国として言及されているが、感染イベントの実発生地はDRCのみ。PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain（稀な株）、ワクチン・治療薬なし、武装勢力との共存地域という複合リスク要因あり。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Journalisten tar kamp mot ebola med radioprogram
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The journalist takes up the fight against Ebola with a radio program.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kongo-Kinshasa region) hampered by skepticism, attacks on health workers, and misinformation. Local journalist Verité Johnson, based in Ituri Province where the outbreak is worst, launches a daily 45‑minute radio program about Ebola to counter misinformation and educate the public. The show reinforces the dangers of Ebola and how to protect oneself, and invites listeners to call in with questions for experts. AP notes that distrust remains and media plays a crucial role in outbreak response. The initiative provides a channel for rapid information and may help improve protective behaviors amid the ongoing epidemic as of 2026-06-06.

triage.headline_ja: ジャーナリストがラジオ番組でエボラ対策に取り組む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の課題対応、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、管理困難性）。現在進行中の流行により社会的・政治的関心が継続。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月時点でDRCでのエボラ流行が継続していること、保健システムへの信頼欠如と誤情報が大きな課題であることを示唆。ジャーナリスト主導の情報対抗措置は流行対応の複雑性を反映。Ituri Province での最悪の発生状況が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: 34 petugas kesihatan dijangkiti ebola, 7 maut - Africa CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 34 health workers infected with Ebola, 7 dead - Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, Africa CDC and WHO report 397 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases: 381 in the Democratic Republic of Congo and 16 in Uganda, with 63 deaths (including one in Uganda). Eight recoveries discharged (six in DRC, two in Uganda). The Ituri region in eastern DRC now accounts for about 90% of confirmed cases and 76% of deaths. President Felix Tshisekedi appointed Kasongo Mulumba Batoka Gaby as the new military governor of Ituri to bolster control measures. The outbreak faces challenges including limited treatment options for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, weak health infrastructure, and strain on health systems, plus infections among health workers, high population mobility, security and displacement issues, misinformation, and distrust. Africa CDC and WHO launched a continental Ebola preparedness and response plan targeting US$518 million for June–November to enhance detection, coordination, and rapid response.

triage.headline_ja: 34人の医療従事者がエボラに感染、7人が死亡 - Africa CDC
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスによる継続的な多国間での確認症例・死亡・医療従事者感染があり、WHO・Africa CDCが大規模な対応計画を立案している。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが、WPRO対象国リストに該当しないため除外。記事サマリーからDRC（特にイトゥリ地域）が主要な発生地であることが確認される。医療従事者感染34人、死亡7人の報告あり。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の限定的な治療オプション、弱い保健インフラ、セキュリティ問題など管理上の課題が複数存在。WHO・Africa CDCが5.18億米ドルの大規模対応計画を策定中。

article.articleHeadline: US warns Ebola outbreak on scale of largest 'is possible'
article.articleSummary: CDC models indicate the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda could reach scales similar to the 2014 West Africa epidemic if public health interventions are not strong. Four intervention scenarios span 20–95% isolation/treatment; under poor isolation with no other measures, there is a 65% chance cases exceed 20,000 within three months. The outbreak was declared May 15 in northeastern DRC; the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus is believed to have circulated earlier. As of now, 381 confirmed DRC cases and 64 deaths; three provinces affected, Ituri epicenter with about 90% of cases and 76% of deaths. Uganda reports 16 confirmed cases and 1 death; seven DRC and two Uganda patients recovered. WHO/African Union call for $518 million over six months to fight the outbreak. Public health response may need to match 2014–2016 effort; model is a planning tool, not a forecast.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の感染拡大が過去最大規模に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認事例増加、死亡事例、複数国への拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、および公開衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUgandaと Angola が含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは確認事例と死亡事例が記載されている（16例、1死亡）。ただし、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。記事は2026年6月の仮想データと思われるが、エボラ出血熱・複数国への拡大・高死亡率・モデル予測に基づく深刻な警告という要素から、フルRRA対象として判定。

article.articleHeadline: Traders face big losses after Uganda closes Congo border over Ebola contagion fears
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-06, Uganda closed the Congo border at Mpondwe amid Ebola contagion fears, freezing cross-border movement and immobilizing a long convoy of trucks on both sides of the Uganda-Congo frontier. Ugandan trader Leah Masika described mounting losses as her consignment of plantains destined for Uganda leaked water and risked spoiling within hours if movement did not resume. Authorities prevented trucks from entering or leaving Uganda as part of escalating measures aimed at preventing cross-border Ebola spread. The border shutdown underscores the economic impact of outbreak-related controls, with traders facing stalled shipments, damaged cargo, and lost income while waits for clearance extend. The article documents containment measures and trader hardship.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがコンゴ国境を閉鎖、エボラ感染懸念により商人が大きな損失に直面
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク（DRC-ウガンダ間の国境閉鎖）、異常・予想外の事象、かつ国家レベルの対応（国境閉鎖）が発生しており、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する可能性が高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダの国境閉鎖に焦点を当てているが、エボラの実際の発生地はDRC（モンドウェ地域を含む）であり、ウガンダはここでは対応国である。発生地域フィールドにはウガンダも含まれるが、サマリー上でエボラ感染イベント自体の発生国はDRCであることから、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。国境の経済的影響と感染防止対策の急速な実施が報告されており、エボラの国際的拡大リスク（DRC→ウガンダへの越境）が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Current Ebola outbreak could match deadly 2014 scale, US warns
article.articleSummary: Current Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) could reach the scale of the 2014 West Africa epidemic, according to US CDC projections cited in Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report. The DRC outbreak, declared May 15, involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare species, with 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths reported across three provinces, centered in Ituri which accounts for about 90% of cases and 76% of deaths. Cross-border transmission to Uganda has produced 16 confirmed cases, including one death; seven recovered in DRC and two in Uganda. The CDC emphasizes that these figures depend on public health actions; models consider four intervention scenarios with isolation/treatment ranging from 20% to 95%. In parallel, WHO and Africa Union request about $518 million for six months to combat the outbreak in DRC and neighboring regions. The agency notes that isolation and treatment adherence will shape outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 現在のエボラ出血熱の流行は2014年の致命的規模に達する可能性があるとアメリカが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威であり、稀な亜種（Bundibugyo）による流行で既に国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境伝播）が発生し、2014年の西アフリカ流行規模に達する可能性が示唆されている。
triage.notes: DRC東北部イトゥリ州を中心とした流行で、ウガンダへの越境伝播が確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。WHO・アフリカ連合が6ヶ月間で5億1800万ドルの支援要請中。隔離と治療の遵守が転帰を左右する。

article.articleHeadline: بعد تسجيل إصابات جديدة.. الكونغو تحذر من انتشار سريع لإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Warns of Rapid Ebola Spread After New Infections.
article.articleSummary: DRC reports 71 new Ebola infections in 24 hours, raising total confirmed cases to 452 and deaths to 82 as of June 6, 2026. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo strain, first announced on May 15. Cases remain largely in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, a remote area with weak health infrastructure and security challenges. The daily Ministry of Health report warns of rapid spread among the population, underscoring ongoing transmission and the difficulties of containment in conflict-affected settings.

triage.headline_ja: 新規感染確認後、コンゴがエボラの急速な拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の活発な流行で高い公衆衛生上の危険性、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性を認める。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の活発な流行事案。24時間で71例の新規感染、累計確認症例452例、死亡82例。稀なBundibugyo株による流行で2026年5月15日に初報告。紛争地域である北東部Ituri州での感染が大多数で、脆弱な保健インフラと治安上の課題が制御困難性を示唆。WHOへの通知基準を満たし、早期のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola scare in India: Three African nationals quarantined for 21-days in Chhattisgarh's Durg
article.articleSummary: Three African nationals were quarantined for 21 days in Durg, Chhattisgarh, amid an Ebola scare after a surge of cases in Africa; tests so far have not confirmed infection and none of the individuals are showing symptoms. State health minister Shyam Bihari Jaiswal said hospitals and quarantine facilities are on alert and that the precautionary isolation is routine while surveillance continues. The move follows a Ugandan woman isolated in Bengaluru who was tested after arriving May 23 from Uganda, with samples collected for testing. The WHO on May 17 classified the Uganda- and DRC-linked Ebola outbreaks as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). India has not reported a confirmed case of Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo strain. The Centre advised avoiding non-essential travel to Congo, Uganda and South Sudan. Rajasthan reported a suspected case in a Ugandan national arriving from Sharjah, under hospital isolation pending results. Chhattisgarh CM helpline launched to bolster public grievances.

triage.headline_ja: インドでのエボラ懸念：チャッティスガル州ドゥルグでアフリカ国籍3人が21日間隔離
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、WHO PHEIC指定という要件を満たす。インドでの複数地域での隔離・疑似患者発生は異常かつ予想外であり、IHR基準3項目以上、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、インドのチャッティスガル州ドゥルグとラージャスターン州での隔離事例、ベンガルールでのウガンダ女性の疑似患者が報告されており、インドが主要な対象国である。DRCとウガンダはエボラ流行国として記事中で言及されており、WHOは2026年5月17日にウガンダおよびDRC関連のエボラアウトブレイクをPHEIC指定している。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはアラブ首長国連邦やスーダンも含まれているが、記事サマリーでは明示的にこれらの国での患者発生は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Globális vészhelyzet: a Kongóban tomboló ebolajárvány minden korábbinál súlyosabb lehet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global emergency: the Ebola outbreak raging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be more severe than ever.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak could be more severe than ever, according to CDC’s Ebola response chief Dr. Satish Pillai, who warns that without strong public health measures the current epidemic might reach dimensions seen in past crises. Jennifer Nuzzo, director of Brown University’s Pandemic Center, says models reinforce earlier concerns, but outbreak trajectories are hard to predict and numbers should be treated cautiously, per The Guardian. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no targeted treatment or licensed vaccine at present. Ebola transmission occurs via infected bodily fluids, such as blood or vomit, and the disease is often fatal. The article notes ongoing monitoring, but provides no specific case or death counts or details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: グローバルな緊急事態：コンゴ民主共和国で蔓延するエボラアウトブレイクは過去のいかなる時期よりも深刻となる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当する高リスクシグナル。エボラウイルス疾患は極めて重篤で致死率が高く、DRCでの大規模流行は国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威となる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクに焦点を当てており、アメリカはCDC専門家のコメントソースとしてのみ言及されている。実際の発生地域はDRCであることを確認。Bundibugyo virus による感染症で、ワクチンや標的治療法がない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Puluhan IRT di Salatiga Terjangkit HIV AIDS 2026 Data SIHA Ungkap Pemicunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of IRT in Salatiga Infected with HIV/AIDS; 2026 SIHA data reveal the culprits.
article.articleSummary: Salatiga, Central Java, Indonesia reports ongoing HIV/AIDS concerns per SIHA data through April 2026: 44 HIV+ cases among housewives (Ibu Rumah Tangga) and 41 among students/residents. Cumulative ODHIV stands at 466 as of April 2026, placing Salatiga 23rd in Central Java behind Semarang and Surakarta. Transmission is predominantly from partners; husbands’ risk behaviors—multiple sexual partners and injection drug use—and gender inequality limiting women’s ability to negotiate testing or protection are key drivers. Government response emphasizes collaboration among the Health Office (DKK), the Department for Women, Children, Population and Family Planning (DP3APPKB), and the AIDS Control Commission (KPA), with expanded screening and mass education to interrupt transmission and reduce stigma. Residents are urged to seek testing promptly to improve outcomes with ongoing treatment. Data reflect ongoing exposure risk rather than individual behavioral fault, underscoring public health measures focused on screening, education, and stigma reduction.

triage.headline_ja: サラティガの何十人もの主婦がHIV/AIDSに感染；2026年SIHAデータが原因を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）でHIV感染報告であり異常性・重症度が認められるが、イベントは継続的な公衆衛生課題であり新興感染症アウトブレイクではない。情報不足のため経過観察に値する。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年の日付を持つ将来のデータであり、実際のイベント時系列の確認が必要。HIV/AIDSは進行中の慢性疾患であり、急性アウトブレイクではないが、特定集団（主婦）への感染拡大は異常性がある。性的接触による水平感染とジェンダー不平等が主な駆動要因として記載されており、国家公衆衛生対応が既に展開中。フルRRA前に記事の日付妥当性と統計の確実性を検証すべき。

article.articleHeadline: ইবোলা পরিসংখ্যানে আশার আলো কঙ্গোতে! বিপদ কাটেনি, সতর্ক করছেন বিশেষজ্ঞরা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A glimmer of hope in Ebola statistics in Congo! The danger isn't over, experts warn.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, Ebola virus disease outbreaks persist in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda. In DRC, 380 infections and 60 deaths are reported; Uganda has 15 infections and 1 death. Ituri province shows multiple confirmed and suspected infections and deaths, while Kampala reports separate, unlinked cases. Earlier claims of over 1,000 symptomatic cases are contrasted by current emphasis on confirmed diagnoses; physicians note a rough drop to about 250 symptomatic cases, but danger remains. Only about 45% of exposed contacts have been traced, raising the risk of undetected transmission as many fever cases were later found to be malaria. The cross-border region remains volatile, with conflict and weak health systems increasing the likelihood of unnoticed spread. WHO remains cautious and urges continued surveillance and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ統計に希望の光！危機は去らず、専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱とマラリアの複合感染症イベントが確認され、IHR基準において「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「国際的拡大リスク（DRC-ウガンダ国境）」「異常性」が該当。WPROスクリーニングでも「重症度」「流行のしやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当し、WHO警告も発せられており、シグナルとしてのピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラとマラリアの複合発生がDRC（特にIturi州）で確認されている。ウガンダ（Kampala）でも別の関連のないエボラ症例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを含める。接触追跡率が45%と低く、未検出の感染拡大リスクが高い。国境地域の紛争と脆弱な保健システムが懸念される。WHO警告により社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: La course au vaccin contre l'Ebola Bundibugyo s'accélère ( le Point Santé )
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The race for a Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine accelerates.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease remains the main health emergency in the DRC and Uganda, with 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths as of early June 2026; 233 patients are in isolation. The Ituri province is the epicenter (359 cases across 17 health zones), with additional cases in Nord-Kivu (19) and Sud-Kivu (3); Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, including Kampala and Wakiso. This is the third-largest Ebola outbreak ever, and Bundibugyo lacks an approved vaccine or treatment. In malaria, the RTS,S/AS01 Mosquirix vaccine is reported to reduce under-5 mortality in African settings, bolstering vaccination goals. Cholera is resurging in sub-Saharan Africa: Angola reports 2,120 new cases by May end, Mozambique 413, and DRC 115 deaths; Angola plans a $500 million, five-year elimination plan for 2030. HIV: South Africa launches lenacapavir PrEP; 37,920 doses across 360 facilities; US aid cuts cut PrEP initiations by over 40%.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョエボラウイルス感染症ワクチン開発競争が加速（保健ポイント）
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョエボラウイルス病は DRC およびウガンダで確認された重大な公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。また WPRO スクリーニング基準では「重症度」「流行可能性」「管理可能性」が複数該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラウイルス病は過去3番目の大規模アウトブレイク（381確認症例、64死亡）。ウガンダへの越境感染（19症例、2死亡）も確認されており、国際的拡大のリスクが明確。Ituri 州が震源地（359症例）で、Nord-Kivu および Sud-Kivu にも波及。ワクチン・治療法が未承認の状況下での急速な拡大は管理可能性に懸念あり。また記事では同時にマラリア、コレラ、HIV も扱われているが、ブンディブギョエボラウイルス病がメイン主題。

article.articleHeadline: 世衛啟動超5億美元埃博拉疫情防控計劃 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO launches more than $500 million Ebola outbreak prevention and control plan | Telecom.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC launched a $518 million Ebola outbreak prevention and control plan to address Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Announced June 5 during an online briefing, the plan aims to raise $518 million from June to November 2026 to strengthen national preparedness, rapid detection, and response. The DRC health ministry reports as of June 4 cumulative Ebola cases at 452 with 82 deaths, with rapid community transmission ongoing. There are 258 patients in isolation or hospital care, with 8 recoveries. Africa CDC notes the outbreak places heavy strain on frontline health workers; as of June 3, 34 health workers infected, 7 deaths, 6 recoveries. The initiative seeks to unite African actions, support affected countries, and protect neighboring regions from further spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行対策に5億ドル超の資金計画を立ち上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された流行であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCおよびウガンダでの活発な感染伝播と死亡例の報告。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際の流行発生地はDRCとウガンダ（対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため未掲載）。DRCでの452例・82死亡、ウガンダでも確認。複数国での感染伝播と医療従事者への感染リスクが報告されている。ベンディブギオウイルス種による流行。WHO・Africa CDCによる国際的な対応計画が立案されている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Cases Jump as CDC Warns Outbreak Could Be Among Largest Ever
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensified as of 2026-06-06, with health authorities reporting 71 new cases in a single day and 21 additional deaths as testing expands in the mining town thought to be the outbreak’s origin. Officials caution the epidemic may be far larger than previously understood, a warning echoed by the CDC that the outbreak could rank among the largest on record. The surge in confirmed infections comes amid intensified surveillance and expanded laboratory testing in the affected area. The mining town remains the epicenter under investigation, with authorities focused on containment, case finding, and rapid isolation to stem transmission. No details are given about laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or imported/exported cases in the available report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例が急増、CDCが過去最大級の流行になる可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（重症度・長期曝露・流行性・管理可能性）、且つ社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行。1日71症例、21死亡が報告され、CDCが過去最大級の流行となる可能性を警告。鉱業町が震源地とされ、拡大検査が実施されている。国際的な懸念と支援の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Australia Serahkan 5 Juta Dolar untuk Bendung Penyebaran Virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Australia Donates $5 Million to Curb the Spread of the Ebola Virus.
article.articleSummary: Australia commits about 3.6 million USD (5 million AUD) to curb the Ebola virus outbreak in Central Africa and prevent further spread. The pledge, announced by Foreign Minister Penny Wong and International Development Minister Anne Aly, will be channeled through the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies and the World Health Organization. The funding will fund patient care and vital medical supplies, as well as water and sanitation services, and support surveillance and preparedness efforts to strengthen local health systems. According to the WHO, the current outbreak includes 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and 15 cases and one death in Uganda. The assistance underscores regional efforts to contain the virus and prevent cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリア、エボラウイルスの拡大を防ぐために500万ドルを提供
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において「公衆衛生への影響は深刻」「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の3つが該当。エボラ出血熱の確認患者344例、死亡60例という深刻な状況下での国際支援であり、フルRRA進行の必要あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ発生の主体はコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダの中央アフリカであることが確認される。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。オーストラリアからの国際支援表明は発生国ではなく支援国であるため除外。現在進行形の急速な感染拡大と国境越境感染リスク、および複数国での確認死亡例があることから、IHR基準3つ以上かつWPRO基準5つ全て該当し、社会政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Uzmanlardan korkutan 'ölümcül salgın' uyarısı: 'Vaka sayısı 20 bine yükselebilir'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming warning from experts about a 'deadly epidemic': 'The number of cases could rise to 20,000'.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in Central Africa's Democratic Republic of the Congo has grown to about 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths; real counts may be higher. CDC modeling indicates the case load could reach 10,000 to 20,000 in the near term, underlining potential severity comparable to the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic. There is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo virus disease, increasing risk if rapid isolation and detection are not scaled up. The World Health Organization had declared a global health emergency in May, but access for health teams is severely constrained by ongoing conflict, with the Congolese government fighting M23 rebels and ISIS-linked attacks. Health experts warn the outbreak could escape control without swift, strong interventions, though models carry uncertainties.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家からの不安な警告「致命的な流行」：「患者数は2万人まで増加する可能性がある」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の急速な流行拡大、高い致死率、WHO による公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、国際的な支援必要性が確認される。フルRRAに進むべき重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）での Bundibugyo virus エボラ型ウイルスの流行を主題としている。Bluedot API が Angola を発生地域に含めているが、サマリー本文には Angola での発生の記載がないため除外した。DRC は対象国リストに含まれる。WHO が5月に公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。武装紛争による医療アクセス制限、ワクチン・特異的治療法の欠如などにより管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: САД со дополнителни 38 милиони долари за борбата против епидемијата со ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. adds $38 million to fight the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: The United States approved about $38 million in additional funding to fight Ebola, bringing direct U.S. aid to over $200 million. The State Department said the CDC will coordinate with authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda to deliver a rapid, comprehensive response to the Ebola outbreak. The World Health Organization reports 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The State Department also announced that U.S. citizens exposed to the virus but asymptomatic will be quarantined in Kenya at a special facility being built by the United States. The funding and measures aim to strengthen surveillance, containment, and international cooperation to curb transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行対策に米国が追加で3,800万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確定患者344例・死亡60例が報告され、複数国での発生と米国による大規模な資金拠出により国際的な政治的関心が極めて高い。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主に報告されているのはDRC内でのエボラ流行（344確定患者、60死亡）。Ugandaは「当局との調整」対象として言及されているが、ウガンダでの患者発生の記載がないため除外。Kenyaは米国が無症状者隔離施設を建設予定の場所として言及されるのみであり、流行発生地としては記載されていないため除外。米国はドナー国として資金提供主体であり、発生地ではないため除外。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当するため verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, registrati 71 nuovi casi in Repubblica del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 71 new cases registered in the Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 71 new confirmed Ebola cases were reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo over the last 24 hours, linked to an outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo lineage, a rare Ebola strain. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, total confirmed cases reached 452, with 82 reported deaths to date. The data come from the Congolese Ministry of Health and reflect ongoing transmission within the affected region as of 2026-06-06. The report notes laboratory-confirmed cases; no further details on symptoms, transmission setting, or infection sources are provided. No information on imported or exported cases is included. This update underscores sustained spread of the Bundibugyo strain in the DRC and the need for continued surveillance and public health response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国で71件の新規症例が登録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo系統）の確認症例452件、死亡82件という深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀な系統による予想外の発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確に認められるため、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統は稀なエボラ系統であり、通常の注視対象であるザイール系統ではない点に注目。過去24時間で71件の新規確認症例、累積452確認症例、82死亡という急速な拡大。継続的な接触者追跡と監視体制の強化が必須。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تُحذّر من انتشار سريع لـ"إيبولا".. وتسجيل 71 إصابة جديدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo warns of rapid spread of Ebola, with 71 new cases recorded.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda: 71 new cases confirmed in the last 24 hours, 65 in Ituri and 6 in North Kivu, bringing total confirmed infections to 452 with 82 deaths since the Bundibugyo strain was identified on May 15. Ituri and North Kivu account for the majority, indicating rapid spread among residents in the northeast DRC amid security and health-system challenges; Uganda also reports confirmed cases. The World Health Organization, joined by Africa CDC, announced a six-month plan costing $518 million to curb the outbreak, calling for funding and political commitment to stop transmission. The plan aims to help DRC and Uganda contain the outbreak and prepare other countries for potential cases through enhanced surveillance and border testing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラの急速な拡大に警告、71の新規感染者を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当するエボラアウトブレイク。DRC・ウガンダで確認、短期間での大幅な感染者増加（71症例/24時間、82死亡）、国際的拡大リスク、WHOが518百万ドル規模の対応計画を発表する深刻な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでも確認されたと述べているが、ウガンダ(id:226074)は評価対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。エボラは高い致死率と人間-人間感染特性を持つ病原体であり、IHR・WPROスクリーニング基準の全項目に該当する最高リスク象徴イベント。WHOおよびAfrica CDCの公式対応計画発表により、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱境外移入+1！今年累計65例 高雄本土個案監測至6/23
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Imported dengue fever case +1! This year's cumulative total 65 cases; Kaohsiung local cases under surveillance as of 6/23.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports 1 new dengue fever case imported from Indonesia, bringing the year-to-date total to 65 cases: 64 imported and 1 locally acquired in Kaohsiung City (Qianzhen District) involving a man in his 60s who developed fever, headache and myalgia on May 23. NS1 rapid test and PCR confirmed Dengue virus serotype 1; local case under monitoring through June 23. Among imported cases, Indonesia accounts for 20, the highest source, with overall imported 64 cases from Southeast and South Asia (Maldives 14, Vietnam 8). Year-to-date 2026 totals exceed 2022 (2) and 2023 (43) but are below 2024 (263) and 2025 (70). As Taiwan enters the monsoon season, heightened rainfall favors Aedes aegypti breeding; authorities urge community actions:巡、倒、清、刷 to remove stagnant water containers, discard abandoned items, and weekly wash of water storage vessels. Travelers with fever should report travel history to clinicians and airports; TOCC questions should be asked. Keywords: dengue, Taiwan, Kaohsiung, imported cases, monsoon, mosquito control.

triage.headline_ja: 登革熱境外移入+1！今年累計65例 高雄本土個案監測至6/23
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での輸入デング熱事例（64例）と局所獲得事例（1例）が報告されているが、対象国リストに台湾は含まれていない。ベトナムとインドネシアでの発生が言及されているものの、記事の主題は台湾での事例集計であり、対象国の直接的な発生イベントではない。情報不足のため経過観察段階での判定。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾でのデング熱事例の集計報告であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていない。ただしベトナムとインドネシアがデング熱の輸入源として言及されているため、これらを verified_locations に含める。モンスーン時期の蚊媒介感染症の流行可能性は注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Three returnees from Ebola-hit African countries quarantined in Durg: Chhattisgarh Health Minister Shyam Jaiswal
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, three returnees from African countries were quarantined in Durg, Chhattisgarh, as a precaution amid Ebola outbreaks in Africa. They were isolated for 21 days; tests have not confirmed Ebola and they show no symptoms. Health Minister Shyam Bihari Jaiswal stated that hospitals and quarantine facilities are prepared, and a CM public grievance helpline was launched. The Central Government advised avoiding non-essential travel to Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan, as the WHO declared the Ebola situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 17 May 2026. In Rajasthan, a suspected Ebola case—an Ugandan national arriving from Sharjah to Jaipur—prompted isolation with samples sent to a Pune laboratory; no India-confirmed Ebola cases from the Bundibugyo virus strain have been reported. Ebola disease is caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain; there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行地域からの帰国者3名がチャッティスガル州ドゥルグで隔離：チャッティスガル州保健相シャイアム・ジャイスワル
triage.triage_reason: インドでエボラ疑い患者が確認され、アフリカでのエボラPHEIC宣言を受けた国際的な関心事案。IHR基準2項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、インド国内（ラジャスタン州ジャイプール、チャッティスガル州ドゥルグ）でエボラ疑い患者および検査対象者の隔離が実施されている。アフリカではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンで流行が確認されており、WHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）を発表している。記事の主題はインドへのリスク拡大にあるため、verified_locationsはインドとDRCのみを列挙。

article.articleHeadline: В ДРК число подтвержденных случаев заражения Эболой возросло до 452
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the number of confirmed Ebola cases has risen to 452.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 6 June — Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have risen to 452, with 82 deaths. The latest ministerial report notes 71 new confirmed cases on 4 June in Ituri and North Kivu, including 21 deaths, indicating rapid, ongoing local transmission of the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. A total of 258 patients are in isolation or hospital care, with eight recoveries. Contact tracing remains a major bottleneck: of 4,766 contacts under observation across three provinces, only 2,755 (57.8%) have been examined. The Ministry highlights key challenges: reluctance to collect post-mortem swabs, insufficient standardized Ebola treatment capacity, ineffective contact tracing, shortages of essential medicines and infection-prevention supplies in North Kivu, weak alert systems, and a funding gap of $21.5 million.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確定症例が452例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な増加、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。エボラは国際保健上の最重要脅威。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の急速な地域内伝播が進行中。452例82死亡（致命率18.1%）。接触者追跡の不十分性（57.8%のみ検査）、資金不足（$21.5百万）、医療体制の脆弱性が主要課題。DRCはシグナル対象国であり、フルRRA実施の優先度は最高。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: कांगो में इबोला का प्रकोप तेज, 452 मामलों की पुष्टि और 82 लोगों की मौत; WHO ने जारी किया अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak: In Congo, the Ebola outbreak is accelerating, 452 cases confirmed and 82 deaths; WHO has issued a warning.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak accelerates: 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of June 6, with Ituri and North Kivu provinces reporting a surge (71 new cases, 21 deaths) on June 4. Bundibugyo strain driving rapid community transmission; Uganda has 19 total cases after 3 new infections. About 258 patients are in isolation; 8 recoveries reported. Contact tracing is weak: of 4,766 identified contacts across three provinces, 2,755 have been followed up (57.8%). Challenges include resistance to post-mortem swabbing, shortages of standardized treatment centers, medicines, and PPE, and a $5 million funding gap. Africa CDC and WHO launched a continent-wide Ebola preparedness plan to raise $518 million for June–November 2026. Health workers affected: 34 infected (7 deaths, 6 recovered). There are no approved medical countermeasures or vaccines specific to Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴでのエボラ感染拡大が加速、452例の確定例と82人の死亡；WHOが警報を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）かつWPRO基準も複数該当。DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（確定例452、死亡82）とウガンダへの波及、医療システムの脆弱性が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 1814991に相当する対象国ではないため verified_locations に含めず）でも19例の感染確認されているが、主要な発生地はDRCであり記事の主眼。Bundibugyo株による急速な社会感染、弱い接触者追跡（57.8%のカバー率）、医療資源不足（$500万ドルの資金ギャップ）、承認されたワクチンなし、医療従事者感染（34例）など、多数のリスク要因が存在。Africa CDCとWHOが518百万ドルの大陸規模準備計画を立ち上げ、国際的対応フェーズに移行している。

article.articleHeadline: Ученых обвинили в завозе тайком ампул с вирусом оспы и лжи властям
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists accused of secretly smuggling ampoules containing the smallpox virus and lying to authorities.
article.articleSummary: Federal charges were filed in Detroit against Vincent Manster and Claude Kwe, two scientists from the Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Hamilton, Montana, for smuggling ampoules containing deactivated variola virus (smallpox) into the United States and lying to investigators. They were detained at Detroit Metro Airport after returning from Paris and a nine-day stay in the Republic of Congo, where a smallpox outbreak reportedly killed more than 2,000 people and was declared over in April. Government statements say the tests showed they carried ampoules of the deactivated virus, which they did not declare or obtain authorization to import. The FBI noted Manster’s false statements about documentation, while NIH said it is cooperating fully with the investigation. The case underscores public-trust risks in handling dangerous biological materials; prosecutors continue to pursue the matter.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者が天然痘ウイルスのアンプルを密かに密輸し当局に嘘をついたとして告発
triage.triage_reason: 天然痘ウイルスの違法な密輸という極めて深刻な公衆衛生事象。IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な影響・異常性）に該当し、国際的拡大および渡航制限のリスクあり。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国での違法密輸事件だが、対象国リストに米国は含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし、コンゴでの天然痘アウトブレイク（2,000人以上の死亡と報告）が背景事象として記述されているため、DRCを記載。天然痘はCat.A病原体であり、違法な国際移動は極めて深刻な生物セキュリティリスク。フルRRA緊急実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: ABD'den Ebola çağrısı: En ölümcül seviyeye ulaşmak üzere
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US issues Ebola appeal: On track to reach the deadliest level.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading in Central Africa, with US CDC modeling warning that, if unchecked, cases could climb into the 10,000–20,000 range. Africa CDC tallies show about 400 laboratory-confirmed cases and 63 deaths to date, though field gaps in contact tracing likely conceal many more suspected infections. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or established direct treatment protocol. In May, the World Health Organization declared a Global Health Emergency over this risk. Security crises in the region—fighting between Democratic Republic of the Congo government forces and Rwanda-backed M23 rebels, plus ISIS-aligned groups—limit access for international health teams and fuel mass displacement, raising urban transmission risk. Epidemiologists say at least 50–70% of patients must be isolated to curb spread, though conflict hampers feasibility. Past CDC models projected 1.4 million cases in 2014 without action, but interventions reduced that projection; current dynamics remain dire.

triage.headline_ja: 米国からのエボラ警告：最も致命的なレベルに達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO Global Health Emergency宣言済み。Bundibugyo変異体による新規流行で不確実性が高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCが対象国リストの唯一の該当地。Rwandaは紛争関連として言及されるが、エボラ発生地としては記事サマリーで明示されていないため除外。米国言及は地政学的文脈（CDC警告）であり、発生地ではない。WHO Global Health Emergency宣言（5月）、無認可ワクチン・治療法未確立、紛争による医療アクセス阻害が複合的リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Diễn biến dịch Ebola tại CHDC Congo tiếp tục phức tạp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to be complex.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) remains complex. As of June 5, the DRC reports 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, with 71 new infections in the past 24 hours; Uganda records 19 cases and 2 deaths. Health workers infected total 34, including 7 deaths and 6 recoveries. Response spans surveillance, contact tracing, border screening, and treatment, but authorities stress countering misinformation to maintain public trust and vaccination-like cooperation. WHO and Africa CDC caution on Bundibugyo-specific gaps, weak health infrastructure, resource constraints, cross-border movement, health-worker infections, misinformation, and distrust, prompting a continental Ebola preparedness and response plan to mobilize USD 518 million for June–November. UAE bans entry for travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan from June 6, with exemptions for those who left >21 days prior; cargo/transit flights continue.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行が引き続き複雑化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の複数国での拡大、高い致死率、保健労働者感染、越境感染リスク、弱い保健基盤、国際的な渡航制限など、多次元的に深刻な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでの流行を述べているが、対象国リストはDRCのみ。南スーダンは対象国外、UARTはイベント発生地でなく渡航制限を実施した国として言及されているため除外。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行、複数州への拡大、保健労働者への高い感染リスク、公式な国際的渡航制限の発動（UAE）など、複合的に深刻なシグナル。フルRRA推奨。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱境外移入+1！今年累計65例　高雄本土個案監測至6/23 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever: +1 Imported Case from Abroad; This Year’s Total 65 Cases; Kaohsiung Local Cases Monitored Through June 23 | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports 1 newly imported dengue case from Indonesia this year, bringing total confirmed dengue to 65 (64 imported, 1 local). The local case is a Kaohsiung City resident in Qianzhen District, a man in his 60s; dengue virus serotype 1; onset May 23; NS1 rapid test and PCR positive; monitoring through June 23. Two close contacts were negative; authorities plan expanded community testing around home and workplace and intensified vector surveillance. Regional dengue activity is rising and fluctuating in Southeast and South Asia, with Indonesia as the top source of imports; other affected countries include Vietnam, Malaysia, Laos, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, and Thailand. Early-2026 figures cited: Vietnam ~30,986; Malaysia ~20,090; Laos ~1,093; Cambodia ~6,566; Sri Lanka ~25,270; Bangladesh ~2,483; Indonesia ~34,194; Thailand ~6,081. Taiwan urges intensified vector control during plum-rain season:巡、倒、清、刷; remove standing water; prompt testing for travelers and suspected cases; repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR-3535).

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：国外移入+1例、今年累計65例、高雄市の本土患者監視は6月23日まで
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でのデング熱の国外移入増加と本土感染の報告であり、IHR基準では異常性・予想外性が高く、WPRO基準でも流行しやすさ・曝露継続の観点から対象となる。地域的にはアジア太平洋で複数国の感染報告があり、国際的拡大リスクが認識されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに台湾（1668284）が含まれているが、対象国リストに台湾は含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。記事サマリーから対象国としてはベトナム、タイ、インドネシアが地域流行の主要国として確認される。台湾での本土感染事例の報告と地域的なデング熱流行リスク上昇が着目される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Scare In Chhattisgarh: Three African Nationals Placed In Quarantine For 21 Days
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, three African nationals were quarantined in Durg, Chhattisgarh, India, amid fears of Ebola after a surge of cases across Africa. The individuals were placed in 21-day isolation as a precautionary measure; tests have not confirmed Ebola infection, and they are not displaying symptoms. Chhattisgarh Health Minister Shyam Bihari Jaiswal said the state has been prepared for a month at every level to handle any potential virus infections. A new public grievance helpline under the Chief Minister’s office was announced. No cases have been confirmed in the state, with the quarantine serving as precautionary containment in response to ongoing Ebola activity abroad.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティースガル州でエボラ熱警戒：アフリカ国籍者3人が21日間隔離
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱は高い病原性を持つが、本記事では対象国インドでの確認症例がなく、予防的隔離措置のみであり、IHR基準2つ以上の明確な該当が認められない。今後の検査結果と国内感染確認の有無を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではインド（チャッティースガル州）で3人のアフリカ国籍者が予防的隔離されているが、エボラ感染の確認例はなく、症状も認められていない。アフリカでの流行を受けた予防措置との位置付け。IHR基準では『unusual_unexpected』と『epidemic_prone』に該当するが、インド国内での実際の患者発生がないため、現時点ではWATCHとして位置付け、今後の検査結果と感染状況の動向を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : le triage sanitaire renforcé pour déceler les cas suspects malades - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: strengthened health triage to detect suspected cases of illness - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts strengthened health triage to separate suspected cases from other patients. On 6 June 2026, Dr. Dieudonné Mwamba, Director General of the National Public Health Institute (INSP), announced that health facilities in Ituri have implemented comprehensive triage measures and reinforced staff training to ensure efficient separation of suspected Ebola cases. Upon arrival, patients are questioned about medical history and symptoms to determine if they meet the suspected case definition. Suspected cases are not mixed with other patients and are directed to an Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) even before laboratory confirmation. This rapid isolation reduces nosocomial transmission. Authorities urged communities to seek care promptly at health facilities rather than stay at home, advising those with symptoms to attend the nearest center.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ：疑い患者を検出するための健康トリアージの強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ発生は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な疾患、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを伴う。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は致死率の高い感染症であり、DRCでの発生報告は国際的な懸念事項。イトゥリ州での強化されたトリアージ措置の実施は、感染の制御と拡大防止の取り組みを示唆している。ノゾコミアル感染のリスク軽減に向けた対応が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Travelling abroad? UAE ministry shares Ebola safety guidance
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. There is no licensed vaccine for the Bundibugyo variant. On 2026-06-06, UAE MoHAP issued travel guidance: review advisories, follow destination health guidance, practice good hygiene, avoid contact with infected individuals, monitor health during and after travel, and seek medical advice if symptoms develop, informing providers of recent travel. UAE MOFA advised against travel to DRC, Uganda and South Sudan unless necessary. Ebola incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pain, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, sore throat and abdominal pain; severe cases can progress to bleeding, organ failure and shock. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids, contaminated surfaces, infected wildlife, or bodies of deceased patients; it is not airborne and contagiousness is mainly after symptoms. WHO classifies the outbreak as a PHEIC; global risk is low. UAE emphasizes surveillance and preparedness with partners.

triage.headline_ja: 海外旅行予定者向け エジプト保健省がエボラ出血熱の安全ガイダンスを共有
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHO PHEIC指定のバンジブギョエボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク継続中。DRCとウガンダでの活動的な感染症流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンでの発生が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。バンジブギョエボラウイルス病はBNV亜種でワクチンなし。WHO PHEIC指定。UAE発の旅行ガイダンス発出は社会的・政治的関心の高さを示す。DRC内での継続的な流行が主要懸念。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل 71 إصابة جديدة بفيروس "إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records 71 new Ebola virus cases.
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 71 new Ebola virus cases, bringing the total confirmed to 452 since the outbreak of the rare Bundibugyo strain began on May 15. Confirmed deaths reached 82. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced a six‑month Ebola response plan worth $518 million, seeking rapid fundraising and political commitment to halt transmission. The plan, developed with the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, aims to help the DRC and Uganda contain the outbreak and to boost preparedness in other countries through enhanced surveillance and border testing. The response emphasizes cross-border coordination and rapid case detection to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスの新規感染者71例を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス（稀なブンディブギョ株）の確認例452例、死亡82例を伴う異常で予想外の国際的リスク事例であり、WHOが6億ドル超の対応計画を発表している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主要発生地であり、ウガンダは準備強化対象として言及されているが、確認例・死亡例はDRCに限定されている。WHOレベルでの国際対応計画発表により社会的・政治的関心も非常に高い。Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルスの稀な系統で、異常性の評価をさらに高める。

article.articleHeadline: Конго предупредува за брзото ширење на еболата
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo warns of the rapid spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 71 new Ebola cases in the last 24 hours, raising confirmed infections to 452 since May 15, when an outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus was declared. There have been 82 deaths. Cases remain concentrated in Ituri Province in the northeast, a remote region with weak health infrastructure and ongoing conflict-driven insecurity. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus unveiled a six-month, $518 million plan to fight Ebola, seeking funding and political commitment. The U.S. State Department added about $38 million in aid, bringing total direct assistance to over $200 million. American citizens exposed to the virus but asymptomatic will be quarantined in a facility in Kenya under construction. CDC models indicate the outbreak could become one of the worst yet if isolation remains low.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラの急速な拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus(ブンディブギョエボラウイルス)の大規模流行。24時間で71例の新規症例、累計452例、死亡82例。Ituri Province(北東部)に集中しており、保健インフラ脆弱で紛争関連の不安定性がある地域。WHOが6ヶ月間5億1,800万ドルの対策計画を発表、米国が3,800万ドル以上の援助。米国民の曝露者がケニアで隔離対象とされている。CDCモデルでは隔離不十分だと過去最悪レベルの流行となる可能性。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に指定。

article.articleHeadline: Mauritius imposes temporary travel curbs amid Ebola outbreak concerns
article.articleSummary: as of 2026-06-06, Mauritius has imposed a temporary entry ban on foreign nationals who recently travelled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda or South Sudan amid the latest Ebola outbreak. The restriction targets those who have travelled to, transited through, or stayed in these countries in the past 21 days. Mauritian citizens and foreign residents with valid work, residence, occupation, business, or student permits will still be allowed entry, but must undergo a mandatory 21-day quarantine if they visited any of the three countries within the previous three weeks. The measures reflect authorities' efforts to reduce potential Ebola importation while the outbreak evolves. The article does not provide counts of cases or fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生懸念の中、モーリシャスが一時的な渡航規制を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の影響を持つ疾患であり、DRC/ウガンダ/南スーダンでの発生に対するモーリシャスの渡航制限措置は、国際的な感染拡大のリスク認識と渡航制限を示す明確なIHR基準該当。IHR基準で最低3つ以上該当の可能性が高く、シグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ発生がDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンで言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国外のため除外。モーリシャスも対象国外。本事象は対象地域外での発生であるが、エボラの国際的影響の高さとIHR基準の強い該当性からPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola. Sobe para 452 o número de casos na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola. The number of cases in the DRC rises to 452.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths as of June 6, 2026, with 71 new confirmed cases reported in the last 24 hours. The outbreak, officially declared on May 15, is characterized by rapid, ongoing community transmission. It was first detected in Ituri province near the border with Uganda and South Sudan, and has spread to the eastern provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu, as well as to the Ugandan territory, where 19 cases have been recorded, including two deaths. The cross-border spread highlights widening transmission toward Uganda, underscoring the need for enhanced surveillance and cross-border coordination to contain the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ。DRコンゴの感染者数が452人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生影響を有し、既に国際的に拡大（ウガンダ19例）し、感染者数が急増している緊急事態。
triage.notes: DRコンゴで確認された大規模エボラ流行。452例、82死亡、過去24時間で71例の新規確診。Ituri州からNorth Kivu、South Kivu州へと拡大し、ウガンダにも越境感染（19例、死亡2例）。社会的・政治的関心が高く、国際的な支援と協調が必須。発生地域にはSudan, Uganda等も記載されているが、サマリー記事の主題はDRコンゴの流行であり、対象国リスト内ではDRコンゴのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Нов предупредувачки сигнал: 71 нов случај на ебола за 24 часа во Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New warning signal: 71 new Ebola cases in 24 hours in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, 71 new Ebola cases were reported in the last 24 hours in the Democratic Republic of Congo, bringing the total confirmed to 452 since the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain emerged on May 15. Deaths total 82. Most infections remain in Ituri province in the northeast (65 new cases), with six more in North Kivu; neighboring Uganda has also confirmed similar cases. The outbreak is complicated by weak health infrastructure and conflict in Ituri. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced a six-month plan with a $518 million budget to help Congo and Uganda contain the outbreak and to prepare other countries through enhanced border screening, in coordination with the Africa CDC. The Bundibugyo strain is driving this outbreak and cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい警告信号：コンゴで24時間以内に71例の新規エボラ症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準4項目該当（異常、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）、かつ社会的・政治的関心が高い（WHO事務局長による声明、国際的支援枠組み）。
triage.notes: ウガンダも症例を確認しているとサマリーに記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみ対象国であり、記事の主要な発生地。Bundibugyo株による急速な患者数増加（24時間で71例）、死亡率の上昇（82死亡）、弱い保健基盤と紛争による管理困難さが懸念される。WHO事務局長による6ヶ月計画と5.18億ドルの予算配分が発表され、国際的な対応が既に開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Por qué vuelve el ébola? Experto epidemiólogo explica el brote en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is Ebola back? An expert epidemiologist explains the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo virus is resurging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with the World Health Organization declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. As of June 2, 2026, 363 cases and 62 deaths in the DRC, plus 15 cases and 1 death in Uganda, have been reported. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or targeted treatment. Factors driving persistence include ecological conditions in equatorial DRC—fruit bats as reservoirs, spillover from wildlife to humans, and sustained interactions with forests—alongside social practices, conflict, access barriers, and population movement. Survivors can shed the virus for months in bodily fluids, particularly semen, enabling potential sexual transmission. Transmission occurs via contact with infectious body fluids; no documented airborne or vector transmission. Incubation ranges 2–21 days; early, nonspecific symptoms (fever, fatigue, headache) can delay diagnosis and complicate differentiation from malaria, typhoid, or meningitis.

triage.headline_ja: なぜエボラが戻ってきたのか？専門家疫学者がコンゴ民主共和国での流行を説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレーク。重篤性、国際的拡大、複数国での確認、ワクチン/治療法なしという重要な感染症危機。
triage.notes: ウガンダもサマリーで言及されており、2例目の国として確認される（1例の死亡を含む15例）。しかし、対象国リストではウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・特異的治療がなく、性的感染の可能性もある重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威。

article.articleHeadline: Aquecimento global pode levar à expansão do vírus chikungunya para regiões temperadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global warming could lead to the expansion of the chikungunya virus into temperate regions.
article.articleSummary: Global warming could enable local chikungunya transmission in temperate regions, expanding beyond current tropical zones. As of 2026-06-06, a Chinese-led study in Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology projects expansion to temperate areas by 2100, notably Central Europe, Northeast North America, and East Asia. Europe and North America are not yet endemic; most cases are traveler-associated. The study notes 139 countries/regions (about 21.3% of land) are at risk, with roughly half of Europe suitable for transmission in July–August. Aedes albopictus (tiger mosquito) plays a key role; a new mutation increases chikungunya’s compatibility with this vector. Using 16 IPCC climate scenarios and variables like wind, altitude, and temperatures, the researchers map virus and vector spread. By 2040, surveillance is advised in North-Central Europe, Northeast North America, and East Asia; Portugal and southern European countries are flagged as high risk. Transmission could occur about six months per year in these regions.

triage.headline_ja: 地球温暖化により、チクングニアウイルスが温帯地域への拡大の可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動に伴うチクングニアの潜在的な地理的拡大に関する予測研究であるが、現在のところ温帯地域での実際の流行発生を報告しておらず、スクリーニング基準は限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は気候変動予測に基づく2100年までのチクングニア拡大シナリオに関する査読済み研究報告である。実際の患者発生事例や流行ではなく、モデリング研究であるため、現段階ではシグナルではなく将来リスク予測情報と分類される。中国の研究機関による発表であることから対象国に含める。ポルトガルおよびポルトガル共和国は記事の文脈で高リスク地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tayang di Bioskop, Colony Soroti Upaya Profesor Lawan Virus Zombi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Now Playing in Theaters, Colony Spotlights the Professor's Efforts to Fight the Zombie Virus.
article.articleSummary: Zombie outbreak erupts when a rapidly mutating virus escapes a biotechnology conference, unleashing mass chaos around the venue. Colony, directed by Yeon Sang-ho, follows Kwon Se-jeong, a professor of biotechnology (Jun Ji-hyun), as survivors are sealed inside an enclosed building while infected transform into zombies.
