Authorities isolate the facility, forcing Se-jeong and others—Choi Hyun-seok (Ji Chang-wook), Choi Hyun-hee (Kim Shin-rok), Han Kyu-seong (Ko Soo), Kong Seol-hee (Shin Hyun-been), and Seo Young-cheol (Koo Kyo-hwan)—to unite for survival. Seo Young-cheol, a researcher who can control zombies, holds a crucial role. The film, a departure from Train to Busan, explores fear in a world that has already changed. Premiered at Cannes Midnight Screenings (May 2026), opened in Korea May 21 and Indonesia June 3; by June 2 it had sold over 3.7 million tickets. Jun Ji-hyun returns to cinema after 2015’s Assassination.

triage.headline_ja: 映画館で上映中、Colony は教授がゾンビウイルスと戦う努力をハイライト
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は架空のゾンビウイルスを題材とした映画作品の紹介であり、実在の感染症イベントではない。医学的・公衆衛生的な懸念はなし。
triage.notes: 記事は映画『Colony』の劇場公開に関するエンターテインメント記事。架空のゾンビウイルスを扱う虚構の内容であり、実在の感染症イベントではない。Bluedot APIが感染症キーワード検出により拾い上げたと考えられるが、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: مكافحة إيبولا- الكونغو تسابق الزمن وتحذير من تفش واسع للوباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fighting Ebola in Congo: a race against time and a warning of a widespread outbreak of the epidemic
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is intensifying, driven by the Bundibugyo lineage across three provinces, centered in Ituri in the northeast. It began May 15 in northern DRC. WHO reports 381 confirmed infections and 64 deaths in the DRC; Uganda confirms 16 infections and 1 death (7 recoveries in DRC, 2 in Uganda). Three provinces are affected, with Ituri accounting for about 90% of confirmed cases and 76% of deaths per Africa CDC. Health facilities face severe shortages of equipment and supplies; CARE warns that delays in aid and funding hinder response and raise infection risk among medical staff, especially in hard-to-reach, conflict-affected areas. US CDC modeling projects 10,000–20,000 cases, with a worst-case near 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths, underscoring the urgency of robust public health measures to avert a West Africa 2014–2016-scale outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ対策：時間との闘いと流行の広がりへの警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大、複数国への国際的な波及、高い死亡率、深刻な公衆衛生への影響が確認されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。フルRRAを実施すべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、アンゴラの3国が発生地域として列挙されていますが、サマリーの主題はDRCを中心とした感染症イベントです。ウガンダは16確認症例1死亡と限定的な報告であり、アンゴラについてはサマリーに記載がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとします。US CDI予測による10,000～28,000症例および高い死亡率が提示されており、西アフリカ2014-2016年のエボラ流行に匹敵する規模への懸念があります。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de ébola en el Congo aumentan a más de 70 contagios en un solo día
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rise to more than 70 infections in a single day.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surged on July 4, with 71 new infections in a single day and 21 deaths, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) on X. The spike followed expanded testing by health workers in the mining city believed to be the outbreak source, suggesting the epidemic may be larger than previously understood. The report cites Bloomberg's caution that the current outbreak could rank among the largest in history. The article provides no symptom details or laboratory confirmation, and does not specify transmission routes. The development underscores intensified surveillance and testing in the mining region and raises concerns about the outbreak's true scale.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者が1日で70件を超える感染に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4/4満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も5/5該当。エボラの急速な感染増加（1日71件）と高い致死率（21死亡）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示唆し、国際的な拡大リスクと社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 1日71件の新規感染と21死亡の報告は、鉱業都市での拡大検査により検出されたもの。Bloomberg引用による「歴史上最大級の流行の可能性」との指摘は、国際的なリスク評価を必要とする。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Los casos de ébola se disparan en RDC conforme aumenta el ritmo de...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases surge in the DRC as the pace of.... increases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northern and northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 82 deaths and 452 confirmed cases. The Ministry of Health reports 21 deaths and 71 new cases from Thursday to Friday, centered in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, thought to be the epicenter. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no vaccine, has spread to the Kivu region and Uganda, where two deaths were reported. CDC modeling warns the outbreak could exceed 20,000 cases in three months depending on rapid identification and isolation. Transmission likely started in February, with cases identified between May 14–23 and May 25–June 3. Contact tracing improved from 46% to 58%, with about 4,800 contacts under monitoring. A new diagnostic laboratory in Mongbwalu is increasing testing capacity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）ではエボラウイルスのケースが急増し、医療検査のペースが加速している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。ワクチンなしのBundibugyo ebolavirus株による大規模発生で、ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認され、3ヶ月で20,000例を超える可能性があるCDC警告がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーでは2名の死亡報告のみであり、主要な発生地はDRC（Ituri州Mangbwalu）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はワクチンが利用不可のため、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。CDC推計による指数関数的増加の可能性が重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Elon Musk's Starlink joins Ebola fight in Africa with 150 internet kits for outbreak zones
article.articleSummary: Starlink has donated 150 high-speed internet kits to the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention to bolster frontline Ebola response teams in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The move targets long-standing infrastructure gaps and unreliable connectivity that hinder real-time case reporting, data transmission, and emergency logistics in remote outbreak zones. Africa CDC notes that only about 30% of DRC's population had internet access in 2023, and the new kits will connect remote clinics and isolation centers to central command and technical support, speeding case reporting and coordination of supplies and staff. The initiative follows May 2025 approval of Starlink in the DRC and is described by Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya as critical for outbreak containment and saving lives. Elon Musk publicized the donation on social media to spotlight Starlink's role in the international public health response.

triage.headline_ja: イーロン・マスクのStarlink、アフリカでのエボラ対策に150個のインターネットキットで参加
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は進行中のエボラ出血熱の新たな発生を報じるものではなく、既存の東部DRCのエボラ対応に対する技術支援（インターネットキット寄付）の実施を述べたもの。新規シグナルとしての疾病学的懸念なし。
triage.notes: 本イベントはエボラの新規発生を報じるシグナルではなく、既知の流行に対する技術的支援の発表である。記事の重点は通信インフラ改善にあり、疾病学的リスク評価の対象外。DRCの既存エボラ対応の文脈での報道であるため、地域検証ではDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo eleva a 452 los casos de ébola confirmados, incluyendo 82 muertes - EFE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo raises the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 452, including 82 deaths - EFE
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, with rapid, ongoing community transmission. As of June 5, 2026, 71 new confirmed cases were reported in the prior 24 hours; 258 people are hospitalized or in isolation and eight have recovered across 25 health zones. Ituri province remains the epicenter with 424 cases; North Kivu 25; South Kivu 3. The outbreak has extended to Uganda, which has 19 infections and two deaths, both imported from the DRC; Uganda closed its border on May 27. The strain is Bundibugyo, with a reported case fatality rate of 30–50% and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO classifies the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern since May 17, noting high risk in sub-Saharan Africa and lower global risk. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, and diarrhea. The virus is estimated to have circulated in Ituri about two months before the outbreak declaration.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認患者数が452人に増加、死亡82人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、高い死亡率、WHOが国際的懸念対象とすでに分類。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの波及報告（19例、2死亡）があるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC内の流行であり、ウガンダは二次的な言及。DRC対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo strain、死亡率30-50%、ワクチンなし。WHO PHEIC分類済み（5月17日）。25の保健ゾーンに拡大、Ituri州が主要感染地。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Kwilu : la rage canine gagne le secteur Kipuka, quatre décès déjà enregistrés | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Kwilu: canine rabies has spread to the Kipuka sector, four deaths already recorded | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Kwilu province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has spread to the Kipuka sector near Kikwit, with canine rabies causing 25 cases in one week and four deaths. Kipuka's sector chief, Kiamfu Romain, called the situation alarming and urged dog owners to vaccinate; anti-rabies vaccines are available, and violators face legal sanctions. To curb transmission, vaccination sites have been set up in the sector, and some teams are conducting door-to-door campaigns. Authorities also announced the slaughter of stray dogs. Data from Kikwit indicate more than ten deaths among 58 canine rabies cases to date. The ongoing response focuses on vaccination drives and dog culling to reduce spillover risk to humans in the province.

triage.headline_ja: Kwilu州：イヌ狂犬病がKipuka地区に拡大、4件の死亡が既に記録されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行性・対応困難性で複数該当。DRC（対象国）での確認感染症。
triage.notes: DRCのKwilu州で犬からのヒト感染を伴う狂犬病クラスター発生。1週間で25例の犬狂犬病と4件のヒト死亡。Kikwit地区では58例中10以上の死亡が報告。当局は犬の強制予防接種およびノラ犬の殺処分による対応を実施。狂犬病は致死率が高く（治療後も90%以上）、ヒト-ヒト感染は稀だが動物からの継続的曝露リスクあり。地域的な動物感染症制御の困難性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Estudio identifica a Darién como epicentro del virus Oropouche en Centroamérica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study identifies Darién as the epicenter of the Oropouche virus in Central America.
article.articleSummary: Darién province in Panama is identified as the epicenter of the Oropouche virus in Central America, marking the first large documented outbreak in the region. A study led by Centro Carson with Icges, Minsa, and Indicasat AIP used clinical surveillance, genomic analyses, and climate models to trace the outbreak to a single introduction around October 2024, with no evidence of hidden circulation. Of 1,040 individuals evaluated, 43% tested positive, indicating intense community transmission. Genomic data link variants detected in Panama to lineages that circulated in Brazil, Bolivia, and Cuba, mapping a route prior to Panama. The outbreak featured headaches more frequently than dengue, and a household secondary attack rate of 56%. Risk factors included waste burning. Darién’s location as a migratory corridor makes Bocas del Toro and Los Santos vulnerable; models indicate broad transmission potential across Panama. Findings support Darién as a sentinel site to detect and preempt arbovirus spread.

triage.headline_ja: パナマのダリエン州がセントラルアメリカにおけるオロポウシェウイルスの震源地として特定される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスクの2項目以上に該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・流行易度・管理可能性に該当する新興感染症の大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はパナマ（対象国外）のダリエン州におけるオロポウシェウイルスアウトブレイクだが、ゲノム系統はブラジル・ボリビア・キューバの変異株に関連し、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。パナマは対象国でないため除外。初回の大規模記録アウトブレイク、高い二次感染率（56%）、中米全域への伝播ポテンシャルあり。セントラルアメリカの他地域への拡大リスク高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD di Lebak Tembus 391 Orang, Dinkes Minta Warga Gencar 3M Plus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Cases in Lebak Reach 391 People, Department of Health Urges Residents to Step Up 3M Plus.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Lebak Regency, Banten, Indonesia rose to 391 as of early June 2026, per the Lebak Health Office. The surge coincides with heavy rains driving Aedes aegypti proliferation. Health officials warn cases could rise further if prevention is not rigorous. Dr. Firman Rahmatullah, head of Health Services, urged a community-wide mosquito-control effort (PSN) and the 3M Plus approach—cover water storage, drain baths, and recycle discarded items that can breed mosquitoes—plus giving Abate to kill larvae. In Rangkasbitung, a patient named Atin, 45, from Pasir BPM, Rangkasbitung Timur, tested positive for dengue and is admitted at Husada Clinic. A local RT/RW reported three dengue-positive residents in the RT/RW 01/09 area in the past week. Sofi, 34, from Cibadak, said her younger child exhibited fever-like symptoms after returning from a pesantren. The outbreak underscores need for environmental monitoring and community education.

triage.headline_ja: レバク県のデング熱患者数が391人に達し、保健局が住民に3Mプラス対策の徹底を要請
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのレバク県で391人のデング熱患者が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行可能性）を複数満たす可能性があるが、情報が限定的（死亡者数不明、実際の管理能力の評価困難）であり、続報による状況確認が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年6月初旬時点でレバク県（バンテン州）のデング熱患者が391人に達したとの報告。降雨によるネッデスイッパヤ（蚊）の増殖が原因と指摘されている。保健当局は3Mプラス（水の貯蔵容器の蓋、風呂の排水、不用品のリサイクル）による予防とアバテ幼虫駆除を推奨している。個別患者の入院や症例が複数報告されており、コミュニティレベルでの感染拡大の懸念がある。ただし、重症度（死亡者）や国内他地域への拡大状況、対応能力については記事に明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള ഭീതി: ഛത്തീസ്ഗഡിൽ മൂന്ന് ആഫ്രിക്കൻ പൗരന്മാർ നിരീക്ഷണത്തിൽ, ജാ​ഗ്രതയോടെ സർക്കാർ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola scare: In Chhattisgarh, three African nationals under observation, government on alert.
article.articleSummary: Three African nationals are under observation in Durg, Chhattisgarh, India, for suspected Ebola virus disease and have been quarantined for 21 days. Health minister Shyam Bihari Jaiswal said no infection has been confirmed and there are no symptoms among them as of 6 June 2026. Quarantine and hospital facilities are on high alert to safeguard public safety. Earlier, a Ugandan woman who arrived in Bengaluru on May 23 was also placed under observation after showing Ebola-like symptoms, but a laboratory test was negative for Ebola. India has put precautionary measures in response to Ebola outbreaks in African countries; the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and Africa CDC has declared a continental public health emergency, with travel advisories advising avoidance of nonessential travel to DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖: チャッティースガル州で3人のアフリカ系外国人が経過観察中、政府は警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（WHO PHEICレベルの懸念）に関する国際的な流行背景があり、インドで疑似症例の検査隔離が実施されている。IHR基準2つ以上該当（予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（異常性、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）のため、フルリスク評価対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではインドでの疑似症例（チャッティースガル州、ベンガルール）が主題であり、DRコンゴ・ウガンダ・南スーダンの背景情報は公式な国際的対応措置に基づく言及。verified_locationsはインドのみとした。WHOがPHEICを宣言し、複数国で隔離措置が講じられていることから国際的な公衆衛生関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: US Adds $38 Million For Ebola As Health Body Warns Outbreak Could Match 2014
article.articleSummary: US adds $38 million in Ebola response funding, bringing total US support to more than $200 million as of 2026-06-06. The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths per WHO data. The State Department and CDC are coordinating with the DRC and Uganda to mount a rapid, comprehensive response, aided by three CDC official scientific reports published to marshal international resources. CDC scenario modeling warns that without strong public health interventions, the outbreak could reach or exceed the scale of the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic; some models suggest it could become one of the largest ever if case isolation remains limited. The State Department plans to quarantine asymptomatic U.S. exposed individuals in a Kenyan facility under construction.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ対応に3800万ドル追加支援、保健当局は2014年並みの流行の可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、344確定患者、60死亡）は重篤で、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行規模に達する可能性が警告されており、国際的な対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主要な流行発生地はDRCとウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。米国はエボラ対応支援国として言及されているが、流行発生地ではないため除外。ケニアは隔離施設の場所として言及されているが、流行発生地ではない。2026年の日付は架空設定と考えられるが、評価に影響しない。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS anuncia un plan de ayuda de 440 millones de euros para combatir el ébola en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO announces a 440-million-euro aid plan to combat Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization (WHO) and Africa CDC have announced a 518 million USD (about 446 million EUR) aid plan to combat an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring countries. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, has circulated for some time and was not declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern until May 17. As of the latest WHO figures, 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths are reported in the DRC, with an additional 16 cases in neighboring Uganda. The plan targets emergency coordination, epidemic surveillance, laboratory analysis, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community mobilization, with contributions from UNICEF, UNHCR, WFP, and IFRC. It also covers research, logistics, and maintaining essential health services; there is no vaccine or treatment. Tedros emphasised rapid diagnostics, isolation, and a community-centered response and urged neighboring countries to act to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカのエボラ出血熱に対する440万ユーロの援助計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ以上満たす（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確定患者および死亡が確認され、複数国への拡大が報告されている。WHO/Africa CDCによる5億ドル規模の国際支援体制構築が示されており、シグナルとしての優先度は高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの事例が明記されているが、ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda, id:226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCでのBundibugyo Ebola株による確定患者381名、死亡64名は深刻な公衆衛生影響を示唆。PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）後のWHO/Africa CDCによる大規模国際支援体制構築により、シグナルとしての重要性は最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية ومركز مكافحة الأمراض فى أفريقيا يضعان خطة للقضاء على الإيبولا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC lay out a plan to eradicate Ebola - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Six-month continental plan (June–November 2026) by the World Health Organization and Africa CDC to prepare for and respond to Ebola outbreaks caused by the Bundibugyo strain, aiming to raise $518 million to support African countries and partners. The One Health approach unites governments, communities, and partners to strengthen emergency coordination, disease surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics, and essential health services, complementing national plans in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Leaders Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Africa CDC Director General Dr. Jan Kasia emphasized political commitment, sustainable funding, community trust, and rapid action to save lives. The program prioritizes high-risk groups, cross-border cooperation, and swift response to new cases, noting no licensed vaccines or therapies specifically for Bundibugyo Ebola. Ten priority countries will receive enhanced preparedness to ensure early detection and timely response, while safeguarding other health programs like malaria, cholera, and measles.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDCはエボラ出血熱の根絶計画を策定 - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大陸規模対応計画であり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。DRC・ウガンダでの実際の発生リスク対応のためWHO・アフリカCDCが5億1800万ドル規模の資金調達計画を立案している点から、重大な公衆衛生対応が既に動いており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo株エボラ対応の大陸規模計画であり、複数疾患（エボラ、マラリア、コレラ、麻疹）が含まれているが、主題はエボラの準備・対応体制整備。配信日時が2026年となっており、将来日付である可能性があるが、記事内容として既存の対応計画として提示されているためそのまま評価した。

article.articleHeadline: САД одобрија нови 38 милиони долари за борба против еболата
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States approved new $38 million to fight Ebola
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-06, the United States approved an additional $38 million to support Ebola response efforts, bringing total direct US assistance to over $200 million. The U.S. CDC will collaborate with authorities in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda to ensure a rapid and comprehensive outbreak response. The World Health Organization reports 344 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC, with 60 deaths. The State Department said exposed American citizens who are asymptomatic will be quarantined in Kenya, where a special facility is being built to monitor and provide preventive isolation for potentially exposed individuals. The new funding is part of broader international efforts to curb the virus’s spread and strengthen health capacities in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ出血熱対策に3800万ドルの追加資金承認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確認症例344例、死亡60例を報告。複数国での対応と米国民の隔離措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、ケニア、米国が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダはサマリーに「当局との協力」として言及されているが、確認症例・死亡の報告はDRCのみ。ケニアは米国市民の隔離施設が建設予定地として言及されており、エボラの発生地ではなく対応拠点。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola emergency: DRC outbreak crosses into Uganda as WHO scrambles to catch up - KMA Updates
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DRC's Ituri province (Bundibugyo strain) has crossed into Uganda, with 220 suspected deaths and more than 900 suspected cases identified; as of 2026-06-06 Uganda reported seven confirmed cases, including two health workers in Kampala. No vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola. WHO declared this outbreak a public health emergency of international concern last week. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said surveillance is scaling up but the epidemic is outpacing response, urging neighbouring countries to act. The epicenter is Ituri, with spread up to 200 km from ground zero and beyond the border. Violence and hostility hinder response: a Mongbwalu hospital was stormed; a MSF tent for suspected/confirmed cases torched; a treatment centre in Rwampara burned; Congo bans funeral wakes and gatherings over 50 to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱緊急事態：DRC流行がウガンダに拡大、WHOが対応に追われる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際拡大、国際的懸念、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo株の多国籍流行で、WHO緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株、ワクチン・治療法なし。220疑い死亡、900以上疑い患者、ウガンダで7確定患者（医療従事者含む）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。暴力と非協力が対応を阻害。地域境界を越えた約200km拡大。緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola scare: 3 African nationals quarantined for 21 days in Durg, Chhattisgarh
article.articleSummary: Three African nationals are quarantined for 21 days in Durg, Chhattisgarh, amid suspected Ebola exposure, with no symptoms observed so far as of 2026-06-06. The precautionary measure follows assurances from Chhattisgarh Health Minister Shyam Bihari Jaiswal that hospitals are prepared and quarantine facilities are in place; no Ebola case has been confirmed in the state. Earlier, a 28-year-old Ugandan woman was isolated in Bengaluru with Ebola-like symptoms, and samples were sent for testing. The World Health Organization has designated the Uganda–DRC Ebola outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). India has not reported any confirmed Ebola case, but states are increasing vigilance, including airport screening of travelers from Africa. Chhattisgarh has also launched a toll-free helpline for Ebola-related public grievances.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒：チャッティスガル州ドゥルクで3人のアフリカ国籍者が21日間隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがウガンダ・DRCエボラアウトブレイクをPHEIC指定し、インドでも警戒・検査体制が強化されている状況。
triage.notes: 記事は主としてインドでのエボラ懸念事例（ウガンダ女性とアフリカ国籍者3名の隔離）を報じている。ウガンダ・DRCでの継続的アウトブレイクをバックグラウンドとして言及しているが、インドでの接触者管理と空港スクリーニング強化が主要な話題。確定症例はインドにまだないが、懸念レベルの高さとWHO PHEIC指定により、フルRRA対象として抽出する。

article.articleHeadline: in congo sono stati registrati 71 nuovi casi di ebola nelle ultime 24 ore. i morti finora sono 82
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 71 new cases of Ebola have been registered in the last 24 hours. The death toll so far is 82.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) reported 71 new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours, bringing total confirmed cases to 452 since the outbreak was declared on May 15, with 82 deaths to date, per the Congolese Ministry of Health via WA M. The report confirms ongoing transmission of the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, the rare form identified at outbreak onset. Separately, the United Kingdom is developing a universal vaccine designed by artificial intelligence to protect against all coronaviruses, including COVID-19 variants, and potentially Ebola. In early human trials, 39 volunteers were evaluated for safety; a follow-up study involving about 200 participants is planned to assess the vaccine’s efficacy against diverse viral threats.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで過去24時間にエボラウイルスの新規症例71件を報告。これまでの死者数は82人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常・予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク）。急速な新規症例増加（24時間71件）と高い致死率は即応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ発生（Bundibugyo株）。英国のCOVID-19ワクチン開発言及は背景情報であり、DRC外での実際の感染症イベント発生を示さないため、verified_locationsに英国は含めない。DRCはWPRO対象外だが、IHR基準3項目該当により即座のシグナルとして識別。発生宣言（5月15日）以降、急速な病例増加と高い致死率（82/452=18.1%）が確認されており、重篤性は明らか。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ ve CDC'den acil Ebola uyarısı: Vaka sayısı 20 bini aşabilir!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent Ebola warning from WHO and CDC: The number of cases could exceed 20,000!
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Central Africa, concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with approximately 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths reported by Africa CDC; numerous infections are likely unreported due to conflict and limited access. If decisive action is not taken, computer models project cases quickly rising to 10,000–20,000. WHO declared a global health emergency in May 2026. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Ongoing fighting between the DRC government and M23 rebels, supported by Rwanda, along with ISIS-linked attacks, impede outbreak response and drive mass displacement of hundreds of thousands, hindering surveillance and isolation efforts. Containment depends on rapid detection and isolation of 50–70% of cases, a challenging target amid security chaos. The crisis recalls the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak, which surpassed 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO・CDCからの緊急エボラ警告：感染者数が20,000人を超える可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。WHOが5月2026年に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラウイルス流行で、対象国DRCを含む中央アフリカで発生している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョウイボラウイルス）の流行を報道。DRCが主要発生地で、ルワンダは紛争に関係する文脈で言及されているが、サマリーではDRCでの流行が中心。アンゴラはAPIの発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーに具体的な言及がないため除外。WHOが2026年5月に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言している点は極めて重要。コンピュータモデルでは10,000～20,000例への急速な増加を予測。現在約400例確認、63死亡報告。

article.articleHeadline: El brot d'Ebola a la República Democràtica del Congo supera els vuitanta morts i s'escampa a Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed eighty deaths and has spread to Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the north and north-east Democratic Republic of the Congo has 82 deaths and 452 confirmed cases, with Uganda reporting two deaths as the spread widens. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine, has reached the Kivu region and Uganda from Mongbwalu in Ituri. The US CDC warns the outbreak could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed over 11,000. Symptoms emerged mainly May 14–23, followed by a second wave detected May 25–June 3, indicating ongoing community transmission before recognition. CDC models show outbreak size depends on isolation: isolating 20% of cases yields about a 65% probability of exceeding 20,000 within three months; isolating 70% reduces risk substantially. Improvements include contact tracing rising from 46% to 58%, about 4,800 people under surveillance, and a new diagnostic lab in Mongbwalu enabling rapid testing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が80人以上の死者を超えウガンダに拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。深刻な公衆衛生影響（82確定例、82死亡、2014-2016西アフリカエピデミック規模への懸念）、国境を越えた国際的な地理的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、ワクチン未開発のBundibugyo株による脅威。緊急スクリーニング対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主要な発生はDRC（Ituri州Mangbwalu）。ウガンダへの拡大報告（2死亡）も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストにないため verified_locations に含めない。ワクチン未開発のBundibugyo株、二次感染波の検出、2014-2016西アフリカエピデミック規模への懸念、隔離率による流行予測モデル（20%隔離で3ヶ月内に20,000人超える65%確率）などが報告されており、緊急介入が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള ഭീതി: ഛത്തീസ്ഗഡിൽ മൂന്ന് ആഫ്രിക്കൻ പൗരന്മാർ നിരീക്ഷണത്തിൽ. 21 ദിവസത്തേക്ക് ക്വാറൻ്റൈനിൽ പ്രവേശിപ്പിച്ചത്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola scare: Three African nationals under surveillance in Chhattisgarh. Quarantined for 21 days.
article.articleSummary: On June 6, 2026, three African nationals were placed under a 21-day quarantine in Durg district, Chhattisgarh, amid suspected Ebola linked to Africa. They were admitted to a quarantine facility in Durg as a precaution, with hospitals and containment measures in place to safeguard public safety; no symptoms or confirmed Ebola cases have been reported. Health Minister Shyam Bihari Jaishwal stated the state is fully prepared and that those under observation follow established infection-control protocols. Earlier, a Ugandan woman who arrived at Bengaluru’s Kempegowda International Airport on May 23 was transferred to Indira Nagar hospital; her samples tested negative for Ebola, and she remained under observation. As of June 6, 2026, there are no confirmed Ebola cases in the state, and the situation is being monitored for any symptom development or imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖: チャッティスガル州でアフリカ国籍3人が監視下に。21日間隔離
triage.triage_reason: 疑わしいエボラ関連で3人が予防的隔離されているが、確認症例なく、検査陰性例あり。情報不足でスクリーニング基準の判定が限定される。続報注視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は「エボラ疑い」の予防的隔離を扱うが、確認症例なし。ベンガルール経由のウガンダ人女性の検査は陰性。発生地域フィールドにはウガンダが含まれるが、記事サマリーではインドが主たる舞台（隔離施設の所在地）であり、ウガンダ人女性はインドに入国した事例の報告に留まるため、verified_locationsはインドのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية ومركز مكافحة الأمراض في أفريقيا يضعان خطة لمواجهة الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC Lay Out a Plan to Combat Ebola
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC have unveiled a joint continental plan to prepare for and respond to Ebola outbreaks caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The strategy aims to raise $518 million to bolster preparedness and rapid response across Africa from June to November 2026, uniting governments, partners, and communities under a One Health approach. It emphasizes coordinated emergency response, disease surveillance, and laboratory testing, and supports national response plans in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The initiative also promotes cross-border collaboration and protection of the most at-risk groups, while strengthening health systems to withstand health emergencies. Activities are underway in at-risk countries, with intensified actions in 10 priority nations. Endorsements came from WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Africa CDC Director Dr. John Kasia.

triage.headline_ja: WHO とアフリカCDC がエボラ対策計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重大な疾患に関する国際的な準備・対応計画であり、スクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当する可能性があるが、記事は既発生の流行報告ではなく予防的な戦略・計画に焦点を当てており、現在進行中の確定的な発生状況の詳細が不明。継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は Bundibugyo ebolavirus によるエボラ発生に対する国際的な準備計画であり、DRC とウガンダが主要対象国として言及されている。ただし、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に追加していない。記事は既発生の流行報告というより予防的な戦略の発表であるため、確定的な流行状況の詳細は不明。WHO と Africa CDC の高レベルの関与、6月～11月 2026 年の実施予定、$518 百万の資金調達計画から社会的・政治的関心の高さは認められる。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية: وباء الإيبولا ينتشر ونحاول اللحاق به لوقف تفشيه - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Health Director: The Ebola outbreak is spreading, and we are trying to catch up with it to halt its spread - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri, is spreading, with WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reporting from Congo as authorities intensify response. A joint Africa-wide preparedness and response plan, led by WHO and Africa CDC with partners including UNICEF, UNHCR, WFP, IFRC, and FIND, aims to halt transmission and bolster neighboring-country readiness. Spanning June to November, the plan costs $518 million and coordinates emergency response, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement, while supporting research, logistics, and essential health services. It builds on national plans in DRC and Uganda, addressing cross-border movement and ongoing outbreaks. Central to success are community trust, timely testing and isolation, misinformation countermeasures, political commitment, and sustainable funding—operating under one plan, one budget, and one team.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健事務局長：エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大中、封じ込めに取り組んでいる - Youm7
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数満たす。エボラウイルス病の地域流行は公衆衛生上極めて深刻で、国際的な対応体制が構築されており、WHO事務局長による直接発表という社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）Ituri州を中心とした流行を報告している。ウガンダは隣国準備対応計画の対象として記載されているが、記事の主題となる実発生地はDRCである。エボラウイルス病は最高リスクの感染症であり、WHO事務局長による現地報告は国際的優先度が極めて高い。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго подтверждено более 450 случаев заражения вирусом Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, more than 450 cases of Ebola virus infection have been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has confirmed 452 Ebola virus disease cases and 82 deaths, according to the National Institute of Public Health of DR Congo as cited by EFE. The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri province in eastern DR Congo, from which transmission has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Cross-border transmission has reached Uganda, with 19 cases reported, including two deaths. Authorities warn that the outbreak is spreading rapidly and remains ongoing, underscoring the expanding geographic scope of this Ebola event in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染が452例確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの確認された多数例死亡者、複数州への拡大、国境を越えたウガンダへの伝播が認められ、フルRRAへの進行が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの国境を越えた伝播が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内での確認452例、死亡82例、Ituri州・North Kivu・South Kivu州への拡大、急速な蔓延継続中。エボラウイルスは高い致死率・感染性を有するため、リスク評価優先度は最高。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole u Centralnoj Africi preti da postane najveća do sada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in Central Africa threatens to become the largest to date
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, Ebola (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) in Central Africa risks becoming the largest outbreak to date, spreading from the Democratic Republic of Congo into Uganda. In DRC, Ituri is hardest hit, with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths; 71 new cases were reported in a single day, indicating rapid community transmission, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border spread to Uganda. There are no approved vaccines or specific therapies for this strain. The World Health Organization has launched a six-month, $518 million plan to curb transmission in DRC and Uganda and to ready neighboring countries. CDC models project up to 20,000 cases if detection and isolation are not accelerated. Testing delays, incomplete contact tracing, distrust of medical teams, and armed conflict in eastern Congo hinder response; the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak remains the benchmark, with more than 28,600 cases and 11,325 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ流行が過去最大となる脅威
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準もすべてに該当。エボラウイルスによる急速な国際的拡大、高い死亡率、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が確認されており、WHOが大規模対応計画を立てている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus によるアウトブレイク。DRC（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州）からウガンダへの越境拡大を確認。CDC予測では適切な検査・隔離がなければ20,000症例に達する可能性。2014-2016年西アフリカアウトブレイク（28,600症例以上）との比較言及あり。検査遅延、接触者追跡の不完全性、武装紛争による対応阻害等の課題が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: EAU Suspendem Vistos Para Viajantes de Três Países Africanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: UAE suspend visas for travelers from three African countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa prompts the UAE to suspend visas and entry for travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan from 6 June 2026. Transit travelers are barred unless they have spent over 21 days outside the three countries; cargo and transit flights continue. Ebola spreads by direct contact with bodily fluids and causes fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding. In the DRC, 363 confirmed cases and 62 deaths were reported as of 4 June, up 19 cases and 2 deaths since the prior Tuesday; outbreak began 15 May in Ituri and has reached North and South Kivu. Uganda reports 15 cases and 1 death, with one death imported from DRC. Bundibugyo has 30-50% fatality and no approved vaccine or specific treatment per WHO. East African Community ministers agreed to harmonize surveillance at airports, ports, and land borders and form a regional technical working group.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：アラブ首長国連邦が3つのアフリカ諸国からの渡航者に対するビザを一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（DRC363確認例・62死亡）が複数国に拡大し、国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（363例、62死亡、Ituri州で5月15日発症開始、North/South Kivu州に拡大）とウガンダ（15例、1死亡）でのエボラアウトブレイク、南スーダンへの言及がある。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはUganda、Sudan、Mozambique、UAE等が含まれるが、サマリー上で主要な感染症イベント（確認例・死亡報告）はDRCで発生しており、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダはサマリーで言及されるが対象国リストに含まれない。UAE、Sudan、Mozambique、South Sudan等への渡航制限は二次的な対応であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生地はDRC。

article.articleHeadline: One of two Sudanese nationals tests negative for Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06 in Hyderabad, Telangana, Gandhi Hospital reported two Sudanese nationals under Ebola preparedness. A 35-year-old Sudanese man tested negative for Ebola per NIV Pune results and remains in isolation as a precaution. A second case, a 22-year-old Sudanese student, was shifted from Apollo Hospital, Nanakramguda, after developing fever and is under observation with samples sent to CCMB for testing; results awaiting and potential referal to NIV Pune for confirmatory analysis. The patient is clinically stable, and the accompanying attendant has no symptoms and is in home quarantine. The investigation includes yellow fever-related protocol monitoring. No confirmed Ebola cases have been reported publicly; authorities continue testing and monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 2人のスーダン人国民のうち1人がエボラに対して陰性の検査結果を得た
triage.triage_reason: スーダン人患者がハイデラバード（インド）でエボラ疑い症例として報告されており、黄熱及びニパウイルスのプロトコル監視も含まれているが、現在のところ確認症例はなく、検査結果は未確定。情報不足のため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインド（テランガナ州ハイデラバード）でスーダン国民2名がエボラ疑い患者として報告されたもの。現在のところ確認症例はなく、1名は陰性、もう1名の検査結果は未確定。発生地域にスーダンが含まれているが、記事の主題はインドでの疑い患者報告であるため、verified_locationsはIndia（1269750）のみ。黄熱とニパウイルスのプロトコル監視も言及されているため、複数病原体のシグナルとなる可能性がある。続報による確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Comerciantes afrontan grandes pérdidas tras cierre de Uganda de frontera con Congo por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Merchants face heavy losses after Uganda closes its border with the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: June 6, 2026 — Uganda closed its border with the Democratic Republic of the Congo at the Mpondwe crossing after an Ebola outbreak prompted the move, disrupting cross-border trade. Merchants faced heavy losses as a long convoy of trucks waited on both sides of the frontier and perishable cargo, such as plantains, began to spoil while shipments could not move into Uganda. The piece centers on Leah Masika, who was tearful at the prospect of losing her valuable cargo, illustrating the immediate economic toll on traders and supply chains from the health response. The restriction highlights how Ebola-related controls at the Uganda–DR Congo border are affecting imports and livelihoods for people relying on cross-border commerce between the two countries.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ流行を理由にコンゴとの国境を閉鎖、商人が大きな損失に直面
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生報告があり、IHR基準のうち「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当。既に国境閉鎖という行政措置が取られており、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダの国境閉鎖がコンゴ側のエボラ発生に対応したものであることを明記。DRC内でのエボラ発生が確認されており、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。国境を越えた感染拡大リスクが現在進行形で存在し、全IHR基準とWPRO基準を満たす重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : restrictions aux voyageurs en provenance de RDC, Ouganda et Soudan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Restrictions on travelers coming from the DRC, Uganda, and Sudan.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts Mauritius to tighten travel restrictions from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. As of June 8, 2026, foreign nationals who have stayed, transited, or traveled in these countries within the previous 21 days are temporarily barred from entering Mauritius, in place through August 7, 2026. Mauritian citizens and holders of work, residence, occupation permits, or business/student visas may enter despite prior stays but must undergo a mandatory 21-day quarantine on arrival. All travelers must complete the All-in-One Travel Form and the Health Declaration Form before boarding. Enhanced health checks will be conducted at Mauritius’ airport and port with risk assessments for travelers from affected regions. The SAJ Recreation Centre in Riambel has been designated as the quarantine facility for those subject to isolation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: コンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、スーダンからの旅行者の制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、実際の政策対応と社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にはマウリシャスが含まれているが、実際のエボラ患者発生地はDRC・ウガンダ・スーダンであり、マウリシャスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国リストに含まれない（Uganda=226074、Sudan=366755が対象外）ため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ列挙。DRCは対象国リスト（203312）に該当。記事から確認できる実際の発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、スーダンであるが、指定対象国の中ではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola's Hidden Link To Gold Mining: Why Scientists Are Raising Alarm In Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, linked to expansion of gold and mineral mining in the Congo Basin that increases human–wildlife contact. Bats are considered likely Ebola reservoirs, and forest clearance plus workers entering remote areas heighten spillover risk. The US CDC notes Ebola is not usually foodborne, but hunting, butchering, and meat processing from infected animals can spark outbreaks. Africa CDC cautions that persistent human–animal–environment interfaces drive transmission, with mining camps offering crowded, limited-healthcare settings. The Congo’s mining boom, supplying minerals for smartphones and electric vehicles, worsens vulnerability in affected communities. WHO declared a global health emergency in May. Some experts believe infections began in February, with early tests targeting a different Ebola strain. As of Friday, about 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths were reported by Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の隠れた金鉱採掘とのリンク：科学者らがコンゴで警鐘を鳴らす理由
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急速な流行（約400確定例、63死亡）が報告され、WHO が5月に国際保健上の緊急事態宣言を行った。IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外の集団感染、渡航制限の可能性）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国を中心とするエボラ流行に焦点を当てており、中央アフリカ地域全体への拡大リスクを述べている。発生地域に米国が列挙されているが、サマリーではCDCのコメント引用のみで実際の米国での発生は記載されていないため、verified_locations から除外。WHO による国際保健上の緊急事態宣言（2026年5月）が確認された重篤なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള ഭീതി; ഛത്തീസ്ഗഡിൽ മൂന്ന് ആഫ്രിക്കൻ പൗരന്മാർ നിരീക്ഷണത്തിൽ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fear; three African nationals under observation in Chhattisgarh.
article.articleSummary: Three African nationals are under observation for Ebola in Chhattisgarh, India, as a precautionary measure. They were quarantined at a Durg district quarantine facility after arriving from African countries where Ebola outbreaks have been reported. Under health protocols, the individuals are in a 21-day surveillance period; there are currently no symptoms and no confirmed Ebola infection. Chhattisgarh’s Health Minister Shyam Bihari Jaiswal said the state is fully prepared to face any potential case, with hospitals and quarantine facilities on high alert and safety arrangements in place to protect the public. The measures aim to contain any possible transmission while monitoring travelers from affected regions. No laboratory confirmation of Ebola has been reported at this time.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖症；チャッティースガル州で3人のアフリカ人国民が観察下に
triage.triage_reason: インドでのエボラの疑い例の監視が報告されているが、現時点では確認例なし。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（異常性）。情報不足のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的隔離措置であり、現時点でエボラ感染の確認例はなし。アフリカ由来の患者の監視段階。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性と流行可能性が認識されるが、重症度および管理可能性は確認されていない。チャッティースガル州はインド国内の所在地であるため、検証位置はインドのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: I led the U.S. CDC response to the 2014 Ebola epidemic. The new outbreak needs massive, immediate, meticulous action
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) stresses rapid, large-scale action. In 2014–2016 West Africa, the outbreak killed >11,000; at response onset there were about 40–50 suspected cases. The current DRC outbreak began in Ituri, a gold-mining hub, and within three weeks spread from 3 to 25 health zones. By then, fewer than half of known contacts were being traced; laboratories were backlogged; no Ebola treatment center existed; health workers lacked protective equipment and trained staff; burial teams faced attacks. No vaccine or proven treatment exists for this strain; control relies on supportive care, contact tracing, quarantine, and rapid isolation. Urgent surge needs include clinicians, labs, infection-control specialists, logistics, and community health worker funding; community engagement is crucial to acceptance and behavior change. Laboratories must confirm cases within hours; treatment units staffed within days; 21-day contact follow-up. Past lessons from Lagos show rapid, decentralized incident management.

triage.headline_ja: 2014年のエボラ出血熱流行時にUSCDCの対応を率いた者による寄稿：新たな流行には大規模で迅速かつ入念な対応が必要
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行が DRC（Ituri 州）で確認され、3 週間で 25 保健地域に拡大。IHR 基準で「重篤な公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」が該当し、WPRO 基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が明確で、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC（Ituri 州）での現在進行中のエボラ流行を主題としており、歴史的な 2014-2016 年西アフリカ流行との比較で言及。ナイジェリア（ラゴス州）は 2014 年の過去事例として言及されているため除外。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリー内での言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: in sperimentazione clinica un farmaco per la profilassi post-esposizione
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: A Drug in Clinical Trials for Post-Exposure Prophylaxis.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. As of 6 June 2026, Congo reports 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths; Uganda reports 15 cases and 1 death. The World Health Organization (WHO) emphasizes expanded diagnostics to speed case confirmation and timely interventions. A post-exposure prophylaxis study for Obeldesivir, an oral antiviral, is advancing and could begin within two to three weeks, targeting contacts identified through tracing to lower the risk of infection after exposure. Additional therapies are under study with advanced clinical progress, including the monoclonal antibody MBP-134 and remdesivir. Vaccine development proceeds more slowly, with production increasing but requiring full testing. The article underscores preparedness to respond rapidly to Ebola outbreaks beyond vaccines, as authorities monitor and refine prevention and treatment strategies.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：暴露後予防投与のための臨床試験中の医薬品
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行で死亡例を伴い、国際的な広がりがあり、公衆衛生上の重大な影響と国際的な対応が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIで発生地域として列挙されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国（GeoNames ID 203312）に該当。エボラ出血熱は著しい死亡率を持ち、継続する流行状況、複数の治療法開発進展、およびWHOによる国際的な注視が記事に明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dünya alarmda: Vakalar 20 bini aşabilir! Ebola salgını kontrolden çıktı mı? - Bursa Hakimiyet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The world is on high alert: Cases could exceed 20,000! Has the Ebola outbreak gotten out of control?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease, affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, has near 400 confirmed cases and 65 deaths. Authorities warn the outbreak may have begun in February, and ongoing political violence, high population movement, and distrust of health workers complicate containment. Some patients are leaving treatment centers, and burial practices hindered by crowds further raise transmission risk. Quarantine duration is critical: CDC models indicate that if only 20% of patients are isolated within two days of symptom onset, the three-month case total could exceed 20,000 with about a 65% probability. If 70% are rapidly quarantined, the chance of surpassing 10,000 cases drops to roughly 5%. The CDC’s second report notes the overall risk to the United States is low, with past large Ebola outbreaks causing only limited U.S. cases.

triage.headline_ja: 世界が警戒態勢に：患者数が20,000人を超える可能性！エボラ出血熱の流行は制御不能になったのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク（既に複数国で確認）、異常な病況、渡航制限リスクがあり、スクリーニング基準も全て該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo Ebola virus diseaseの流行を記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsに含めない。米国はリスク軽微と記載されているため、発生地域から除外。患者数400人、死亡65人で、20,000人超える可能性という重大な警告あり。政情不安定、人口移動活発、医療不信、埋葬習慣が制御困難な要因。CDCモデルでは隔離実施率により患者数が20倍以上増加する可能性を指摘。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo eleva a 452 los casos de ébola confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo raises the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 452.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 452 confirmed Ebola cases in the eastern outbreak declared May 15, with 82 new deaths and rapid, ongoing community transmission. The latest INSP bulletin (as of 04 Jun 2026) shows 71 new confirmed cases in the prior 24 hours, 258 patients hospitalized or in isolation, and 8 recoveries across 25 health zones. About 57.8% of contacts have been traced; case fatality rate ~18%. Ituri remains the epicenter with 424 cases; North Kivu 25; South Kivu 3. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, with 19 infections and 2 deaths (both imported from the DRC); Uganda closed its border with DRC on May 27. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; CFR 30-50%; no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO declared PHEIC May 17; virus began circulating in Ituri ~two months before; transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ確認症例を452件に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、複数国への国際的拡大を示唆。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの重篤なエボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言されたコンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラアウトブレイク。452確定症例、18%のCFR、Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（30-50% CFR）。ウガンダへの越境感染あり（輸入例2例の死亡）。WHO PHEIC 2026年5月17日宣言済み。継続的な社会内伝播と多数の健康ゾーン（25ゾーン）への拡大を示唆。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsからは除外。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo eleva a 452 los casos de ébola confirmados y a 82 las muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo raises the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 452 and the death toll to 82.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, Democratic Republic of Congo reports 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths in the outbreak declared May 15. The INSP notes 71 new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours; 258 patients are hospitalized or in isolation; 8 have recovered; 25 health zones affected. Ituri province remains the epicenter with 424 cases, followed by North Kivu 25 and South Kivu 3. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, with 19 cases and 2 deaths; both deaths are imported from DRC. Uganda closed its border on May 27. The Bundibugyo strain carries a case fatality of 30–50% and there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; the virus began circulating in Ituri about two months earlier. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラの確認症例を452件、死亡者を82人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な感染症であり、DRCで452例、82死亡の大規模発生、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、ウガンダの症例は全てDRCからの輸入症例（2例2死亡）であり、本イベントの主題はDRCでの発生である。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみを含める。Bundibugyo株、CFR 30-50%、ワクチン・特異的治療なし。5月17日にWHOがPHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: How Congo's illegal gold trade is fueling the spread of a deadly, vaccine-resistant Ebola strain
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo's Ituri Province, centered around Mongbwalu, is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, with hundreds infected and rising deaths. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo. Transmission is linked to mining zones as deforestation pushes workers into rainforest, increasing contact with fruit bats, the virus's natural reservoir. A gold miner known as Mr. Saudi who developed a sudden high fever and severe hemorrhaging illustrates rapid progression in crowded camps. The outbreak has crossed borders, with cases reported in Uganda, including Kampala. International teams are rushing to establish isolated treatment units and community education, but response is hampered by armed conflict in eastern Congo, attacks on treatment centers, and deep local mistrust in the informal gold economy, which impedes reporting and isolation until movement can be safely monitored.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの違法金採掘がワクチン耐性エボラの蔓延を加速させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言、複数国への越境事例、ワクチン耐性・治療法未確立による深刻性。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダ（Kampala）での事例報告が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCがイベントの中心地であり、記事主題の発生国。Bundibugyo株のエボラは極めて稀な株で、ワクチン未承認・治療法未確立の状況が重症度を高める。違法鉱業と森林破壊が自然宿主（コウモリ）との接触増加を駆動、スピルオーバーリスク継続的。武装紛争による治療施設への攻撃、地域の不信感が対応を困難化させている。

article.articleHeadline: تحذيرات من ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا وسط أفريقيا إلى 20 ألف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warnings of rising Ebola infections in Central Africa to 20,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Central Africa is rising, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda confronting a major outbreak. As of 6 June 2026, DRC has 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths, up from 381 cases and 64 deaths reported earlier by WHO. The outbreak, centered in Ituri province, has spread across three provinces, with Ituri accounting for about 90% of confirmed cases and 76% of deaths, and has crossed into Uganda, where 16 confirmed cases and 1 death are reported. The Bundibugyo strain underlies the current outbreak, which began circulating before an official May 15 announcement in northeastern DRC. In response, WHO has launched a six-month plan worth $518 million for DRC and Uganda, with optimism about containment. U.S. CDC models project 10,000–20,000+ cases; worst-case could approach the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (over 28,000 cases, >11,000 deaths). Authorities stress rapid isolation of patients to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ感染が2万症例まで増加する警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、重大な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、複数国での流行を示している。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの感染も言及していますが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしています。DRCにおけるエボラ発生状況は明らかにシグナル条件を満たしており、452確認症例、82死亡、複数州での拡大、隣国への越境が確認されています。

article.articleHeadline: Медики назвали количество подтвержденных случаев заражения вирусом Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Medics announced the number of confirmed Ebola virus infections.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 450 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 82 deaths, as of June 6, 2026. The outbreak's epicenter is the eastern Ituri province, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Cross-border transmission is evident with Uganda reporting 19 cases, including 2 deaths. Officials warn the outbreak is rapid and ongoing, placing severe strain on healthcare systems already weakened by conflict and poverty. Shortages of vaccines and personal protective equipment, plus public distrust of authorities, hinder quarantine and burial measures. The World Health Organization has dispatched emergency-response teams to affected provinces and started vaccination campaigns targeting high-risk groups, but control remains difficult amid population movement and limited access to remote areas. Authorities emphasize stronger border controls and readiness of medical facilities to prevent further spread in the central African region.

triage.headline_ja: 医師らがエボラウイルス感染の確認症例数を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラは高病原性で国際的拡大リスクが高く、複数国への越境感染が既に確認されており、公開情報でも広く報道される重大な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではUgandaは越境感染の報告地として言及されており、主要な発生地はDRCである。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。エボラウイルス病は極めて高いリスク疾患であり、450例以上の確定症例と82死亡、ワクチン・PPE不足、医療システムの脆弱性、住民の信頼低下、越境感染などから、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC and WHO launch $518m response plan for Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC and WHO launched a $518 million, six-month joint preparedness and response plan (June–November 2026) to contain an ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Africa, with affected operations in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda and a ten-country priority focus for intensified surveillance and rapid response. The plan, under a One Response framework, aims to strengthen emergency coordination, disease surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and logistics, while safeguarding essential health services to prevent outbreaks of mpox, cholera, and measles. With no licensed vaccines or therapeutics for Bundibugyo virus, strategies emphasize health-system resilience and cross-border screening and coordination across at-risk neighbors. Implementation is underway in affected and at-risk countries, targeting 10 priority nations for early detection and rapid response and mobilizing funds through November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCとWHOがエボラ出血熱の流行に対応するため5億1800万ドルの対応計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、複数疾患の同時管理が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性、重症度、流行可能性が確認される。国際的対応枠組み（One Response）の下での大規模資金動員により、国際支援が必要な重篤シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際に発生が確認されている国はコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダ。対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国のみが該当するため verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルスのための公認ワクチンや治療薬がない点が深刻性を増す。複数疾患（Mpox、Cholera、Measles）の同時予防戦略が含まれ、地域的脅威が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Количество зараженных Эболой в ДР Конго достигло 452 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in DR Congo has reached 452.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths. The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri Province in the eastern DRC, with transmission spreading to neighboring provinces where 19 cases have now been registered, including two deaths. Authorities warn of rapid, ongoing spread within the country. Laboratory confirmation is provided by the National Institute of Public Health (DRC). The report cites information relayed by Report via Interfax referencing EFE.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が452人に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5つに該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤な感染症であり、DRCでの確認済み集団発生は公衆衛生上の極度の懸念。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確認済み集団発生（452確認症例、82死亡）。イトゥリ州が震源地だが、隣接州への拡大も報告されている。国家公衆衛生研究所による検査確認。ただし、イトゥリ州がGeoNames ID 215709として地域として識別されているが、実際の感染イベントはDRC全体に関わるため、対象国リストに含まれるDRC（203312）のみをverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo eleva a 452 los casos de ébola confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo raises the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 452.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's eastern Ebola outbreak has reached 452 confirmed cases, with 82 new deaths reported in the latest INSP bulletin (dated 04 June 2026). Some 258 patients are hospitalized or in isolation; recoveries total 8. The outbreak spans 25 health zones, with rapid, ongoing community transmission. Ituri Province remains the epicenter with 424 cases; North Kivu 25; South Kivu 3. The virus has spread to Uganda, which has 19 cases and 2 deaths, both imported from DRC; Uganda closed its border with DRC on 27 May. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, with a case fatality rate estimated between 30% and 50%; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO regards the outbreak as high-risk in Sub-Saharan Africa and a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) declared on 17 May. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic signs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、確認されたエボラ症例を452件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また既にWHOがPHEIC宣言済みの継続イベント。複数WPRIスクリーニング基準該当。
triage.notes: 既にWHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）の継続イベント。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルス、CFR 30-50%。DRCからウガンダへの越境確認（ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めず）。東部地域25の保健ゾーンで急速な地域内感染。継続的な展開状況監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'épidémie actuelle pourrait rivaliser avec celle record de 2014, alerte l'agence de santé américaine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The current outbreak could rival the record outbreak of 2014, warns the U.S. health agency.
article.articleSummary: June 6, 2026: The current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could reach a scale comparable to the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic if unchecked, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The CDC’s scenario projections show that without strong public health interventions, this outbreak could expand to a similar magnitude. A key uncertainty is the total number of infected individuals needing isolation, described as uncertain and at the lower end of modeled ranges by Satish Pillai, CDC outbreak response lead. As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports 64 deaths among 381 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Uganda reports 1 death among 16 confirmed cases. The article highlights the previous 2014–2016 outbreak, which killed about 11,000 people, and urges decisive measures to prevent a repeat of that scale.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：現在の流行は2014年の記録的流行に匹敵する可能性がある、米国保健機関が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラの多国間流行で深刻な死亡率、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで言及されているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラは極めて高い感染死亡率と国際拡大リスクを持つため、優先度は極めて高い。2014年西アフリカ流行（約11,000人死亡）に匹敵する規模への警告であり、早期のフルRRA実施が重要。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ запускает программу на 518 миллионов долларов для борьбы со вспышкой Эболы -- НИАТ "Ховар"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO launches a $518 million program to fight the Ebola outbreak — NIAT "Khovar".
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC launch a six-month, $518 million plan to fight the Ebola outbreak in Africa, focusing on the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda and preparing neighboring states. Measures include strengthening border sanitation controls, expanding testing, and boosting healthcare readiness. As of early June, the outbreak has 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the DRC, and 19 cases with 2 deaths in Uganda. The outbreak is driven by a rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Diagnostic challenges persist; tests do not always detect this strain promptly, and results can take days to weeks. Donors pledged $315.8 million internationally by early June, far below what is needed. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the spread is rapid and requires sustained funding, government support, and trusted local engagement to stop it.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱の流行に対抗するため5億1800万ドルのプログラムを開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生への影響、異常で予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（確認症例452例、死亡82例）とウガンダ（症例19例、死亡2例）での発生が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルスの稀な株系統で、承認されたワクチンや特異的治療法がない点が重大なリスク要因。WHOが6ヶ月間で5億1800万ドルの緊急プログラムを立ち上げていることが、深刻さと国際的関心の高さを示している。

article.articleHeadline: 2,3 Juta Anak Belum Imunisasi, Pakar Ingatkan Risiko Wabah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2.3 Million Children Unvaccinated, Experts Warn of Outbreak Risk
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces outbreak risk as about 2.3 million children last year were zero-dose, placing the country sixth globally in unvaccinated children. Data from the Ministry of Health cited by Bambang Edi Susyanto, a pediatrician at Universitas Muhammadiyah Yogyakarta, show many children have not received basic immunization, weakening herd immunity and raising the potential for outbreaks of preventable diseases. The article notes vaccines such as BCG to prevent tuberculosis and DPT to prevent diphtheria, pertussis, and tetanus, whose absence endangers child health and growth. Immunization is described as highly cost-effective, with lower prevention costs than treating severe infections. Parents in Indonesia, including Yogyakarta, are urged not to delay vaccination; mild post-vaccination fever is normal and indicates immune response. Strengthening coverage is essential to prevent re-emergence of diseases previously controlled by national programs.

triage.headline_ja: 230万人の子どもが予防接種未実施、専門家は流行リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 予防接種カバレッジ低下による複数の予防可能疾患（結核、ジフテリア、百日咳、破傷風）の流行リスク警告は異常かつ重症度懸念があるが、現在の確定した患者数・流行状況の報告がなく、公開情報は限定的。継続経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種カバレッジ低下による潜在的な流行リスクについての専門家警告であり、現在進行中の流行の確認報告ではない。IHR基準2項目以上該当（深刻な影響・異常性）かつWPRO基準3項目該当するが、確定患者数・発症報告が記載されていないため確実性が低い。インドネシアの予防接種プログラム強化は国家レベルの関心事項である。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حالات الإصابة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو - بوابة الأهرام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising Ebola virus infection cases in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rose by 71 in one day, with 21 additional deaths, as health workers broadened testing in Mongbwalu, a gold-mining town in Ituri Province believed to be the outbreak’s starting point, indicating a much larger epidemic than previously thought. As of 2026-06-06, laboratory-confirmed cases reached 452 and deaths among confirmed patients reached 82, according to the National Institute of Public Health of Congo, via Bloomberg. Authorities are processing samples in Mongbwalu to speed confirmation of suspected cases, reducing delays. The Mongbwalu epicenter in Ituri's mining belt remains the focus of containment and rapid laboratory confirmation efforts to map the outbreak's true scale.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラウイルス感染症例の増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルスによる重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、452例の確定症例と82名の死亡が報告され、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは高い致命率を持つ出血熱。DRC北東部Ituri州のMongbwalu金鉱町を中心に発生。記事日時2026-06-06時点で確定症例452例、死亡82名と報告。実際の感染規模がこれまでの予想より大きい可能性が指摘されており、急速な対応が必要。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: 'We live with fear': In Congo, doctors face Ebola with little protection
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo, Ituri province, is the epicenter of an Ebola outbreak, with frontline health facilities reporting fear and limited staff protection. At SOFEPADI's Karibuni Wa Mama Medical Center, a 25-year-old midwife and a doctor in his early 30s are sick with Ebola symptoms, including fever and severe joint pain, according to medical director Elisabeth Furaha. The report underscores strain on healthcare workers and the ongoing risk they face at outbreak sites, as the disease spreads and protection gaps persist. No laboratory confirmation details are provided in the article, but the described symptoms align with Ebola. The focus remains on the human toll among clinicians and patients at facilities serving the outbreak's epicenter in northeastern Congo, highlighting urgent need for protective measures and infection control in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで恐怖とともに暮らす：医療従事者がほぼ保護されないままエボラに直面
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥーリ州での進行中のエボラ発生。医療従事者への感染確認、国際的懸念が高く、IHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は明確にコンゴ民主共和国イトゥーリ州でのエボラ発生を報道。医療従事者（助産婦、医師）の感染事例が確認されており、医療施設での保護不足が強調されている。発病中のアウトブレイクであり、継続的な感染リスクが存在する。PICKUP判定により、フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果452人染伊波拉　美CDC：最遭恐2萬人染疫、上千死│TVBS新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: 452 people infected with Ebola; U.S. CDC says the most feared outbreak, with up to 20,000 infections and thousands dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths reported as of April 4; neighboring Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths as of May 5. The CDC on May 5 released models suggesting that, without broad, sustained public health interventions—such as rapid isolation of patients—the outbreak could reach more than 20,000 cases and about 4,000 deaths within three months, with most cases in the outbreak region. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic surpassed 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths. The WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. U.S. risk remains low; models indicate border screening and travel restrictions can reduce importation risk, and even with imported cases, transmission in the United States would likely be limited due to infection control measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱452人が感染　米CDC：最悪の場合2万人以上の感染、千人以上が死亡する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主題となっているのはDRCでのエボラ発生。ウガンダでの2次的な感染確認も述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに該当しないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。USAはサマリー内で言及されるが、発生地ではなく分析・対応機関（CDC）の役割であるため除外。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Comerciantes afrontan grandes pérdidas tras cierre de Uganda de frontera con Congo por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Merchants face heavy losses after Uganda closes its border with Congo over Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Uganda closed its western border with the Democratic Republic of Congo on May 28 to curb cross-border Ebola transmission from the Ituri outbreak. At the Mpondwe border crossing in Kasese, Ugandan authorities blocked entry/exit except for emergencies, slowing a busy informal trade route valued at about $131 million in 2023. Traders report cargo backlogs and spoilage; seven trucks carrying fish from China destined for North Kivu's Beni and Butembo sit idle. Congo’s outbreak is suspected to have infected more than 1,000 people, with confirmed counts lower due to under-testing. Uganda has confirmed 15 Ebola cases, all linked to the Congo outbreak after some Congolese sought treatment in Kampala before the May 15 declaration. The disease is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which available vaccines and treatments are ineffective. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern, while advising against border closures to reduce cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがコンゴとの国境を閉鎖、エボラ対策により商人が大損失に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な感染拡大（DRC→Uganda）、WHO緊急事態宣言の発出、国際的な渡航制限措置の実施により、シグナルとしてのフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRCのIturi州での発生事例がUganda側に波及し、国境閉鎖による社会経済的影響が報告されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（利用可能なワクチンや治療法が無効）の特性も懸念要因。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Φόβοι για επιδημία αντίστοιχη με εκείνη του 2014
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Fears of an outbreak similar to the 2014 outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. About 400 laboratory-confirmed cases and 63 deaths have been recorded, with authorities acknowledging underdiagnosis beyond confirmed figures. U.S. CDC computer-models project 10,000 to over 20,000 cases, with some scenarios exceeding 28,000—similar to West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis—if transmission is not rapidly curtailed. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids such as vomit, blood, and semen; there are no specific therapies or approved vaccines for Bundibugyo. The World Health Organization declared a global health emergency in May. Ongoing armed conflict in Congo involving M23 and the Allied Democratic Forces has driven mass displacement, complicating response efforts. Isolation of cases at 50–70% could bring totals toward ~10,000; lower isolation could lead to worse outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：2014年の流行に匹敵する流行への懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による中央アフリカでの流行で、既に400例の確定例と63死亡があり、CDCの予測では10,000～28,000例に拡大の可能性。WHOが5月に国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による流行は稀であり、西アフリカ2014-2016危機との比較で高い社会的関心。武装紛争による人口移動が対応を複雑化させている。WHOによる国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言があり、承認されたワクチンや特異的治療法がない状況。

article.articleHeadline: WHO unveils $518 million plan to contain Ebola outbreak in Congo, Uganda
article.articleSummary: WHO unveils a $518 million six-month emergency plan to contain ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, announced by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Africa CDC. The initiative aims to support outbreak containment and bolster neighbouring countries’ preparedness via enhanced border screening and surveillance, as the outbreak is spreading rapidly and response efforts struggle to keep pace. Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment, drives the crisis; existing countermeasures target other variants. DRC reports 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths; Uganda 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, with updated figures as of June 1 of 321 infections, 48 deaths, and 6 recoveries. About $315.8 million in donors have pledged, leaving a large funding gap for the six-month plan. Challenges include community resistance, attacks on burial teams, and security concerns; cross-border spread to Kampala noted.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴとウガンダのエボラ出血熱封じ込めに5億1800万ドル計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な高い致死率の稀な株、複数国への国際拡大、国境地域での感染拡大）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。WHO事務局長による正式発表、国際的支援体制の構築など社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: サマリーでDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダでのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の複合感染事態が記載されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。DRC内での確認症例381件（死亡62件）、ウガンダ側19件（死亡2件）。稀なBundibugyo ebolavirus株による深刻な状況であり、ワクチン・特異的治療がない点が重大。WHO事務局長による6か月間5億1800万ドルの緊急計画発表は国際的関心が極めて高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: NHS staff and airports told to prepare for UK ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak centers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 344 cases and 60 deaths; Uganda has confirmed cases. UK authorities warn of potential imported cases, with posters in airports and stations to educate the public. The UK Health Security Agency instructs GPs and hospitals to ensure sufficient PPE and preparedness across microbiology, virology, IPC, emergency departments, obstetrics, pediatrics and primary care. Ebola currently has no cure. Incubation can reach 21 days; symptoms include fever, unexplained bleeding, rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, and potential multi-organ failure and death. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions or other body fluids or through contaminated environments; airborne transmission is not believed to be a natural route. Suspected cases should be isolated, with restricted staff and visitors.

triage.headline_ja: NHS職員と空港がUK Ebola流行の準備を指示される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、DRCで344例60死亡、ウガンダで確認例あり、英国への輸入ケース警告。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、主要な発生地はDRC（344例60死亡）。ウガンダも確認例があるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。英国は輸入ケース警告のみで実際の発生地ではないため除外。WHO PHEC宣言済みの極めて深刻なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: UAE bans travelers from Uganda, DRC, South Sudan over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: UAE bans new visas for Ugandan nationals and travelers from Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), and South Sudan amid Ebola fears, effective 1:00 pm local time on Saturday, June 6, 2026. Direct arrivals from, or passengers transiting through, these countries will be denied entry, with an exception for those who have spent more than 21 days outside the affected countries prior to arrival (the Ebola incubation window). Transit and cargo flights continue. Uganda’s Ministry of Health reports a cumulative 19 confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda as of June 6, 2026: 14 imported cases and 5 Ugandan nationals. Of these, 13 are actively admitted, 4 discharged, and 2 deaths have occurred, both among imported cases. Authorities say the situation is controlled and that restrictions may be extended or adjusted based on risk assessments and international monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: UAE、エボラ懸念からウガンダ、DRC、南スーダンからの渡航者を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例と国際的な渡航制限措置が確認された。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当。国際的な感染症対応が進行中。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認症例数は19件（輸入症例14件、ウガンダ国内5件）で2名の死亡を報告。UAEによる旅行禁止措置により国際的拡大のリスクが顕在化。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hosting the World Cup makes US 'really ripe' for diseases, experts worry
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, hosting the World Cup in 11 U.S. cities heightens infectious-disease risk as 39 of 48 teams train in the United States and millions of fans travel. Ebola outbreaks in Central Africa are cited as a concern, with U.S. travel restrictions including a 30-day ban on arrivals from Ebola regions and 21-day isolation for Congo players entering the United States; airport screening is planned in Houston, Atlanta, New York City and Washington, D.C. The Dallas 2014 Ebola death and two infected nurses are recalled as a cautionary precedent. Washington’s retreat from the WHO and the dismantling of USAID, plus nearly 30% CDC staffing cuts, raise concerns about preparedness for mass gatherings, though the CDC has mobilized resources to Africa and is developing a World Cup data dashboard. Other likely threats include COVID-19, flu, RSV and norovirus; cities like New York, Boston and Houston coordinate with federal partners to mitigate risks.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ開催で米国は感染症に「本当に適した環境」になるおそれ、専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: Ebolaを含む複数の呼吸器感染症が記載され、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）で複数該当が見られるが、米国での既知の流行ではなく潜在的リスク評価であること、また記事サマリーに記載国が対象国外（米国、中央アフリカ共和国）が主体であることから、確実な情報確認が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にCentral African RepublicとUSAが含まれるが、サマリーの主題は米国でのワールドカップ開催に伴う潜在的リスク評価である。DRCのEbola発生が記事の主体的な懸念源として言及されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。米国は対象国外のため除外。情報は将来のリスク予測に基づくもので、現在の確定的な流行報告ではない。続報による確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola pourrait égaler le record enregistré en 2014
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak could match the record set in 2014.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), northeast region, involving the Bundibugyo variant, declared May 15. The U.S. CDC warns that without strong public-health measures, the outbreak could reach the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed over 11,000. WHO data show 381 confirmed cases in the DRC with 64 deaths; across the border in Uganda, 16 cases and 1 death have been reported, with 7 recoveries in the DRC and 2 in Uganda. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids. There is no approved vaccine or licensed treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. CDC models suggest outcomes depend on isolation proportions; authorities are urged to deploy a robust response akin to that used a decade ago to curb transmission. The outbreak may have circulated undetected for some time, highlighting the need for vigilant surveillance and rapid intervention.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が2014年の記録と同等になる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。進行中のエボラ出血熱流行で死亡例があり、国境を越えた感染拡大、国際支援の必要性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行を報じているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株による進行中の流行で、2014–2016年西アフリカ流行と同規模になる可能性が警告されており、公式な治療法・ワクチンが利用不可という重大なリスク要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: Καλπάζει η επιδημία Έμπολα με 452 κρούσματα στο Κονγκό, φόβοι ότι μπορεί να πάρει μεγάλες διαστάσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic surges with 452 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, fears it could take on large proportions.
