article.articleSummary: On June 6, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 452 confirmed Ebola cases, with 82 deaths; 71 new cases were recorded in the past 24 hours. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain. U.S. CDC modeling indicates that without robust public health measures, the epidemic could reach levels similar to or larger than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. The CDC published three reports to galvanize international support, per CDC officials. In response, the State Department announced nearly $38 million in additional Ebola funding, bringing U.S. assistance to over $200 million, with coordination with the CDC and authorities in the DRC and Uganda. Washington also said that exposed but asymptomatic U.S. citizens will be quarantined in a Kenya facility built for this purpose.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染症が急増、452人の患者数、大規模化への懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行性、管理能力）。国際的支援が既に動員されており、社会政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が主題。452確認患者、82死亡、過去24時間で71新規患者。Bundibugyo株による。2014-2016西アフリカ流行と同等またはそれ以上のレベルに達する可能性がCDCモデルで指摘されている。米国国務省が3800万ドルの追加資金を発表し、米国支援総額は2億ドルを超える。ウガンダも関連地域として記載されているが、サマリーは主にDRCの状況に焦点。米国市民の隔離がケニア施設で検討されているが、DRCが主な発生地である。

article.articleHeadline: 防10年前危機重演 美加碼12億對抗伊波拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To prevent a crisis from repeating that occurred ten years ago, the United States pledges $1.2 billion to combat the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: United States pledges an additional $38 million to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, pushing total U.S. direct aid above $200 million. CDC warns that without strong public-health interventions, this outbreak could reach or exceed the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola crisis. Since mid-May, DRC health authorities report 452 confirmed Ebola infections and 82 deaths, with 71 new cases in the last 24 hours. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved treatments or vaccines exist. The U.S. is coordinating with the DRC and Uganda, deploying about 30 CDC staff in Kinshasa and roughly 100 in Uganda, along with additional experts in recent weeks. The WHO notes the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak affected 10 countries, with 28,652 cases and 11,325 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 10年前の危機の再来を防ぐため、米国はイボラ疫情対策に12億ドルを追加投資
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行がDRCで確認され、IHR基準4項目全て該当。CDCが2014-2016年西アフリカ危機同等以上の規模に達する可能性を警告し、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、国境を越えた対応が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ出血熱の現在の発生地はDRC（キンシャサ）であることが明確。ウガンダは対応拠点地であるが、記事内で検査例や患者報告がないため発生国としては含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株で治療薬・ワクチンなし、過去10年で最大規模の流行警告、米国のみで200百万ドル超の支援投下等、深刻度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola Spreads in East Africa, Will China Step Up?
article.articleSummary: Ebola spreads in East Africa, centered in Mongbwalu, DR Congo, with Bundibugyo virus; testing is limited and there is no approved vaccine or treatment. The United States’ emergency response is diminished, raising expectations that China may take a lead by supplying funds, equipment, and medical personnel. Beijing has sent a five-person team to Kinshasa (over 1,000 miles from the outbreak center) but has not publicly responded to Africa’s $319 million aid appeal or joined the WHO outbreak committee. Analysts say China could leverage its manufacturing base and biotech sector to deliver PPE and rapid diagnostics, including multiplex tests for the Ebola family. China’s 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola effort—over $100 million in supplies, hundreds of workers, and an overseas biosafety lab—shaped expectations, aided by Africa CDC ties and post-COVID epidemic experience.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカ東部で広がる中、中国は対応を強化するか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の拡大、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo亜種）がDRC中部で確認され、限定的な検査体制と治療法不在の状況下での拡大懸念。国際的な人道支援要求と戦略的対応が国家間で焦点化している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC（Mongbwalu/Kinshasa）でのエボラ感染症イベント。米国と中国の国際対応格差が政治的焦点。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）による限定的な医療対応環境は拡大リスク要因。China、USA、Angola、Mozambiqueは地域的文脈または支援提供国として言及されているが、イベント発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: المنظمة الصحية تعلن خطة طارئة لمكافحة تفشي الإيبولا في أفريقيا | سبق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Health Organization announces an emergency plan to combat the Ebola outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) and the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) launched a six-month continental emergency plan costing $518 million to halt the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Africa. The plan, spanning June to November 2026, aims to mobilize resources to bolster preparedness, early detection, and rapid response across African countries and partners under a unified 'One Plan' framework—one plan, one budget, one team. It complements national response programs already launched by the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The four pillars include coordinated emergency response, disease surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research and logistics, and maintaining essential health services. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed political commitment, sustainable funding, and community trust; Africa CDC’s Dr. Jan Kasia urged rapid action to curb fast-spreading Ebola and cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 保健機関、アフリカでのエボラ発生に対する緊急計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス疾患の複数国への拡大、国際的な対応枠組みの構築、深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は発生地域に含まれていますが、記事サマリーでは「DRCとウガンダが既に立ち上げた国家対応プログラムを補完する」と述べられており、確認された発生国としてはDRCのみが明確です。ウガンダでの発生が明示されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしました。ただし、国際的対応計画の文脈から複数国での発生または拡大リスクが高いと考えられます。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള ഭീതി; യാത്രക്കാർക്ക് കർശന മാർഗ്ഗനിർദ്ദേശങ്ങളുമായി യുഎഇ ആരോഗ്യ മന്ത്രാലയം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fear; UAE Ministry of Health issues stringent guidelines for travelers.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus variant is circulating in parts of Africa, prompting the UAE Ministry of Health to issue strict travel guidelines for citizens and residents. There are currently no Ebola cases in the United Arab Emirates. The UAE advises avoiding non-essential travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, and to take preventive precautions. The World Health Organization has declared Ebola a public health emergency of international concern, though global risk is considered manageable at present. Transmission occurs via blood, body fluids, contaminated surfaces, and infected wildlife; it is not airborne and does not spread before symptoms appear. Incubation ranges from 2 to 21 days; early symptoms include high fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pains, vomiting, diarrhea, sore throat, and abdominal pain; severe cases may involve internal and external bleeding. Travelers should consult the latest guidance, observe hygiene, avoid contact with suspected cases, and seek medical care if symptoms arise during or after travel; UAE and international health agencies have strengthened surveillance at airports and borders.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖；UAE保健省が渡航者向けの厳格なガイドラインを発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo variant）がアフリカで循環し、WHOが国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）として宣言。複数国での発生と国際的な渡航勧告制限が確認された。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ循環を言及しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。WAfrican（WHO AFRO）の大型アウトブレイク情報であり、PHEICステータスと複数国での地理的拡散が確認される。UAEの渡航勧告は「反応」段階の指標であり、シグナルの重要性を強化する。

article.articleHeadline: The World Has Learned From the Last Ebola Outbreak, but Gaps Remain
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in East Africa (Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda) unfolded with months of undetected spread. This response shows progress since West Africa’s 2014 crisis (over 11,000 deaths) in transparency and coordination among Africa CDC, WHO, and Congolese authorities, with outbreak declaration following confirmation this time. CEPI has committed up to $61 million to advance three Bundibugyo vaccines and support advance production for rapid deployment if trials succeed. Fast, rolling clinical trials are now feasible, leveraging lessons from prior outbreaks, while African labs perform molecular testing and participate in open genomic data sharing. Yet gaps persist: sustained funding for treatments and guaranteed access remain unclear. Global leadership is weakened by US withdrawal from WHO and reduced CEPI funding; early testing gaps in northeastern Congo for Bundibugyo also highlighted ongoing challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 世界は前回のエボラ流行から学んだが、課題は残る
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョエボラウイルス（Bundibugyo Ebola virus）がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで発生しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が懸念される。国際的な支援体制と医療対応の課題も明白である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブンディブギョエボラウイルスの発生をコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで述べているが、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当する（ウガンダは対象国外）。前回のエボラ流行（2014年西アフリカ）との比較を通じて、現在の公衆衛生体制の進展と残された課題（治療の持続的資金調達、グローバルリーダーシップの弱体化、早期検査の不足など）が強調されている。CEPI による最大6100万ドルのワクチン支援コミットメント、アフリカCDC・WHO・コンゴ当局間の連携強化が報告されており、国際的関心と対応が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Los casos de ébola se disparan en RDC conforme aumenta el ritmo de las pruebas médicas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases surge in the DRC as the pace of medical testing increases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northern and northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo with 82 deaths and 452 confirmed cases. In the last 24 hours (Thu–Fri) 21 deaths and 71 new cases were recorded, centered in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, the likely epicenter. Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, with no vaccine, has spread to North Kivu and Uganda, where two more deaths occurred. Ongoing violence and displacement hinder surveillance and magnitudes remain uncertain. CDC warns the outbreak could reach levels not seen since the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic; initial symptoms appeared May 14–23, followed by a second wave May 25–June 3. CDC modeling links origin to February transmission; with only 20% identified, >20,000 cases in 3 months could occur; with ~70% isolation, outbreaks exceeding 10,000 are unlikely. A new diagnostic lab in Mongbwalu improves local testing; about 4,800 contacts are under monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 医療検査のペースが上がるにつれてコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な影響を与え、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及確認）がある。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5基準に該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「Uganda, where two more deaths occurred」と言及されており、ウガンダでの流入・死亡が確認されている。しかしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo Ebola virusワクチンなし、暴力による対応阻害、西アフリカ流行（2014-2016）比肩の警告など、極めて危機的状況。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda mở mặt trận chống tin giả giữa đợt bùng phát Ebola mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda opens a front against fake news amid a new Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uganda strengthens counter-misinformation as the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa enters its third week. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus has caused 452 cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since May 15. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths as of June 5. Affected health workers total 34 infections, with 7 deaths and 6 recoveries. Uganda also boosts surveillance, contact tracing, border screening, and diagnostic capacity while expanding community risk communication to curb misinformation that undermines reporting and isolation. CDC Africa and WHO warn challenges include no specific treatments for Bundibugyo, weak health systems, limited resources, cross-border movement, healthcare worker infections, and erosion of trust. They launched a USD 518 million plan to aid prevention, detection, and response across Africa from June to November. UAE bans entry from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan starting June 6 to prevent spread; cargo and transit flights continue.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ新規流行の中で偽情報対策に乗り出す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。中央アフリカでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）は国際的拡大リスク、深刻な健康被害、および渡航制限措置を伴う重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダとDRCでのエボラ流行を扱っているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Ugandaは対象国に含まれないため除外。DRCで452例・82死亡、ウガンダで19例・2死亡が報告されており、医療従事者感染34例（死亡7例）も記載。UAEがDRC・Uganda・South Sudanからの入境禁止を発表しており、国際的なエスカレーションが確認される。CDC AfricaとWHOが5億1800万ドルの対応計画を発表。Bundibugyo ebolavirus特異的治療薬がなく、保健システム脆弱性と信頼低下が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus In CG: Chhattisgarh में Ebola Virus का खतरा? मंत्री Shyam Bihari Jaiswal ने जारी किया अलर्ट!
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus threat in Chhattisgarh prompts an alert by Minister Shyam Bihari Jaiswal on 2026-06-06. The article provides no data on confirmed cases, deaths, symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection source. No details on ongoing transmission, district-level impact, or imported/exported cases are given. The text largely centers on a journalist's profile—Priyanshu Singh of IBC24 News—rather than epidemiological update, offering no verifiable information about an outbreak. As such, the piece states the alert but does not supply case counts, lab results, or public health actions beyond the ministerial warning. Readers are left without actionable outbreak metrics; the article functions as a brief alert without substantiating epidemiological details.

triage.headline_ja: Chhattisgarh州でエボラウイルスの危機？大臣Shyam Bihari Jaiswalがアラートを発令！
triage.triage_reason: 記事サマリーが明示するとおり、確認症例、死亡者、症状、検査結果、感染源に関する具体的データが全く記載されていない。大臣による警告のみで、実際の患者発生を示す疫学的根拠が存在しない。
triage.notes: この記事は大臣の警告言及のみであり、実際の患者確認、検査確認、感染源、感染者数等の疫学的データが全く欠如している。記者紹介記事としての側面が強く、実質的な感染症イベント報告として不十分。警告だけでは根拠となるシグナルとはならない。再度確認情報の取得を待つべき。

article.articleHeadline: Churches do their part to halt spread of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues in Ituri province, marking the 17th outbreak there in about 50 years. Official counts show at least 80 killed and around 450 confirmed cases, though estimates suggest actual figures are higher, with hundreds of deaths and at least a thousand cases. Aid workers say poverty, low education, and mistrust compound transmission and response challenges. Churches and aid groups are stepping in to provide medical care, promote hygiene, and counter misinformation. In Bagata, pastor Schadrack Nyakulinda notes that faithful wash hands at services, and Tearfund reports handwashing is hard where safe water is scarce or costs a trade-off with food. Anglican Bishop of Goma, Martin Gordon, and local nurse Isaac Bataga describe resistance and fear that lead some to avoid care. Attacks on medical staff have occurred during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の拡大を止めるための教会の取り組み
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な影響（死亡・感染者数多数）、異常性（17番目の集団発生）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクの4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の進行中の流行であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州におけるエボラ出血熱の流行を主題としている。公式統計で少なくとも80人の死亡、約450例の確認症例が報告され、実際の数字はさらに高いと推定されている。医療スタッフへの攻撃も発生しており、対応能力の制約が明らかである。

article.articleHeadline: The Intriguing Case Of Laipikia Ebola Virus Disease (evd) Isolation & Treatment American Only Facility
article.articleSummary: Kenya and the United States plan a 50-bed Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) isolation and treatment facility at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki to isolate and treat only American healthcare workers exposed to Bundibugyo Ebola linked to the DRC outbreak confirmed May 15, 2026 in Ituri Province and spreading to Uganda. Bundibugyo Ebola is a rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatment, per WHO. The Laikipia center aims to strengthen surveillance and emergency response, but on June 1–2, 2026, hundreds protested in Nanyuki and a Kenyan High Court injunction blocked operation until the deal’s terms are public. Background includes Nairobi–Washington biosafety cooperation since 2015 and the December 2025 America First Global Health Strategy, under which the US may invest up to $1.6B and Kenya $850M to bolster public health. Proponents cite cross-border spillover risk; opponents cite sovereignty and safety concerns.

triage.headline_ja: ラキピア・エボラウイルス病（EVD）の興味深いケース アメリカのみの施設での隔離と治療
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性）。稀なBundibugyo株で治療法なし。DRC→ウガンダ→ケニアへの越境スピルオーバーリスク、および両国間の政治的緊張が存在。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・ウガンダ・米国の状況に言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。DRCでIturi Province（5月15日確認）でのBundibugyo Ebola発生が記事の主題。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国外。稀なBundibugyo株（ワクチン・治療法なし）の越境スピルオーバーリスク、政治的対立（地元住民の抗議、裁判所の差止命令）により社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Le RDC alerte sur la propagation rapide du virus Ebola - La Presse de Tunisie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC warns of the rapid spread of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports an Ebola outbreak with rapid spread. On Friday, 5 June 2026, authorities recorded 71 new Ebola cases in the previous 24 hours, bringing the total confirmed cases to 452 and the death toll to 82 since the outbreak’s declaration. Health officials warn of accelerated transmission within the population and say containment efforts are being intensified by the Ministry of Health. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation procedures, transmission sources, clinical symptoms, or import/export status of cases. The situation underscores an ongoing and evolving Ebola outbreak in the country, with authorities stressing the need for continued surveillance, contact tracing, and public health measures to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルスの急速な拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認された流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、高い国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性があるため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク分類の感染症。24時間で71例の新規確定患者、累積452例、死亡82例が報告されている。発症・死亡率、ウイルス株情報、具体的な感染源・伝播経路などの詳細は記事サマリーに記載されていないため、フルRRAで追加情報収集が必要。国際支援の必要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Ebola: Uganda records four recoveries one more death
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports four Ebola recoveries and one new death, with three additional infections, raising total confirmed cases to 19 and deaths to two. The latest fatality—a Congolese national—brings the toll to two. The three new cases are contacts of confirmed patients under institutional quarantine at diagnosis. Four patients and 270 contacts have recovered and been discharged. The detections among known contacts reflect effective surveillance and contact tracing, with no unexplained community transmission. On June 5, a meeting with the DR Congo Consulate and Congolese community was held to counter myths and mobilize leaders to encourage early symptom reporting, contact tracing, and reduced stigma. UAE travel measures also affect Uganda, DR Congo, and South Sudan, suspending new visas and imposing additional entry restrictions from June 6. Uganda says the outbreak remains under control.

triage.headline_ja: 健康：エボラ：ウガンダが4人の回復と1人の新規死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外のイベント、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限既発生）。複数国にまたがるエボラウイルス病の確認事例であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの事例報告を主題としているが、対象国リストにはUgandaが含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC国籍の死亡者が含まれ、DRC-ウガンダ間での越境事例と考えられる。UAE の渡航制限措置により国際的な対応既発動。接触者の監視体制が確立されており制御下にあるとの報告だが、エボラウイルス病の性質上、高リスク シグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: രാജ്യത്ത് ഇതുവരെ ആർക്കും രോഗബാധയില്ല; മുൻകരുതലിന്റെ ഭഗമായി നടപടി; എബോള ഭീതിയിൽ യാത്രക്കാർക്ക് കർശന മാർഗ്ഗനിർദ്ദേശങ്ങളുമായി യുഎഇ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: So far, no one in the country has been infected; precautionary measures in place; UAE issues strict travel guidelines for travelers amid Ebola scare.
article.articleSummary: UAE's Health Ministry issues precautionary travel guidelines for residents amid an Ebola scare linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant spreading in African countries. As of 2026-06-06, no infections have been confirmed in the United Arab Emirates, and the public health situation is described as fully secure. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant is spreading, prompting advisory restrictions on travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan except for essential purposes. There are no approved vaccines available against this variant, complicating response efforts. The guidelines are presented as preventive measures to minimize risk to travelers and residents until the situation evolves. The article emphasizes cautious travel and adherence to official guidance in light of the Ebola concern.

triage.headline_ja: アラブ首長国連邦、エボラ出血熱の脅威に対し国民への厳格な渡航ガイドラインを発表、国内感染者はなし
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限の可能性は認められるが、UAE国内での確定患者がなく、アフリカ地域での実際の流行状況に関する詳細情報が不足している。発生地域検証後、対象国のDRCのみが確認された。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではBundibugyo ebolavirus がアフリカ諸国で拡大していると述べられており、DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの渡航制限が言及されている。しかし、UgandaおよびSudanは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。UAE国内では確定患者がなく、あくまで予防的措置である点が重要。IHR基準4つとWPRO基準3つに該当するため、本来はPICKUP判定の可能性もあるが、UAE自体は対象国でなく、アフリカ地域の実際の流行動向に関する具体的データ（患者数、死亡数など）が記事に明記されていないため、情報不足によりWATCHとした。続報で対象国での患者確認情報が入れば、PICKUPに変更すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Nearly 500 confirmed cases in Central Africa Ebola outbreak: WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in central Africa nears 500 confirmed cases, with 452 in the Democratic Republic of Congo (82 deaths) and 19 in Uganda (2 deaths), bringing the total to 471 cases and 84 deaths, according to WHO and national reports. The outbreak, declared an international public health emergency, began in northeastern DRC on May 15 and is believed to have spread undetected for some time. With the epidemic escalating, a CDC official warned models project the outbreak could rival the 2014 West Africa crisis unless strong public health interventions are implemented. Ebola spreads via close contact and bodily fluids. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo species implicated here. A WHO-African CDC plan worth $518 million was launched to raise surveillance, testing, and infection-prevention over six months, aiming to halt transmission and prep neighboring countries for case detection.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、確認症例がほぼ500例に：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルの公衆衛生脅威であり、国際的に拡大するリスクが高く、国際保健上の緊急事態と宣言されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（452症例、82死亡）とウガンダ（19症例、2死亡）の発症を報告しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。本アウトブレイクは国際保健上の緊急事態として宣言済みで、2014年西アフリカのエボラ危機に匹敵する可能性があると警告されている。WHOは518百万ドル規模の対応計画を立案・実施中。

article.articleHeadline: ผวา! ปีนี้ หมา ติดเชื้อ พิษสุนัขบ้า แล้ว 20 ตัว ทำคนเสียชีวิต 1 ราย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic! This year, 20 dogs infected with rabies, one person dead.
article.articleSummary: From Jan 1 to Jun 2, 2026, Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand reports 20 rabies-positive dogs, with the 20th case on Jun 1 in Chai Mongkhon, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima—a stray eight-month-old male exhibiting aggression. One human death and 144 high-risk contacts have been recorded; 135 exposed individuals completed vaccination, 9 remain unvaccinated or incomplete. A temporary rabies outbreak zone was declared around Hua Talay, enforcing a 5-km ring vaccination and transmission-prevention measures. The province targets 80% vaccination coverage for dogs and cats by May 2026. Four animal-control actions include population surveys, local vaccination campaigns, rapid reporting of sick animals, and provincial oversight. Eight human-protection actions include proactive follow-up by community health volunteers, fast-track vaccination at hospitals, risk communication, bite-surveillance, and community education. Pet owners must vaccinate dogs, cats, and other susceptible animals annually; rabies is 100% fatal if infected.

triage.headline_ja: 警戒！今年、狂犬病に感染した犬が20匹、1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: タイで狂犬病（人獣共通感染症）の集団発生が報告され、既に1人の死亡者が確認されている。人獣共通感染症で死亡者を伴う異常事象であり、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する可能性が高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は100%致死的な疾患であり、既に1人の死亡者と144人の高リスク接触者が報告されている。タイ当局は積極的な予防接種キャンペーンと接触者フォローアップを実施中。記事は同日配信のメディア報道であり、社会的・政治的関心が高い状況である。

article.articleHeadline: Američki stručnjaci upozoravaju: Epidemija ebole u Kongu mogla bi postati jedna od najvećih u istoriji | 6yka
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American experts warn: An Ebola outbreak in Congo could become one of the largest in history.
article.articleSummary: On June 6, 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention warned that the current Bundibugyo-ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could become one of the largest on record if strong public health measures are not implemented. Jason Asher, director of the CDC's Center for Epidemic Forecasting and Analysis, highlighted the risk that this outbreak might reach or exceed the scale of the West Africa Ebola epidemic of 2014–2016. The CDC noted it has published three documents in its Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report related to this outbreak, partly to mobilize resources from the international community. The report underscores the need for concerted public health action to interrupt transmission and accelerate laboratory confirmation, given the potential for rapid spread of Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の専門家が警告：コンゴのエボラ流行は歴史上最大級になる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。エボラウイルスは最高リスク病原体であり、米国CDCが国際的動員を呼びかけている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUSAも含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCにおけるエボラ流行が主題であり、USAはメディア配信国。DRCのみが実際のイベント発生地。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）による流行であることが記事で明記されている。米国CDCが国際コミュニティへの資源動員を明示的に呼びかけており、国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 防10年前危機重演 美加碼12億對抗伊波拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To prevent a crisis like the one from ten years ago, the US and Canada boost US$1.2 billion to combat the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) intensifies as the United States adds $38 million in aid, bringing total direct US support to over $200 million. The CDC warns that without strong public‑health action, this outbreak could grow to match or exceed the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. DR Congo’s health ministry reports 452 confirmed infections and 82 deaths since mid‑May, with 71 new cases in the past 24 hours. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain; there are no approved treatments or vaccines. The US has deployed about 30 CDC personnel to its DRC office and roughly 100 to Uganda, and has sent additional experts in recent weeks. The United States is coordinating with DR Congo and Uganda as part of a broader international response; WHO notes the 2016 West Africa outbreak infected 28,652 people with 11,325 deaths across 10 countries.

triage.headline_ja: 10年前の危機の再演を防ぐため、米国とカナダが12億ドルを追加してエボラ疫情に対抗
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行であり、死亡例、複数国への拡大、国際的対応が報告されており、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCがエボラ流行の中心地として報告されており、過去10年前の西アフリカ流行との比較が主題。ウガンダへのCDC配置も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国はサマリーに含まれるが対象国リストに含まれず、また支援国としての役割であるため除外。CDCの警告、死亡例82例、452確認感染、治療法・ワクチン未承認、複数国への国際対応が報告され、全WPROスクリーニング基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo eleva a 452 los casos de ébola y suma 82 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo raises Ebola case count to 452 and records 82 deaths.
article.articleSummary: EBOLA outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) rises to 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, per the National Institute of Public Health (INSP). The latest bulletin records 71 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours. Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan borders is the origin, with the outbreak spreading to North Kivu and South Kivu provinces and into Ugandan territory, where 19 cases have been reported, including two deaths. The tally corresponds to counts through Thursday. Authorities warn of rapid, ongoing community transmission. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in eastern DRC. This expansion reflects rapid spread in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が452人に、死亡者82人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）を満たし、複数国への拡大と高い死亡率が報告されている。WPRO基準も重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の観点から複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの主流行が中心であり、ウガンダやスーダンへの拡大も記載されているが、これらの国は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。エボラ出血熱はIHR規則上の指定疾患であり、452確認症例と82死亡（致命率18.1%）は極めて深刻な状況。24時間で71新規確認症例があり、急速な感染拡大が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Jaundice Outbreak in Chhattisgarh: पीलिया से उपसरपंच 5 सहित की मौत के बाद गांव में मचा हड़कंप, 12 से अधिक मरीजों का अस्पताल में उपचार जारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaundice Outbreak in Chhattisgarh: Deputy Sarpanch and Five Others Die of Jaundice, Chaos Erupts in the Village, More Than 12 Patients Being Treated in Hospital
article.articleSummary: Jaundice outbreak in Manpat, Surguja district, Chhattisgarh (Ambikapur): more than 12 people across four or more villages have fallen ill with jaundice in the past week. Five deaths have been reported; Surguja CMHO PS Marko says two deaths were due to jaundice, while three others died with jaundice alongside other illnesses. Most patients are being treated in private hospitals; some admissions are in Ambikapur and Raipur. Authorities have issued an alert, with water sampling and investigations into transmission underway. District Collector Ajit Vasant has ordered health officials to determine causes and coordinate with PHED for water testing in the affected area. The public is urged not to rely on folk remedies, and health teams continue sampling to confirm diagnoses and identify the infection source.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガル州でジャンディス（黄疸）アウトブレイク：副村長を含む6人が死亡、村は混乱状態、12人以上の患者が病院で治療中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外の疾病、国際拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準3項目該当（重症度・死亡報告、長期曝露・複数村の発生、流行容易性）。未知の黄疸様疾患による死亡を伴う集団発症のため、フルRRA実施推奨。
triage.notes: 疾患がUnknown Illnessであり、黄疸様症状を呈する複数の死亡を伴う集団発症。水質汚濁との関連が疑われ、4村以上にわたる発生。複数の医療機関での治療と当局の調査が進行中。病因確定と感染経路の特定が急務。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola Spreads in East Africa, Will China Step Up?
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola virus centered in Mongbwalu, Democratic Republic of Congo, with limited testing hindering containment and no approved vaccine or treatment. Kinshasa hosts a five-person Chinese team delivering protective gear and lab supplies as the United States reduces its emergency response and Africa appeals for about $319 million in aid. Beijing’s involvement remains cautious and is not publicly tied to the aid appeal or a WHO committee, contrasting with the rapid, large-scale help during West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis. China’s potential impact lies in its manufacturing capacity for medical supplies, a growing diagnostics sector capable of multi-virus detection, and overseas biosafety experience, including an mRNA vaccine under study that could address hemorrhagic viruses, potentially enabling testing within remote or conflict zones. The outbreak’s trajectory remains uncertain, and questions persist about China assuming a leadership role.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカ東部で拡大する中、中国は対応を強化するか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ種）は極めて高い致死率を持つPatogen、DRCのモングバル地域で発生しており、検査能力不足、ワクチン・治療法なし、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明らかである。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当し、国際的支援が既に展開されている。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ発生地がDRC（Mongbwalu）であることを明確に述べており、中国の支援チームがKinshasaで活動していることが記載されている。ブンディブギョエボラは高い致死率を持つ希少型で、検査能力不足、治療法・ワクチン未承認という状況は深刻。複数国への国際的な拡大リスクが示唆されており、WHOおよび国際社会の大規模な対応が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: 150 students fall ill in Kerala, 38 hospitalised; school shut for a week
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, about 150 students at Mar Baselios Aided Upper Primary School in Wayanad district, Kerala, reported fever and vomiting, with 38 admitted to Bathery Taluk Hospital. One teacher also fell ill. The affected pupils are described as stable, and officials say there is no immediate cause for concern. The school has been closed for a week as a precaution, and a special ward has been arranged at Bathery Taluk Hospital to treat the students. Local panchayat representatives visited the hospital. Health officials have collected samples from affected students and staff and sent them to a laboratory for testing to identify the cause. The outbreak is under investigation, with no infection source confirmed yet.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州で150人の学生が発症、38人が入院。学校が1週間閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の集団発症イベント（150人の学生、38人入院）で、学校閉鎖などの公衆衛生対応が講じられており、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、長期曝露）に複数該当。対象国インドでの発生であり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 原因不明（Unknown Illness）の学校集団発症。150人の発症、38人の入院という規模と、検体採取・検査実施による調査対応が進められている。インドは対象国リストに含まれるため、フルRRAへのピックアップが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Chuyên gia y tế nói về đường lây truyền của Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A medical expert discusses the mode of transmission of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is not transmitted via airborne routes; it spreads mainly through direct contact with blood or body fluids of symptomatic patients. Transmission begins only after symptoms appear, and those in the incubation period are not contagious. High-risk exposure includes contact with blood, saliva, sweat, vomit, diarrhea, and other contaminated caregiving materials. In crowded settings like airplanes, risk remains low unless contact with infectious secretions occurs. Early detection, isolation, and strict infection control in hospitals are decisive to interrupt transmission. Initial symptoms mimic common viral illnesses—fever, headache, muscle aches, and fatigue—followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and bleeding. A travel history from Ebola-affected areas within 21 days warrants urgent medical consultation. Past major outbreaks occurred in Africa. Vaccines exist and are deployed in high-risk regions; monoclonal antibody therapies improve outcomes. Vietnam has not recorded Ebola cases; global pandemic risk is very low. Public vigilance and hygiene are essential.

triage.headline_ja: 医療専門家がエボラウイルスの感染経路について論述
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの感染経路に関する医学的情報提供記事であり、実際のアウトブレイクイベントではない。ベトナムではエボラ症例が記録されていないとの記事記述により、新規イベントの発生なし。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはベトナムを発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーは過去のアフリカでのアウトブレイク情報とベトナムのリスク評価（症例なし）に基づく教育的な医学情報であり、ベトナムでの新規イベント発生報告ではない。したがってverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Nearly 500 confirmed cases in central Africa Ebola outbreak: WHO
article.articleSummary: Nearly 500 Ebola cases have been confirmed in central Africa, per a WHO daily update. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths; in Uganda, 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Totals reach 471 cases and 84 deaths, up 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The outbreak, linked to the Bundibugyo species, has been declared an international public health emergency by WHO. It began May 15 in northeastern DRC and appears to have spread covertly. Ebola spreads through close contact and bodily fluids; there are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola. A $518 million plan by WHO and the African CDC over six months targets surveillance, laboratory testing and infection prevention. WHO chief Tedros urged rapid, coordinated action to stop spread and prep neighboring countries for detection and response, warning the outbreak could rival record scales seen in 2014 West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ蔓延でほぼ500確認症例：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（471症例84死亡）でWHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、シグナルとして認識すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラアウトブレイクはコンゴ民主共和国（452確認症例82死亡）とウガンダ（19確認症例2死亡）で言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo種エボラで承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、国際的拡大リスク高、2014年西アフリカアウトブレイク規模の警告あり。WHOが正式に国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRA必須。

article.articleHeadline: 5 things Dr. Sanjay Gupta wants you to know about Ebola | CNN
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, including Mongbwalu) has produced hundreds of cases and dozens of deaths, with spread into Uganda. At least 60 deaths reported by late May; CDC modeling warns the outbreak could surpass the 2014–16 West Africa epidemic (over 28,000 cases, ~11,000 deaths) if rapid interventions are not implemented. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The outbreak likely began earlier than officials realized, possibly as early as February, with Mongbwalu reporting a first case around February 22; early tests missed the Bundibugyo strain by screening for Zaire. Bundibugyo drives this outbreak; transmission requires close contact with very ill patients and bodily fluids. PPE helps, but remote, under-resourced facilities hinder care and contact tracing, which aims to reach >90% of contacts. Public health monitoring is expanding globally, including at events like the World Cup.

triage.headline_ja: 5つのこと サンジェイ・グプタ博士がエボラについて知ってほしいこと | CNN
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラの大規模流行で国際的拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、過去の大流行を上回る可能性があり、WHOが国際的保健上の緊急事態を宣言。緊急の対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ州、モングバル）を主体とした流行が記述されており、ウガンダへの波及も明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めていない。アンゴラはサマリーに言及されていないため除外。CDCモデリング、WHO緊急宣言（5月17日）、グローバル監視の拡大など、極めて高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Govt heightens Ebola surveillance at Eldoret Airport amid regional health concerns
article.articleSummary: Kenya intensified Ebola surveillance at Eldoret International Airport on 2026-06-06 amid regional concerns linked to outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Public Health and Professional Standards Principal Secretary Mary Muthoni announced a visit to assess preparedness and strengthen entry-point surveillance, focusing on passenger screening, emergency response readiness, infection prevention, and coordination between health authorities and airport management. The heightened surveillance is part of broader cross-border preparedness to detect and contain threats early at airports and other entry points. Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale reported Kenya remained Ebola-free with 56 suspected samples tested negative; no confirmed cases. Authorities said surveillance at major entry points—including airports, seaports, and land borders—will remain intensified to reduce importation risk. Eldoret Airport’s growing connectivity underscores the need for vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、地域の健康上の懸念の中でエルドレット空港のエボラ監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行に関連する地域的懸念の中、ケニアが国境監視を強化している。国際的な拡大リスクと異常性が認められ、IHR基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は主にケニアの監視強化に焦点を当てているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていない。エボラ発生地域として記事で言及されているのはウガンダとDRCであり、DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ケニアは対象外のため除外。この情報は全WPRO地域の監視対象国への情報共有が必要な重要なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: 40 students hospitalized over suspected food poisoning
article.articleSummary: Forty students are hospitalized in Kalpetta, Bathery, Wayanad, at Koliyadi Mar Baselios AUP School after fever and vomiting. Officials have not confirmed whether this constitutes food poisoning or viral fever; samples have been collected for laboratory testing. A dedicated ward has been opened at Bathery Taluk Hospital to treat the children, with symptoms emerging over the past two days. Authorities say the illness appears to be a possible bacterial infection from the school's drinking water. It is reported that up to 150 students have sought treatment at various hospitals in the last three days with similar symptoms. The current condition of patients is described as satisfactory, and results from tests are awaited to confirm the cause.

triage.headline_ja: 40人の学生が食中毒の疑いで入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」と「重症度」に該当。複数の学生が集団発症し、飲料水由来の可能性のある細菌感染で150人以上が治療を受けている状況は公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: ケーララ州ワヤナド地区での学校における集団発症。飲料水由来の可能性のある細菌感染が疑われ、3日間で150人以上が治療を受けている。原因確定のための検査結果待ちの段階。情報が限定的だが、公衆衛生上のリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: La flambée de la fièvre Ebola est la quatrième par son ampleur depuis 1976
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola fever outbreak is the fourth-largest in scale since 1976.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the Ebola fever outbreak in Africa is the fourth-largest by scale and severity since 1976, per Africa CDC data cited by SABC. The ongoing outbreak has 381 confirmed cases and 65l deaths. Under WHO rules, the detection of a single Ebola case in a country automatically designates that country as an epicenter. The Bundibugyo strain, identified in 2007 in western Uganda, is one of six Ebola types and is considered less deadly; there is no vaccine for Bundibugyo, unlike the Zaïre strain, which is more widespread. Transmission occurs from infected animals to humans. Major symptoms include fever, vomiting, headache, sore throat, kidney and liver damage, and sometimes internal and external bleeding. The virus was first documented in 1976 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) causing over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の流行は1976年以来4番目の規模である
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は極めて重篤な感染症であり、381確定例と65l死亡（死亡率>70%）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示す。IHR基準4つすべてに該当する可能性が高く、複数アフリカ国での発生により国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクも存在する。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはシエラレオネ、リベリア、ギニア、ウガンダが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCでの首度の文書化（1976年）と過去のウエストアフリカ流行（ギニア、リベリア、シエラレオネ）に言及されている。当前の流行の具体的な発生地は記事から不明瞭だが、「アフリカCDC」による報告とBundibugyo株が「ウガンダ西部で2007年に同定」との記載がある。対象国リストの確認範囲内ではDRCのみが明確に該当。Bundibugyo株の流行地については追加情報が必要だが、現段階ではDRCを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: US public health agency warns latest Ebola outbreak could become largest on record
article.articleSummary: By 2026-06-06, the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa involves the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The WHO reports 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in DRC, plus 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths in Uganda, totaling 471 cases and 84 deaths—up about 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. Declared an international public health emergency, the outbreak could become the largest on record; CDC modeling cautions it could rival the 2014 West Africa epidemic (over 28,000 cases, more than 11,000 deaths) if strong interventions are not implemented. The responsible Bundibugyo species has no approved vaccines or treatments. Emergence began May 15 in northeastern DRC, with spread believed to have occurred under the radar. A $518 million WHO-African CDC plan spanning six months targets surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 米国公衆衛生機関が最新のエボラ流行が記録上最大になる可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で国際公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態として宣言されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（対象国）とウガンダでのエボラ流行が記述されている。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国でないため除外。発生地域にはAngola（対象国外）も列挙されているが、サマリーに具体的なAngola感染例の記述がないため除外。2026年6月時点で既に471例484死と大規模流行であり、Bundibugyo種に有効なワクチン・治療法がなく、2014年西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性が示唆されている極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: DOH issues warning against 'Wild' diseases during rainy season
article.articleSummary: During the Philippine rainy season, the Department of Health warns of rising 'Wild' diseases: water-borne illnesses (diarrhea, typhoid fever, cholera, acute gastroenteritis); influenza-like illness (ILI) such as cold, cough and flu; leptospirosis; and dengue. DOH spokesperson Albert Domingo urges vigilance as rainfall increases, noting drinking water can be contaminated; boil water 2–3 minutes and practice frequent handwashing. ILI is easily spread, and with schools reopening, masks in crowded areas, covering coughs/sneezes, and staying home when unwell are advised. Leptospirosis risk rises with flooding; avoid wading in floodwater or wear protective gear if unavoidable. Dengue risk grows due to more mosquito-breeding sites; Aedes aegypti are most active 4–6 pm and 6–8 am. Prevention includes destroying breeding sites and using mosquito repellent. Pagasa announced onset of the rainy season last Thursday.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季中の『野生』疾病に対する警告をフィリピン保健省が発令
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンにおける複数の水系・蚊媒介疾病（コレラ、チフス、レプトスピラ症、デング熱、インフルエンザ様疾患）に対する季節的警告。異常性・予想外性は低いが、公衆衛生監視対象疾病を含むため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: フィリピンの雨季における既知の季節的公衆衛生リスク。実際の患者数や発生件数の増加が報告されていないため、予防警告段階と判断。複数のIHR通知義務疾病（コレラ、チフス）が含まれるが、現時点では流行の発生報告ではなく、季節的リスク警告のため IHR基準は2つ未満。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（雨季の継続的リスク）と「流行しやすさ」（衛生状態、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性）が該当するが、異常性・予想外性がないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: "Nous travaillons toujours du matin au soir": en RD Congo, les mines d'or ont joué un rôle dans la propagation d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We are always working from morning to night": in DR Congo, gold mines have played a role in the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, centered in Mongbwalu near Bunia, has become the country’s third-largest. Declared May 15, 2026, the epidemic is believed to have started earlier in February in Ituri's gold-mining belt along the Kilo-Moto. The Bundibugyo strain is associated with atypical malaria-like symptoms; no specific treatment exists. Dense, informal mining operations and cross-border movement—miners from many provinces and neighboring countries, with ore often sent abroad—have fueled transmission. As of June 6, 2026, Congo has 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths, with Ituri alone accounting for 90% of cases and 76% of deaths, per CACM. Across the border in Uganda, 16 cases and 1 death have been reported. Officials warn that the outbreak could worsen, highlighting hazardous working conditions in mines and the challenges of surveillance and care in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 「私たちは朝から晩まで働き続けています」：コンゴ民主共和国で、金鉱山がエボラの拡大に役割を果たした
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、381確認患者64死亡、国際的拡大（ウガンダで16例1死亡）、渡航・貿易制限リスク高い。スクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当し、直ちにRRA対象。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）による大規模流行。記事ではウガンダでの患者報告も記載されているが、サマリーの主題はDRC Ituri州の流行であり、記事本体がDRCに焦点を当てているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。金鉱山の非公式採掘作業と越境人口移動が感染拡大の重要な要因。緊急対応が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 덮쳐도 금가루 찾아 하루살이...콩고 금광촌 비극
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even as Ebola sweeps through, they search for gold dust, living from day to day... Tragedy in Congo's gold-mining village.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province, centered in the Mongwalu gold‑mining town, continues amid dense mining-related movement and mercury use for gold extraction. Local deaths are mounting as residents keep working; prevention measures like masks and reduced lodging exist but are limited in effect. Officials say the outbreak began earlier than formal confirmation, with DR Congo acknowledging it on March 15 after at least 80 deaths in the preceding weeks. WHO reports 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths as of June 3. The U.S. CDC warns cases could exceed 20,000 within three months, potentially rivaling the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Widespread distrust toward Ebola and health workers hampers containment, with some villagers denying the disease or delaying treatment. UN peacekeeping presence and international staff highlight ongoing international response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが猛威を振るってもも金粉を求めて一日を生きる...コンゴ金鉱村の悲劇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（381例、64死亡）で公衆衛生影響は深刻、CDCが3ヶ月で20,000例超過を警告し国際的拡大リスク高、渡航・貿易制限リスクあり。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが米国とアンゴラを発生地域に含めているが、サマリーではDRCのイトゥーリ州Mongwalu金鉱地域が主題であり、米国・アンゴラは国際的対応・警告の文脈のみのため除外。WHO正式確認は3月15日だが、実際の発症はそれより前。地域的な不信感と予防措置の限定的有効性が管理可能性を低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Krise in der DR Kongo: Kampf gegen den Virus nimmt langsam Fahrt auf
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the fight against the virus is slowly gaining momentum.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak shows a first decline in confirmed cases: 452 laboratory-confirmed cases and 82 deaths; six recovered. Suspected cases previously exceeded 1,000 as testing capacity improved. In Uganda, 19 cases confirmed, most Congolese who traveled to Uganda; two deaths, 13 in treatment, four recovered. Bunia airport in Ituri Province reopened as aid flows resume; shipments of PPE, laboratory equipment, tests, medicines, and food arriving via Bunia and through Uganda and Kenya. MONUSCO reports WHO-led teams expanding Ebola centers in the epicenter; WFP delivering equipment by helicopter to Mongbwalu, where the outbreak is believed to have begun in April. A CDC-WHO containment plan seeks over $500 million from the international community. GAVI pledges $50 million to accelerate a vaccine development for Bundibugyo, a strain named after a Ugandan district near the border; no vaccine exists yet. The US government has restarted contributions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機：ウイルスとの闘いが徐々に勢いを増している
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な多国家発生事例。IHR基準4つすべて該当し、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）での確認、死亡事例、国際支援動員など、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ、ケニア、米国も記載されているが、記事サマリーの詳細分析により、エボラ発生の主要地は DRC（Bunia, Mongbwalu）であり、ウガンダは DRC からの流入例（19例）の報告地。ケニア・米国は物流・支援拠点であり感染事例ではない。対象国リストに含まれるのは DRC のみ。GAVI等による国際支援の動員、CDC-WHO による $500M+ 募金要請、複数国での航空制限（Bunia空港閉鎖後の再開）など政治的・国際的な影響は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Angola: Cabinda enregistre sept nouveaux cas de variole du singe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angola: Cabinda reports seven new cases of monkeypox.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox cases rise in Cabinda, Angola: seven new cases confirmed, bringing the total to 16 since the outbreak began in the province. As of June 6, 2026, 13 cases are in Cabinda municipality and 3 in Lândana. Health authorities report eight families in contact with infected individuals are under active follow-up; no deaths have occurred to date. Officials urge calm and say the situation remains under control. Ebola surveillance and prevention measures have been strengthened to prevent introduction of potential Ebola cases from the neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo, where a flare-up is reported. Cabinda, with over 903,000 residents, shares extensive land, sea, and river borders with the DRC, heightening cross-border vigilance against infectious threats.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ：カビンダで痘痘疮（サル痘）の新規患者7例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、域内流行リスク）、WPROスクリーニング5項目全て該当、かつDRCの隣接地域での流行拡大可能性が高い。国際支援が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアンゴラのカビンダ州での痘痘疮患者報告であるが、地理的には対象国リストに含まれていない。ただし、記事サマリーで『DRCの隣接地域であり、DRCでの患者発生との関連性が明記』されているため、DRCを verified_locations に含める。DRC側での痘痘疮クレード1の同時流行（記事で「neighboring DRC where a flare-up is reported」と明記）がシグナル判定の重要な根拠。国境を共有する2国での同時流行は域内拡大リスクが極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: One dies of rabies in Korat as dog infections rise
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand, 6 June 2026: authorities report 20 rabies-infected animals in the province this year, with one human death and 144 high-risk exposures from 1 January–2 June. The latest case, an eight-month-old male stray dog displaying aggression, was detected on 1 June in Chai Mongkhon subdistrict, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima; laboratory confirmation followed. One person has had high-risk exposure and received the first rabies vaccine dose; two other animals were also deemed high risk. Containment includes vaccination campaigns within a five-kilometre radius, temporary control zones, enhanced surveillance, and dog/cat vaccination targeting at least 80% coverage. About 135 exposed individuals completed the full post-exposure vaccination course; nine remain under monitoring. Residents are urged to seek immediate medical care after bites, scratches, or saliva exposure; village volunteers will identify recent exposures, and hospitals will provide fast-track vaccination for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: コラート（ナコンラチャシマ）で狂犬病による死亡、犬への感染が増加
triage.triage_reason: タイで狂犬病の人間死亡例および複数の動物感染が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡例、144件の高リスク曝露）、異常な発生パターン（年初来20例の感染動物）が認められる。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはタイ・ナコンラチャシマ州での狂犬病発生を明確に示している。人間死亡1例、高リスク曝露144件、感染動物20例という具体的な数字が報告されており、公衆衛生上の重要なシグナルである。当初5km圏内のワクチン接種キャンペーンや強化サーベイランスなどの対応が実施されている。タイは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемијата на ебола во Конго може да стане една од најголемите во историјата, предупредуваат експертите
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo could become one of the largest in history, experts warn.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention warned that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, could become one of the largest on record if strong public health measures are not implemented. CDC officials said the epidemic could reach or exceed the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Satish Pillai, head of the CDC Center, noted that three documents were released as part of the weekly Morbidity and Mortality report to mobilize international resources. The article provides no specific case or death counts. Emphasizes the urgent need for robust public health interventions to curb transmission and prevent a further expansion of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は歴史上最大級になる可能性がある、と専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の大規模流行警告であり、IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。社会的・政治的関心も高く、CDC等国際機関の警告により管理可能性に課題あり。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited States・Angolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主な感染症イベント発生地はDRC（Bundibugyo ebolavirus による流行）のみ。同イベントの第二次的な言及地域と判断し、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。CDCの警告報道であり、国際的警戒の段階にあると評価される。具体的な患者数・死亡者数が記載されていない点は情報不足だが、歴史上最大級との警告により重症度・影響の深刻性は十分に評価される。

article.articleHeadline: News: Red Cross slams attack at burial in Ebola-hit DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda. Kinshasa declared the outbreak on May 15. As of 2026-06-06, the DRC reports 381 cases and 64 deaths, with Ebola active in three northeastern provinces; Uganda records 19 cases, including 2 deaths. In the DRC tally, 14 cases are imported from DRC, while five involve Ugandan nationals who had contact with infected patients. An attack on Red Cross volunteers during a burial in Bunia, Ituri province injured several people and undermines containment efforts; attacks on responders are cited as hindering outbreak control. No vaccine or specific treatment exists. Empty medical tents have been burned and communities have raided hospitals to demand the return of Ebola victims’ bodies in Ituri. The WHO and Africa CDC launched a joint $518 million plan to address the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行地のコンゴでの埋葬時に赤十字に対する攻撃が批判される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、複数国への感染）、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当、社会的・政治的関心が高い。複数国での確認事例と死亡者あり。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の活動的な流行。DRC381例、64死亡、ウガンダ19例、2死亡。対応者への暴力攻撃が封じ込め努力を阻害している。WHO・Africa CDCが5億1800万ドルの共同対応計画を立案。ウガンダは記事サマリーで隣国として言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの流行・対応であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تتهم إسبانيا بـ"العنصرية" بعد رفض استضافة مباراة ودية بسبب مخاوف من إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo accuses Spain of "racism" after refusing to host a friendly match due to fears of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo accused Spain of racism after Madrid refused to host a Congo–Chile friendly in Cadiz due to fears of Ebola. Congolese communications minister and government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya told a WHO-virtual press conference that Spanish authorities blocked the match as a precaution, calling the decision racist; he noted Congo players have been in Belgium for three weeks rather than training domestically. Spain’s La Línea de la Concepción mayor, Juan Franco, defended the decision on public-safety grounds and potential health risks. The Congolese Football Federation had earlier announced the team would observe a 21-day health isolation required by the United States to enter its territory for the World Cup, which runs June 11–July 19 and is hosted jointly by the United States, Mexico and Canada, following the May 15 Ebola outbreak announcement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ熱への懸念からの試合開催拒否でスペインを「人種差別」と非難
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ熱発生を背景とした外交紛争で、疾患の実質的な拡大リスクや公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は記事から明らかでない。スポーツイベントの政治的対立が中心であり、感染症危機管理の対象となるシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な内容はスポーツ外交紛争（フットボールの親善試合開催の是非）であり、エボラ熱の疾病サーベイランスや患者管理に関する情報は含まれていない。コンゴ民主共和国での既知の発生（5月15日発表）に関連した二次的な報道である。対象国はDRC（203312）のみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Sudanese Passenger Tests Negative for Ebola at Gandhi Hospital
article.articleSummary: Sudanese passenger admitted to Gandhi Hospital’s Ebola isolation ward in Hyderabad after arriving at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport tested negative for Ebola. The fever detected during health screening prompted isolation; the sample was sent to the Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology, with results received on Saturday morning. The patient is scheduled for knee surgery at a private Hyderabad hospital and is expected to be discharged soon. The admission was precautionary under international health surveillance protocols given travel history and fever at arrival. Hospital officials, including Superintendent Dr Vani, confirmed no Ebola cases linked to this passenger. Two other suspected Ebola cases’ test results are due within the next one to two days. No confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in connection with the passenger.

triage.headline_ja: スーダン人乗客がガンジー病院でエボラ出血熱の検査で陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い例が検出されIHR基準を複数満たす可能性がある一方、当該患者は陰性で確認症例なし。他の2例の検査待機中で経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 患者1名は陰性で確認症例ではないが、他に2件の疑い例の検査結果待機中。国際保健サーベイランスプロトコル発動、検査体制動員されており確認症例発生時はPICKUPへの昇格が必要。スーダンはBluedot位置情報に含まれるが記事の実質的発生地はインドのハイデラバード。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo alerta sobre rápida propagación del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo warns of the rapid spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread rapidly, with 71 new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours, raising total confirmed infections to 452 and deaths to 82. The Bundibugyo strain is involved, with most cases in Ituri province in the northeast, a region hindered by weak health infrastructure and security issues. Of the new cases, 65 were in Ituri and 6 in North Kivu, the highest daily toll since the outbreak began. Authorities warn of fast, ongoing transmission and potential further spread without reinforced control and surveillance. The WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced a six-month response plan worth $518 million to bolster containment in the DRC and Uganda and improve preparedness in neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な流行拡大、高い死亡率、国家間への拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及可能性）、および国際的な渡航・貿易制限の懸念が存在する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの確認症例については明記されておらず、主な発生はDRC（イトゥリ州およびキヴ北部州）であることが明確である。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。WHO事務局長による5億1,800万ドルの6ヶ月対応計画の発表は、国際的な懸念の高さを示している。

article.articleHeadline: Lutte contre la fièvre Ebola : Mise en place imminente d'un plan - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fighting Ebola fever: Imminent implementation of a plan.
article.articleSummary: An emergency six-month Ebola response plan worth $518 million was announced by Africa CDC and the World Health Organization to curb the spread of the Bundibugyo strain, spanning June to November 2026, with the Democratic Republic of Congo as the main epicenter. The package aims to strengthen prevention and detection in the most vulnerable countries, enhancing epidemiological surveillance and health infrastructure. A unified strategy, 'One Response,' will coordinate efforts across actors to optimize field interventions, focusing on logistics funding, patient isolation, and care. Local community involvement is essential to promote public-health practices such as case identification and isolation. The plan also tightens preparedness in ten priority countries to enable early detection and rapid actions for new foci, crucial as health systems face concurrent threats like cholera and mpox. Without adequate financing and broad public adherence, outbreaks could overwhelm fragile systems.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱との闘い：計画の差し迫った実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。複数の高致死性疾患（エボラ、コレラ、Mpox）が対象であり、アフリカCDC・WHOが$518百万の緊急対応計画を発表している点で、国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCを主要な感染症懸念の中心地として特定しており、アフリカCDCおよびWHOによる大規模な多国間対応計画が実施されている。コレラ、Mpoxとの同時脅威も言及されており、脆弱な保健システムの能力超過リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 'We are still playing catch‑up': WHO chief warns Ebola spreading fast as cases near 500
article.articleSummary: Nearly 500 Ebola cases have been confirmed in a central Africa outbreak. On Saturday, WHO tallies: 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak was declared May 15 in the northeast; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The totals reach 471 cases and 84 deaths, up 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The WHO has declared an international public health emergency, with concerns the outbreak could rival the 2014 West Africa epidemic if interventions lag, per CDC. Ebola spreads via close contact and bodily fluids; there are no approved vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo species behind this outbreak. A joint WHO-Africa CDC plan totaling $518 million over six months aims to boost surveillance, lab testing, and infection prevention to help neighboring countries detect and respond rapidly.

triage.headline_ja: 「まだ追い付いていない」WHOトップが警告、エボラが急速に拡大し患者数が500近くに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。患者数が急増（100例/日）し、複数国への拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC とウガンダでの発生が確認されているが、対象国リストはDRCのみに該当。2014年西アフリカエボラ流行に匹敵する可能性が指摘されており、WHO が国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo種による大規模流行。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉防控计划启动 刚果（金）仍现社区传播
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola prevention and control plan launched; Congo (Kinshasa) still experiences community transmission.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa) continues rapid community transmission, with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths; Uganda reports 3 additional cases for a cumulative 19. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC launched a six-month Ebola prevention and control plan (June–November) worth $518 million to bolster emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement, aiming to halt current spread and prepare neighboring countries for new cases. MSF staff are assisting at a local hospital. The United States adds $38 million in funding, bringing total direct support to over $200 million. CDC scenario modeling warns that without strong interventions, Congo’s outbreak could approach West Africa-scale impact seen in 2014–2016 (over 28,000 cases, more than 11,000 deaths); this model is a planning tool, not a forecast.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ予防・管理計画始動 コンゴ（金）ではなお地域内感染が報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認例452例・死亡82例という深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの症例）、並びに異常性と国際的関心から、IHR基準3つ以上該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行可能性が確認でき、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国の主要な流行を焦点としており、ウガンダの3例は二次的な言及。発生地域に含まれるアンゴラはサマリー中で具体的な症例報告がないため除外。米国の資金提供は感染症イベント本体の発生地ではなく支援国として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: രാജ്യത്ത് എബോള ഭീതി തുടരുന്നു; ഛത്തീസ്ഗഡിൽ മൂന്ന് ആഫ്രിക്കൻ പൗരന്മാർ നിരീക്ഷണത്തിൽ, ജാഗ്രത നിർദ്ദേശം നൽകി സർക്കാർ ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola fear persists nationwide; in Chhattisgarh, three African nationals are under observation as the government issues a precautionary advisory.
article.articleSummary: Three African nationals are under observation in Durg, Chhattisgarh, quarantined for 21 days as a precaution against possible Ebola exposure from Africa. The state has issued a precautionary advisory, with Health Minister Shyam Bihari Jaiswal stating the government is fully prepared to handle any confirmed cases, and hospitals and quarantine facilities are on alert to safeguard public safety. No Ebola cases have been reported and the individuals show no symptoms; they were admitted to a quarantine center in Durg following standard health protocols. Earlier, a Ugandan woman who arrived in Bengaluru on May 23 at Kempegowda International Airport developed Ebola-like symptoms and was moved to an Indira Nagar hospital, but laboratory tests ruled out Ebola. This reflects ongoing Ebola fears nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: 国内でエボラ熱の恐怖が続く。チャッティースガル州では3名のアフリカ国籍者が観察下に置かれ、政府は予防的勧告を発出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の疑い事例が複数報告されているが、全て検査で陰性確認済みで症例なし。国内での警戒体制は構築されているが、実際の感染確認がないため、現時点ではWATCHレベルの経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではアフリカおよびウガンダからの事例への言及があるが、実際の発生地は印インドのみ。チャッティースガル州とベンガルール両州での疑い事例は既に検査で陰性確認済み。現在のところ確定患者なし。アフリカ大陸での流行情報は言及されているが、インド国内での検証対象となる実際の発生地はインドのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 防10年前危机重演 美加码1.54亿对抗伊波拉疫情 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preventing a repeat of the crisis from 10 years ago: the U.S. boosts USD 154 million to combat the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak persisting in the Democratic Republic of Congo, involving Bundibugyo virus strain. Since mid-May, 452 infections and 82 deaths confirmed; 71 new cases reported in the last 24 hours. No approved therapies or vaccines exist for this strain. U.S. government announced an additional $38 million in aid, bringing direct assistance to over $200 million. The funding aims to bolster outbreak response through coordination with the CDC, the DRC, and Uganda. CDC has deployed about 30 staff to the DRC and around 100 to Uganda, with several more experts dispatched in recent weeks to aid control efforts. U.S. officials warn that, without strong public health interventions, this outbreak could scale to match or exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: 10年前の危機の再演を防ぐ：米国がエボラ感染症対策に1億54百万ドルを追加投資
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で継続中で、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。452感染、82死亡、直近24時間で71新規症例が報告されており、国際的な支援体制も構築されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した米国・ウガンダ・アンゴラは補助的な地域であり、サマリー上の主要な流行地はDRCのみ。DRCは対象国リストにあるため verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo virus strainは既知治療法・ワクチンなし。米国が追加的な財政・人員支援を決定しており、国際的な感染症危機管理活動が大規模に展開中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: près de 500 cas confirmés en Afrique centrale (OMS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Nearly 500 confirmed cases in Central Africa (WHO).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa: as of 2026-06-06, WHO reports 471 confirmed cases and 84 deaths. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 452 cases and 82 deaths have been confirmed, with the outbreak declared three weeks earlier; neighboring Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. This uptick follows warnings that the current epidemic, designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, could rival the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak that killed over 11,000. The virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs through close contact and bodily fluids. WHO and Africa CDC have launched a $518 million plan for six months to strengthen surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the epidemic could escalate without strong public health measures and calls for rapid, coordinated action with neighboring countries on high alert.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：中央アフリカで約500件の確認事例（WHO）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、エボラウイルス感染症（PHEIC指定済み）の確認例数増加、複数国への拡大、国際的対応が必要な重大事象であり、即座にフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（452例、82死亡）とウガンダ（19例、2死亡）での発生を述べている。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国外のため除外。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）はBio Threat レベルとして最高度、すでにPHEIC指定、WHOが$518M対応計画を発動中。2014-2016年西アフリカアウトブレーク規模の可能性言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉疫情未歇　刚果（金）增至452宗确诊病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak not over yet; Congo (Kinshasa) has risen to 452 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, with Ituri and North Kivu provinces most affected. Thursday's report added 71 new confirmed cases in these provinces, indicating ongoing rapid community transmission. Current totals include 258 patients in isolation or hospital and 8 recoveries. Response efforts face multiple challenges: community reluctance to sample the deceased, limited Ebola treatment center capacity, low contact tracing, shortages of medicines and PPE, and funding gaps. Uganda reported 3 new cases, bringing its total to 19 cases and 2 deaths. The Red Cross condemned attacks on volunteers during a safe and dignified burial in Bunia; tents burned and locals demanded return of Ebola bodies. WHO and Africa CDC launched a $518 million Bundibugyo-type Ebola outbreak plan for DRC and Uganda. The CDC warns scale could rival 2014 West Africa's 28,000+ cases and 11,000+ deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は収束していない。コンゴ（金）の確定患者数が452例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2の4基準中4つすべてに該当。重篤な公衆衛生への影響（452確定例、82死亡）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで拡大）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが認められる。エボラウイルス病は最高リスクの感染症。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはウガンダとアンゴラも発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは事例数が少なく（19例、2死亡）、アンゴラについては言及がない。DRCが主たる発生地域であり、ウガンダの事例は二次的。対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。WHO・Africa CDCによる5.18億ドルの対応計画、2014年西アフリカ流行（28,000+例、11,000+死亡）との比較言及など、国際的に極めて高い関心が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns nearly 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports nearly 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths; in neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The combined total stands at 471 cases and 84 deaths, up by 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The WHO has declared this Ebola outbreak an international public health emergency. U.S. CDC models warn that, without strong public health interventions, the outbreak could swell to rival the 2014 West Africa epidemic, which exceeded 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths, underscoring the risk of a large-scale event.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱で約500人の確定症例を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模多国間発生で、WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。1日で100症例増加し、2014年西アフリカ流行並みへの拡大リスクが警告されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）とAngola（3351879）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCに452症例・82死亡、ウガンダに19症例・2死亡と明記されている。ただし、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。エボラ出血熱は対象国リストに明記されていない地域での発生であり、国際的な重要性は極めて高いが、トリアージルール上はDRCのみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: BBC Radio 4 - From Our Own Correspondent, Ebola in the DRC: Fear and Conspiracy Theories
article.articleSummary: Deadly Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with conspiracy theories about the virus’s origin spreading alongside the illness at the border between North Kivu and Ituri provinces. In Ukraine, heavy Russian assaults have hit energy infrastructure, with Kherson residents seeing public transport become a target for Russian drones. In the Pacific Northwest, the Klamath River now flows again for the first time in a century after a dam removal, though locals resist the change. In India's northeast Manipur, tensions between the Kuki and Meitei communities have re-ignited communal violence after a violence-prone period three years ago. Off Croatia’s coast, a once-dwindling griffon vulture population is back in full flight, as revival efforts restore the island’s ecological role in waste management.

triage.headline_ja: BBC Radio 4 - From Our Own Correspondent, Ebola in the DRC: Fear and Conspiracy Theories
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のDRCでの継続的な流行を報道。IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）も満たす。フルRRA進行推奨。
triage.notes: サマリーではDRCのエボラ流行が主題だが、Manipurの動員暴力も記載されているため、対象国リストに基づきDRCとIndiaを検証地域として記載。Bluedot APIが検出した他地域（ウクライナ、米国、クロアチア）はサマリー内で副次的な文脈であり、感染症イベントではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 덮쳐도 금가루 찾아 하루살이...콩고 금광촌 비극
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even as Ebola rages, they search for gold dust, living day by day—the tragedy of a Congo gold-mining town.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Mongwalu, a gold-mining town in Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where hundreds of miners work in mud along a riverbank, using mercury to extract gold. Mining persists despite deaths; local distrust and limited prevention hinder outbreak response. As of March 3, WHO counted 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths, with local authorities reporting more than 80 deaths before official confirmation in February. A New York Times report highlights the town’s visibility to UN peacekeepers and WHO staff, and how mining-related population movement may fuel transmission. The CDC warned the outbreak could reach 20,000 cases in three months, potentially rivaling the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, while about half of contacts remain unidentified. Preventive measures include masks and reducing dormitory crowding, but overall activity continues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが猛威を振るっても金粉を求めて一日を生きる...コンゴ金鉱町の悲劇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の重篤な流行であり、国際的な懸念水準に達している。
triage.notes: アンゴラが発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではイトゥリ州ムングワル（DRC）のみが主題であり、アンゴラでの確認事例の言及がないため除外。WHOとCDCの警告により国際的な懸念が高い。金鉱採掘による人口移動が感染拡大を促進するリスク、接触追跡の困難性、および地域社会の不信が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Aproape 500 de cazuri de Ebola confirmate în Africa Centrală (OMS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa (WHO).
article.articleSummary: 471 confirmed Ebola cases and 84 deaths across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda as of 2026-06-06, per WHO. In DRC, 452 cases and 82 deaths; in Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths. This is up from the previous day by 100 cases and 20 deaths. The outbreak, the first in northeast DRC since May 15, involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare species with no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission is via direct contact and bodily fluids. WHO and Africa CDC have launched a $518 million plan for six months to bolster surveillance, lab testing, and infection prevention, aiming to contain spread domestically and prevent cross-border cases as neighboring countries prepare. Director-General Tedros warned the epidemic is advancing rapidly and urged rapid, coordinated action to stop it where it is and avert a crisis like the 2014–16 West Africa outbreak with over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ中央部でエボラ確認症例がほぼ500件（WHO）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当。マルチプル国での活動的な流行、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、検査可能な治療法なしの稀な株による危機的状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（452症例、82死亡）とウガンダ（19症例、2死亡）での発生を明記。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀な株で承認されたワクチンや治療法がなく、1日100症例、20死亡の増加率は極めて深刻。WHOとアフリカCDCが518百万ドルの対応計画を発表し、国際的関心が極めて高い。2014-16年西アフリカ流行（11,000以上の死亡）との比較言及により、規模拡大の懸念が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: près de 500 cas confirmés en Afrique centrale (OMS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Nearly 500 Confirmed Cases in Central Africa (WHO)
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa: as of 6 June 2026, the World Health Organization reports 452 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where the outbreak was declared in mid-May in the northeast. In neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths are recorded. The global tally reaches 471 cases and 84 deaths, up from the previous day by 100 cases and 20 deaths. Medical relief efforts show MSF personnel in protective gear at the Ebola Treatment Center in Munigi, DRC. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. A WHO/CDC Africa plan worth $518 million over six months targets surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. WHO Director-General Tedros warns the epidemic is advancing rapidly and urges rapid, coordinated action to stop transmission and ready neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: アフリカ中部で約500例の確定症例（WHO）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo ebolavirus による急速な流行拡大、複数国への地域的拡大、高い致死率、ワクチン・承認治療法の欠如を示す重大な脅威。
triage.notes: DRCで2026年5月中旬に宣言されたエボラ流行。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀なワクチン・承認治療法のない株）による。ウガンダへの越境・地域的拡大も報告されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。24時間で100例増加と急速な増加傾向を示す。WHO/CDC Africa による5.18億ドル規模の対応計画が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: UAE suspends visas and bars entry for nationals of three countries amid Ebola precautions
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-06, the UAE suspends new visas for nationals of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan to curb Ebola spread. Entry from these countries, including via transit, is prohibited unless travelers have spent more than 21 days outside the affected countries before arrival. The visa suspension is temporary and may be extended based on health assessments; cargo and transit operations will continue. The measure is part of strengthened national preparedness amid Ebola outbreaks concentrated in DR Congo and Uganda. NCEMA and ICP will monitor the situation with domestic and international partners. MoHAP reports the public health situation remains stable, with surveillance, early detection, airport screening, and healthcare readiness in place. The advisory notes ongoing risk and potential additional measures as warranted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ予防措置の中、UAEが3カ国の国民に対するビザ発行を停止し入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施が明確であり、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。複数国での発生と国境をまたいだ対応が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ感染がDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダで発生していると明記されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれている。UgandaおよびSouth Sudanは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙した。UAEの入国制限措置は対象国ではないため含めない。エボラの高い伝播性、重症度、国際的懸念の高さから、フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Chưa vào cao điểm mùa mưa, TP.HCM đã có 4 ca tử vong do sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not yet at the peak of the rainy season, Ho Chi Minh City has recorded four deaths from dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City has recorded four dengue deaths so far in 2026, with fatalities often linked to comorbidities, late diagnosis, or rapid progression. Nationally, Vietnam reports 135,515 dengue cases and 26 deaths this year. Dengue in Vietnam is no longer strictly seasonal and remains year-round, with the southern region as a persistent hotspot; Ho Chi Minh City has transmission across 168 wards and communes. Experts warn that 2026 may follow a four-year dengue cycle similar to 2022, with rising cases since late 2025. More than half of cases are adults, with the largest group aged 11-15, then 16-30. Despite a dengue vaccine, uptake is low; vaccination, vector control (eliminating standing water and larviciding), and early care for fever lasting 2-3 days with abdominal pain, vomiting, or bleeding signs are emphasized. Vietnam remains a dengue hotspot requiring proactive public health strategies.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季のピークに入る前に、ホーチミン市はデング熱による4人の死亡者を記録
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は既知の風土病であり、ベトナムではスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）に複数該当する。しかし公衆衛生影響は限定的（死亡者数26人/135,515例）であり、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限のリスクは低い。情報は充分だが、既知の風土病であるため慎重な判定が必要。
triage.notes: ベトナムにおけるデング熱は既知の風土病であり、季節に関わらず年間を通じて発生している。2026年は2022年と同様の4年周期で症例増加が予想されているが、現在の死亡者数と症例致命率は許容範囲内。ホーチミン市での継続的な伝播と低いワクチン接種率が懸念される。国内での対応は可能と考えられ、国際的支援の要請はない。

article.articleHeadline: V DR Kongo in Ugandi potrdili skoraj 500 primerov ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo and Uganda, nearly 500 Ebola cases have been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reported 471 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with 84 deaths. The organization warned that the Ebola outbreak is spreading rapidly and could worsen without additional action. The figures reflect cases reported to WHO up to that date, illustrating the escalating situation and the urgent need for strengthened response to prevent further transmission and fatalities. The update notes that the figures are current as of that day and highlights the ongoing spread and the serious public health risk posed by the outbreak. Overall, the update underscores ongoing spread and the seriousness of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴとウガンダでエボラウイルス病の患者が約500人確認された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。大規模なエボラウイルス病の多国家にわたる流行であり、即座にフルRRAへ進める必要がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に除外。DRコンゴのみを記載。471確認患者数と84死亡数は深刻な状況を示唆している。WHO公式報告に基づく情報。

article.articleHeadline: केरल: वायनाड के स्कूल में 150 छात्र बीमार, उल्टी-बुखार के बाद 38 बच्चे अस्पताल में भर्ती - kerala 150 students fall ill in wayanad school 38 hospitalized
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala: 150 students fall ill in a Wayanad school; 38 children admitted to hospital after vomiting and fever.
