Authorities are responding with vaccination campaigns, contact tracing, surveillance at borders and transport hubs, isolation of cases, and escalation of international support. The risk of international spread is low but not negligible; vigilance remains high.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ発生は2014年の流行に匹敵する可能性があるか？米国保健当局者の見解
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRCで発生したエボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、および国際的な対応支援を必要としている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にDRCでのエボラ発生に焦点を当てており、隣国への拡大リスクと2014-16年のギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネの流行との比較言及があるが、現在の実際の発生地はDRCが中心。紛争地域での封じ込め困難性、弱い保健システムを持つ隣国での拡大リスクが強調されている。米国を含む国際的な関心と支援対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: CDC: Η επιδημία Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό μπορεί να προσλάβει διαστάσεις μεγαλύτερες από εκείνη του 2014
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CDC: The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo could take on dimensions larger than those of 2014.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-06, the CDC warned the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could reach or exceed the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic if strong measures are not enacted. The northeastern DRC outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain (rarer, with no specific treatment or vaccine), unlike Zaire-strain outbreaks which have vaccines. WHO data show 381 laboratory-confirmed cases in DRC with 64 deaths; cross-border spread to Uganda accounts for 16 cases and 1 death, with 7 recoveries in DRC and 2 in Uganda. The disease has killed at least 15,000 people in Africa over 50 years, with fatality rates from 25% to 90%. The most deadly DRC outbreak (2018–2020) caused about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases. CDC models emphasize preparedness to avert further spread, given possible undetected circulation prior to declaration.

triage.headline_ja: CDC: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は2014年の規模を上回る可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の新規発生、国際的拡大済み、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による確認された複数国での発生で、スケール拡大の警告あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの越境拡大が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法が限定的であり、過去の西アフリカ流行（2014-2016年、死者数千人）と同等以上のスケール化の警告が CDC から発せられている重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱、感染者２万人・死者４千人試算...コンゴ民主共和国で感染者の隔離措置が不十分な場合 | ヨミドクター(読売新聞)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hemorrhagic fever: estimated 20,000 cases and 4,000 deaths... In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, if isolation measures for infected individuals are inadequate
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: CDC projects that if infected individuals are not adequately isolated, over 20,000 infections and more than 4,000 deaths could occur within three months. This would be the second-largest outbreak after West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic, which killed about 11,000. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved drugs or vaccines; control relies on isolating patients in dedicated facilities and providing symptomatic care. Models indicate that isolating only 20% of cases would permit widespread transmission, whereas isolating 70% could suppress most of the outbreak. CDC urges large, rapid public health interventions to prevent an unprecedented scale. The article underscores the need for aggressive infection control measures in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、感染者２万人・死者４千人試算...コンゴ民主共和国で感染者の隔離措置が不十分な場合
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い公衆衛生インパクト、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航制限リスクを有する。CDC投影による大規模アウトブレイク（2万感染者、4千人死亡）の警告は深刻度が高い。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク予測シナリオ。記事はCDCの投影モデルに基づき、不十分な隔離措置の場合に20,000感染、4,000人死亡の可能性を警告。Bundibugyo株には承認ワクチン・治療薬がなく、感染制御が唯一の対策。記事はアンゴラも発生地域に列挙しているが、サマリーはDRCの状況に焦点。対象国リストにアンゴラは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémia eboly v Kongu je už tretia najväčšia v dejinách. Po Trumpových škrtoch chýbajú zdravotníci aj ochranné pomôcky
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is already the third largest in history. Following Trump's budget cuts, healthcare workers are also lacking protective equipment.
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the third-largest in history, with at least 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths (true toll likely higher). Neighboring Uganda reports 19 infections and two deaths. International aid for the response has plummeted from about $1.4 billion to roughly $21 million, weakening critical Ebola-response capacities, according to epidemiologist Alexandra Bražinová. About a year after the Trump administration ended USAID, public-health experts warned such cuts would hamper future outbreak responses, a prediction reflected in this crisis. Plans to transport Ebola-infected Americans to Kenya prompted mass protests there, underscoring political and logistical challenges in outbreak management.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は歴史上3番目の規模。トランプ政権の予算削減により医療従事者と防護具が不足
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患は極めて重篤で、既に452確定症例・82死亡、国際的な支援不足により対応能力が著しく低下している状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国が主要な発生地としてフォーカスされており、ウガンダでも19感例・2死亡が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。アメリカへの患者輸送計画に関連してケニアでの抗議活動が言及されているが、ケニアは疾病発生地ではなく対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。アメリカも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。国際的な支援メカニズム崩壊（USAID削減）が対応能力を著しく制限しており、リスク管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO：中非伊波拉疫情擴大 確診逼近500例奪84命
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Central African Ebola outbreak expanding; confirmed cases near 500, 84 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa is expanding, with confirmed cases nearing 500 and 84 deaths as of 2026-06-06. The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where the outbreak was first declared about three weeks earlier, totals 452 cases and 82 deaths. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. Overall, 471 cases and 84 deaths have been reported, with the latest daily increases of 100 cases and 20 deaths. The World Health Organization has designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) and warns it could become the largest Ebola outbreak on record. US CDC officials say models project that, without strong interventions, the outbreak could reach the scale of West Africa’s 2014-2016 epidemic (over 28,000 infections and more than 11,000 deaths). Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls for rapid action to halt spread locally and prepare neighboring countries with international support.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：中非伊波拉疫情擴大 確診逼近500例奪84命
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間広がり、高い死亡率、WHOによるPHEIC指定、西アフリカ2014-2016年流行に匹敵する規模の予測があり、明確なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC（452例、82死）とウガンダ（19例、2死）が具体的に言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。PHEICの指定とWHO Tedros事務局長からの警告により、国際的な懸念は極めて高い。西アフリカ2014-2016年流行（28,000感染以上、11,000死以上）に相当する規模への拡大が予測されている。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱、感染者２万人・死者４千人試算...コンゴ民主共和国で感染者の隔離措置が不十分な場合
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus disease: estimated 20,000 cases and 4,000 deaths... in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, if isolation of infected individuals is inadequate.
article.articleSummary: CDC on June 5, 2026 warned that in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola virus disease could exceed 20,000 cases and 4,000 deaths within three months if isolation of infected individuals is inadequate. This would mark the second-worst outbreak after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which caused about 11,000 deaths. The projection assumes only 20% of infections are isolated in dedicated facilities; if 70% can be isolated, the majority of transmission could be prevented. The outbreak is due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo virus) with no approved drugs or vaccines for this strain, requiring isolation and supportive care. CDC stresses that large-scale, rapid public health measures are essential to avert the worst-case scenario.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、感染者２万人・死者４千人試算...コンゴ民主共和国で感染者の隔離措置が不十分な場合
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い重症度と致死率を有し、隔離不十分下では国際的拡大リスクが急速に高まる公衆衛生危機案件である。
triage.notes: CDCが公式警告を発出。最悪シナリオでは2014-2016年西アフリカエボラ流行（約11,000人死亡）に次ぐ規模となる可能性。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（既知治療薬/ワクチンなし）による厳格な隔離対策の必須性が強調されている。この投影は隔離率20%を前提としており、隔離率70%達成で大部分の伝播防止可能とのこと。高い国際的懸念と支援需要。

article.articleHeadline: ابولا در کنگو دوباره اوج گرفت؛ شناسایی ۷۱ مورد جدید در ۲۴ ساعت | ایونا نیوز
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has peaked again; 71 new cases identified in 24 hours | Iona News
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surged again, with 71 new cases identified in 24 hours: 65 in Ituri and 6 in North Kivu, among the highest daily tallies since the outbreak began. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC (since 1976). The prior outbreak occurred September 2025 in Kasaï province (southwest), causing more than 40 deaths and declared over after about three months. The DRC Ministry of Health says confirmed cases with the new Bundibugyo strain indicate rapid transmission in the two provinces. Uganda also confirmed cases, with three new infections bringing its total to 19. WHO Director-General announced a six-month, $518 million plan to fight Ebola, with WHO describing it as the fourth-largest outbreak to date, urging international funding and political commitment as the outbreak persists. Ebola symptoms include fever, sore throat, muscle pain, nausea, diarrhea, vomiting, and bleeding; incubation is 2–3 weeks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱が再び急増；24時間で71件の新規確定患者を特定 | イオナニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大（ウガンダでも確認）、高い死亡率と国境を越えた感染リスクを示しており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでも症例が確認されている旨が述べられているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内の2つの州（Ituri、North Kivu）で顕著な流行が起きており、過去のカサイ州アウトブレイク（2025年9月）との関連性が示唆される。WHO が6ヶ月間の$518百万計画を発表しており、国際的な対応が既に進行中。過去17回目のDRC内エボラアウトブレイクという歴史的文脈を踏まえ、ルーチン監視を超えた対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: മഴക്കാലമാണ്, എലി എട്ടിന്‍റെ പണി തരും; ചളിയിലും വെള്ളത്തിലും ജാഗ്രതൈ | leptospirosis alert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon season is here; rats are on the job; be vigilant in paddy fields and in water | Leptospirosis alert
article.articleSummary: In Kozhikode, Kerala, amid the monsoon, leptospirosis is a rising threat as rats contaminate floodwaters and fields. Transmission occurs via urine from rodents and animals (rats, cows, buffalo, goats, dogs) and enters through breaks in skin or mucous membranes. At-risk workers include sanitation, agriculture, animal husbandry, fishing, and construction. Incubation is typically 10 days, up to 20. Early symptoms: fever with chills, weakness, body and head pain, nausea; appetite loss and mental fog can occur; red eyes, dehydration, photophobia; headache starting at the back and spreading to the neck; muscle pain, especially in the back. In severe cases: intense headache, alternating fever, profound muscle pain, red eyes, vomiting, abdominal pain, chest pain, dry cough, mental confusion; urine may turn dark. Diagnosis via blood, urine, and serum tests. Early treatment is key; self-medication is dangerous. Prevention emphasizes rodent control, sanitation, protective gear, boiled water, and weekly doxycycline prophylaxis for at-risk workers.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン季节、ネズミが活動；水田や水中での警戒 | レプトスピラ症警報
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症の季節的脅威に関する公衆衛生警報。India（Kerala州Kozhikode地区）での発生は確認されるが、現段階では具体的な症例数や死亡報告がなく、国際的拡大リスクの評価は不明。スクリーニング基準複数該当（異常性、曝露継続性、流行しやすさ）のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はモンスーン期に伴うレプトスピラ症の季節的リスク警報であり、予防情報を強調。具体的な症例数、死亡数、流行規模の情報が記事に欠落しており、現在の疾患負荷を評価できない。Kozhikode（Kerala州）での発生は明記されているが、地域的な限定的な警報の可能性あり。確定症例の報告確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kakamega intensifies Ebola preparedness
article.articleSummary: Kakamega County, Kenya, is classified as a high-risk area for Ebola Virus Disease, with intensified preparedness including two quarantine centers along major transit corridors used by long-distance truck drivers. The plan, in coordination with national authorities and KEHPHPU, includes deploying additional public health officers, establishing quarantine facilities, strengthening border surveillance, and integrating environmental conservation into prevention efforts. Kakamega’s location along the Busia-Bungoma highway and routes linking Kenya with Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo increases importation risk, and WHO notes Kenya requires heightened vigilance due to cross-border movement. Emphasis is placed on quarantine and screening at border points and transit routes, with PPE supplied to frontline workers. Ebola incubation of 2–21 days underscores the need for observation facilities. Officials called for expedited permanent terms for UHC officers to sustain workforce stability, with high-risk areas mapped as Kaburengu, Matungu, Khwisero, Chavakali, Chepsonoi, and the stretch from River Nzioa to Eldoret.

triage.headline_ja: カカメガ県がエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ケニアのエボラ対策強化に関する記事であり、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。ウガンダ・DRC との国境地域での高リスク評価と越境移動に対する警戒態勢が示されており、公衆衛生的に重要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアのカカメガ県におけるエボラ対策強化について述べており、隣接するウガンダおよびDRCとの国境地域での越境感染リスク評価が中心。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当国となる。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。越境移動と国際的警戒態勢の強化が明記されており、国境地域での顕在的なリスク認識を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Число заражений вирусом Эбола в Демократической Республике Конго превысило 450
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 450.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 452 confirmed cases with 82 deaths, according to the National Institute of Public Health of the DRC. The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri province in the eastern part of the country, with spread to neighboring provinces within the DRC where 19 cases have been identified, including 2 deaths. Authorities warn of ongoing rapid transmission and continued expansion of the outbreak. As of June 6, 2026, health officials are monitoring the situation and reporting these figures to guide response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス感染者数が450人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（452確認症例、82死亡）であり、急速な伝播と地域拡大が継続中の深刻な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は死亡率が極めて高い一類感染症。DRC東部イトゥリ州が震源地で隣接州への拡大が確認されている。急速な伝播継続中との警告あり。国際支援体制の発動が必要な事象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Bundibugyo-Virus: Ebola-Patient aus Charité entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola virus: Ebola patient discharged from Charité.
article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of Congo was discharged from Berlin's Charité after about two weeks of treatment. He had been admitted on May 20; PCR confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Since May 30, virus tests were negative, and an isolation order was lifted by the local health authority. The patient received experimental therapies under investigation for this Ebola virus type and reported excellent care. His wife and four children, who accompanied him to Berlin, were designated high-risk contacts; they exhibited no symptoms and remained quarantined in a separate ward area. Ebola virus disease is highly contagious and life-threatening, transmitted by contact with bodily fluids. The Bundibugyo variant currently lacks a licensed vaccine or specific therapy; the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains difficult to control. The article will be updated.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス：シャリテ病院からエボラ患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準3つ該当（重症度、長期曝露の継続リスク、管理可能性の課題）。エボラウイルスの国際的な移動と治療上の課題が顕在化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは感染はコンゴ民主共和国で発生し、患者がベルリン（ドイツ）で治療を受けた経過を述べている。ベルリン・ドイツは患者の移動先であり、DRCが発生地である。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。エボラウイルス・ブンディブギョ型はワクチン・特異的治療が未承認であり、コンゴでのアウトブレイク制御が困難という公開情報が含まれている。患者と濃厚接触者（妻・4人の子ども）の隔離管理が継続されている点から、感染制御の課題が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: மத்திய ஆப்பிரிக்காவில் 500 இபோலா தொற்று: WHO அறிவிப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 500 Ebola infections in Central Africa: WHO announces.
article.articleSummary: 500 Ebola infections confirmed in Central Africa as of June 6, 2026, according to the World Health Organization. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 452 cases have been reported with 82 deaths; in Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths have been documented. A single day saw about 100 new infections and 20 deaths across both countries. Despite the declaration of an international public health emergency, Ebola transmission continues to rise. A senior US CDC official warned of a potentially widespread outbreak, saying the current situation could surpass the 2014 West Africa epidemic, which infected more than 28,000 people and killed over 11,000. The ongoing surge highlights the need for intensified surveillance and response efforts in Central Africa to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカで500人のエボラ感染：WHO発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模集団発生で、死亡者を伴う重度の感染症イベント。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として確実にシグナル化が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（452例、82死亡）とウガンダ（19例、2死亡）の2か国での確認を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations はDRCのみ。2014年西アフリカエボラ流行（28,000以上の感染者、11,000以上の死亡者）を上回る可能性があるとUS CDCが警告。国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態として既に宣言されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: У Східній Африці підтвердили майже 500 випадків Еболи - ВООЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 500 Ebola cases confirmed in East Africa - WHO.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports an Ebola virus disease outbreak in East Africa with 471 laboratory-confirmed cases and 82 deaths. The Democratic Republic of Congo accounts for the vast majority of cases, while Uganda has 19. Case counts rose sharply in the last 24 hours, and authorities warn the outbreak could intensify toward 500 confirmed cases. CDC cautions that, without decisive public health action, this outbreak could surpass the scale of the 2014 West Africa epidemic, which killed over 11,000 and had about 28,000 cases. The WHO has declared the Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and plans to mobilize $518 million for the response. The article provides no additional laboratory confirmation details, transmission sources, or imported/exported-case information beyond these figures.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカでエボラ出血熱の症例がほぼ500件確認された - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）を宣言している国際的に重大な新興感染症アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Congo）とウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクを報告しており、DRCが圧倒的多数の症例を占めている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。モザンビークとアンゴラは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、サマリーに記載されていないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言と$518百万の動員計画は国際的な重要性を示している。2014年西アフリカエボラ流行（11,000以上の死亡）との比較は懸念の深刻さを反映。

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن ترصد 38 مليون دولار إضافية لمواجهة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington earmarks an additional $38 million to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: The United States will earmark an additional $38 million to help combat Ebola, lifting direct U.S. Ebola assistance to over $200 million as part of international efforts to curb spread in several African countries. The State Department did not detail how the funds will be allocated but affirmed ongoing coordination with the CDC and authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda to ensure a rapid, comprehensive response to contain the outbreak. It noted that some American citizens exposed to the virus without symptoms will be quarantined in a facilities being established in Kenya. In the DRC, confirmed Ebola cases have reached 452, with 71 new infections reported in the past 24 hours, underscoring persistent transmission and the need for intensified control and containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントン、エボラ対策に追加3,800万ドルを計上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は確認症例452件、死亡率が極めて高い重大な感染症であり、DRCからウガンダへの国際的拡大リスク、ケニアでの隔離施設設置など国際的対応が展開中。
triage.notes: 記事では米国、ケニアも言及されているが、DRCとウガンダが疫学的に最も重要な発生地。米国とケニアは支援・対応国として位置づけられているため、イベント発生国としての対象リストに該当するのはDRCとウガンダのみ。452確認症例と71/24h新規報告はIHR通知の強い根拠。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient aus Berliner Charité entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient discharged from Berlin's Charité.
article.articleSummary: An American physician treated in Berlin’s Charité has been discharged after about two weeks for Ebola. The doctor contracted the infection in the Democratic Republic of Congo and was admitted May 20. He tested positive for Bundibugyo virus (a rare Ebola lineage) by PCR, and no virus has been detected since May 30. In line with international criteria, the local health authority lifted the isolation order at 12:00 on discharge day. The patient’s wife and four children accompanied him to Berlin; they were classified as high-risk contacts, asymptomatic, and quarantined in a separate section of the ward. This remains an imported Ebola case, highlighting ongoing surveillance and strict infection-control measures in German hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンのシャリテ病院からエボラ患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: 国際的に注目度が高いエボラウイルスの輸入症例（Bundibugyo系統）であり、IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準複数該当。ドイツでの確認事例であり、感染症危機管理上の国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、患者はコンゴ民主共和国で感染し、ベルリンで治療を受けた輸入症例であることが明確に記載されている。発生地域にベルリン/ドイツが含まれているが、実際の感染地はDRCであり、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。患者の接触者管理が適切に実施されており、現在のリスクは低いと考えられるが、エボラウイルスの稀な系統（Bundibugyo）の確認は国際的監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: US doctor treated for Ebola discharged from Berlin hospital
article.articleSummary: US doctor treated for Ebola in Berlin's Charité hospital discharged June 6, 2026, after two weeks of care. He contracted Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and was admitted May 20 following a PCR-confirmed infection. He has tested negative since May 30, enabling the isolation order to be lifted at midday under international guidelines. The patient, now in good health, expressed gratitude and noted experimental therapeutics being evaluated for this Ebola species. The ongoing Congo outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo, remains difficult to contain, with no vaccine or specific treatment available for this strain. The patient’s wife and four children were classified as high-risk contacts, arrived in Berlin, and were quarantined in a separate ward area but showed no symptoms. This case represents an imported Ebola exposure to Germany.

triage.headline_ja: 米国医師、ベルリン病院でエボラ治療後に退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo種）の国際輸送ケース。コンゴでの流行との関連、ドイツへの輸入症例、高リスク接触者の存在により、IHR基準3つ以上該当。国際的な感染症脅威として認識される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認できる実際の発生地はDRC（患者感染源）。ドイツ（ベルリン）は治療地であり二次的な輸入症例であるため、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。コンゴでの継続的流行、ワクチン・特異的治療の欠如、高リスク接触者の存在が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Secretária da Saúde alerta para aumento dos casos de Influenza - NPDiário
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Secretary warns of an increase in influenza cases.
article.articleSummary: On 6 June 2026, the Municipal Health Secretariat of Santo Antônio da Platina warns of a marked rise in respiratory syndromes, notably influenza (flu). To curb transmission, residents are urged to wear masks when symptomatic, practice hand hygiene, and observe respiratory etiquette in enclosed or crowded settings. Influenza vaccination is being prioritized for children, seniors, and health workers. The city reactivated the Respiratory Syndromes Sentinel Unit, located between the Municipal Emergency Department and Hospital Nossa Senhora da Saúde, operating daily 7:00–19:00 for patients with fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, or breathing discomfort. Other care avenues include the Municipal Emergency Care and Basic Health Units. Oseltamivir (Tamiflu) is available only through the Ministry of Health via the State Health Secretariat; municipal acquisition is not routine, and stock is currently insufficient due to rising demand. Authorities monitor daily and urge early care and adherence to preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生事務局がインフルエンザ症例の増加について警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・パラナ州の単一自治体（サント・アントニオ・ダ・プラチーナ）でのインフルエンザ増加警告。季節性インフルエンザの一般的な対策がとられており、異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスクは限定的。情報不足のため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations は空配列。記事はブラジル・パラナ州の自治体レベルでの季節性インフルエンザ警報であり、通常の季節対応と見なされる。重症例・死亡の報告なし。Oseltamivir在庫不足が記載されているが、これは治療アクセスの問題であり、重症度ではなく管理上の課題。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Scare in Jaipur: Uganda Tourist Hospitalised in Rajasthan With Symptoms, Sample Sent for Test
article.articleSummary: A 19-year-old Ugandan woman hospitalized in Jaipur at RUHS Hospital with symptoms resembling Ebola virus disease. Ebola has not been confirmed; a sample was sent to Pune for testing, with a second sample to be collected after 48 hours. If positive, she will undergo a 21-day quarantine and treatment. She arrived from Sharjah on an Air Arabia flight and was identified during airport screening; she remains in isolation as laboratories confirm the cause. Initial reports indicated abdominal pain, loss of appetite and headache. Passengers on the same flight are advised to self-isolate while investigations continue; results were expected by Friday night or Saturday morning. The case occurs amid heightened global surveillance following Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO classified the Ebola situation as a PHEIC on May 17, 2026; Africa CDC declared a PHECS, with enhanced surveillance at points of entry. A separate Sudanese national at Hyderabad was isolated, samples sent to CCMB; no confirmed link. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola; India has provided humanitarian aid to Uganda.}}

triage.headline_ja: ジャイプールでエボラ不安：ウガンダ人観光客がラジャスタン州で入院、症状あり、検査用サンプル送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疑い症例が対象国（インド）で検出され、国際的な広がりリスク（ウガンダからの入国者）が存在。WHO/Africa CDCが既にPHEIC/PHECSを宣言している時期の継続的な疑い症例報告であり、IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは複数国を記載（シャルジャ=UAE、DRC、ウガンダなど）だが、記事の主題は『インドのジャイプールで検出された疑い症例』であり、検査対象者はウガンダ発症ではなくインド到着後の発症。したがってverified_locationsはインドのみ。ウガンダ由来のエボラ（Bundibugyo-strain）による国際的な拡大リスクが存在し、WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）の文脈における継続的な懸念事例。

article.articleHeadline: تحذيرات أمريكية من تفشي "إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American warnings about an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: CDC warns that without immediate intervention to curb the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, cases could surge to 10,000–20,000 in a short period. Africa CDC reports about 400 lab-confirmed cases and 63 deaths to date, though true totals may be higher due to surveillance gaps in remote areas. A rare Bundibugyo lineage of Ebola has emerged, and there is no globally approved vaccine or proven treatment for this strain, prompting WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, armed conflict with M23 rebels and ISIS-linked groups hampers containment and isolates hotspots, while mass displacement increases urban transmission risk and challenge in achieving 50–70% case isolation. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak sickened over 28,000 and killed about 11,000; CDC models warn of large outbreaks without interventions, though actual outcomes were much lower.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者の急増に対する米国の警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の中央アフリカでの拡大、WHO PHEIC宣言、国際的拡大リスク、医療対応の限界が確認され、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統のエボラは珍しい系統であり、承認されたワクチンや実証済みの治療法がない。武装勢力による衝突により封じ込めが困難。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月）。対象国リストにおいてDRCのみがサマリー内で明記されている。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーでは具体的言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Американски лекар излекуван од ебола во болница во Берлин
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor cured of Ebola in a hospital in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An American physician, 39, treated for Ebola at Berlin's Charité University Hospital was discharged in good health after recovering from infection contracted in the Democratic Republic of Congo. He was placed in a specialized isolation unit on May 20; his five-member family—wife and four children—were quarantined as high-risk contacts, with no symptoms and no virus detected. By May 30 the viral load had fallen to undetectable levels, and isolation was lifted on Saturday. The doctor, who contracted the Bundibugyo variant while working for the American Christian missionary organization Serge in DRC, thanked the care team and expressed solidarity with people in Congo lacking access to such treatment. An Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has seen several hundred confirmed infections and dozens of deaths in the past month.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカの医師がベルリンの病院でエボラから治癒し退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染による個別症例の治癒報告であり、DRCでの流行継続を背景としているが、ドイツでの二次感染リスクは低く、現在のところ国際的拡大の具体的証拠がない。情報不足のため継続監視推奨。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はドイツでのエボラ症例治癒報告であるが、対象国リストにはドイツが含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。DRC でのエボラ流行（数百の確認症例、数十の死亡）は継続中だが、ドイツでの感染または二次感染の具体的リスクは記載されていない。患者の家族は高リスク接触者として検疫されたが症状なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Bundibugyo-Virus: Ebola-Patient aus Charité entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Bundibugyo virus: Ebola patient discharged from Charité.
article.articleSummary: US-American Ebola patient discharged from Charité in Berlin after about two weeks of treatment for Bundibugyo virus, a form of Ebola acquired in the Democratic Republic of Congo. PCR-confirmed infection; admitted May 20, discharged after tests were negative since May 30; isolation order lifted. The patient arrived in Berlin from Uganda by special aircraft and was cared for in a dedicated high-security isolation unit; his wife and four children were identified as high-risk contacts and quarantined separately but asymptomatic. He received antiviral therapy alongside experimental treatments; symptoms and viral load declined within the first week and laboratory values normalized. Bundibugyo type has no vaccine or specific therapy. Ongoing Congo outbreak: 381 confirmed cases, 62 deaths; Uganda: 16 cases, 1 death. No danger to the public; isolation unit deemed indispensable.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・ブンディブギョ・ウイルス：シャリテ病院からエボラ患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外な事象、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱はPHEIC該当疾患。DRCでの流行継続と国際患者の発生により、WPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツ・ベルリンの病院での患者治療と退院について報じているが、感染源はDRCの継続流行。対象国はDRCのみ該当。ウガンダも記事内に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラ出血熱は国際的に極めて重大な公衆衛生脅威であり、DRC発の流行として捉える必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dagboek van Belgische arts in ebola-gebied: 'Je ziet het topje van de ijsberg, maar hebt geen idee hoe groot de ijsberg zelf is'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diary of a Belgian doctor in the Ebola region: 'You see the tip of the iceberg, but you have no idea how large the iceberg itself is.'
article.articleSummary: In Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, near Bunia, the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola drives an outbreak centered on Rampara, about 10 km from Bunia. After two days of bureaucratic delays in Kinshasa, a Belgian doctor travels on a UN flight since commercial services are canceled by the virus. GeneXpert PCR testing yields results in 1–2 hours, but there are no cassettes for the Bundibugyo variant, forcing clinicians to restart the process. Patients endure severe pain, muscle and headaches, dehydration with diarrhea, and some die while others recover; isolation remains grim. A patient is particularly affected by agony; two recently deceased lie in beds. New Ebola-care cubes with transparent walls aim to restore some contact between patients and staff and ease families’ concerns. Contact tracing is difficult; many cases lack clear links and quarantine has limited social buy-in. A vaccine for this variant does not yet exist.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ地域のベルギー人医師の日記：「氷山の一角は見えるが、氷山そのものがどれほど大きいかは見当もつかない」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ブンディブギョ変種エボラの流行で、ワクチンが存在せず、接触者追跡が困難、臨床対応の制約がある状況。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから報告された発生地域にはバングラデシュ（ラジシャヒ地域）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国のイツリ州・ブニア近郊ラムパラに限定されており、バングラデシュでの実際の発生は記載されていない。したがってverified_locationsに含めない。ブンディブギョ変種エボラは珍しい変種であり、ワクチン不在かつ診断用試薬の不足が対応を複雑にしている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO：中非伊波拉疫情擴大 確診逼近500例奪84命
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa expands, with confirmed cases nearing 500 and 84 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa expands as of 2026-06-06, with 471 confirmed cases and 84 deaths, nearing 500. Democratic Republic of Congo, declared outbreak about three weeks ago, reports 452 cases and 82 deaths; Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths. The latest update shows an increase of about 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). U.S. CDC modeling warns that without strong public health interventions, the outbreak could reach the scale of the 2014 West Africa Ebola crisis (over 28,000 infections and more than 11,000 deaths). Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed rapid spread and urged local containment, sustained international support, and preparedness of neighboring countries to detect and act quickly.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：中非伊波拉疫情擴大 確診逼近500例奪84命
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO が PHEIC を宣言した高リスクシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラの実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（452例、82死亡）とウガンダ（19例、2死亡）であることが明確。Bluedot の発生地域にはアンゴラも含まれているが、サマリー上では言及されていないため除外。U.S.は CDC モデリング言及のため除外。対象国のうち DRC のみが verified_locations に該当。PHEIC 宣言、2014年西アフリカエボラとの比較（28,000感染以上、11,000死以上）、急速な伝播と国際支援の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Po viac ako dvoch týždňoch opustil izolované oddelenie. Američana s ebolou prepustili v Berlíne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After more than two weeks, he left the isolation ward. An American with Ebola was discharged in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with Ebola in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, was discharged after more than two weeks of treatment at Berlin's Charité hospital, in good health. He was flown to Germany at the US request; his wife and four children were admitted the next day as a precaution though asymptomatic. A second American with Ebola was admitted May 21 to Prague's Bulovka University Hospital and remains asymptomatic; isolation could end next week if no symptoms appear. A Czech soldier, who returned from a Congo mission, has been in isolation since June 2 at a Czech military biocontainment center in the Orlickoústecko region. The CDC confirmed an outbreak in Ituri on May 15; WHO warns transmission may have begun as early as January. Congo reports 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, Uganda 19 cases and 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain has no vaccine or proven treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 2週間以上後、隔離病棟を退出。エボラに感染したアメリカ人がベルリンで退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ拡大で死亡例あり、複数国での患者報告と対象国（DRC）での流行確認により、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはベルリン、プラハ、チェコ、米国が含まれているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ（Ituri州）での流行であり、ドイツ・チェコへの患者輸送は二次的事象。対象国リストで該当するのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株（ワクチン・実証済み治療法なし）による死亡例82例、複数国での患者報告、WHO警告による早期感染可能性指摘により、国際的な懸念は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO：中非伊波拉疫情擴大 確診逼近500例奪84命 - 國際新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa widens as confirmed cases near 500, 84 deaths - International News - PChome Online News.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa widens as WHO data show confirmed cases nearing 500 with 84 deaths. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, three weeks into the outbreak, 452 cases and 82 deaths were reported. Neighboring Uganda reported 19 cases and 2 deaths. Current totals across both countries are 471 cases and 84 deaths, with day-to-day increases of about 100 cases and 20 deaths. The outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) and is intensifying. A US CDC modeling official warned that, without strong public health interventions, the outbreak could reach levels seen in the 2014 West Africa epidemic (more than 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths). Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged rapid action to halt spread, support affected nations, and ensure neighboring countries remain prepared to detect and respond.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱疫情が拡大 確診が500例近くに達し84名が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多国間での流行拡大（DRC 452例、ウガンダ19例）、死亡例の増加、PHEIC宣言、国際的な懸念の高まり。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、DRC（452例、82死）とウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の流行が明記されている。しかし、対象国リストにウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。PHEIC宣言済み、WHOおよびUS CDCによる警告が発出されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルのRapid Risk Assessment（RRA）が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Dėl Ebolos protrūkio JAV institucijos ragina imtis griežtų priemonių
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to the Ebola outbreak, U.S. authorities urge that strict measures be taken.
article.articleSummary: CDC urges stringent public health interventions against Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with Uganda affected as well. Models warn the outbreak could reach the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic if unchecked. The outbreak has surpassed 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths. Outcomes improve when more patients are identified, isolated, and treated. Four intervention scenarios model isolation and treatment levels from 20% to 95%; at the low end (around 20%) with no other measures, there is a 65% chance case count exceeds 20,000 within three months. The DRC outbreak, declared May 15 in northeast, is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus across three provinces, with Ituri epicenter accounting for about 90% of cases and 76% of deaths. Uganda reports 16 cases and one death; seven in DRC and two in Uganda have recovered. WHO and African Union seek $518 million over six months to fight the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行により、米国当局が厳格な対策の実施を促促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。大規模流行の警告とWHOによる国際支援要請により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（主要な発生地）とウガンダの影響を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。28,000超の症例と11,000超の死亡が報告され、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行規模に達する可能性が警告されている。CDCとWHOによる国際的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Заразившегося Эболой в Конго врача выписали из клиники
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The doctor who contracted Ebola in Congo has been discharged from the clinic.
article.articleSummary: 39-year-old American physician infected with Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo completed treatment and was discharged from Berlin's Charité hospital after about two weeks. He was flown to Germany on May 20 by a medical aircraft specialized for high-risk infections, arriving from Uganda, where he had entered from the outbreak zone. Symptoms began to improve in the first week, and by May 30 daily laboratory tests were persistently negative, indicating viral clearance. A final assessment confirmed no active infection, and the patient and his family, who accompanied him and were quarantined in the same facility, were discharged in good health. Five accompanying relatives showed no symptoms and were released after incubation-period isolation. Bundibugyo virus is a less common Ebola species within Filoviridae, with potential differences in clinical course and fatality versus Zaire ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラに感染した医師がクリニックから退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染例であり、IHR基準で異常性（予想外の国際的発生）と国際拡大リスクが該当。感染例の国際移動を伴う事例であり、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際の感染発生地はDRC（コンゴ）であることが明確。患者は米国人医師でDRCで感染し、ウガンダ経由でドイツ（ベルリンのCharité病院）に搬送されたため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。Bundibugyo Ebolavirusは比較的稀な亜種で、臨床経過と致死率がZaire ebolavirusと異なる可能性がある点も注目。

article.articleHeadline: US doctor treated for Ebola discharged from Berlin hospital
article.articleSummary: US doctor treated for Ebola in Berlin's Charité hospital discharged after two weeks, in good health, having tested negative for the Bundibugyo virus since May 30. The infection, contracted in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, was confirmed by PCR on May 20. Bundibugyo is the Ebola strain identified in the ongoing central African outbreak; authorities note there is no vaccine or specific treatment for this strain, complicating containment in Congo. The doctor praised the Charité team and described receiving experimental therapeutics being evaluated for this virus. He highlighted the lack of access to such care for those affected by Ebola in Congo. His wife and four children, arriving in Berlin as high-risk contacts, were quarantined in a separate ward and showed no symptoms. Ebola spreads via physical contact and bodily fluids, and the Congo outbreak remains challenging to control.

triage.headline_ja: 米国医師がベルリンの病院からエボラ治療後に退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の確定症例で、コンゴでの感染から国際的に拡大（ドイツへの輸入症例）。IHR基準では深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクの複数該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴでのエボラ感染が確認された米国医師がドイツで治療を受けた事例。ドイツ（ベルリン）での治療・退院は輸入症例であり、実際の発生地はコンゴ。Bundibugyo株（中央アフリカでの進行中の流行）であり、ワクチンや特定治療法がないと記載されている点が管理可能性の課題を示唆。医療従事者が患者と接触する可能性があり、流行のしやすさが高い。

article.articleHeadline: US announces additional $38M in Ebola response support
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the United States added $38 million to Ebola response efforts in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, elevating direct U.S. Ebola funding to over $200 million and adding to a prior $350 million allocated for Ebola response and humanitarian aid in the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda. The funds, announced by the U.S. Department of State in coordination with the CDC and the governments of the DRC and Uganda, aim to bolster a rapid and coordinated outbreak response. The outbreak remains confined to Uganda and the DRC, with South Sudan reporting no Ebola cases. Authorities have intensified surveillance, especially at border areas and points of entry, to reduce cross-border transmission. Officials urge vigilance and reporting of suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラウイルス対応に追加38百万ドルを発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。アクティブなエボラ流行への国際的対応を示唆するシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年6月時点のアクティブなエボラ流行をDRCとウガンダで報告している。南スーダンではケースなしと明記。US、Sudan は発生地域に含まれていても主題は対象国ではないため verified_locations から除外。米国の資金支援発表は国際関心の高さを示す強いシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: 71 novos casos são registrados e CDC alerta que o surto pode ser um dos maiores da história
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 71 new cases have been reported and the CDC warns that the outbreak may be one of the largest in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo expands rapidly: on Friday, June 5, 2026, 71 new cases and 21 additional deaths were reported, raising lab-confirmed cases to 452 and deaths to 82. The surge centers in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, where testing was intensified to cut confirmation delays. The outbreak has spread across more than two dozen health zones in three eastern provinces and has reached neighboring Uganda, with 19 confirmed cases. U.S. CDC warned the Bundibugyo outbreak could become one of the largest in history if control measures are not accelerated. WHO and Africa CDC launched a continental response plan seeking about $319 million by November to support control, with total needs estimated at $518 million.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：71件の新規症例が報告され、CDCは同発生が歴史上最大級となる可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。452人の確認患者、82人の死亡、複数地域・国への急速な拡大、および高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生とウガンダへの拡大を述べているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため記載。CDCが「歴史上最大級となる可能性」と警告しており、国際的支援（WHO・Africa CDC）が既に動員されている。高いリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Around 150 students fall ill in Kerala school, classes suspended for a week
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, about 150 students at Mar Baselios Aided Upper Primary School in Koilady, Wayanad district, Kerala, reported fever and vomiting; 38 were admitted to Sulthan Bathery Taluk Hospital, with one teacher also symptomatic. In response, the school was closed for one week. Health authorities have set up a separate ward at the hospital to manage the increased number of patients. Investigations are underway; samples have been collected from the school and adjacent areas for laboratory analysis. Officials are considering contaminated food, water, a viral infection, or another source as the possible cause, but no etiology has been identified yet. The District Medical Officer says the situation is under control and there is no immediate cause for concern. Results from laboratory tests are awaited to determine the source and to guide further actions.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州の学校で約150人の学生が体調不良に、1週間の休校措置
triage.triage_reason: 未確定の集団発生イベント（150人の学生が発熱・嘔吐）で異常性と重症度の可能性がありますが、病因が未特定であり、情報が限定的なため。検査結果待ちの段階であり、詳細判断に情報不足が存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではケーラ州ワヤナド地区の学校での集団発症が報告されており、約150人が罹患、38人が入院。原因不明（食物汚染、水汚染、ウイルス感染、その他を検討中）。当局は状況がコントロール下にあると報告しているが、検査結果待ちの段階。WPRO基準の3項目該当（異常性、長期曝露リスク、流行可能性）により要経過観察の判定。フルRRAのためには病因特定後の追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲伊波拉疫情升溫！WHO：確診逼近500例　CDC警告最糟恐逾2萬人染疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa's Ebola outbreak heats up! WHO: confirmed cases nearing 500; CDC warns worst-case could exceed 20,000 infections.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa intensifies with Bundibugyo-strain virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) and Uganda. As of 2026-06-06, WHO reports 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in DRC, plus 19 cases and 2 deaths in Uganda; total 471 cases and 84 deaths. The epidemic began about three weeks ago, with rapid community transmission across multiple health zones in Ituri. There is currently no vaccine; survival improves with quality medical care. WHO designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, but not a pandemic. CDC modeling warns that without sustained, large-scale interventions, totals could exceed 20,000 cases and 4,000 deaths within three months, approaching 2014–2016 West Africa levels. U.S. risk remains low; authorities emphasize rapid detection, isolation, and breaking transmission chains. Director-General Tedros urged international support and preparedness for neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱が激化！WHO：確認患者数が500例近く　CDC警告では最悪の場合2万人超が感染の可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響を伴い、急速な地域伝播が進行中。複数国への国際的拡大リスクが顕著で、WHO PHEICに指定されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてUganda、Angola、USAが列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（Ituri州）とUgandaのエボラ流行である。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国は検査施設言及のみで発生地ではなく除外。Angola言及なしのため除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に入れる。WHO PHEIC指定、CDC警告による国際的な社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola v Afrike udrela naplno: WHO hlási už takmer 500 prípadov a varuje pred katastrofou | Info.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Africa has struck hard: WHO reports nearly 500 cases and warns of catastrophe.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa accelerates; as of 6 June 2026, WHO confirms nearly 500 cases. The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 452 confirmed infections and 82 deaths; Uganda records 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo lineage has no approved vaccines or therapeutics. The outbreak was officially declared on 15 May 2026 in northeastern DRC, though transmission likely began earlier. Models cited by CDC warn of potential expansion similar to West Africa 2014–2016, which saw over 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths. In response, WHO and Africa CDC launched a $518 million plan over six months to bolster surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention, aiming to halt transmission, support affected countries, and ready neighbors for imported cases. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasized urgency.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱が猛威：WHO、ほぼ500件の症例を報告し、大惨事を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。重症度が高く（82死亡）、異常・予想外の急速な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性あり。スクリーニング基準も全て該当。緊急対応が必要な高リスクシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認された主要な発生地はDRCおよびウガンダ。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo系統によるエボラ出血熱で、ワクチン・治療薬なし。5月15日公式宣言、6月6日時点で既に452症例・82死亡。西アフリカ2014-2016流行との比較により大規模化リスクを警告。WHOと Africa CDC が5億1800万ドル6ヶ月計画を立案。

article.articleHeadline: Nearly 500 confirmed cases in Central Africa Ebola outbreak: WHO
article.articleSummary: Nearly 500 Ebola cases have been confirmed in central Africa, with 452 in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and 19 in Uganda as of 2026-06-06, totaling 471 cases and 84 deaths. The outbreak, first declared in northeastern DRC on May 15, includes a first case in Goma, a major eastern city controlled by the M23 armed group. WHO has declared an international public health emergency. U.S. CDC models warn the outbreak could rival the 2014 West Africa epidemic (over 28,000 cases, 11,000+ deaths) if responses lag. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo Ebola species; there are no approved vaccines or treatments. To counter, WHO and Africa CDC launched a $518-million, six-month plan focusing on surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention, and readiness in neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行で約500例の確認例：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全項目該当。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言した大規模なエボラ出血熱流行であり、死亡例も報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの感染が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。Bundibugyo Ebolaという稀な種であり、ワクチンや治療薬がないことが特筆すべき。$518百万の6ヶ月対応計画が展開されている。

article.articleHeadline: 快新聞／WHO：中非伊波拉疫情擴大「確診已逼近500例」　恐釀大流行破萬人喪生 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: WHO Says Ebola Outbreak in Central Africa Is Expanding; "Confirmed Cases Nearing 500" Could Trigger a Pandemic With Over 10,000 Deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa is expanding, with the World Health Organization reporting 471 confirmed cases and 84 deaths across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda. The DRC accounts for 452 cases and 82 deaths; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, bringing total to near 500. WHO has raised the outbreak’s risk level to the highest category for the DRC, warning it could become the largest Ebola outbreak on record. US CDC officials say, without strong public health interventions, the outbreak could scale to a pandemic with more than 10,000 deaths, resembling the 2014 West Africa epidemic which saw over 28,000 infections and more than 11,000 deaths. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed that containment must be pursued locally, support provided to affected countries, and neighboring nations prepared for rapid detection and action. The update notes the outbreak was declared three weeks ago.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：WHO、中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱の拡大を警告「確診例が500近くに」 万人以上の死亡の危機も
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模な確認例（471例）と高い死亡率、多国への国際的拡大、WHO最高リスク警告により、フルRRA対象のシグナルと判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCがエボラアウトブレイクの主要発生地（452例）と明記されているため verified_locations に DRC を含める。ウガンダは記事に記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国は輸入症例報告国と思われるが、サマリーでは具体的な輸入症例記述がないため除外。発生から3週間の時点での報告であり、流行初期段階での警告であることに注意。WHO最高リスク警告（highest category）が発出されている。

article.articleHeadline: वायरल तोड़ रहा शरीर, इस बार कई मरीजों का तीन से पांच दिनों में नहीं उतर रहा बुखार; यह बरतें सावधानी - viral fever cases rise amidst weather changes take precautions to prevent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A viral infection is taking a toll on the body; this time, fever is not subsiding in three to five days for many patients; take precautions.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, in Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh, viral fever cases are rising with weather fluctuations (clouds, rain, heat). Outpatient department sees over 250 patients with viral fever, cold, and throat infections. Common symptoms: high fever, body aches, sore throat; fever typically subsides in 4-5 days, full recovery about 6 days. Many patients experience prolonged weakness and muscle pain after fever; some report throat swelling, hoarseness, cough, and voice loss. Most recover with paracetamol (acetaminophen), rest, fluids, and nutritious food; a minority receive antibiotics after clinical evaluation. Complications such as persistent fever beyond a week, breathing difficulties, ear pain, or throat discharge prompt further investigation. Precautions include avoiding cold drinks immediately after coming indoors and avoiding open foods to reduce transmission. Emphasis on prophylaxis: careful use of medications for children and the elderly.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性熱が体に打撃を与えている。今回、多くの患者の発熱が3〜5日で引いていない。予防措置を講じよ。
triage.triage_reason: 不明熱（Unknown Illness）が対象地域で発生しており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する可能性があるが、情報不足（病原体同定なし、正確な患者数・重症度・死亡情報不明）のため、続報を注視する段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は気象変動（降雨、気温変化）に関連したウイルス性疾患の集団発生を報告。外来患者250人以上が関連症状で受診しており、症状の遷延（通常4〜5日で軽快するが、一部患者で延長）が特徴。ただし病原体の同定なし、正確な入院者数・死亡情報・感染確認例不明。Bulandshahr（ウッタル・プラデーシ州）での地域的な環境関連疾患の可能性も含む。定期的な続報監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolapatient aus Berliner Charité entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Patient Discharged from Berlin's Charité
article.articleSummary: US citizen treated for Ebola virus disease at Berlin's Charité has been discharged after about two weeks. He contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo; PCR-confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Since May 30 no virus detected, and the isolation order was lifted by public health authorities. Admitted May 20, he was initially very weak with a high viral load and typical Ebola symptoms, but improved after a combination antiviral regimen and experimental therapies; laboratory values normalized. His wife and four children arrived in Berlin as high-risk contacts and were quarantined in a separate section but remained asymptomatic. Outbreaks in Congo and Uganda persist: 381 Congo confirmed cases and 62 deaths; Uganda 16 cases and 1 death. WHO notes ongoing transmission challenges; about 45% of contacts traced vs. the 90% target. No approved vaccine for Bundibugyo type; historically, West Africa 2014–2015 killed >11,000; East Congo 2018–2020 about 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンのシャリテ病院からエボラ患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: PCR確認されたBundibugyo ebolavirus症例の国際的な輸送と治療成功事例であり、IHR基準において異常性（国際的な重症患者の移送）と国際拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの流行継続）に該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・管理可能性・流行しやすさの複数基準に適合する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベルリンでのエボラ患者の治療・退院事例であるが、感染源および継続的な流行地はDRCおよびウガンダである。対象国リスト内はDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（West Africa系統以外）は承認ワクチンがなく、公衆衛生上の懸念は高い。患者の家族（妻子4名）の隔離状況から二次感染リスク評価も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Charité: Ebola-Patient gesund aus Krankenhaus entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Charité: Ebola patient discharged from hospital in good health.
article.articleSummary: An American physician employed by a Christian aid organization contracted Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and received treatment at Berlin Charité’s special isolation unit. Admitted May 20, he underwent combination antiviral therapy and was fully symptom-free for more than 72 hours with repeated PCR tests showing no detectable virus since May 30; he was discharged on 2026-06-06. His wife and four children, also isolated, remained asymptomatic and their isolation orders were lifted. Charité infectious-disease chief Leif Erik Sander called the outcome a major therapeutic success and highlighted the isolation unit as an indispensable component for handling highly pathogenic infections. The DRC is the Ebola epicenter, with WHO-confirmed over 60 Ebola-related deaths and many more suspected. The UN declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in mid-May; suspected cases in DRC and Uganda briefly rose above 900 before declining.

triage.headline_ja: シャリテ病院：エボラ患者が健康状態で退院
triage.triage_reason: 患者の回復・退院報告であり、新規の感染拡大や異常な発生ではない。感染症イベントの制御・終結段階の報告であるため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 背景：DRCでのエボラ流行は既知の継続事象であり、本記事は患者個別の回復報告。ベルリンでの治療は終了し、患者一家は隔離解除。WPROスクリーニング対象地域（DRC）での発生は確認されるが、本記事自体は流行の新規拡大を示すシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mauritius bans entry of travelers from DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: Mauritius has temporarily banned entry for foreign nationals who have travelled to, transited through, or stayed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the last 21 days, amid an Ebola outbreak. The measure also prompted postponement of the US-Africa Business Summit scheduled for July 26–29. Entry will be allowed for Mauritian and foreign nationals holding a valid work, residence and occupation permit or a business or student visa who have travelled from the three countries within the preceding 21 days, subject to a mandatory 21-day quarantine on arrival. Public health screening and risk assessment at points of entry will be mandatory, with immediate isolation and clinical assessment for travelers displaying Ebola-compatible symptoms. The Health Ministry will strengthen active surveillance and contact monitoring. The African Union views the outbreak as a serious regional threat, with the WHO declaring it a public health emergency of global concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱への懸念から、モーリシャスがコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの旅行者の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク、複数国での流行確認、渡航制限の実施、WHO緊急事態宣言により、IHR基準3項目以上該当。対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）での感染症イベント認定に相当。
triage.notes: サマリーからエボラ出血熱がDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンで発生していることが確認される。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、アフリカ連合が地域的脅威と評価している。モーリシャスによる渡航制限、米国-アフリカビジネスサミットの延期、21日間の隔離要件など、国家レベルの対応が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Zlom v boji s ebolou: Nakaženého lékaře propustili, v Česku ale dál izolují dva muže
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A turning point in the fight against Ebola: The infected doctor was released, but in the Czech Republic two men remain in isolation.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease centered in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with spillover to Uganda. As of 2026-06-06, Congo has 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths; Uganda 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The WHO/CDC note that confirmation began May 15, with transmission possibly starting in January. A 39-year-old American physician who contracted Ebola in Ituri was evacuated to Germany, treated at Charité Berlin, and released after more than two weeks; his wife and four children were quarantined. A second American infected with Ebola is asymptomatic in Prague’s Bulovka hospital, with isolation to end next week if no symptoms. A Czech soldier who recently returned from Congo remains isolated at the Těchonín center. Bundibugyo variant lacks an available vaccine or effective treatment; transmission occurs via contact with infected persons or contaminated materials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとの戦いの転機：感染した医師がベルリンで退院、チェコでは2人の男性が隔離継続中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の国際的伝播、複数国での確認症例、渡航制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準もすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的伝播は極めて重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによれば、エボラ疫学の中心はDRCのイトゥリ地域にあり、ウガンダへも飛び火している。しかし対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。ドイツ（ベルリン）、チェコへの伝播例は記載されているが、これらは対象国外であり verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの確認症例（452例、82死亡）、ウガンダでの確認（19例、2死亡）、Bundibugyo亜種でのワクチン・治療の欠如、複数国での患者隔離という状況は、IHR基準とWPROスクリーニング基準をすべて満たし、フルRRAへの進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Udupi DC tells ULBs to take precautions to contain spread of infectious diseases
article.articleSummary: Udupi Deputy Commissioner T.K. Swaroopa directed urban local bodies in Udupi district to intensify monsoon-season precautions against dengue, chikungunya, and malaria. At the Dengue/Malaria Inter-Departmental Coordination Committee meeting, she ordered teams of volunteers, health department staff, and ASHA workers to visit homes, eliminate outdoor mosquito breeding sites, and raise community awareness. Breeding grounds on public and private properties should be destroyed, with coordinated efforts from health authorities, gram panchayats, and local organizations, plus scientific waste disposal to maintain a clean environment. Acknowledging inflow of labourers from outside the district and other states, she urged meetings with construction firms and contractors and health check-ups for workers. Priorities include cleanliness in fisheries and harbours and ongoing awareness programs in hostels, schools, colleges, anganwadis, and village health and sanitation committees in every gram panchayat to prevent disease spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウドゥピ副知事、感染症拡大抑制のための予防措置を実施するよう都市地方自治体に指示
triage.triage_reason: デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリアの3疾患が同時に報告されており、モンスーン時期の感染症対策強化が地域レベルで進行中。ただし、具体的な患者数、重症度、死亡例の報告がなく、情報が限定的なため、継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のモンスーン時期の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア）に対する地域予防強化策を報じたもの。患者数や死亡例などの具体的な発生データが記載されていないため、実際の流行規模は不明。労働者の流入により感染リスクが存在する点は注視が必要。今後の患者報告や重症化事例の報告がない場合は見送りになる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: US warns Ebola outbreak on the scale of largest 'is possible'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa (Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda) raises alarms as CDC warns it could reach historic scale, potentially rivaling 2014-2016 West Africa's 28,646 cases and 11,323 deaths. Current modeling suggests the crisis could exceed 20,000 cases within three months if isolation remains low, though these projections are planning tools, not inevitabilities. There are 397 confirmed Ebola cases across DRC and Uganda, with 65 deaths to date. To avert a worst-case scenario, the CDC calls for a massive public health response focusing on identification, isolation, and treatment of patients. The WHO and Africa CDC have launched a $518 million emergency plan to coordinate international efforts. Experts say immediate, large-scale international coordination is critical to breaking transmission chains and preventing further spread of the virus.

triage.headline_ja: US warns Ebola outbreak on the scale of largest 'is possible'（米国が過去最大級規模のエボラ感染症アウトブレイクの可能性を警告）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて重篤で高い死亡率を有する感染症であり、複数国での感染拡大、国際的な大規模対応体制の構築、重大な国際保健上の危機。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ感染症確認と記述されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダ（226074）はスクリーニング対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Angolaも同様に対象国外のため除外。現在397確認症例、65死亡、3ヶ月以内に20,000例を超える可能性との警告。WHO・Africa CDCが5億1,800万ドルの緊急対応計画を立案。歴史的規模のアウトブレイク警告により国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: V strednej Afrike potvrdili takmer 500 prípadov eboly
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Almost 500 Ebola cases confirmed in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports almost 500 Ebola cases in Central Africa, with 452 confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) including 82 deaths, and 19 confirmed cases in neighboring Uganda including 2 deaths. Government tallies raise totals to 471 cases and 84 deaths, up by about 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The northeast DRC outbreak, declared three weeks ago on May 15, continues to spread through close contact and exposure to bodily fluids. The region has seen more than 15,000 Ebola deaths in Africa over the last five decades. To stem transmission, WHO and the Africa CDC launched a six-month response plan on Friday, valued at $518 million, prioritizing surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: 中央アフリカでエボラ熱の症例がほぼ500例確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ熱は極めて高い重篤性と致命性を有し、複数国での確認、国際的拡大リスクが明確。WHO主導の大規模対応計画立案による国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC(203312)のみ。ウガンダ(GeoNames ID: 226074)は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラ熱の高い病原性（致死率50%以上）、3週間で452→471例への急速な増加、複数国への拡大、および$518百万規模の国際対応計画立案により、複数のシグナル基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Radio station in DR Congo seeks to stop misinformation amid spread of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-type Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has 397 confirmed cases and 63 deaths as of 2026-06-06, per the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention. The outbreak was announced on May 15 after weeks of spread went unnoticed. Skepticism, attacks on health workers, and widespread misinformation hinder response efforts. A DR Congo radio station is actively working to stop misinformation to support containment and public health messaging. The report centers on laboratory-confirmed case counts and ongoing transmission, while offering few details on infection source or imported/exported cases. The situation underscores the importance of trust in public health measures as authorities coordinate surveillance, risk communication, and health worker safety to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のラジオ局がエボラの拡大に伴う誤情報を止めるために尽力
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率と重症度を持ち、公衆衛生への深刻な影響がある。397確認例、63死亡。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダも記載されているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ拡大に限定されており、ウガンダでの発生は明記されていないため、DRC のみを verified_locations に含めた。誤情報対策が必要となる状況であり、公共衛生対応の複雑性が増加している。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: تسجيل 500 حالة مؤكدة.. "الصحة العالمية" تحذر من تفشي إيبولا بوسط أفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 500 confirmed cases recorded... WHO warns of an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports about 500 Ebola infections in Central Africa, with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where the outbreak was declared three weeks earlier, and 19 confirmed cases with 2 deaths in neighboring Uganda. The combined tally is 471 cases and 84 deaths, up from the previous day by 100 cases and 20 deaths. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. The WHO has declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). In response, WHO, in partnership with the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, launched a joint response and funding plan totaling $518 million for six months (June–November 2026) to bolster surveillance, laboratory capacity, diagnostics, rapid response, and preventive interventions in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 500件の確認症例が記録... WHOが中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、PHEIC宣言済みの重大な感染症危機。DRCとウガンダで確認された多数の死亡症例と急速な増加傾向により、即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国（203312）であり、記事サマリーで主要な発生地として明記されている。PHEIC宣言、24時間で100症例・20死亡の増加、$518M規模の国際対応計画策定など、極めて重大な公衆衛生危機を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: जहां पहले कम जोखिम था, वहां कैसे बढ़ रहे डेंगू के केस? अंबाला में ये कैसी आफत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where there was initially low risk, how are dengue cases increasing there? What kind of calamity is this in Ambala?
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever risk is rising in Ambala, India, as climate change and higher temperatures extend transmission into the summer. Dengue is no longer just a monsoon threat; with changing weather, cases may appear during hotter months. Health authorities urge vigilance from May through September and emphasize clean surroundings. Dr. Sunil Hari of Ambala notes increased mosquito breeding due to rain and humidity and that climate change and rising temperatures have escalated risk, now affecting previously low-risk areas. The health department has prepared teams to inspect water at homes and run awareness campaigns. Early dengue symptoms are often mistaken for viral fever: severe abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, breathing difficulties, bleeding gums or nose, blood in urine or stool, weakness. Preventive measures include wearing long sleeves, using repellents, and securing doors and windows; a weekly “Dry Day” to empty standing water.

triage.headline_ja: 以前はリスクが低かった場所で、どのようにデング熱の患者数が増えているのか？アンバラではこのような災厄がどのように起きているのか？
triage.triage_reason: インドのアンバラ地域におけるデング熱の季節外の発生と気候変動との関連が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、流行しやすさ）に該当するが、現在の重症度や国際的拡大リスクの具体的情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動により季節外れの時期（夏季）にデング熱が発生している異常現象を報告している。アンバラはこれまで低リスク地域だったが、降雨と湿度増加により蚊の増殖が加速し、新たに罹患者が出現している。死亡数や重症者数など具体的な重症度情報が記事サマリーに含まれておらず、現段階ではWATCH段階の継続観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikansk læge udskrevet fra tysk hospital efter ebolasmitte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor discharged from German hospital after Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: An American physician treated in Berlin after contracting Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been discharged from Charité University Hospital after two weeks of hospitalization. DR Congo currently faces an Ebola outbreak. The patient, who worked in DR Congo, was reported by DPA; as of May 22 he was not critically ill and his family tested negative. He has tested negative for Ebola since May 30. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in DR Congo and is believed to have spread from bats. Discharge followed two weeks of hospitalization in Berlin.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染後、アメリカ人医師がドイツ病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性の懸念あり。エボラウイルス疾患という高危険病原体の国際的ケースであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはベルリン・ドイツ・米国が含まれるが、実際のエボラ感染発生地はDRC（患者がDRCで感染）。患者はドイツで治療・退院したが、この記事の主題は『DRCで流行中のエボラアウトブレイク』であり、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。高危険病原体（CBRN関連）、複数国にまたがる国際的ケース、死亡リスク、渡航懸念のため PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Dagboek van een Belgische arts in ebola-gebied: 'Elke dag ontdekken we meer en meer hoe diepgeworteld de epidemie is'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diary of a Belgian doctor in the Ebola-affected region: "Every day we discover more and more how deeply rooted the epidemic is."
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, Ebola virus disease is ongoing in Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, linked to the Bundibugyo variant. A Belgian doctor notes flight disruptions from Kinshasa and reliance on UN airlifts. Diagnosis uses GeneXpert PCR, but no cassettes exist for this variant, delaying testing. Contact tracing is severely limited; few contacts are followed for 21 days and quarantines are not widely accepted, leaving many cases with no clear epidemiological links. Inpatient care occurs in the red zone with PPE, while Ebola cubes—transparent-walled treatment units with built-in arms—are planned to restore patient-family contact. Community outreach has reduced conspiracy theories. Two variant-specific vaccine candidates exist but are not yet approved: an Oxford vaccine could be ready in 2–3 months, a U.S. candidate in about six months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱地域に派遣されたベルギー人医師の日記：「毎日、この感染症がいかに深く根付いているかをますます発見している」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）がDRC東部で継続的に拡大中であり、IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、Bundibugyo株という異常な変異株、国際的拡大リスク）。接触者追跡の崩壊、治療能力不足、ワクチン未承認等の管理上の課題が明らかであり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異株は稀であり、既存GeneXpert PCR検査キットが使用不可という診断上の重大な制約がある。接触者追跡機能の著しい低下、コミュニティレジスタンス、および2−6ヶ月のワクチン開発予定は緊急の国際支援ニーズを示唆している。ベルギー医師の現地日記形式の報告は国際的関心も示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 5 things to know about the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, Mongbwalu) with spread into Uganda; hundreds of cases and dozens of deaths; at least 60 fatalities by late May. The Bundibugyo strain, not Zaire, underlies the outbreak; initial cases likely starting as early as February; delays in recognizing and linking cases worsened spread. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17; CDC modeling warns the outbreak could surpass 2014–16 West Africa with rapid case identification and isolation. Transmission requires close contact with very ill patients; PPE helps, but remote, resource-limited settings hinder care and contact tracing; WHO aims to reach >90% of contacts, but less than half have been reached. Most patients are women aged 20–39. One American, Dr. Peter Stafford, is infected and being treated in Germany; the US is establishing a facility in Kenya for exposed individuals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行について知るべき5つのこと
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の複数国での流行により、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。DRCはWPRO対象国。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州モングワル地区でのエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの拡大、米国人医師の感染も言及されているが、これらは二次的な情報。WPRO対象国のうちDRCのみが実際の発生地として確認される。WHOは2026年5月17日に国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。推定100人以上の死亡例あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola no Congo pode ser um dos maiores surtos da história, alerta CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo could be one of the largest outbreaks in history, CDC warns.
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak in Ituri's Mongbwalu has 452 lab-confirmed cases and 82 deaths, with 71 new infections and 21 new deaths recorded in a single day. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is driving transmission, with community spread likely before alert; symptom onset occurred May 14–23, and a second surge May 25–June 3. The outbreak spans more than two dozen health zones across three eastern provinces and has reached Uganda, with 19 cases. A new diagnostic lab in Mongbwalu improves testing timeliness, and about 4,800 people are under monitoring; contact tracing rose from 46% to 58%. WHO and Africa CDC launched a continental plan, seeking $319 million by November; total needs pegged at $518 million. No licensed vaccine or approved therapy for Bundibugyo yet; vaccines and experimental treatments are under development. Attacks on volunteers during safe-burial operations in Bunia threaten response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラは過去最大級のアウトブレイクになる可能性があると、CDCが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の確認例、複数国への拡大、高い致死率、国際的な支援要請が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（Uganda）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは二次的な拡大として記載されており、主要な発生地はDRC（Ituri州Mongbwalu）である。WPROスクリーニング対象国にウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。CDCおよびWHO、Africa CDCが警告・対応計画を発表しており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikansk læge udskrevet fra tysk hospital efter ebolasmitte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor discharged from German hospital after Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been discharged from Charité University Hospital in Berlin, Germany. The patient, a U.S. citizen, was hospitalized in Berlin after contracting the deadly virus in DR Congo. The discharge occurred on a Saturday, according to the report. The article identifies the infection source as DR Congo but provides limited information on clinical details such as symptoms, treatment, or laboratory confirmation. No broader outbreak context or numbers are included in the excerpt. As of 2026-06-06, this appears to be a solitary recovered case from Germany reported in the piece, with no mention of additional infections or export of cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染後、ドイツの病院からアメリカ人医師が退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）してWPRO基準も満たすが、対象国（DRC）での発生であり、単一症例で既に回復しているため情報不足で慎重な評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでの感染ですが、治療はドイツで行われ患者は既に退院している。単一症例で二次感染の報告なし。症状や臨床経過の詳細情報が不足している。エボラウイルスの国際移動を示す事象として異常性と国際拡大リスクは確認されるが、公衆衛生への深刻な影響はまだ評価できない段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola xəbərdarlığı: Yeni epidemiya tarixin ən ölümcül mərhələsinə çata bilər
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola warning: The new epidemic could reach the deadliest phase in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa could reach tens of thousands of infections in coming months, with fatalities potentially rivaling the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that killed over 11,000. As of 2026-06-06, hundreds of confirmed infections and dozens of deaths have been reported, though many cases likely go unreported. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is circulating and there is no approved vaccine or treatment. The World Health Organization has declared a global health emergency. Ongoing armed conflict between government forces and rebels in the Congo hampers access for health workers to high-risk areas, and hundreds of thousands have been displaced, raising the risk of wider spread. Early detection and isolation of at least half of cases could dramatically slow transmission, but regional instability challenges such measures. Without swift international action, Ebola could become a global threat.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警告：新たな流行は歴史上最も致命的な段階に達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス感染症による大規模流行の可能性があり、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言している。国際的な支援が必要な重大な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確にDRCでのエボラ流行について述べられている。アンゴラは発生地域に列挙されているが、サマリーではDRCの紛争状況が中心的な懸念事項として説明されており、DRCの確認症例・死亡例が報告されている。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言済み。2014-2016年西アフリカエボラ流行（11,000人以上の死亡）の規模に匹敵する可能性が指摘されており、国際的脅威度が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: US warns Ebola outbreak could rival 2014 West Africa epidemic
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-06, the US CDC warned that the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, could become one of history’s largest if public health measures are not rapidly strengthened. Declared in northeastern DR Congo on May 15, the outbreak centers on Ituri Province, with WHO reporting 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in DR Congo, while neighboring Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. CDC modelling suggests the outbreak could reach scales comparable to the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths). Director Jason Asher cautioned that “that scale is possible.” Under scenarios with limited case identification and isolation, there is a 65% chance of exceeding 20,000 cases within three months. The projections are planning tools, and the public health response may need to be of similar magnitude to the West Africa effort.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の流行が2014年西アフリカ流行に匹敵する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、複数国への国際的拡大、歴史的規模への発展の可能性があり、フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRコンゴ、ウガンダ、米国が記載されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に匹敵する規模への発展可能性が指摘されている。3ヶ月以内に20,000例を超える確率65%との予測モデルあり。複数国への拡大と国際的な公衆衛生対応が必要な緊急事象。

article.articleHeadline: Hospitais da RDC pressionados devido ao surto de Ébola - O País - A verdade como notícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospitals in the DRC under pressure due to the Ebola outbreak - O País - The truth as news
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak tests the Congolese health system. In Bunia, the city concentrating most cases, a major health facility is overwhelmed as demand for care rises. Since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has recorded 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths, with 71 new cases confirmed in the past 24 hours, signaling persistent intense community transmission. The outbreak is centered in Ituri province but has spread to other eastern regions. Health authorities face shortages of medicines, insufficient treatment centers, and challenges in contact tracing. International support is mobilizing: the World Health Organization and the Africa CDC launched a response plan valued at $518 million to back outbreak response, strengthen surveillance, and prepare neighboring countries for potential cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: RDCの病院がエボラ流行により圧迫状態にある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。活動的なコミュニティ伝播、482確認患者82死亡、医療機関の過負荷、隣国への越境拡大リスク、および$518百万の国際支援動員。
triage.notes: Ituri州のBuniaを中心に5月中旬宣言以来の大規模流行。直近24時間で71新規症例、継続的な激しいコミュニティ伝播を示唆。医薬品不足、接触者追跡の課題あり。WHO・アフリカCDCが$518百万規模の対応計画を展開中。隣国への越境リスクは記事サマリーで明示されており、国際支援動員中。

article.articleHeadline: Près de 500 cas d'infection au virus Ebola confirmés en Afrique centrale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 500 cases of Ebola virus infection confirmed in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in Central Africa reaches nearly 500 confirmed cases as of June 6, 2026, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo reporting 452 cases and 82 deaths, and Uganda reporting 19 cases and 2 deaths. The combined total stands at 471 cases and 84 deaths, up by 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO and is unfolding three weeks after detection. In response, the WHO and Africa CDC launched a six‑month plan totaling $518 million (about €446 million) to strengthen surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that transmission is accelerating and emphasized stopping the outbreak where it is while ensuring neighboring countries are ready to detect and act quickly if cases appear.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカでエボラウイルス感染が約500例確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの国際的な多国間爆発が確認され、WHOが国際的懸念事項としての公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーでは「19例、2死亡」の報告のみで対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCのみが対象国（203312）として verified_locations に含められる。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、6ヶ月5.18億ドルの対応計画策定、複数国への伝播リスク、日増200例以上の急速な増加傾向など、極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の危機。
