article.articleHeadline: WHO：中非伊波拉疫情擴大「確診已逼近500例」 恐釀大流行破萬人喪生
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa widens; "confirmed cases near 500" could trigger a pandemic, with death toll exceeding 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the WHO reports 471 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 84 deaths in Central Africa, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) accounting for 452 cases and 82 deaths, and Uganda reporting 19 cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak, declared about three weeks ago, has led WHO to raise the region's risk to the highest level, warning it could become the largest Ebola outbreak to date. U.S. CDC modeling suggests that without strong public health interventions, the outbreak could resemble the 2014 West Africa epidemic, potentially exceeding 28,000 infections and 11,000 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the spread is rapid and we are behind; he urges local containment, sustained international support, and preparedness in neighboring countries for immediate detection and response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：中非伊波拉疫情擴大「確診已逼近500例」 恐釀大流行破萬人喪生
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行でIHR基準4つ全て該当。DRC及びウガンダで471例の確定患者、84人の死亡が報告され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCで452例、ウガンダで19例が報告されている。ウガンダ（対象国リストに未含）は検出されたが、サマリーの主題はDRCの流行である。米国はCDCのモデリング提供者として言及されているが、実際の発生地ではない。WHOの警告により国際支援の必要性が明確である。

article.articleHeadline: निजी अस्पताल में भर्ती तीन बच्चों में हेपेटाइटिस-ए की पुष्टि
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis A confirmed in three children admitted to a private hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, Hepatitis A has been confirmed in three children admitted to a private hospital in Nayagaon, Sitarganj. Rapid Response Team testing indicates more than 20 children with liver enlargement and related symptoms. Water samples from six households have been collected for laboratory testing as authorities monitor Nayagaon and surrounding areas for viral hepatitis activity. A teenager with jaundice died in Delhi during treatment. Health authorities have intensified surveillance, testing, and case management to identify sources and contain possible spread.

triage.headline_ja: 私立病院に入院した3人の子どもでA型肝炎が確認された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の「重症度」「異常性」に該当し、複数州での集団発生と死亡例が報告されている。スクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが該当し、社会的関心も高い状況。
triage.notes: 複数の州（ウッタラーカンド州のシターガンジ、デリー）での同時発生報告。20人以上の肝腫大症例、死亡例（デリー）を含む。水源汚染の可能性が示唆されており、人-人感染も懸念される。継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US doctor treated for Ebola discharged from Berlin hospital
article.articleSummary: Two weeks after admission, a US doctor treated for Ebola in Berlin's Charité hospital was discharged on Saturday, having contracted Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He tested negative for the virus since May 30; isolation was lifted midday per international guidelines. The patient arrived Berlin May 20; treated in a dedicated isolation unit; his wife and four children, designated high-risk contacts, quarantined separately but asymptomatic. The doctor, who flew from Uganda to Berlin, received antiviral therapy and experimental therapeutics under evaluation; he expressed gratitude. The outbreak remains ongoing in Congo and Uganda: Congo reports 381 confirmed cases with 62 deaths (Africa CDC); Uganda reports 16 cases, 1 death. WHO notes difficulties isolating and monitoring contacts; only about 45% traced versus the 90% target. Bundibugyo has no vaccine or specific treatment currently. Past Ebola outbreaks in West Africa (2014–2015) killed about 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の医師がベルリンの病院からエボラ出血熱の治療後に退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo型）の多国間での発生。IHR基準では深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクのいずれかに該当。WPRO基準では重症度（死亡例あり）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染、接触者追跡不十分）、管理可能性（WHO対応、国際支援）の複数基準に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、Bundibugyo Ebola virusの発生地はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダ。コンゴ民主共和国のみが対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsはコンゴ民主共和国のみ。ベルリン・ドイツはセカンダリ・ロケーション（患者の治療地）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。381確認症例62死亡（コンゴ）、16症例1死亡（ウガンダ）。接触者追跡45%（目標90%未達）により管理困難を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Niemcy. Pacjent leczony na ebolę opuścił szpital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany. A patient treated for Ebola left the hospital.
article.articleSummary: Germany: A 39-year-old American physician contracted Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo while working for the Serge missionary organization. Treated at Charité hospital in Berlin, he and his five-member family were placed in isolation; his wife and four children were quarantined but later showed no symptoms and were not infected. He was admitted on May 20 to a dedicated isolation unit; while he presented with symptoms, they gradually subsided and his viral load declined. By May 30 no virus was detected, and the isolation order was lifted by Saturday noon. The patient was discharged in good health, with hospital officials praising the high level of care. The eastern DRC Ebola outbreak began about a month earlier, with hundreds of cases and dozens of deaths, underscoring ongoing public health risk and the international response to imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ。エボラウイルスで治療を受けた患者が病院を退院した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの国際的な事例報告であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはベルリンでの患者退院について述べているが、エボラウイルス感染の本来の発生地はDRCであり、国際的には継続中のDRC東部の流行の文脈における輸入事例として位置づけられている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ドイツは対象国ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲伊波拉疫情升溫！WHO：確診逼近500例 CDC警告最糟恐逾2萬人染疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Ebola outbreak intensifies! WHO: confirmed cases nearing 500; CDC warns the worst could exceed 20,000 infections.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak intensifies in Central Africa. Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) reports 452 cases and 82 deaths; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. Combined, 471 cases and 84 deaths across both countries, with transmission quickly expanding to multiple health zones in Ituri. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus. On May 17, WHO designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), though it is not yet a pandemic-level emergency. CDC models warn that, without rapid, sustained public health interventions, total cases could exceed 20,000 and deaths surpass 4,000 within three months, potentially approaching the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,000 infections, >11,000 deaths). Effective control relies on early detection, isolation, and breaking transmission chains. The United States currently has no cases; risk remains low, but vigilance for imported/exported cases remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ疫情が加速！WHO：確認症例が500例に迫る；CDCは最悪の場合2万人以上の感染を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo種）による多国間での急速な感染拡大、高い死亡率、国際的な緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）指定、および大規模流行の可能性から、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaおよびAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーで明示的に患者報告があるのはDRC（Ituri州）とUgandaのみ。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのため、verified_locationsに記載。WHOがPHEIC指定（2026年5月17日）し、Bundibugyo Ebola virusによる急速な拡大、CDCの悲観的シナリオモデル（3ヶ月以内に20,000症例超、4,000死亡超の可能性）が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻度と国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Charité in Berlin: Ebola-Patient gesund entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Charité in Berlin: Ebola patient discharged healthy.
article.articleSummary: US citizen Ebola patient exported to Germany after contracting Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Admitted May 20 to Berlin’s Charité; PCR-confirmed Bundibugyo virus with initial high viral load and Ebola-like symptoms. Under a combination antiviral therapy and supportive care, clinical signs markedly improved within the first week; no virus detected since May 30. Isolation lifted at 12:00 by the local health department; patient treated in a high-security isolation ward on Charité’s Virchow Campus, having arrived in Berlin from Uganda on a special flight. Hospital expresses gratitude to the care team; officials say there is no risk to the public. Ongoing outbreak context: 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; 16 cases and 1 death in Uganda. WHO notes likely under-counting; Bundibugyo type currently lacks a vaccine and specific therapy.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンのシャリテ病院：エボラウイルス患者が回復して退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。輸入エボラ症例は各基準を満たし、確定診断、回復経過良好だが国際的波及リスク認識が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的検証：DRCでのBundibugyo Ebola virus流行が主題（381確定症例、62死亡）。患者はDRCで感染後、ウガンダ経由でドイツに空路搬出。ベルリンでの隔離治療は二次的な事象。対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダは対象外、ドイツ・米国も対象外。ウイルス型はワクチン・特異的治療欠如。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo eleva a 452 los casos confirmados de ébola y alerta rápida propagación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo raises the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 452 and warns of rapid spread.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths as of 6 June 2026, with 71 new infections in 24 hours. Ituri bears the majority (65 cases in a day); North Kivu adds 6 and South Kivu 1. Cases have been detected across 17 health zones in Ituri, 7 in North Kivu, and 1 in South Kivu, with linked cases in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, a less common Ebola strain with no vaccines or approved treatments. WHO and Africa CDC launched a regional response plan worth US$518 million for six months to contain transmission, strengthen surveillance, and prepare neighboring countries. Violence and armed conflict hinder containment, complicating contact tracing and patient isolation; Uganda temporarily closed a border crossing, affecting cross-border movement. This is among the most significant Ebola outbreaks in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ確定患者数を452人に増加と報告、急速な感染拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。452例の確定患者、82名の死亡、24時間で71例の新規感染、国境越えの事例、ウガンダでも感染を検出。Bundibugyo株でワクチン・承認治療薬なし。WHO・Africa CDCが5億1800万米ドルの地域対応計画を立案。
triage.notes: 2026年6月6日時点の情報。Bundibugyo株（ワクチン・承認治療なし）による大規模エボラ流行。武装勢力による暴力により感染対策が阻害され、ウガンダで国境検問所が一時閉鎖。DRC史上最大級の流行の一つ。

article.articleHeadline: UAE travel advisory raises questions for Kenyan travellers amid Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: UAE tightens travel advisories over Ebola outbreaks in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and South Sudan. Effective 6 June 2026, entry is suspended for travellers arriving directly or indirectly from these countries or with travel histories linked to them; cargo and transit operations remain open. A 21-day clearance rule requires visitors who have recently been in the affected states to stay outside the region for 21 consecutive days before entering the UAE. Indirectly, Kenyan travellers may face delays or enhanced screening due to regional movement and transit through East Africa, with Nairobi serving as a key connecting hub. Kenya reports no confirmed Ebola cases; surveillance and screening are ongoing at Eldoret International Airport and border crossings Malaba and Busia, with expanded labs in Nairobi and Kisumu. Separately, the United States is considering a controlled medical unit at Laikipia airbase in Kenya, drawing concerns about international travel restrictions tied to outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: UAE travel advisory raises questions for Kenyan travellers amid Ebola concerns
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の複数国での流行（ウガンダ、DRC、南スーダン）に対するUAEの渡航制限措置であり、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」および「渡航・貿易制限リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」および「管理可能性」も満たす。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した「発生地域」にはケニアの複数地点（ナイロビ、キスム、エルドレット等）が含まれているが、記事サマリーでケニアは「確認事例なし」と明示されており、主要な流行地はウガンダ、DRC、南スーダンである。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダ（対象国でない）での流行も記事に言及されているが、GeoNames IDリストに含まれないため除外。本イベントはIHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected gastroenteritis kills 53-year-old in Mizoram's Lawngtlai
article.articleSummary: Localized outbreak of suspected gastroenteritis in Darnamtlang village, Lawngtlai district, Mizoram, as of June 2026. A 53-year-old man died and seven others fell ill; four patients were admitted to Bungtlang South Primary Health Centre. Cholera was initially suspected but ruled out due to symptom profile. A district medical team led by a medical officer dispatched to the village; medicines sent and samples sent to a laboratory in Aizawl for confirmation. Health officials maintain surveillance to prevent further spread; residents urged not to panic. Darnamtlang comprises about 115 households with around 540 residents. The response underscores local containment efforts amid prior regional cholera activity along border areas with Myanmar, with past outbreaks prompting heightened vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ミゾラム州ローンタライにおける疑い胃腸炎で53歳男性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 局地的な疑い胃腸炎アウトブレイク（死亡1名、患者7名）が報告されており、コレラは除外されたが地域的な疫学背景があるため、病原体確定と地域拡大リスクの経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは疑い胃腸炎とされ、コレラは症状プロフィールに基づき除外されたが、地域のコレラ活動歴（ミャンマー境界地域での過去アウトブレイク）があり、サンプル確認待ちの段階。IHR基準2つ以上該当するが、確定病原体が決定されていないため、病原体確定と地域拡大リスク評価のため経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: A park famed for rare gorillas gears up to fight Ebola and protect its primates
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo threatens Virunga National Park, a 2 million-acre reserve along the Uganda border, where rangers guard gorillas amid violence and a spreading epidemic. The outbreak has no vaccine for the circulating strain. Virunga and nearby Okapi Wildlife Reserve act as natural barriers to movement toward East Africa and Kinshasa, prompting five screening posts on roads leaving the affected area. Each post costs about $44,000 and includes a diagnosis room, analysis and isolation facilities, reliable internet, and space for 30 staff (two-thirds security and eight paramedics) to manage crowds and trace travelers. The park funds the effort amid a drastic drop in aid; US assistance fell from $1.4B in 2024 to just over $400M in 2025. North Kivu health services report limited resources; two body bags were reported, with 100 delivered in 48 hours and 1,000 more arriving subsequently.

triage.headline_ja: レアゴリラで有名な公園がエボラ出血熱と闘い、霊長類を保護する準備を整える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のDRC発生は IHR基準4項目全て該当し、また WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が認められるため、フルRRA対象のシグナルと判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのエボラ出血熱発生を主題としており、ウガンダとモザンビークは国際拡大リスクの文脈でのみ言及されているため verified_locations に含めていない。ワクチンがない流行株、資金不足、保健資源の限定が懸念要因。国立公園での野生動物保護と人間の公衆衛生が交錯する複雑な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Ebola di Afrika Tengah Tembus 471, WHO Waspada Ledakan Wabah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Central Africa reach 471, WHO warns of outbreak surge.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in Central Africa near 471 confirmed; Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 452 confirmed cases with 82 deaths, outbreak first announced three weeks ago; Uganda has 19 confirmed cases with 2 deaths. Combined totals: 471 cases and 84 deaths, up sharply from the previous day with about 100 new cases and 20 additional deaths. The outbreak centers in eastern Congo, with the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, a rare strain for which there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO and Africa CDC launched a US$518 million funding plan for six months to bolster surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention and control measures. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the spread is rapid and called for stopping transmission at the source while helping neighbors improve readiness. The World Health Organization had previously declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ中部のエボラ患者数が471人に到達、WHOが感染爆発を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、WPRO基準でも5項目全て該当。WHOが既に国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが明示的にDRCとウガンダの患者数を報告しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみ記載。既にWHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant（稀株）は承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、極めて高いリスク。6か月間で5億1800万ドルの資金計画が発表されており、国際的対応が急速に進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient geheilt - Arzt darf Klinik verlassen | Heute.at
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient cured - doctor may leave the hospital | Heute.at.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Bundibugyo virus, a form of Ebola, while working in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has recovered and left Berlin's Charité hospital. Admitted May 20, he tested positive for Bundibugyo virus by PCR; by May 30 no virus was detectable. The isolation order on a dedicated Charité Virchow-Klinikum unit was lifted on June 6 at 12:00. He was transported from Uganda by a special aircraft to Berlin and received a combination antiviral therapy with experimental treatments, with symptoms improving in the first week and laboratory values normalizing. His wife and four children, designated high-risk contacts, followed to Berlin and are in quarantine in a separate ward. The Congo outbreak remains far from under control: 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths; Uganda reports 16 cases and 1 death, with only 45% of contacts traced, while 90% are needed to halt spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が治癒 - 医師は病院を退院できる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus）の確定患者が複数国で報告されており、IHR基準2つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでは381確定症例、ウガンダでは16症例と継続中の流行が確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事に言及されているが、WPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。本件は継続中の大規模エボラ流行（DRC 381確定症例）の一部であり、国際患者輸送と医療介入の事例。DRC での流行制御が不十分（接触者追跡率45%）である点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Бизнес-саммит Африка - США перенесли из-за эпидемии лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa-US Business Summit postponed due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda leads to postponement of the Africa-US Business Summit. Mauritius announced that the U.S.-Africa Business Summit, planned for July 26–29 and expected to involve about 3,000 leaders, will be rescheduled due to sanitary risks linked to the outbreak. WHO advised Port Louis to consider delaying and highlighted risk from developments in parts of Africa; the Seychelles-hosted SADC Parliamentary Assembly will also be held via videoconference for the same reason. The DRC and Uganda first declared the outbreak on May 15. On June 5, the African Union Health Service said this outbreak ranks fourth in scale and severity since 1976. WHO confirms 452 Ebola cases and 82 deaths. The report notes public health concerns affecting major international meetings and regional cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ・米国ビジネスサミット、エボラ出血熱の流行により延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、国際イベント延期の政治的影響により社会的関心が高い。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラウイルス病の発生地はDRC及びウガンダである。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。Port Louis（モーリシャス）、セーシェルは発生地ではなく、国際イベント開催予定地または影響地域であるため除外。452症例、82死亡が確認され、1976年以来4番目の規模と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: LIVE Amerikaanse dokter mag ziekenhuis in Berlijn verlaten, al 500 bevestigde gevallen van ebola in Centraal-Afrika | VRT NWS Nieuws
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LIVE: American doctor may leave hospital in Berlin, already 500 confirmed cases of Ebola in Central Africa | VRT NWS News
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus drives a current outbreak in Central Africa, with no vaccine or approved treatment yet. The World Health Organization (WHO) highlights three promising treatment options: monoclonal antibodies MBP134 and Maftivimab, and the antiviral remdesivir (potentially in combination). For post-exposure prevention, obeldesivir is proposed for contacts of suspected or confirmed cases, contingent on effective contact tracing, which remains challenging in parts of the Congo. On vaccination, the rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine (developed by IAVI) could enter clinical testing in 7–9 months; another candidate, ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford University and Serum Institute of India), shows potential. Ervebo, approved for the Zaïre strain, is not licensed for Bundibugyo and cross-protection evidence is lacking. The WHO deems these options sufficiently promising to justify accelerated evaluation in clinical trials as part of an epidemic-response program.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人医師がベルリンの病院を退院できる見通し、中央アフリカではすでにエボラ500例確認
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルスによる中央アフリカでの流行（500例以上確認）は、IHR基準「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、未承認株での治療法不足とワクチン開発遅延という管理可能性の課題があるため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo Ebolaの中央アフリカ流行（特にコンゴ）での治療・予防・ワクチン開発状況を述べている。WHO治療オプション検討中だが、承認治療法なく、接触者追跡が課題。ベルリンの医師事例は国際的なケース転出を示唆し、国際的拡大リスクを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Second Sudanese patient tests negative for Ebola at Gandhi Hospital
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, Gandhi Hospital in Hyderabad is managing three suspected Ebola cases. Two have tested negative, while results for the remaining patient are pending. The Sudanese student admitted to the hospital’s Ebola isolation ward had been referred from Apollo Hospitals Nanakramguda after fever developed during care for a suspected yellow fever case; he tested negative for Ebola on Saturday. The first Sudanese passenger, who arrived at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport on Thursday, presented with mild fever detected by thermal scanners. Tests for one more suspected Ebola patient are expected in a day or two, and hospital authorities expect discharge of the already-cleared patient soon. No deaths reported; ongoing observation in the context of potential imported Ebola concerns in Hyderabad.

triage.headline_ja: ガンジー病院での第2番目のスーダン人患者、エボラ検査陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ・黄熱の疑い患者が検出されたが、検査陰性が確認されており、死亡・重症例なし。国際輸入リスクは認識されているが、現時点での確定例なし。情報の確定を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: スーダン発生地域が含まれているが、記事の主題はインドのハイデラバードで検出された患者管理であり、スーダンでの発生は不明。エボラ・黄熱の疑い患者が複数検出されたが、既に検査陰性が確認されている。残る1名の患者の検査結果待ち。国際輸入リスクは存在するが、現在のところ疑い例のみで確定例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Nearly 500 Confirmed Cases In Central Africa Ebola Outbreak -- WHO
article.articleSummary: In central Africa, the Ebola outbreak spans the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The DRC reports 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths; Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Combined totals reach 471 cases and 84 deaths, up 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The outbreak, declared May 15 in northeastern DRC, involves the Bundibugyo Ebola virus lineage, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Transmission occurs mainly via close contact and bodily fluids. The WHO has declared an international public health emergency, with a $518 million, six‑month plan by the WHO and African CDC to boost surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention, and to prepare neighboring countries to detect and respond quickly. U.S. CDC modelling suggests the outbreak could rival the 2014 West Africa epidemic (over 28,000 cases, >11,000 deaths) if interventions are not strengthened.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱の発生でほぼ500例の確認症例 — WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多数の確認症例と死亡、複数国への拡大、WHO による国際保健緊急事態宣言、および西アフリカ2014年流行に匹敵する可能性が報告されており、公衆衛生上の重大な影響と国際的広がりのリスクが明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（対象国）とウガンダでのエボラ発生を明確に記述しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。WHO による国際保健緊急事態宣言、承認済みワクチン・治療法の欠落、過去の大規模流行との比較言及により、シグナルの重要性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: SZO: Do sada potvrđeno skoro 500 slučajeve ebole u Centralnoj Africi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: So far nearly 500 Ebola cases confirmed in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) reports 452 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, including 82 deaths, in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where the outbreak was declared three weeks ago. In neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, with two fatalities. The daily update notes rising concern about the potential scale of the hemorrhagic fever epidemic across Central Africa. The article provides aggregated counts but does not detail symptoms, transmission patterns, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources, nor does it mention imported or exported cases. As of the June 6, 2026 update, the outbreak activity spans DRC and Uganda, underscoring cross-border transmission risk and the need for ongoing surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：中央アフリカでエボラ出血熱の確定症例が約500例報告されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国境を越えた流行（DRC 452例・ウガンダ19例、計471例の確定症例と82死亡）は重大な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを持つ。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーでは隣接国として言及されており、主要な流行地域はDRCであることが明確である。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため検証位置として記載。ウガンダ（1562822に相当しない）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。3週間前に流行宣言、日々増加する懸念が報告されており、継続的なサーベイランスと対応の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Virus Ebola : Près de 500 cas confirmés en Afrique centrale, l'OMS lance un vaste plan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: Nearly 500 confirmed cases in Central Africa, WHO launches a broad plan.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa reaches 471 confirmed cases and 84 deaths as of 2026-06-06. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 452 cases and 82 deaths are recorded; in Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths. This reflects a daily increase of 100 cases and 20 deaths. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with the Africa CDC launching a six-month plan worth $518 million USD (about €446 million) to enhance surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. The epidemic is progressing rapidly and could rival the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak that killed over 11,000 people if strong public health measures are not implemented.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：中央アフリカで約500例の確認症例、WHOが大規模計画を立ち上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模発生（471確認例、84死亡）で、WHOが国際的懸念事項として公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。IHR基準4つ全て該当し、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生国として記事サマリーに記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。348日単位の急速な増加率、過去の大規模流行との比較、WHO/Africa CDCの緊急対応宣言など、全スクリーニング基準が該当し、即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient nach erfolgreicher Behandlung aus Charite entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient discharged from Charité after successful treatment.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus infection caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in a US citizen who contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, treated at Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin. Diagnosis on May 20; admitted to a dedicated isolation ward. Symptoms were severe at onset but reduced significantly within the first week under antiviral therapy and supportive care. By May 30, follow-up tests detected no virus; isolation lifted after more than 72 hours without symptoms and repeated negative PCR tests. The patient was discharged in good health. Five family members, high-risk contacts, were quarantined at Charité; they remained asymptomatic and showed no laboratory evidence of virus. The quarantine for the family ended after 21 days. No secondary transmissions are reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が成功した治療後にシャリテ病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（致死的な感染症）の患者が確認され、IHR Annex2の「異常/予想外」「国際拡大のリスク」を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当するが、すでに患者は完治退院し、二次感染報告がなく、接触者も陰性であるため、現在のアクティブな脅威度は低い。情報が不足している部分も多く、継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCで感染し米国市民。ドイツのシャリテ病院で治療。記事では既に患者は治療完了・退院し、二次感染ゼロと記載されており、現在のリスクは低い。しかし、Bundibugyo ebolavirus確認という点で公衆衛生上の重要なイベント。ドイツ（対象国でないため verified_locations には含めない）での症例確認であるが、感染地がDRCであるため。

article.articleHeadline: WHO opozarja: Izbruh ebole v osrednji Afriki se nevarno stopnjuje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa is escalating dangerously.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa is escalating. As of 6 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda have reported 471 cases and 84 deaths (DRC: 452/82; Uganda: 19/2). The DRC outbreak, officially declared on 15 May, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rarer variant with no licensed vaccine or specific therapy. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the current response lags behind spread and requires rapid, coordinated action by national authorities, international agencies, and humanitarian partners. To bolster control, WHO and the Africa CDC have drafted a six-month plan valued at $518 million, prioritizing epidemiological surveillance, expanded lab capacity, and infection-prevention measures to curb transmission. Some U.S. experts warn the outbreak could become among the worst Ebola epidemics, citing the 2014–2016 West Africa toll of over 11,000 deaths and more than 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警告：中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行が危険な速度で拡大中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱（致命的、ワクチンなし）による急速な流行拡大、複数国への国際的拡大、高死亡率、国際的対応の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク感染症。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）は既知のワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない亜種。DRC発表公式日は2026年5月15日。ウガンダも患者報告があるが、記事の主流行地はDRCであり対象国はDRCのみ。WHO/Africa CDCが518百万米ドルの6ヶ月対応計画を策定。

article.articleHeadline: 美籍男子在剛果染伊波拉病毒　赴德治療後宣告康復出院 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American man who contracted the Ebola virus in Congo, treated in Germany and discharged after being declared recovered.
article.articleSummary: An American man who contracted Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo was treated in Germany and discharged after recovery. After being airlifted to a Frankfurt hospital for specialized care, he underwent weeks of intensive antiviral therapy and supportive treatment. Laboratory tests confirmed the virus was no longer detectable, and health authorities stated he is no longer contagious. Ebola is highly lethal and primarily spread through contact with the blood, secretions, or organs of infected individuals. While vaccines and antiviral drugs exist, outbreaks remain a serious threat in resource-limited settings such as the DRC. The case underscores the effectiveness of modern medical care and international collaboration. The patient’s identity has not been disclosed to protect privacy. The WHO and international partners continue to monitor the Congo outbreak and emphasize cross-border cooperation in outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで感染したアメリカ人男性がエボラウイルスに罹患、ドイツで治療後の回復を宣言して退院
triage.triage_reason: 回復患者の退院報告であり、新規の流行拡大リスクや公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は示唆されていない。DRCでの既知の流行に関連する個別の回復事例に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの感染から治療、回復に至る個別症例の報告。既知の流行地域での患者の良好な転機を述べており、新規のシグナルとしての価値は限定的。Germany（対象国外）での治療対応の有効性を示唆しているが、トリアージの判定には影響しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'daki Ebola Salgını Uganda'ya Sıçradı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo has spread to Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province has spread to Uganda, marking one of the largest outbreaks on record. As of now, at least 60 deaths have been reported; CDC modeling suggests that, without rapid intervention, the outbreak could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,000 cases, 11,000 deaths) and reach 100–200 deaths by late May. The epicenter is Mongbwalu; the first case may date back to February, with early testing misdirected toward the Zaire strain rather than Bundibugyo. Ebola remains highly infectious but typically spreads in advanced disease; most patients are women aged 20–39, with frontline workers and caregivers at greatest risk. Contact tracing is hampered by violence, insecurity, distrust, and displacement. The WHO says global risk is low and pandemic risk near zero, though it declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern around May 17. There is no specific Bundibugyo treatment; supportive care is critical, and two monoclonal antibodies are under investigation; the 2014–2016 Zaire vaccine has limited data on Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染症がウガンダに拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当。エボラ出血熱の国境を越えた拡大、重篤な影響（死亡例60名以上、2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性）、国際的懸念の高さ、WHO緊急事態宣言の発出により、直ちにフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥリ州（Ituri）が主要発生地で、ウガンダへの拡大も報じている。ただし対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。アンゴラはBluedotが抽出したが、サマリー本文に言及なし。ウガンダも含まれるが対象国リストに未含。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、CDC予測では甚大な影響の可能性。接触者追跡が暴力・混乱により阻害されており管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Podaci koje lede krv u žilama: Raste broj zaraženih od EBOLE, oglasila se Svetska zdravstvena organizacija!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Figures that make your blood run cold: The number of people infected with Ebola is rising, the World Health Organization has issued a statement!
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the Ebola outbreak spans the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda. The WHO daily report records 452 laboratory-confirmed cases in the DRC, including 82 deaths, with the outbreak declared three weeks ago in the northeast. Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and two deaths. Overall, 471 people have been infected and 84 have died, up about 100 cases from the prior day. The outbreak has been designated a public health emergency of international concern and risks matching the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed over 11,000. Transmission occurs through close contact and bodily fluids. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak. A $518 million plan by WHO and the African CDC aims to boost surveillance, lab testing, and infection prevention over six months.

triage.headline_ja: あなたの血管を冷やすようなデータ：エボラ感染者数が増加、世界保健機関が声明を発表！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国籍流行で、死亡例を含む重症例が多く、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態が宣言されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダにおけるエボラ流行が報告されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較により重大性が強調されており、WHO・アフリカCDCによる5億1800万ドルの対応計画が示されている。Bundibugyo株による流行で、承認されたワクチン・治療法がない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Traders disrupted as Uganda closes border due to Ebola outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: On 28 May 2026 Uganda closed its western border with the Democratic Republic of the Congo over Ebola fears, disrupting trade at Mpondwe. The Congo outbreak in eastern Ituri province is suspected to have infected over 1,000 people, though confirmed cases are fewer as many victims die outside hospitals. Uganda has confirmed 15 Ebola cases, all linked to the Congo outbreak after Congolese nationals sought treatment in Kampala before detection. Border restrictions permit only emergencies, outbreak response, humanitarian aid, cargo or security movements. Kasese district reports tightened crossings at the border. Mpondwe’s informal exports were valued around $131 million in 2023; traders cite cargo delays and rotting plantains. Bundibugyo-type Ebola remains hard to treat; Kasese’s isolation center can return lab results within six hours, with 41 samples negative. WHO declared PHEIC but discouraged border closures; local task forces plan tighter cargo controls.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがコンゴでのエボラ流行を理由に国境を閉鎖、商人が混乱
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な多国間拡大（DRC-Uganda）で、IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大）。また重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性の課題があり、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのイツリ州での発生が主題であり、ウガンダはDRCからの流入例（15例）を報告。WPRO地域外（アフリカ）だが、エボラVHFは高リスク。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'île Maurice interdit l'entrée aux voyageurs en provenance de la RDC, de l'Ouganda et du Soudan du Sud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Mauritius bans entry for travelers arriving from the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, Mauritius imposed a temporary entry ban on foreign nationals who traveled, transited, or stayed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days, in response to an Ebola outbreak. Mauritian nationals and foreigners with valid work, residence, or occupation permits, or business or student visas will be allowed entry only after a 21-day quarantine on arrival. Mandatory health screenings and risk assessments will be conducted at entry points for travelers from the affected countries, with immediate isolation and clinical evaluation for anyone showing Ebola-compatible symptoms. The Ministry of Health will strengthen active surveillance and contact tracing. The government also proposed postponing the US-Africa Business Summit scheduled for July. The outbreak across the three countries remains a regional public health threat; the WHO has designated it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：モーリシャスがコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの旅行者の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、WHO PHEIC指定、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラアウトブレイクはWPRO基準も全て満たし、国家および国際的な関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラアウトブレイクが発生している主な国はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンとされている。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。モーリシャスは対象国ではなく、他の地域はアウトブレイク発生地ではなく対応側であるため含めない。WHO PHEIC指定により国際的な懸念が最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: German hospital discharges US man cured of Ebola infection
article.articleSummary: 2026-06-06 Berlin - Charité hospital in Berlin discharged a US man who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo after 17 days of antiviral therapy and medical care. The patient, a surgeon for a Christian missionary group in the DRC, and his five family members who had been quarantined are in good health and permitted to leave. This represents an imported Ebola infection to Germany, with the patient and his quarantined relatives returning to normal activities. The report highlights Ebola's high fatality potential but does not mention additional active cases in Germany. No details on laboratory confirmation or symptom specifics are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツの病院がエボラ感染から治癒した米国人を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: 輸入されたエボラ感染症の個別症例（治癒例）であり、現在のドイツでの二次感染リスクや継続的な公衆衛生上の脅威は限定的だが、エボラウイルス感染の国際的移動は注視対象。
triage.notes: 記事は主にドイツ（Berlin）での治癒症例の退院を報じているが、感染源はDRCであり、対象国リストにはドイツが含まれていないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。IHR基準で2項目該当（異常性と国際的移動）するが、既に感染者は治癒し隔離解除されており、ドイツでの継続的なリスクは低い。ただし、エボラ輸入症例は感染症危機管理上の重要な信号であるため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: L'epidemia di Ebola in Africa potrebbe raggiungere i livelli record del 2014: l'analisi dei CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Africa could reach the record levels of 2014: the CDC's analysis.
article.articleSummary: CDC simulations warn that Ebola in Central Africa, centered in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, could reach levels comparable to the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak if large-scale public health interventions are not rapidly implemented. Based on May 24, 2026 death data, scenarios project more than 20,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths within three months with only 20% isolation. With higher isolation, outcomes improve: about 1 in 20 chance of more than 10,000 cases if 70% are isolated, while 70% isolation reduces cases and deaths in many simulations. Spillover likely occurred between mid and late February 2026, weeks before WHO declared the outbreak an international emergency. Africa CDC reports about 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths as of June 5, but true burden may be higher due to underdiagnosis. Uganda reports cases; conflict and access barriers hinder response. Broad public health action is essential to prevent one of Ebola's epidemics.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ流行は2014年の記録的レベルに達する可能性：CDCの分析
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクを示す。CDCの警告に基づく重大な流行シナリオ。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダとアンゴラも列挙されているが、記事サマリーではDRCのイトゥリが主要な流行地であり、ウガンダは二次的な症例報告のみ、アンゴラは記事では言及されていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。CDCのシミュレーションに基づく警告で、急速な対策実施がない場合は2014-2016年西アフリカ流行レベルに達する可能性を示唆。紛争と医療アクセス障害が対応を阻害。

article.articleHeadline: OMS confirma más casos de ébola en África Central en su balance
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirms more Ebola cases in Central Africa in its update.
article.articleSummary: 471 Ebola cases and 84 deaths have been reported in Central Africa. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths are recorded, with the outbreak declared three weeks ago; in Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths have been documented. The totals reflect an increase of 100 cases and 20 deaths since yesterday. The epidemic, declared May 15 in northeastern DRC, is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Ebola spreads by close contact with bodily fluids. WHO and Africa CDC have launched a $518 million, six-month plan focusing on surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. Jason Asher of the CDC warned that the level could be matched if public health measures are not intensified. Officials warn the outbreak could rival the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which claimed more than 11,000 lives; rapid action is urged.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、中部アフリカでのエボラ出血熱の追加症例を確認、最新情報を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目全てに該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模発生で社会的・政治的関心が非常に高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、アンゴラが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダはUgandaで対象国に含まれず、アンゴラも対象国に含まれない。471症例、84死亡、致命率約18%という深刻な状況。ワクチンなし、2014-2016西アフリカ流行との比較により極めて高リスク。WHO・Africa CDCによる5.18億ドル支援計画が立案されており、国際的対応が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）和乌干达累计报告471例埃博拉病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Congo (Kinshasa) and Uganda have cumulatively reported 471 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports a cumulative 471 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) and Uganda, with 84 deaths. In the past day, about 100 new cases and 20 deaths were recorded, signaling rapid spread and drawing international concern. To curb transmission, WHO and the Africa CDC have jointly launched an emergency response plan worth $518 million over six months, prioritizing enhanced outbreak surveillance, expanded laboratory testing, and strengthened infection prevention and control measures. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the outbreak is spreading quickly and urged faster, more effective action to assist affected countries and bolster prevention in neighboring regions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ（金）とウガンダが累計471例のエボラ病例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準もすべて満たす。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生脅威であり、国際的な懸念と対応が発生している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は重大感染症であり、記事サマリーに基づきDRC（コンゴ金）とウガンダで471例、84死亡が報告されている。1日当たり約100例の新規症例と20死亡が記録されており、急速な拡大を示唆している。WHO事務局長からの警告と5億1800万米ドルの緊急対応計画の立ち上げが報道されており、国際的関心と支援が高い。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないが、DRCとの共同での区域内重要イベントとして評価。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲伊波拉疫情扩散 约5000名密切接触者受监测
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in Africa; about 5,000 close contacts under surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa continues to spread, with about 5,000 people who had close contact with patients under surveillance, and 11 countries deemed high-risk. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC are jointly rolling out outbreak-control measures to help affected nations strengthen surveillance, laboratory testing, and response capacity, aiming to raise $518 million between June and November 2026 to fund rapid testing and preparedness. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated that containment depends on political commitment, sustained funding, and trusted community engagement. In Congo's Bunia, the health system is under heavy strain as workers expand facilities and a newly opened treatment center nearly doubles bed capacity to handle rising patient numbers. Satellite imagery also shows Kenya: despite a court ruling halting a US isolation facility plan, construction proceeds, while US public health experts urge repatriating infected citizens for treatment; the United States has 13 facilities ready to treat Ebola patients.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行が拡大、約5000人の濃厚接触者が監視対象
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。多国間での急速な拡大、11カ国が高リスク評価、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡散リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 複数国での拡大が言及されているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国（ブニア）でのエボラ流行。ケニア・米国はエボラ対応施設に関連するが、実際の発生地ではない。対象国内での実際の発生はDRC確認のみ。WHO及びアフリカCDCの公式対応発表であり、社会政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում էբոլա վիրուսով վարակման ավելի քան 450 դեպք է հաստատվել
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, more than 450 cases of Ebola virus infection have been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 452 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 82 deaths, per the National Institute of Public Health. The eastern Ituri province is the epicenter, with spread subsequently to North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Cross-border transmission has reached Uganda, where 19 cases have been confirmed, including 2 deaths. Congolese authorities warn of rapid and sustained spread within the country. The figures reflect laboratory-confirmed infections used to monitor the evolving outbreak and response needs. The report provides no details on symptom profiles, vaccination status, or infection sources, but underscores ongoing regional transmission and the need for heightened surveillance and cross-border public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルス感染の450例以上が確認された
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い死亡率を有する感染症であり、452例の確認患者と82人の死亡が報告されている。国際的な越境感染（ウガンダでの症例確認）と国内の複数地域への拡大が示唆されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する緊急シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国内での発生が主題であり、South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu各州での症例報告が確認されている。ウガンダでの越境感染も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙した。WHO通知基準を著しく超える事例であり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Research Reveals Maternal-Fetal TORCH Infection Risks
article.articleSummary: TORCH surveillance in North India analyzed lab records of individuals tested for TORCH pathogens from 2019–2025 at a tertiary care hospital. The TORCH complex—toxoplasmosis, rubella, CMV, herpes simplex—can cause mild maternal illness but fetal consequences such as stillbirth, birth defects, or lifelong disability. CMV exposure remained constant, signaling persistent community circulation. Rubella immunity was consistently high, consistent with vaccination impact, though some individuals remained susceptible. Toxoplasmosis susceptibility persisted, highlighting preventive measures like safe food handling and cat litter hygiene. The findings argue against a one-size-fits-all TORCH testing approach and support sustained surveillance, targeted public health education, and region-specific screening. Limitations include a single-center retrospective design; larger multicenter studies are needed to assess regional variations. Findings were presented at ASM Microbe 2026 in Washington, D.C.

triage.headline_ja: 母体-胎児TORCH感染リスクに関する研究
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は北インドの医療機関における過去6年間の後向き研究結果の発表であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、疫学的な監視データの分析である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当がなく、公衆衛生危機を示すシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事はASM Microbe 2026学会での研究発表の紹介であり、単一施設の後向き研究データに基づく監視分析である。新規アウトブレイク、異常な増加、緊急の公衆衛生対応を要するシグナルは認められない。ワシントンD.C.は学会開催地であり、感染症発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: СВЕТ НА НОГАМА, УПАЉЕН ЦРВЕНИ АЛАРМ: Расте број заражених од Еболе - Хитно оглашавање СЗО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World on Its Feet, Red Alert Triggered: The Number of Ebola Infections Is Rising — Urgent WHO Announcement
article.articleSummary: Central Africa’s Ebola outbreak worsens. As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports 471 total infections and 84 deaths, up 100 cases from the previous day. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, with the northeast outbreak declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 15. Neighboring Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and two deaths. The epidemic is driven by the Bundibugyo virus lineage, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. The surge raises fears it could rival the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed over 11,000. A joint WHO and Africa CDC plan of $518 million over six months targets enhanced surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: 世界が揺れ動く、赤色警報発令：エボラ感染者数が増加 — WHOの緊急声明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間の確定患者数増加（DRC 452例、ウガンダ19例）、84名の死亡、PHEICの宣言、ワクチン・治療薬の未承認により、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性がすべて認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ対象国として確認。記事サマリーでは2026年6月6日現在でDRC内で452確定患者・82名死亡、northeast outbreakがPHEIC宣言（5月15日）、Bundibugyo virus lineage（ワクチン・治療薬未承認）による爆発的増加の報告あり。2014-2016西アフリカ流行（11,000名以上死亡）への懸念も言及されている。WHOおよびAfrica CDCによる$518百万の6ヶ月計画が立案されている。

article.articleHeadline: Casi 500 casos confirmados de ébola en África Central, según la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Almost 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: WHO’s daily report lists 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak was declared about three weeks ago. In neighboring Uganda, 19 cases are confirmed with 2 deaths. The combined total is 471 cases and 84 deaths, up from the previous day by about 100 cases and 20 deaths. The outbreak, labeled a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO, unfolds at a time when authorities warn it could rival the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Limited resources complicate response to an endemic disease in the region. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. A $518 million, six-month plan from the WHO and Africa CDC prioritizes surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention.

triage.headline_ja: WHO発表：中央アフリカでエボラ確認症例がほぼ500件に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、予想外の急速な増加、国際的拡大リスク、そして国際的対応が必要な重大事態。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ発生を明記しているが、ウガンダはスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。アンゴラは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、サマリーでは言及されていないため除外。Bundibugyo Ebola virusは治療薬やワクチンが不在であり、WHO は国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）に指定。2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性がある重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ameriški zdravnik po zdravljenju ebole zapustil berlinsko bolnišnico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American doctor left a Berlin hospital after Ebola treatment.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor who contracted Ebola while working in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been discharged from Berlin's Charité Hospital after two weeks of treatment. He is in good health, and tests have not shown Ebola since the end of May, according to the hospital. This marks an imported case managed in Germany, with recovery confirmed at discharge and ongoing monitoring to ensure no relapse. The report situates the event at Charité University Hospital in Berlin and notes the patient's return to health following isolation and standard supportive care. The published date indicates the discharge occurred on June 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療後、米国医師がベルリン病院を退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染の輸入症例で確認されたが、患者は既に回復・退院済みで検査陰性。IHR基準2つ以上該当する可能性があるものの、リスク軽減済みのため情報収集継続が適切。
triage.notes: 症例はコンゴ民主共和国での感染であるが、患者はドイツで治療・回復済みで陰性確認。ドイツは対象国外のため verified_locations には含めない。国際的な二次拡大のリスクは低いが、ウイルス輸入事例として報告価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient nach zwei Wochen aus Charité entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient discharged from Charité after two weeks.
article.articleSummary: US citizen Ebola patient discharged from Berlin's Charité after just over two weeks of treatment for Bundibugyo virus, a strain of Ebola, contracted in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Admitted May 20; PCR confirmed Bundibugyo virus. No virus detected since May 30; isolation order lifted at 12:00 in line with international criteria. Discharged after the treatment period, with gratitude expressed for care including experimental therapies currently being tested for this virus variant. His wife and four children, designated as high-risk contacts, accompanied him to Berlin and remained asymptomatic in quarantine in a separate ward. The case reflects an imported infection from Central Africa and ongoing use of experimental treatments during Ebola outbreaks, alongside standard public health precautions for contacts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者、2週間後にベルリンのシャリテ病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の確認症例であり公衆衛生的に重要だが、患者は既に治癒して退院し、接触者は無症状のため、現時点では急進的なリスク拡大の可能性は低い。ただし国際的な移動と実験的治療の情報は追跡価値あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、患者がコンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo株に感染し、ベルリンで治療を受けた輸入症例。患者は既に治癒・退院、接触者は無症状であることから、国内二次感染のリスクは現在のところ低い。ただしエボラウイルス確認症例として公開通知相当だが、活動的な流行リスクは限定的と判断。

article.articleHeadline: RASTE BROJ ZARAŽENIH OD EBOLE: Oglasila se i Svetska zdravstvena organizacija, podaci su jezivi!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola is rising: The World Health Organization has also spoken out; the data are chilling!
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Central Africa is rising. The World Health Organization reports 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), plus 19 confirmed cases and two deaths in Uganda, for a total of 471 infections and 84 deaths, up 100 cases from the previous day. The outbreak, declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, began May 15 in northeast DRC, with suspected silent spread. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain driving the outbreak has no approved vaccine or treatment. In response, WHO and the Africa CDC launched a $518 million six-month plan to strengthen surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. The United States will provide about $38 million in additional funding, bringing direct U.S. support to over $200 million, in coordination with the CDC, DRC, and Uganda. Asymptomatic Americans exposed to the virus may be quarantined in a Kenyan facility under construction.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者数が増加：世界保健機関も声を上げ、データは戦慄すべきものである！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの急速な拡大、PHEIC宣言、複数国への国際的拡大、WHO・米国による大規模資金支援投入により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: サマリーではウガンダとケニアの言及もあるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRC は対象国として含める。PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・治療法なし）、1日で100症例増加、国際的な大規模支援体制構築中という極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Mutane 500 sun kamu da cutar Ebola a Tsakiyar Afirka-WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa: In DR Congo's Kwango Province, 452 people infected and at least 82 deaths reported over three weeks. In neighboring Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the disease is still spreading rapidly, and authorities are struggling to accelerate vaccine supply for the new Ebola strain. The report notes ongoing cross-border transmission risk as the outbreak expands toward adjacent regions. Historical context recalls the 2014 West Africa outbreak, which infected over 28,000 people and caused about 11,000 deaths. A caption mentions the WHO director’s visit to Ituri Province in DR Congo, underscoring the international attention on the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカでエボラ熱患者500人—WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダとアンゴラも列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは明確に報告されているのはDRC（Kwango州452人感染・82人死亡）とウガンダ（19人・2人死亡）。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。ワクチン供給の加速が難しい状況、2014年西アフリカアウトブレイク（28,000人感染、11,000人死亡）との比較言及により、極めて高いリスク評価を支持。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的対応の活発さを示している。

article.articleHeadline: Эксперты предупредили о риске крупнейшей в истории вспышки Эболы в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts warned about the risk of the largest Ebola outbreak in Africa's history.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda threatens to become the largest on record. As of June 2, 2026, 378 laboratory-confirmed cases and 63 deaths were reported across both countries. Initial infections may have emerged as early as February 2026. U.S. CDC warns that with insufficient case finding and isolation, the number of cases could exceed 20,000 within three months, with a 65% probability. Prompt isolation of most cases could substantially slow transmission. Officials note that this already represents the largest Bundibugy o ebolavirus outbreak observed to date, and without urgent, large-scale public health measures it could rank among the world's most extensive Ebola outbreaks. Kazakhstan's health ministry had previously issued travel advisories for residents planning overseas trips.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行の危機を警告する専門家
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、および国際支援の必要性が明確である。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダにおいて確認された流行が記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国に該当しないため除外した。米国とカザフスタンは発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主題は両国での発生ではなく（米国CDCの警告、カザフスタンの旅行勧告のみ）、対象国に該当しないため除外した。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）による流行であり、現在378例、63死亡が確認されており、3ヶ月以内に20,000例を超える可能性が指摘されている。緊急かつ大規模な公衆衛生介入が急務。

article.articleHeadline: US Adds $38 Million As Ebola Outbreak Spreads In DR Congo And Uganda - The News Chronicle
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda as of 6 June 2026. The United States commits nearly $38 million more for the response, bringing direct Ebola support to over $200 million; a separate $350 million package for DRC, South Sudan and Uganda is part of a $1.8 billion UN OCHA contribution. WHO and Africa CDC launch a $518 million six‑month emergency plan for DRC, Uganda and neighbors. DRC initially reported 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths, later revised to 321 infections, 48 deaths, and six recoveries; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; laboratory testing delays and community resistance hinder containment. The outbreak was declared a global health emergency on May 17, 2026, with cross-border spread to Kampala. Border screening, airport measures and community outreach are supported by IOM, UNICEF, WFP, and partners, amid trade disruption.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ出血熱対応に3,800万ドルを追加 - コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの流行拡大に対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。2026年5月17日に世界的保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが記載されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの2例・2死亡に触れておりコンゴ民主共和国が主要な流行地である。同国のみを verified_locations に含める。ウガンダが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療法なし、2026年5月17日に国際的保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تعلن الطوارئ.. "إيبولا" يخرج عن السيطرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares emergency... Ebola out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in East Democratic Republic of the Congo is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Central Africa, with WHO declaring a global health emergency in May. Transmission occurs through contact with infected body fluids (blood, vomit, semen). About 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths have been reported, though true infections may be higher due to underreporting. Ongoing insecurity in eastern DRC, including clashes involving M23 rebels and ISIS-linked ADF, hinders surveillance, case identification, and isolation. CDC models project 10,000 to over 20,000 cases under current conditions; higher totals may occur if isolation remains low. If isolation reaches 50–70%, projections could be closer to 10,000. The final trajectory hinges on international response, effectiveness of containment, and ability to operate in conflict-affected areas; there are currently no licensed vaccines or targeted therapies for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.”}{

triage.headline_ja: WHO、緊急事態を宣言...エボラが制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirusによるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、WHO が全球的健康非常事態を宣言。CDC予測で1万～2万件以上の症例。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀なエボラウイルス種。東DRC の紛争地域での発生のため、監視と対応能力が著しく制限されている。ワクチンや治療法がない。CDC の疫学モデルは隔離の程度によって大きく異なる予測を示唆している（隔離50-70%で約1万件、現在の条件では1万～2万件以上）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : une église reprend ses activités religieuses dès le 7 juin - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: A Church Resumes Its Religious Activities as of June 7.
article.articleSummary: Facing the Ebola virus threat in Bunia, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, a church resumes religious services on Sunday, June 7, 2026 at 07:00 local time after a preventive suspension and sanitation work across the Temple central and other gathering spaces. The decision, announced by Reverend Jacques Lika, provincial coordinator, follows an epidemiological evaluation and completion of cleaning activities in line with health guidance. The church urges parishioners to stay vigilant and strictly observe health measures to prevent disease transmission; adherence to sanitary directives is presented as a collective responsibility essential to protecting communities and supporting outbreak response. The reopening has met with relief among congregants in Bunia and surrounding areas. No laboratory-confirmed cases or infection sources are stated in the report.

triage.headline_ja: Ebola in Ituri: A Church Resumes Its Religious Activities as of June 7.
triage.triage_reason: Ebola is inherently serious and unusual/unexpected, meeting IHR criteria (2 count). However, the article describes a church reopening after preventive measures with no confirmed cases reported. Information on current outbreak status, case numbers, and transmission risk is insufficient for PICKUP determination.
triage.notes: Article focuses on church reopening in Ituri, DRC following Ebola threat. No confirmed cases are mentioned in the report. While Ebola itself meets IHR criteria, the specific event described is a facility reopening with preventive measures rather than an active outbreak escalation. Continued monitoring of DRC Ebola situation recommended due to inherent severity of the pathogen and unpredictable nature of outbreaks in affected regions.

article.articleHeadline: Q&A | Wordt dit de grootste ebola-uitbraak ooit? 'Bezuinigingen zijn problematisch'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Q&A | Will this be the largest Ebola outbreak ever? 'Budget cuts are problematic'.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda, with 381 confirmed cases in Congo and 19 in Uganda as of June 6, 2026. Epidemiologists Amrish Baidjoe and Laurens Liesenborghs warn the situation is not under control and the coming weeks will determine whether this becomes one of the largest Ebola outbreaks to date. The Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccines or specific treatments; available measures target the Zaire ebolavirus variant and do not work against Bundibugyo, underscoring the need for rapid research. Transmission is via body fluids, with highest risk in households, between patients and caregivers, and during traditional funeral rites. Poverty, conflict, and logistics hinder access and medical supply delivery; health facilities are strained by other infections like measles and malaria. Mortality is around 50% in the region; better care could reduce it to 10–15% elsewhere. Europe is not at immediate risk; calls for increased international investment and sustained innovation against zoonotic diseases.

triage.headline_ja: Q&A | これは過去最大のエボラ流行になるのか？『予算削減は問題だ』
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダにおけるブンディブギョエボラウイルスの継続的な流行。確定例381例（コンゴ）、19例（ウガンダ）。IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度50%、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIで「発生地域」として記載されているが、記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国が主要な発生地で、ウガンダは隣接地域での確定例19例の言及に留まる。対象国リストでウガンダが該当しないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。ブンディブギョエボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）は既存ワクチン・治療法が効果がなく、致死率約50%と高い。予算制約と衛生インフラの脆弱性が対応を阻害している。国際的投資と研究支援の必要性が明記されており、WHO通知レベルの事象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : l'absence des dispositifs de mesures barrières décriée au marché central - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Absence of barrier measures criticized at the central market - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease persists in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, with 25 laboratory-confirmed cases, 16 deaths, 2 recoveries, and 7 active cases as of 5 June 2026, in the 17th outbreak across three provinces. In Beni, the central market lacks basic barrier measures at major entrances—no handwashing stations or temperature screening visible, aside from at the market office. Beni market deputy administrator Bavo Tengetenge notes logistical constraints in installing washing devices at multiple entry points and appeals for support from authorities and health partners. With thousands of traders and customers passing daily, the situation elevates transmission risk and underscores calls to reinforce preventive measures at this high-traffic site. Health authorities and partners are urged to intensify risk communication and barrier deployment to curb spread within the market setting.

triage.headline_ja: ベニでのエボラ：中央市場での防疫措置の欠如が批判される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。エボラウイルス病の継続的な流行、防疫措置の不十分さ、高リスク施設での曝露という要因から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 北キブ州ベニでのエボラウイルス病の第17回発生。2026年6月5日時点で25例の確認症例、16死亡、7活動例。中央市場は数千の商人・顧客が日々出入りする高リスク施設であり、防疫措置の欠如（手洗い施設、体温スクリーニング）が感染拡大リスクを著しく高めている。当局と保健パートナーからの支援要請が明示されており、管理可能性が不確実。

article.articleHeadline: EUA Anunciam Doação de Quase US$38 Milhões a Mais para Resposta ao Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Announces Almost $38 Million More for Ebola Response.
article.articleSummary: US$38 million in additional Ebola response funding announced by the United States, raising total direct US funding to over US$200 million. The State Department, working closely with the CDC, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Uganda, aims to mount a rapid and comprehensive response to the Ebola outbreak. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC have launched a continental plan seeking about US$319 million (through November) to support outbreak control in affected countries and strengthen readiness in neighboring nations; the final plan estimates total funding needs at US$518 million. US citizens exposed to the virus but asymptomatic will be quarantined in Kenya in a facility under construction. In DRC, Ebola cases rose by 71 in one day with 21 additional deaths; lab-confirmed cases reached 452 and deaths 82. Health workers are expanding testing in a mining city amid conflict, displacement, and weak health systems, hindering case tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ出血熱対応に追加で約3,800万ドルの寄付を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は継続中の大規模流行で、複数国に及び、米国が大規模資金支援を表明するなど政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Geonames ID: 203312）とウガンダでのエボラ流行が主題。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めず。米国やケニアでの活動は対応・支援地点であり、流行地ではない。紛争、人口移動、弱い保健システムなど管理上の課題が明記されており、オンゴーイングの複雑な危機状況を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Досега потврдени речиси 500 случаи на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: So far nearly 500 Ebola cases confirmed.
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, the World Health Organization reports nearly 500 Ebola virus disease cases confirmed in Central Africa. The latest daily update lists 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak was declared three weeks ago. In neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed cases have been reported, with two fatalities. The rising counts underscore growing concern about the potential scale of this hemorrhagic fever outbreak in the region. The information comes from the WHO daily briefing.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：これまでにほぼ500件のエボラ感染確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病による深刻な公衆衛生影響（452確認例、82死亡）、国際的拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダ）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクあり。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダに19例の報告があると記載されていますが、ウガンダはGeoNamesの対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めていません。DRCはリストに含まれ、サマリーの主要発生地です。エボラアウトブレークは国際保健上の最優先事項であり、即座のリスク評価が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - Ebola: le patient américain soigné en Allemagne est guéri et a pu sortir de l'hôpital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - Ebola: the American patient treated in Germany has recovered and was discharged from the hospital.
article.articleSummary: An American patient treated in Berlin after contracting Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has recovered and was discharged from Charité University Hospital. The patient, previously described as very weakened but not in a critical state, had no detectable virus for a week. His wife and four children, who remained asymptomatic during quarantine, have also left medical care in good health. The discharge indicates no ongoing infection among the family. The case remains an imported Ebola infection from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Germany. Charité stated the family were quarantined and released in good health, without evidence of continued transmission. No further details on follow-up or local monitoring were provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱 - ドイツで治療を受けたアメリカ人患者が治癒し、病院を退院
triage.triage_reason: 患者は既に回復・退院し、家族も無症状で経過した輸入症例。継続的な感染リスクなく、重症例ではなく、国際的な拡大の兆候がない。
triage.notes: 本事例は過去に発生した輸入症例の治療完了報告であり、アクティブな感染症クラスターではない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるが、現在進行形の感染症イベントではなく、既に解決した輸入症例の転帰報告のため、シグナルピックアップの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Američana, ktorý sa v Kongu nakazil ebolou, po vyliečení prepustili z nemocnice
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American who contracted Ebola in Congo was discharged from the hospital after recovery.
article.articleSummary: An American patient who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and was treated in Germany has been discharged from Charité University Hospital Berlin after 17 days of antiviral treatment, signaling recovery. The patient, who worked in the DRC as a surgeon for a Christian missionary organization, along with five family members kept in quarantine, is reported to be in good health and released. WHO data on 6 June 2026 show the Ebola outbreak spreading in Central Africa with nearly 500 confirmed cases. In the DRC, 452 confirmed infections and 82 deaths; in neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The day’s update marks an increase of about 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. WHO had warned the epidemic could become the largest recorded Ebola outbreak and declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで感染したエボラ患者（米国人）が回復後、ドイツの病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な多地域発生（DRC・ウガンダ）で、患者数が急速に増加（約100例/日）し、WHO が国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。国際的な拡大リスク、重症度、管理可能性に関するWPRO基準が複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで発生したエボラ発生を主題としており、ドイツでの患者治療は国際的な流出例である。ウガンダも記事に記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO が PHEIC を宣言し、急速な症例数増加（452例/82死亡 in DRC、19例/2死亡 in Uganda）が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry launches WhatsApp chatbot JALI for Ebola information
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Ministry of Health launched JALI, a WhatsApp-based chatbot providing verified Ebola information as Kenya intensifies preparedness amid outbreaks in Uganda and the DRC. Access via saving 0700 719 719, starting a WhatsApp chat, saying Hello, entering age and gender, and typing 'Ebola' to receive information on symptoms, prevention measures and resources. Kenya has no confirmed Ebola cases and maintains heightened surveillance at border points. Over 80,000 travellers have been screened since enhanced surveillance, with 3,969 screens in the last 24 hours. 56 samples from travellers with history to Uganda/DRC were tested and all were negative. The ministry emphasizes JALI to disseminate timely, reliable information and curb misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラ対策用WhatsAppチャットボット「JALI」を立ち上げ
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダとDRCでのエボラ流行により国際的拡大リスクが存在し、ケニアが準備強化・サーベイランス措置を講じている状況。ただし記事は情報提供ツール立ち上げに焦点があり、ケニアの確認症例はなく、現在のイベント規模・重症度に関する具体的データが不足している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCとウガンダでの流行、ケニアの準備強化が記述されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCとケニアの両国で実際のイベント対応が進行中と判断。IHR基準2つ該当でPICKUP閾値に達しているが、記事主体は予防啓発であり、現在のエボラ国内流行の直接的なデータ不足のため、WATCH判定とした。ただし続報で症例情報が出現した場合はPICKUP昇格が適切。

article.articleHeadline: शेरों के आठ शावकों की मौत 'बाबेसिया' संक्रमण से नहीं, बल्कि गर्मी के कारण हुई : गुजरात के मंत्री
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eight lion cubs died not from Babesia infection, but due to heat: Gujarat minister.
article.articleSummary: Eight Asiatic lion cubs in the Gir region of Gujarat died due to extreme heat, not Babesia parasite or any virus, according to Forest Minister Arjun Modhwadia (June 6, 2026). Earlier, 17 lions were ill and isolated; 12 have recovered and been released back into the wild, while five remain healthy and due for release. To curb disease risk in the surrounding area, about 600 lions underwent tick control and deworming. The minister stated no deaths were linked to a dangerous pathogen; a lioness death was due to pregnancy complications. Initially, on May 29, authorities attributed eight cub deaths in Gir Somnath and Amreli districts to suspected Babesia infection. Ongoing actions include monitoring, preventive treatment, and rapid release of recovered animals to reduce confinement.

triage.headline_ja: ライオンの仔8頭の死亡はバベシア感染ではなく、熱が原因：グジャラート州大臣
triage.triage_reason: 初期仮説（バベシア感染）は公式に否定され、実際の死亡原因は極度の熱（環境要因）と判明。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事はバベシア感染の初期疑いを扱っていますが、グジャラート州森林大臣による公式声明で原因が極度の熱による死亡と明確に否定されています。野生ライオンへの感染症イベント（公衆衛生上の脅威ではない）であり、またシグナル自体が既に否定されているため、トリアージは不要。ただし、地域での予防的な滴虫駆除およびワクチン接種が実施されたことが記録されています。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le patient soigné en Allemagne a quitté l'hôpital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the patient treated in Germany has left the hospital.
article.articleSummary: Ebola patient Peter Stafford, a missionary doctor with the American Christian NGO Serge, exposed while treating patients at Nyankunde hospital in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, has left the Charité hospital in Berlin in good health. Admitted May 20 to the high-risk infectious disease isolation unit at the request of the United States, Stafford’s viral load was initially high but declined markedly with antiviral remdesivir and supportive care, alongside antibody therapy. Since May 30, daily tests have detected no virus, and the isolation order was lifted at noon on Saturday. Stafford’s wife and four children, who remained asymptomatic during quarantine, also left medical care in good health. The hospital authority emphasized the case demonstrates the critical role of specialized isolation units amid global risk. Thoughts are voiced for Congo residents who lack access to such care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：ドイツで治療を受けた患者が病院を退院
triage.triage_reason: 患者の臨床的転帰は良好で、ウイルス陰性化が確認され、感染者の新規発生ではなく既知ケースの治療終了報告である。国際的な疾病拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は治療されたエボラ患者の退院報告であり、新規の感染症発生事例ではない。患者は既に5月30日から日々のテストでウイルス陰性が確認されており、臨床的には解決している。DRCでの暴露事例は過去の既知ケースであり、本報告時点での疾病拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: le patient américain soigné en Allemagne, guéri, et sa famille sont sortis de l'hôpital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the American patient treated in Germany, recovered, and his family have left the hospital.
article.articleSummary: An American missionary treated in Berlin for Ebola, at the request of the United States, has recovered and left the Charité hospital with his wife and four children, all in good health. Peter Stafford, admitted May 20 to the high-risk infectious diseases unit after exposure while treating patients at Nyankunde hospital in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, began with a severe illness and a high viral load. He received antibody therapy and remdesivir, plus supportive care, and his viral load fell markedly. Since May 30, no virus has been detected in daily follow-ups, and the isolation order was lifted on Saturday. The wife and four children, asymptomatic, completed a 21‑day high-risk contact quarantine and were released. WHO data show about 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths in the DRC, and 19 cases with 2 deaths in Uganda; the outbreak is a PHEIC with concerns it could rival 2014–16.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：ドイツで治療を受けた米国人患者が回復し、家族とともに病院を退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の既知アウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）の継続報道だが、個別の回復事例報告であり新規シグナルではない。PHEIC指定済みの既報パターンだが、情報継続監視の価値あり。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラ症例の継続的な報告。既にPHEIC指定されている既知アウトブレイク（452確認症例、82死亡）の一部。患者はDRC内での曝露後にドイツで治療を受けた国際医療移送事例。新規流行地域の発生ではなく、既報アウトブレイクの進展追跡として位置付けられる。WATCHレベルで継続監視を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in DR Kongo: mehr als 450 bestätigte Infizierte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: more than 450 confirmed infections
article.articleSummary: 452 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 82 deaths; 258 patients are in quarantine and 8 have recovered. The outbreak centers on Ituri province, near Uganda and South Sudan, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or therapy. Africa CDC notes this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo since 1976. Officials warn of rapid, sustained spread within the population. Uganda reports 19 infections, including 2 deaths, and has temporarily closed the border with DR Congo as of late May. Symptoms include fever, muscle aches, diarrhea, internal bleeding, and organ failure; transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids. WHO lists Bundibugyo fatality at 30–50%. The most deadly DR Congo outbreak occurred 2018–2020 with about 2,300 deaths; last August caused 34 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイク：450人以上の確認感染者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。エボラの確認症例452人、死亡82人という重大な公衆衛生被害、国境閉鎖や複数国への拡大、国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC（イトゥリ州）での確認症例452人、死亡82人が主要な発生内容。ウガンダでの19感染（2死亡）も記述されているが、サマリーの焦点はDRCでのアウトブレイクにあり、ウガンダは国境閉鎖の文脈での言及であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療なし、致命率30-50%、複数国への拡大リスク高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient nach erfolgreicher Behandlung aus Charite entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient discharged from Charité after successful treatment.
article.articleSummary: US citizen infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Congo was treated at Berlin's Charité and discharged after successful antiviral therapy. Diagnosed May 20, the patient required isolation on a dedicated ward; initial Ebola symptoms were severe but subsided within the first week. By May 30, repeated tests failed to detect any virus, and the health authority lifted isolation after more than 72 hours symptom-free with consecutive negative PCRs. Five family members, considered high-risk contacts, were quarantined at Charité; they remained asymptomatic with negative laboratory results, and the quarantine was lifted after 21 days. No deaths reported. This case highlights importation risk and the effectiveness of strict isolation and monitoring to protect public health in Germany during treatment and recovery as of June 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者がシャリテ病院での成功した治療後に退院
triage.triage_reason: 患者が既に治癒し退院済み、濃厚接触者も陰性で隔離解除済み。国際的な拡大リスク、公衆衛生上の継続的脅威がない。過去の事例報告にとどまる。
triage.notes: 本事例は2026年6月6日時点で既に解決済み。患者は治癒して退院、濃厚接触者も陰性で隔離解除済み、死亡者なし。感染源はDRCであるが、ドイツで発症した輸入症例であり、進行中の流行警告ではない。WPROスクリーニング基準に該当せず、シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Američana, ktorý sa v Kongu nakazil ebolou, po vyliečení prepustili z nemocnice v Berlíne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American who contracted Ebola in the Congo has been discharged from the hospital in Berlin after recovery.
article.articleSummary: An American physician for a missionary organization who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo was discharged from a Berlin hospital after recovery. Five family members who were quarantined were also allowed to leave the hospital. WHO reported that the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa now totals nearly 500 confirmed cases: 452 confirmed in the DRC, including 82 deaths, and 19 confirmed in Uganda, including 2 deaths. Compared with the previous day, totals rose by about 100 cases and 20 deaths. The report notes ongoing transmission across the DRC and Uganda, with laboratory confirmation underpinning the figures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで感染したエボラ患者、ベルリンの病院で回復後退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認アウトブレイクであり、IHR Annex2基準の4項目すべてに該当する。DRCとウガンダで約500例が確認され、死亡例も報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、主なエボラアウトブレイクはDRCで452例（死亡82例）、ウガンダで19例（死亡2例）であることが明記されている。ドイツ（ベルリン）は治療の受け入れ国だが、エボラの発生地ではない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとなる。CDCによるWHO報告の引用があり、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大関心事項である。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : six établissements sanitaires reconnus et équipés pour la prise en charge d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: six health facilities recognized and equipped to manage Ebola - ACP.
