article.articleSummary: Six facilities in Ituri, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, have been officially recognized and equipped to manage suspected and confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases: Evangelical Medical Center (CME); General Reference Hospital (HGR) in Bunia; HGR in Rwampara; HGR in Mongbwalu; HGR in Nyankunde; and HGR in Aru. These centers are designated as reference structures for EVD patient care. Dr. Marcel Lola Loway, provincial health division chief, urged that anyone meeting the suspected-case definition be directed to these centers for secure, appropriate care. Ongoing expansion plans include Mambasa General Hospital, Komanda General Hospital, and the CSR Health Center of Sota, which are slated to join the treatment and transit center network. The article notes that care for suspected/confirmed EVD remains free in authorized facilities; no charges for screening, hospitalization, or treatment are to be demanded. Date: 6 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：エボラ管理のために認可・整備された6つの保健施設 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の治療施設整備に関する報道であり、既存の発生への対応体制強化を示唆。ただし記事サマリーは新規患者発生や疫学的悪化を明示しておらず、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月6日付で、DRCのイトゥリ州におけるエボラ対応施設の整備状況を報道している。Bluedot APIが出力した地域には Mexico や Rwanda が含まれているが、サマリーの主題は DRC（イトゥリ州）に限定されるため、検証済み地域には DRC のみを記載した。記事は施設整備の進捗を示す行政報告であり、新規患者数や死亡、疫学的な悪化を明確に示していない。スクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」には該当する可能性があるが、情報不足のため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 'They die as they arrive': Ebola is spreading in eastern DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province’s Bunia and the Mongbwalu health zone. The first cases were reported in late April; the source is not pinpointed, and officials warn the outbreak may have started weeks earlier and gone unnoticed. At Mongbwalu General Hospital, patients arrive too late, with some dying on arrival or within 24 hours. Africa CDC characterizes this as an ongoing outbreak and notes public hesitancy and pockets of resistance hindering the response. No case counts or laboratory confirmation details are provided. Key locations affected: Bunia (capital of Ituri) and the Mongbwalu mining area, illustrating high-traffic zones as potential transmission hotspots. The report emphasizes urgent need for community engagement to overcome hesitancy and improve containment.

triage.headline_ja: 「患者たちは到着時に亡くなる」：エボラがコンゴ民主共和国東部で感染拡大中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の活動中アウトブレイク（IHR基準4項目すべてに該当の可能性が高い）で、公衆衛生への重大な影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性が明確であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の高病原性・高致死性と院内感染リスク、社会的抵抗による対応困難が報告されている。ケース数や検査確認の詳細が記事サマリーに含まれていない点は注視が必要だが、Africa CDCの公式確認と東部DRC鉱業地帯での流行性の高さから優先度は高い。本件はIHR通知基準を明確に満たすシグナルと判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Drop in Congo's Ebola case count offers hope, but outbreak remains serious
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo) remains serious. As of 2026-06-06, DR Congo reports about 380 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths, with neighboring Uganda reporting 15 confirmed cases and 1 death. Previously, authorities logged more than 1,000 suspected cases and nearly 250 suspected deaths. The apparent downturn reflects improved laboratory testing, with many suspected cases ruled out after tests, including for malaria. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said response teams are beginning to catch up after the outbreak’s early foothold. A key challenge is contact tracing: only about 45% of people who had direct contact with confirmed patients are currently being monitored, underscoring ongoing transmission risks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者数の減少は希望をもたらすが、感染拡大は依然として深刻
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大のリスク）。複数国での確認患者・死亡者、接触者追跡の不十分さ（45%）により継続的な伝播リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC での確認患者 380 例、死亡 60 例、接触者追跡率 45% と低い状況が継続的伝播リスクを示唆。WHO Director-General による言及で国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Fears of wider spread as Ebola outbreak in Central Africa nears 500 cases
article.articleSummary: MSF reported at Elikya clinic Ebola treatment center in Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, illustrating a widening outbreak. Ebola has 452 confirmed cases in the DRC with 82 deaths and 19 confirmed cases in Uganda with 2 deaths, as of June 6, 2026, per WHO. The combined total is 471 cases and 84 deaths, up 100 cases and 20 deaths from the prior day. The outbreak, declared May 15 in northeastern DRC, involves the Bundibugyo species, which has no approved vaccines or treatments. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids. WHO and Africa CDC launched a $518-million six-month plan to strengthen surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention, and to ready neighboring countries for detection and rapid response. CDC models warn the outbreak could rival the 2014 West Africa epidemic if public health actions lag.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ感染症アウトブレイクが500例に近づく中、より広い拡大を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てに該当。Ebolaは公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを全て備える。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。即座にフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Ebolaアウトブレイクは記事で主にコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の東部Buniaで発生していることが明確。ウガンダでの確認例（19例、2死亡）も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーで具体的な言及がないため除外。Bundibugyo種による多剤耐性、24時間以内に100例以上の急速な増加、WHOとAfrika CDCによる大規模対応計画、2014年西アフリカエピデミックとの比較言及により、極めて高優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolasmittad amerikan skrivs ut från tyskt sjukhus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-infected American discharged from German hospital.
article.articleSummary: An American man infected with Ebola has been discharged from a German hospital after 17 days of treatment. He contracted the virus in Kongo-Kinshasa while working as a physician for a Christian missionary group. Now recovered, he says he received first-class care, including experimental treatments being tested for this virus. He added that his thoughts are with people in Kongo-Kinshasa who do not have access to the same level of care. The article notes that the United States does not permit Ebola-infected citizens to travel home for treatment; infected Americans are instead cared for at facilities in Kenya or, when possible, sent to Europe.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染の米国人、ドイツの病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: 既存の感染者の回復・退院事例であり、新規発生ではない。DRCでの流行継続の兆候はあるが、本記事は個別治療例の報告に過ぎず、公衆衛生への深刻な新規影響や異常の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでエボラに感染した米国医師の個別治療・退院事例である。DRCでの現在のエボラ流行状況については記事に記載されていない。米国とドイツは記事に言及されているが、新規感染地ではなく治療を受けた場所として登場するのみのため、verified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Mauricio prohíbe la entrada de extranjeros desde Congo, Uganda y Sudán del Sur por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mauritius bans entry of foreigners from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Mauritius restricts entry to foreigners traveling from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, or who have recently been there (last 21 days); Mauritian citizens and legal residents may enter but must undergo a mandatory 21-day quarantine on arrival. Entry screening and risk assessment are being implemented at points of entry for travelers from affected countries. The measure follows the Ebola outbreak declaration on May 15, 2026, in Ituri Province, DRC near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, which has since spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda reports 19 Ebola cases and 2 deaths, both imported from the DRC. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with an estimated case-fatality rate of 30–50%; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists. WHO categorizes the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: モーリシャス、エボラ対策としてコンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの外国人入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。2026年5月15日に宣言されたEbola outbreak（Bundibugyo株、CFR 30-50%）がWHOにより国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態と認識されており、複数国で確認。国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題は、DRC（South Kivu Province, Ituri Province, North Kivu）で発生したEbola outbreakであり、Uganda報告例はDRCからの輸入例。モーリシャスの渡航制限はWHO PHEIC宣言に基づく国際的対応。Sudan（スーダン）はAPIで「Republic of the Sudan」として記載されているが、記事では「South Sudan（南スーダン）」とされており、対象国リストにはSudanが含まれていないため除外。Uganda（226074）はAPIに含まれるが対象国リストに未記載のため除外。したがって、対象国リスト内で実際に流行が確認されているのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: US Ebola patient released from German hospital | News.az
article.articleSummary: American doctor Peter Stafford contracted Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo while working for a missionary group. He was admitted May 20 to Berlin's Charité hospital's specialized isolation ward—the largest such facility in Germany—where the virus was laboratory-confirmed. Stafford and his four family members, who did not contract Ebola, were quarantined in Berlin; the family completed the 21-day exposure window and were discharged on June 6. German authorities arranged for Stafford's stay in Germany after reports that Washington would not repatriate him. Stafford reported receiving first-rate care and experimental treatments currently being tested for this virus, and Charité officials described his progress as very positive and a significant therapeutic success after he arrived very weak. It remains unclear who will cover medical expenses or whether Stafford and his family will return to Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人エボラ患者、ドイツの病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染確認例であり、国際的な移動・治療に関わる事例だが、患者は回復し退院済みであり、現在の流行拡大リスクは低い。DRCでの流行状況の詳細情報がないため、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC（エボラ感染地）で感染し、ドイツで治療を受けた個別事例。記事は既に患者が退院し回復していることを示唆しており、現在の流行状況や他の感染者についての情報は記載されていない。DRCでのエボラ流行の現状把握のため続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Skoro 500 zaraženih ebolom, WHO strahuje od scenarija iz 2014. godine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 500 people infected with Ebola, WHO fears a 2014 scenario.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 500 Ebola cases have been confirmed in a cross-border outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, per WHO daily briefing on 2026-06-06. In the DRC, 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths have been reported since the outbreak was declared three weeks earlier (May 15). Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Total confirmed cases reach 471 with 84 deaths, up by about 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The current outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Transmission occurs through close contact and bodily fluids. A WHO/Africa CDC plan worth $518 million has been launched for six months to curb spread and shield neighboring countries. CDC officials warn models could reach the scale of the 2014 West Africa outbreak if public health measures are not rapidly implemented.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの感染者がほぼ500人に達し、WHOは2014年のシナリオを懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株によるDRC・ウガンダでの多国間流行で、高い死亡率、急速な増加、ワクチン・治療薬なし、2014年流行レベルの懸念があり、国際的支援が進行中の重大事象。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）はBluedot APIで発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。ただしサマリーでDRCとウガンダの多国間流行が明記されており、DRCが対象国であるためPICKUPとする。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はワクチン・治療薬がなく、現在の症例数・増加速度・死亡率は極めて懸念すべき水準。

article.articleHeadline: Najnoviji izveštaj SZO o eboli: Rast broja slučajeva izaziva dodatnu pažnju zdravstvenih institucija - Preko 500 obolelih potvrđeno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The latest WHO report on Ebola: The rise in case numbers is drawing increased attention from health institutions - Over 500 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the WHO reports Ebola activity in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In DRC's northeast, 452 confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded with 82 deaths; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Overall, 471 infected and 84 deaths, up about 100 cases from the prior day. The outbreak, declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 15 in northeastern DRC, appears to be spreading quietly. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain currently lacks an approved vaccine or treatment. A joint WHO and Africa CDC plan worth $518 million (€446 million) over six months targets surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. Context notes a historic West Africa outbreak (2014–2016) with over 11,000 deaths; Ebola transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: 最新のWHOエボラ報告書：症例数の増加が保健機関の注目を集める - 500件以上の確認症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株で承認済みワクチン/治療なし、短期間で100症例増加し急速に拡大している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダでのエボラ活動が報告されているが、対象国リストはDRC（203312）のみを含む。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は稀で、既知のワクチン/治療がないため管理可能性が低い。短期間での症例数急増（1日で約100件増加）と国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。WHOが5月15日に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: تسجيل 500 حالة مؤكدة.. "الصحة العالمية" تحذر من تفشي إيبولا بوسط أفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 500 confirmed cases recorded... WHO warns of Ebola outbreak in Central Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in Central Africa, with confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of 6 June 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) reports about 500 confirmed cases: 452 in the DRC with 82 deaths, and 19 in Uganda with 2 deaths. Based on government reports, totals are 471 cases and 84 deaths, up by roughly 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The outbreak was first declared on 15 May in northeastern DRC, and the virus may have circulated undetected for some time. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids. WHO has declared this a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). US CDC warns that, without robust public health interventions, the outbreak could reach levels comparable to West Africa in 2014, which caused over 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 500人の確認患者が登録... WHO、中央アフリカでのエボラ流行に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスによる多数の確認患者と死亡、複数国での報告、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、西アフリカ2014年規模への拡大リスク指摘により、直ちにフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。中央アフリカ（地域）は特定国ではないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み、複数の高リスク要因が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Новий спалах Еболи в Центральній Африці загрожує повторенням масштабів катастрофи 2014 року
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A New Ebola Outbreak in Central Africa Threatens a Repetition of the Scale of the 2014 Disaster.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Central Africa, centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain). As of early June 2026, about 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths; experts caution true numbers are higher due to limited diagnostics. Transmission occurs via contact with infected human fluids and the virus has a high fatality rate; there are no effective vaccines or antivirals for this strain. CDC analyst Dr. Satis Pillai estimates that isolating 50–70% of patients could limit total infections to around 10,000, but without rapid containment the trajectory could mirror the 2014 outbreak, which killed over 11,000. WHO declared a global health emergency in May 2026. Containment is hampered by ongoing armed conflict in DR Congo between government forces and rebel groups, including a Rwanda-backed faction and ISIS-linked Allied Democratic Forces, causing mass displacement and hindering surveillance and medical missions.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカの新たなエボラ出血熱の流行が2014年の災害規模の繰り返しを脅かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行であり、WHOが既に5月2026年に世界的保健上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの中心はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり、ルワンダが紛争関連で言及されているが、エボラ流行の実際の発生地はDRCに限定。Bundibugyo ebola virus（Bundibugyo株）による流行で、確認症例約400、死亡63（実際はより多いと推定）。武装紛争による保健医療活動の阻害が重大なリスク要因。WHO既に全球的健康緊急事態を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: الطبيب الأمريكي المصاب بفيروس إيبولا يغادر مستشفى شاريتيه في برلين - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The American doctor infected with the Ebola virus leaves Charité Hospital in Berlin - Shorouk Gate
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Ebola (Bundibugyo strain) has left Charité Hospital in Berlin after about two weeks of treatment. The hospital said the patient is in good condition and no virus has been detected since May 30; the isolation order was lifted at 12:00 noon by the relevant health authority. The patient was transferred to Charité on May 20 following a laboratory-confirmed PCR diagnosis of Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain with no widely available vaccine or specific treatment. The exposure occurred in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where he worked. His wife and four children arrived in Berlin soon after; officials labeled them high-risk contacts, though they showed no symptoms and were quarantined in a separate wing. The hospital noted the use of experimental therapies being tested for this virus.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人医師がベルリンのシャリテ病院を退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の確定症例であり、国際的な移動を伴う感染事例。公衆衛生影響の深刻性（確定症例）、異常性（稀な株）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国への移動）、および管理可能性の観点から、IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国医師のエボラ感染事例であり、感染源地がDRCであることが明記されている。ベルリン及びドイツは治療・隔離施設の所在地であるが、本イベントの発生地はDRCである。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。稀なBundibugyo株による確定症例であり、実験的治療法の使用も報告されている点は注目値。家族との接触歴も存在し、二次感染リスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola, un virus letal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, a lethal virus.
article.articleSummary: Current Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with epicenter in Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan borders; declared May 15, 2026, and now in the hundreds of cases. No vaccines or specific treatments exist for Bundibugyo, unlike the Zaire strain which has vaccines and therapies. Previous Bundibugyo outbreaks occurred in Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012), with 59 cases (38 confirmed, 21 probable) and 34 deaths (case fatality 30–50%). Uganda also reported two Kampala cases on May 15, 2026, linked to travel from DRC. Transmission requires contact with blood or body fluids or contaminated objects; not contagious until symptoms, and funeral practices can spread it. Isolation and safe burial practices are challenged by conflict and population movements in Ituri. Ebola is a zoonosis from fruit bats, chimpanzees, and other wildlife.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、致命的なウイルス
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。ブンディブギョ株の新規発生で報告ワクチンなし、複数国での検出により対応が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダとスーダンはBluedot APIで発生地域として検出されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの2事例が旅行者（DRC由来）として報告されており、主要な発生地域はDRCのイトゥリ州である。スーダンについては記事内で明確な症例報告がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。本イベントはIHR通知対象の明確な基準を満たし、ワクチン未利用株、紛争地帯での対応困難性、多国間での検出により国際的な対応が必須。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. doctor with Ebola released from German hospital after recovering from deadly virus
article.articleSummary: Dr. Peter Stafford, a U.S. physician who contracted Bundibugyo ebolavirus while volunteering in Congo, was evacuated to Charité hospital in Berlin on May 20, 2026. He received antiviral therapy and supportive care; his initially high viral load decreased and, by May 30, no virus was detected in daily PCR tests. Isolation was lifted at 12:00 PM after meeting criteria of symptom-free status for more than 72 hours and negative PCR results. Stafford’s wife Rebekah and their four children were evacuated and quarantined but never developed Ebola symptoms; the family was reunited on June 6, 2026. The Bundibugyo outbreak in Congo, which has spread to neighboring Uganda, is of serious concern; the strain is significantly less common than Zaire and currently has no vaccines or specific treatments.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人医師がドイツの病院からエボラ症からの回復後に退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外性」「国際的拡大リスク」の2つ以上に該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な患者移動と、コンゴ・ウガンダでの流行継続が確認されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念あり。
triage.notes: ベルリンとドイツは記事上で患者の治療地点であり、エボラ発生地ではない。実際の流行はコンゴ（DRC）とウガンダで発生している。本シグナルはDRCでの継続的なBundibugyo ebolavirus流行を示唆しており、フルRRA実施が必要。ワクチン・治療薬が利用不可という重要な懸念も存在。

article.articleHeadline: Estadounidense que contrajo ébola en República Democrática del Congo recibe el alta Ensegundos República Dominicana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is discharged Ensegundos Dominican Republic
article.articleSummary: An American who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo was discharged from Berlin's Charité hospital after 17 days of antiviral treatment. The patient, a surgeon for a Christian missionary group, and five relatives in quarantine are in good health. About 500 Ebola cases have been confirmed in Central Africa, with the northeastern DRC outbreak declared on May 15; transmission is believed to have begun earlier. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for the current Bundibugyo strain. Ebola spreads via close contact and bodily fluids, and the disease has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人がコンゴ民主共和国で感染したエボラ出血熱から回復しベルリンの病院を退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重大な感染症であり、国際的な懸念事項である。コンゴ民主共和国での継続的な流行（約500例）と国際的な患者移送が確認されており、IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行が主題。患者がベルリンで治療されたことは国際的拡大の証拠。500例の確認例と治療法の不在が重大リスク。ドミニカ共和国やドイツはニュース配信地であり、実際の流行地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Virus Ebola, chi arriva da Congo e Uganda lo comunichi all'Ausl
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus, anyone arriving from Congo and Uganda should report it to the AUSL.
article.articleSummary: Emilia-Romagna region enforces mandatory reporting for travelers entering Italy who have stayed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda within the prior 21 days, in response to Ebola virus measures. Under a ministerial ordinance issued May 29, individuals must declare to the Public Health Department within 24 hours of entry, even if asymptomatic. The circular also requires immediate self-isolation upon symptom onset, warns against presenting to emergency departments or clinics without prior notification to authorities, and obliges travelers to pre-notify any movements outside the territory during the observation period. The contact at AUSL di Piacenza is [email protected]. If identified at an international entry point, USMAF-SASN will provide health information and coordinate with the local Public Health Department for the traveler’s destination or stay.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス、コンゴとウガンダからの入国者はAUSLに報告すること
triage.triage_reason: 記事は対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）でのエボラ発生ではなく、イタリアへの入国者に対する予防的行政措置を述べたものである。当該対象国での新規流行シグナルではなく、既知のリスク対応であるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリア（Emilia-Romagna地域）での入国規制措置であり、DRCやウガンダでの新規エボラ発生を報じたものではない。既知のリスク対応の行政通知のため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。Bluedot APIが含めたイタリアの位置情報は除外した（対象国リストに非該当）。

article.articleHeadline: Somalia Strengthens Ebola Preparedness Amid Regional Outbreak Risks - Radio Dalsan
article.articleSummary: Somalia elevates Ebola preparedness to high alert as cross-border transmission risks from Bundibugyo-strain Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda trigger regional vigilance. As of 6 June 2026, Somalia reports no confirmed Ebola cases but has activated the National Ebola Emergency Preparedness and Readiness Plan and expanded entry screening at airports, seaports, and land borders. An electronic traveler health declaration with QR codes has been rolled out to streamline screening, while coordination with WHO and Africa CDC strengthens laboratory diagnostics, infection prevention, and clinical readiness. National and sub-national surveillance, case management, and logistics are now fully operational. Public guidance urges regular hand hygiene, avoiding contact with bodily fluids of the sick, and immediate symptom reporting, with official updates issued through government channels to counter misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: ソマリアが地域的なアウトブレイクリスクの中でエボラ準備態勢を強化 - ラジオダルサン
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の地域的な拡大リスクが存在し、複数国での発生またはその可能性が報告されている。IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当するため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: サマリーの記述「Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda」に基づき、DRCでの確認されたエボラ発生が主題となっている。ソマリアはDRCからの越境感染リスク下での準備態勢強化が主題であり、実際の発生地ではない。ウガンダはサマリーで言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo株エボラの地域的広がりを示唆する高度なリスク状況。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）和乌干达累计报告471例埃博拉病例_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Cumulative 471 Ebola virus disease cases reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda - Beijing News Network
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with cumulative 471 cases and 84 deaths reported to date. In the past 24 hours, roughly 100 new cases and 20 deaths were recorded, signaling rapid transmission. To curb the outbreak, the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) launched an emergency response plan totaling USD 518 million, scheduled over six months, prioritizing enhanced surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention and control. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that transmission is accelerating and urged the international community to act more quickly to support affected nations and bolster prevention measures in neighboring regions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダの累計エボラ病例数471例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生に深刻な影響を与え、急速な伝播が報告されており、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（対象国リストに未含）も記載されているが、対象国はDRCのみ。エボラウイルス病は高致死率の一級感染症であり、24時間で約100新規症例・20死亡が報告されており、急速な伝播が確認されている。WHOが6ヶ月間で5.18億米ドルの緊急対応計画を発表するなど、国際的な関心と支援が高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases surge over 400 as fears grow over central Africa outbreak
article.articleSummary: 471 Ebola cases and 84 deaths across the central Africa outbreak as of 6 June 2026, with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo and 19 confirmed cases with 2 deaths in Uganda. The totals reflect a 24-hour rise of 100 cases and 20 deaths. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain, declared on 15 May in northeastern DR Congo, with the virus believed to have spread undetected beforehand. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo. The WHO has declared the crisis an international public health emergency, and a $518 million response plan by WHO and Africa CDC aims to strengthen surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention to curb spread and prepare neighboring regions. The outbreak is described as potentially one of the largest on record, necessitating rapid, coordinated action.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者が400人以上に急増、中央アフリカの感染拡大への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て満たす。Bundibugyo株による大規模エボラ出血熱の国際的公衆衛生緊急事態として、WHOも宣言済み。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株は稀な株であり承認済みワクチン・治療法がない。24時間で100例・20死亡の急速な増加を示し、隣接地域への拡大リスクが高い。WHOが既に国際公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言しており、518百万米ドルの対応計画が立案されている。ウガンダの19例は確認されているが、記事の主題はDRコンゴの発生に基づいているため verified_locations はDRコンゴのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Число зараженных Эболой в Конго превысило 450 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in Congo has surpassed 450.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 452 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 82 deaths, per Xinhua citing the Ministry of Health. As of June 4, 2026, 71 new cases were logged in Ituri and North Kivu, including 21 fatalities. A total of 258 patients remain in isolation or hospital care, while eight have recovered. Contact tracing remains a major challenge: of 4,766 individuals under observation, only 2,755 have been examined (57.8%). The Health Ministry cites obstacles such as resistance to collecting post-mortem swabs, limited treatment options for Ebola, ineffective contact tracing, shortages of medicines and infection-prevention supplies, a weak alert system, and a funding gap of $21.5 million.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染者数が450人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（452確認例、82死亡）、予想外のアウトブレイク、国際拡大リスク（複数州での発生、流行継続中）、渡航・貿易制限リスク。WPROスクリーニングでも複数基準該当。フルRRA進行必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体。452確認例、82死亡、接触追跡の課題（57.8%のみ検査）、資金不足($21.5百万のギャップ）など重大な管理課題が報告されている。Ituri州とNorth Kivu州での継続的な発生。

article.articleHeadline: Эпидемия Эбола отменила саммит Африка -- США
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic canceled the Africa Summit — U.S.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, prompted postponement—not cancellation—of the US–Africa Business Summit. The WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Mauritius, the host, said the July 26–29 summit will be rescheduled per WHO guidance, and the SADC Parliamentary Forum in Seychelles will be held by videoconference due to the outbreak. Russia’s health minister claimed a vaccine for the new strain was developed at the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum. The WHO notes a serious Bundibugyo outbreak with no effective vaccine; armed conflict hampers contact tracing (about 45% traced). Isolated traveler cases have appeared in Europe, suspicions in South America, but global risk remains low as transmission is not airborne.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行がアフリカ・米国サミットを中止に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、異常性）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのバンディブギオエボラウイルスアウトブレイク。複数国への拡大と国際的影響が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのバンディブギオエボラウイルスアウトブレイクを主題としているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Saint Petersburg、Mauritius、Seychellesは言及されているがサマリー上の主題は対象国外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2024年～2026年の継続的なアウトブレイク）。イベント日付が2026年6月とされているのは未来日付であり注意が必要（Bluedot配信データの時間精度に関わる可能性）。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Paciente norte-americano tratado na Alemanha e família tiveram alta hospitalar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: American patient treated in Germany and his family discharged from hospital
article.articleSummary: Peter Stafford, a U.S. missionary doctor with Serge, contracted Ebola while treating patients at Nyankunde hospital in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. He was hospitalized in Berlin on May 20 in a high-risk infectious-disease isolation unit and treated with antibodies and the antiviral Remdesivir. Viral load declined, with tests from May 30 onward showing no detectable virus; the isolation order was lifted around 12:00 on June 6. Stafford’s wife and four children, in the same unit and asymptomatic, completed a 21-day quarantine with no detectable virus and were discharged in good health. The case, treated at the request of the United States, underscores the role of specialized isolation facilities in outbreak response. WHO’s latest update lists about 452 confirmed Ebola cases with 82 deaths in the DRC and 19 cases with 2 deaths in Uganda; Ebola has killed more than 15,000 in Africa over 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ドイツで治療されたアメリカ人患者と家族が退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常性」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当（2基準以上）。DRCでの集団発生事例とドイツでの治療例という国際的対応の事例。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「異常性」「長期曝露」「流行性」に該当。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ集団発生事例（452確認例、82死亡）と、ウガンダでの事例（19例、2死亡）が背景にある。患者はDRC東部のNyankunde病院で治療中に感染。ドイツはEU域内で対応したが、verified_locationsはサマリーの主題の感染症イベント発生地に基づきDRCのみとした。高度な隔離施設による成功例としての国際的な関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Alarm iz Konga: Ebola se brzo širi, pojavio se retki soj
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm from Congo: Ebola is spreading rapidly, a rare strain has appeared.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading rapidly due to the rare Bundibugyo strain. In the last 24 hours, 71 new confirmed cases raise the total to 452 since May 15, with 82 deaths; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. Cases remain largely concentrated in Ituri Province in the northeast, a region with weak health infrastructure and insecurity from armed conflict. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus unveiled a six-month plan worth $518 million and urged donations and political commitment to stop transmission. The U.S. State Department will provide about $38 million in additional aid, bringing U.S. assistance to over $200 million. U.S. CDC modeling warns the outbreak could become one of the worst if isolation remains low. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴからの警告：エボラが急速に拡大し、稀な株が出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の急速な拡大、複数国への国際的拡がり、高い死亡率、ワクチン・治療法なしという深刻な公衆衛生脅威。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大が確認されているが、ウガンダは評価対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。DRCのみ対象国に該当。Bundibugyo株はエボラの5つの既知株の中で最も致死率が低いとされるが、今回の急速な拡大と高い確認死亡数（452例中82死亡）、加えてワクチン・治療法の欠如により極めて深刻。弱い保健インフラと武装勢力による紛争という環境悪化因子も懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Gần 500 ca nhiễm được xác nhận ở Trung Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Nearly 500 confirmed cases in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda has reached 471 confirmed cases and 84 deaths, with 452 and 82 in the DRC, and 19 cases with 2 deaths in Uganda, per WHO. The totals mark an increase of 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. WHO has declared the Congo–Uganda outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to cross-border spillover risk, warning it could become the largest Ebola outbreak if interventions are not robust. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. On 5 June, WHO and Africa CDC announced a $518 million plan for June–November 2026 to bolster surveillance, testing, infection control, patient treatment, and community outreach. The outbreak, announced 15 May in NE DRC, is suspected to have spread silently before detection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：中央アフリカで約500人の感染者が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模発生で、国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、死亡例多数、国際的拡大リスク（国境越えスピルオーバー）、国際支援必要（5.18億ドルの対応計画）の全てが確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ出血熱発生が主題。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法未承認。WHOによるPHEIC宣言は国際的対応の重要性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Norte-americano tratado na Alemanha e família com alta hospitalar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: American treated in Germany and family discharged from hospital.
article.articleSummary: An American treated in Berlin for Ebola contracted in the Democratic Republic of Congo, and his family were discharged. Peter Stafford, a missionary physician with NGO Serge, was isolated at Charité after exposure at Nyankunde hospital in eastern DRC. After severe illness, the viral load declined thanks to antiviral therapy and supportive care; daily tests from May 30 showed no detectable virus. The isolation order was lifted at 12:00 on June 6, 2026. Stafford’s wife and four children, quarantined in the same unit and asymptomatic, were released 21 days after their last high-risk contact, with all tests negative. Leif Erik Sander highlighted the unit’s vital role for safety. Stafford received antibodies and Remdesivir, with therapies in experimental phases cited. WHO’s update reports 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths in DRC, plus 19 cases and 2 deaths in Uganda; about 500 cases. Ebola spreads via close contact and bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ドイツで治療されたアメリカ人と家族が退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は既知の高リスク病原体であり、複数国での確認例および治療事例は国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ出血熱の発生地はDRC（東部Nyankunde病院）であり、治療場所はドイツ・ベルリンである。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。ドイツとウガンダは記事で言及されるが、サマリー上の主要発生地はDRCのみ。WHO発表によるDRC内の452確認例、ウガンダ19例、計約500例は既知の進行中流行を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Shoppings, museus e metrô recebem campanha de vacinação contra gripe, febre amarela e sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malls, museums and the subway are hosting a vaccination campaign against influenza, yellow fever and measles.
article.articleSummary: Free vaccination campaign against influenza, measles, and yellow fever will be held in São Paulo from June 8–12, 2026, at more than 400 sites across the city, including malls, museums, supermarkets, churches, parks, gyms, bus terminals, and train/metro stations. Major venues such as Mercado Municipal, Museu do Ipiranga, and Museu Catavento will host. Organised by the Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS) to mark National Immunization Day on June 9, the effort aims to strengthen protection against vaccine-preventable diseases in the capital. For updates on other vaccines, residents are advised to visit a Basic Health Unit (UBS). People without a vaccination card or records can still be seen; health professionals will assess eligibility and recommend vaccines according to age and the current schedule. The article lists all participating points.

triage.headline_ja: ショッピングセンター、博物館、地下鉄でインフルエンザ、黄熱病、麻疹に対するワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知であり、現在の感染症アウトブレイクを報告していない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の該当なし、社会的関心も通常のヘルスキャンペーンレベル。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施告知である。疾患の集団発生や異常事象の報告はなく、シグナル化のためのイベント情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: UAE's Entry Restriction To Those Who Have Been To Congo, Uganda & South Sudan In The Previous 21 Days
article.articleSummary: DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan are subject to UAE entry restrictions as of 6 June 2026 due to Ebola concerns. The UAE will not permit entry to travellers who have recently been in these countries within the prior 21 days unless they have been outside the countries for more than 21 days; transit passengers must comply with the entry requirements of their final destination. Emirates indicates it will still allow travelers from these countries if they have clearance to enter their destination country. The measures take effect at 1:00 PM Dubai time on 6 June 2026 and remain in place until further notice (update logged 05:44 Dubai time). The advisory notes Ebola outbreaks in parts of Africa appear severe, but transmission typically requires very close contact with an infected or deceased person. Travelers should verify destination entry requirements through official channels.

triage.headline_ja: UAE、コンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの過去21日以内の渡航者に対する入国制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク（アフリカから中東への防疫措置）があり、IHR基準の「国際的拡大のリスク」および「渡航制限」に該当。複数の対象国での同時発生と政府の公式対応措置が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRコンゴでのエボラ発生が主題である。ウガンダと南スーダンも言及されているが、対象国リストには含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRコンゴのみを記載。UAEの渡航制限措置は対象国外の政策対応であり、DRコンゴでの実際の発生を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Donates K400,000 Ebola Supplies to Zambia - ZNBC
article.articleSummary: WHO donates Ebola preparedness supplies worth over K400,000 to Zambia to bolster the country's ability to prevent, detect, and respond to Ebola and other viral haemorrhagic fevers amid cross-border risks. The donation, announced by WHO Country Representative Dr. Clement Lasuba during the handover, arrives as the Bundibugyo Virus Disease outbreak in a neighboring country continues to pose a regional public health threat. Zambia has not yet recorded an Ebola case, but increased cross-border movement and trade with affected areas heighten preparedness needs. Ministry of Health Permanent Secretary for Donor Coordination Dr. George Sinyangwe described the support as a timely boost to outbreak readiness. The funding supports surveillance, rapid response capabilities, and essential supplies to mitigate potential importation and spread of Ebola within Zambia.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがザンビアにK400,000相当のエボラ対策物資を寄付 - ZNBC
triage.triage_reason: エボラ対策物資の寄付に関する記事であり、隣国でのBundibugyo Virus Disease発生による地域的脅威が存在するが、ザンビア国内での確認患者がなく、現時点では確立した感染症イベントではなく予防的対応段階である。情報の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は隣国（おそらくDRC）でのBundibugyo Virus Disease発生による地域的リスクへの対応としてのザンビアへの物資寄付を報道しているもの。ザンビア国内での確認患者は現在のところなし。クロスボーダー移動と貿易による持ち込みリスクが主な懸念。今後の隣国での流行拡大状況と、ザンビアでの実際の症例発生の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Речиси 500 потврдени случаи на ебола во Централна Африка, расте загриженоста за ширењето на епидемијата
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Nearly 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa, rising concern over the spread of the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease surge in Central Africa: as of 6 June 2026, WHO reports 452 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where an outbreak was declared three weeks ago, with 82 deaths. Neighboring Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths. The totals underscore rising concern about the epidemic’s scale and cross-border transmission risk in the region. Health authorities continue intensive surveillance and response activities; international organizations remain engaged to curb further spread. The report describes Ebola as a hemorrhagic fever, with ongoing monitoring of outbreak dynamics and control measures across affected areas. No further details on infection sources or imported/exported cases are provided. The situation calls for sustained public health interventions and vaccination strategies as responses expand.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：中央アフリカでエボラの確認症例がほぼ500例に達し、流行の拡大懸念が増大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。大規模エボラ流行の跨境拡大リスク、高い死亡率、国際的関心が高く、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC内での452確認症例、82死亡、ウガンダへの跨境拡大（19例、2死亡）が明記されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみを対象国として記載。エボラは最高リスク感染症であり、452例・82死亡という大規模流行、3週間前の宣言、跨境感染、国際機関の関与など、すべての評価基準で重大リスク判定。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus considerado letal coloca autoridades em alerta e Ministério da Saúde faz comunicado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A virus deemed lethal puts authorities on alert, and the Ministry of Health issues a statement.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever remains a major public health concern in Brazil as authorities report renewed circulation of the virus in wild areas, heightening risk of severe disease and fatalities. The Ministry of Health urged enhanced prevention and surveillance nationwide, with vaccination as the principal protection. The yellow fever vaccine is safe, free, and provided by the Unified Health System, and is strongly recommended for people living in or traveling to areas with vaccination advice, or those unsure of their vaccination status. In addition to immunization, individuals should adopt mosquito-protection measures (repellents, long sleeves, caution in wooded areas). Symptoms include high fever, body aches, chills, nausea, vomiting, and extreme weakness; severe cases may involve liver failure, bleeding, and death. Monkey deaths in wild areas are monitored as virus indicators, and any suspected case should be promptly reported.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的とされるウイルスが当局を警戒させ、保健省が声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病の再流行がブラジルで報告され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（IHR基準1,2,3に該当）とWPRO基準複数項目（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当。政府の公式対応と国民的関心があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域はブラジルであるが、記事サマリーではブラジルでの黄熱病再流行が記載されている。ただし、対象国リストに該当なし（ブラジルは3469034だが対象国に含まれない）。したがって verified_locations は空配列。トリアージは全般的な重大性に基づきPICKUPと判定するが、地域的には対象国外のため、後続のRRA段階で地域的優先度は低くなる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Därför uppstod ebolakrisen: Tester upptäckte inte rätt virustyp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why the Ebola crisis arose: Tests did not detect the correct virus type.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus causing Ebola virus disease is spreading mainly in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. There are no vaccines or treatments specifically approved for this strain. The CDC and WHO have issued a joint preparedness plan to curb transmission and strengthen health systems, while acknowledging other crises such as cholera and measles. WHO reports around 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa. A senior U.S. CDC official warned that without strong public health actions the outbreak could reach scales comparable to the 2014 West Africa epidemic, which saw about 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths. DR Congo has a history of containment through isolation and contact tracing, but this outbreak has so far evaded routine surveillance. Preparedness must be built in advance with investments in diagnostics, surveillance, vaccines, treatments, and rapid response for pathogens with pandemic potential.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機が生じた理由：検査が正しいウイルス型を検出できなかった
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の検査失敗、中央アフリカでの国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。複数の高死亡率疾患（エボラ、コレラ、麻疹）の同時流行で、2014年西アフリカ流行と同規模のリスクが指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは「Democratic Republic of the Congo（DRC）のIturi Province」を主要発生地として特定しており、複数疾患（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス、コレラ、麻疹）の同時流行を報告。WHO・CDCが合同準備計画を発表。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリー本文では主たる発生地として言及されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: África Central tem quase 500 casos confirmados de ebola (OMS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Africa has nearly 500 confirmed Ebola cases (WHO).
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in Central Africa raises concern over its potential scale. As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports roughly 500 confirmed Ebola infections in the region, with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where the outbreak was declared three weeks earlier. The daily WHO bulletin underscores ongoing transmission and rising worry about how large the hemorrhagic fever episode could become. These figures reflect laboratory-confirmed diagnoses within the outbreak zone, highlighting the need for intensified surveillance, rapid case investigation, and sustained public health measures to contain transmission within the DRC and across neighboring areas.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカでエボラ確認症例がほぼ500件に達する（WHO）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の集団発生は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の事象であり、国際的拡大および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは中央アフリカ地域での発生を報告しているが、具体的な確認症例452件と死亡82件はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で報告されており、同国が主要な発生地である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。エボラウイルス病の集団発生であり、国際的に極めて重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വൈറസ്: ആഫ്രിക്കന്‍ പൗരന്മാരെ 21 ദിവസത്തെ ക്വാറന്റൈനില്‍ പ്രവേശിപ്പിച്ച് ഛത്തീസ്ഗഡ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: Chhattisgarh places African nationals under a 21-day quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus: Chhattisgarh tightens precautions as three African nationals are quarantined for 21 days in Raipur, with observation centralized at a Durg district quarantine center. In response to reported Ebola spread in African countries, authorities say strict entry precautions are in place and the trio is being monitored under health department directives. Health Minister Shyam Bihari Jaiswal stated that all necessary arrangements are ready to confront any imported Ebola case, including hospital readiness and dedicated quarantine facilities, to safeguard the public. There have been no laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections in the state, and those in quarantine show no symptoms. The government emphasizes ongoing vigilance and infection-control measures in hospitals and quarantine centers to maintain public safety in Chhattisgarh.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：チャッティスガルはアフリカの国民を21日間の隔離対象に
triage.triage_reason: インドでのエボラウイルス疑い事例報告だが、実検査で確認された感染者がなく、隔離対象者は無症状。国際的拡大リスクは現段階では限定的だが、エボラウイルスの潜在的脅威性から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのチャッティスガル州ライプールでアフリカから渡航した3人が隔離された事例を報じている。現時点で確認感染者はなく無症状だが、エボラウイルスという高危険性病原体の報告のため警戒が必要。アフリカでの流行拡大に対応した予防措置と思われる。情報源がマラヤーラム語の地域メディアのため、信頼性と詳細度の確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് പൾസ് പോളിയോ ഇമ്മ്യൂണൈസേഷൻ ജൂൺ 28ന്;അഞ്ച് വയസുവരെയുള്ള 19.8 ലക്ഷം കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങൾക്ക് പോളിയോ തുള്ളിമരുന്നു നൽകും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pulse Polio immunization in the state on June 28; 19.8 lakh children up to five years old will be given polio drops.
article.articleSummary: Polio immunization drive in Kerala is scheduled for June 28, vaccinating 1,980,224 children under five with polio drops. The state will operate 22,288 booths and mobilize 46,663 trained volunteers. Besides standard booths at health facilities, Anganwadi centers, private hospitals, libraries, and schools, 539 transit booths and 283 mobile booths will be deployed at railway stations, bus stands, and boat jetties. Mobile booths will reach guest-worker residences, flood-affected areas, festival venues, and wedding mandaps. If a child misses June 28, house-to-house vaccination will be conducted on June 29–30. The campaign, led by the Health Department and Health Kerala, is conducted in collaboration with Local Self-Government, Women and Child Development, School Education, Kudumbashree Mission, Literacy Mission, Rotary International, and other partners. India was polio-free for 15 years as of January 13, 2026; neighboring countries still report cases, underlining the goal of complete eradication.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州のパルスポーリオ予防接種、6月28日実施；5歳以下の198万人の子どもにポーリオドロップを投与
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポーリオ予防接種キャンペーンの実施予定に関する通常の公衆衛生活動の報道であり、新規患者発生やアウトブレイク、危機的状況を示す証拠がない。インドが15年間ポーリオフリーを維持している事実を示唆する内容である。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のポーリオフリー状態のインドにおいて実施される定期的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知であり、感染症危機の兆候（シグナル）ではない。記事中で『インドは2026年1月13日時点で15年間ポーリオフリーを維持している』と明記されている。これは公衆衛生施策の適切な実行を示す記事であり、シグナルトリアージのレビューは不要。

article.articleHeadline: В США бьют тревогу из-за вспышки Эболы в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The U.S. raises alarm over Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda risks becoming the largest on record. CDC modeling of Bundibugyo-strain scenarios shows that with only 20% isolation and no health measures, the likelihood of exceeding 20,000 cases within three months is about 65%; with 70% isolation, cases are under 10,000 and the outbreak risk falls to 5%. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Ebola in DRC and Uganda. Confirmed cases have been reported across three provinces in both countries. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo; palliative care—such as isolation, fluid replacement, and analgesia—is essential. Health authorities and humanitarian workers report shortages of PPE like masks and an insufficient number of healthcare workers in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がアフリカのエボラ出血熱流行で警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は最大規模の流行リスク、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み、治療法なしで重篤。DRCは対象国に含まれる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国でのエボラ流行を言及しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当（ウガンダは含まれない）。CDC予測モデルでは隔離率次第で3ヶ月以内に20,000例超過の可能性が65%と深刻。治療法なし、PPE不足という管理上の課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases surge over 400 as fears grow over central Africa outbreak
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in central Africa: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of 2026-06-06, 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in DRC; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Combined totals are 471 cases and 84 deaths, up 100 cases and 20 deaths in 24 hours. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain, with no approved vaccines or treatments for this strain. Declared May 15 in northeastern DRC, the virus is believed to have spread undetected beforehand. WHO and Africa CDC launched a $518 million response plan to strengthen surveillance, laboratory testing and infection prevention. WHO has declared the crisis an international public health emergency. Officials warn the outbreak could become one of the largest on record, potentially rivaling the 2014 West Africa epidemic; rapid, coordinated action is urged.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の症例が400を超える、中央アフリカでの感染拡大への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。WHO国際保健上の危機宣言済み、短時間での患者数急増、死亡率8.7%、特殊なBundibugyo株への対策が限定的。国際的支援が強く必要とされている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの感染を報告していますが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため verified_locations に記載。WHOが国際保健上の危機を宣言済み、24時間で100例の症例増加、ワクチン・治療法が利用できない稀有なBundibugyo株によるもの、2014年西アフリカエボラ流行に匹敵する可能性がある。フルのRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 美國男醫剛果染伊波拉　柏林醫院奇蹟治癒出院 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American male doctor contracts Ebola in Congo; Berlin hospital reports miraculous recovery and discharge.
article.articleSummary: An American surgeon, 39-year-old Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola while working in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. He was treated at Berlin's Charité hospital for 17 days, discharged after viral load became undetectable (May 30 onward) following experimental therapy and supportive care. His wife and children, initially considered high-risk contacts, were quarantined but tested negative and discharged the same day. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain driving the Congo outbreak reportedly has no approved vaccine or antiviral, and transmission occurs via bodily fluids and close contact. The Congo outbreak, with Uganda, totals 471 infections and 84 deaths per the World Health Organization. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; the CDC warns it could become the largest Ebola outbreak in history. The patient expressed gratitude to healthcare workers while noting Congo's limited medical resources.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人男性医師がコンゴでエボラに感染　ベルリン医院で奇跡的に治癒して退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO PEICとして宣言され、471症例・84死亡を計上するコンゴ発生地でのエボラ症例であり、国際的な移動・治療事例として関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴでのエボラ感染者がベルリンで治療されたケースを報告。Bluedot APIが Berlin（ドイツ）を発生地域として抽出しているが、感染は DRC で発生しており、サマリー上でも DRC が主題の流行地である。ウガンダとの関連も言及されているが、記事サマリーでは DRC が主要な発生地。対象国リストに DRC が含まれるため verified_locations に含める。WHO PHEIC 宣言、歴史的流行規模への警告、ワクチン・治療薬の欠如など公衆衛生上の重大性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: German hospital discharges US man cured of Ebola infection
article.articleSummary: American surgeon Dr. Peter Stafford, 39, working for a Christian missionary group in the Democratic Republic of Congo, was discharged from Berlin’s Charité hospital on June 6, 2026, after 17 days of care for Ebola infection (Bundibugyo strain). He contracted the virus after operating on a patient in eastern DRC before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. Admitted May 20 with pronounced Ebola symptoms and a high viral load, his viral levels declined under antiviral treatment and supportive care; no virus has been detected since May 30. Stafford and his five family members, quarantined as high‑risk contacts, were released in good health. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments; experimental therapies were trialed. The virus can cause a deadly haemorrhagic fever with up to 50% fatality. As of a WHO overview on June 5, DRC and Uganda reported 471 infections and 84 deaths, and WHO has declared an international public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツの病院がエボラ感染から治癒した米国人男性を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ中3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。WHOが国際公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言しており、シグナル確定。
triage.notes: 記事は米国人がコンゴ民主共和国で感染し、ドイツで治療を受けた事例を報告している。発生地域にドイツ（Berlin）や米国が含まれているが、実際の感染発生地はDRCのみ。WHOが国際公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言済みで、DRC・ウガンダで471感染、84死亡を報告。エボラ出血熱は致死率最高50%の重篤疾患であり、多くのスクリーニング基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola 'avanza': República Democrática del Congo registra 452 casos y 82 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola 'advances': the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 452 cases and 82 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 452 laboratory-confirmed cases and 82 deaths, with 71 new confirmed cases in the previous 24 hours. The outbreak spans 25 health zones; 258 patients are hospitalized or in isolation, and recoveries total 8. Ituri province remains the center of transmission, with 424 of the 452 cases; North Kivu has 25 and South Kivu 3. Uganda reports imported Ebola cases (19 cases, 2 deaths), prompting a temporary border closure with the DRC on May 27. The strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, associated with a 30–50% fatality rate; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, and notes high regional risk in sub-Saharan Africa. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ「拡大」：コンゴ民主共和国が452例と82人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常で予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施済）。エボラウイルス感染症は最高レベルのリスク病原体であり、WHO PHEICが宣言されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが記載されているが、サマリー上ではウガンダは輸入症例（19例、2人の死亡）の報告国であり、主な流行地はDRCのイトゥリ州およびキブ州。主要な発生地はDRCであるため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。WHO PHEICが2026年5月17日に宣言されており、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（30-50%致命率）による大規模流行として高度のリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cómo la desinformación está agravando la epidemia de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Misinformation Is Worsening the Ebola Epidemic
article.articleSummary: Three weeks into the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, in Ituri Province’s Mongbwalu, 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths were reported as of June 6, 2026. Laboratory confirmation by the INRB in Kinshasa established Ebola as the cause, marking the outbreak’s status as the 17th Ebola epidemic in DRC since 1976. The Bundibugyo variant circulating has no vaccine. Misinformation is hindering containment: residents doubt the diagnosis and blame coffins or humanitarian workers’ vehicle antennas for transmission, fueling panic. In late May, enraged crowds at Mongbwalu General Hospital torched MSF tents, prompting staff withdrawal; 18 patients under observation disappeared amid the confusion. Conspiracy theories—ranging from lab origins to bioweapons, involving President Félix Tshisekedi and virologist Jean-Jacques Muyembe—complicate response efforts. Global funding cuts and reduced health-communication budgets worsen emergency responses, underscoring the need for trusted community leadership and access to reliable information.

triage.headline_ja: 新型エボラウイルス感染症の拡大：偽情報がコンゴ民主共和国の第17次流行を悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、未知のワクチン非対応株、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行性・管理可能性が全て該当。エボラ出血熱の新規アウトブレイクは重大シグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo variant は既知のエボラ変異株だが、報告されている地域ではワクチン利用不可。MSF施設への暴力行為、患者の失踪、陰謀論による対応阻害など、疫学的コントロール困難な状況。国際的な保健危機管理および情報戦略支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Nearly 500 Ebola Cases Confirmed as Central Africa Outbreak Expands, WHO Warns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa has reached 471 confirmed cases and 84 deaths (as of 2026-06-06), spanning the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 452 cases and 82 deaths and neighboring Uganda with 19 cases and 2 deaths. Declared May 15 in northeastern DRC, the outbreak is believed to have circulated undetected before confirmation, fueling rapid spread. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO has classified the situation as an international public health emergency, warning of possible further expansion. A six‑month emergency response plan totaling $518 million by WHO and Africa CDC targets enhanced surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection control. If uncontained, modelling suggests potential growth similar to the 2014 West Africa Ebola epidemic (28,000+ cases, 11,000+ deaths). Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱の大流行が拡大、約500例が確認、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、国際的に拡大するリスク極度に高く、渡航制限リスクも顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCで452例82死、ウガンダで19例2死の計471例84死が確認されている。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。DRCのみが対象国リスト内で且つ記事の主題である。Bundibugyo株のエボラで治療薬がなく、未検出での流行期間があり、2014年西アフリカエボラ流行（28,000例以上、11,000例以上死亡）と同規模に成長する可能性がモデリングで示唆されている。WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Новий спалах Еболи в Африці ризикує стати масштабнішим за епідемію 2014 року, - ВООЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Ebola outbreak in Africa risks becoming larger than the 2014 epidemic, WHO.
article.articleSummary: 471 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 82 deaths have been reported in the region, per WHO data. The vast majority of cases are in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Uganda reporting 19 confirmed cases. In the last 24 hours, health authorities recorded a sharp rise in infections, raising concerns that the outbreak could worsen. The CDC warns that, without decisive action, this wave could be larger than the 2014 West Africa Ebola epidemic. 'Such scale is possible,' said CDC Director Jason Asher, commenting on the outbreak's risks. The report underscores ongoing regional spread and the potential for rapid escalation.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの新たなエボラ出血熱の流行は2014年の流行より大規模になる危険性がある、WHO警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、地域的な急速な拡大が確認され、シグナルとして緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、アンゴラが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダ（226074）およびアンゴラ（3351879）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。過去24時間の感染急増、CDC長官による警告、2014年西アフリカ流行との比較など、高いリスク指標が複数確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: África Central tem quase 500 casos confirmados de ebola de acordo com a OMS; saiba mais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Africa has nearly 500 confirmed Ebola cases according to the WHO; learn more.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the World Health Organization reports nearly 500 confirmed Ebola infections in Central Africa, with 452 cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) since the outbreak began about three weeks ago. In Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths are recorded. The totals reach 471 cases and 84 deaths, up 100 cases and 20 deaths from the prior day. The outbreak, declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, could rival the record 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that killed over 11,000. The strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. On Friday, WHO and Africa CDC launched a USD 518 million plan for the next six months, focusing on surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention and control, as Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the outbreak is advancing rapidly.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカでエボラの確認症例がほぼ500件に達する、WHO発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。PHEICが既に宣言されており、急速な拡大、高い死亡率、ワクチン・治療法なし、国際的な支援体制が発動されている。シグナルピックアップ必須。
triage.notes: 2014-2016年の西アフリカエボラ流行（死者11,000人以上）に匹敵する規模になる可能性あり。Bundibugyo株でワクチン・承認治療法なし。DRCで452例82死、ウガンダで19例2死。3週間で100例・20死の増加。PHEICが既に宣言。WHOとアフリカCDCが6ヶ月間で5.18億ドルの対応計画を発動。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Can deforestation predict Ebola outbreaks? Q&A with CDC's Carson Telford
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Central and East Africa has at least 49 deaths; ongoing transmission in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. A CDC-led study analyzed 24 Ebola spillover events from 2001–2022 using a machine-learning model that incorporated deforestation, forest loss/fragmentation, population density, and other landscape variables to predict spillover risk. The analysis found a strong link between forest change and outbreak risk, with high-risk areas including remote, low-density regions. In one DR Congo town, the model ranked it in the top 0.1% of predicted risk a few months before a 2022 outbreak; in Uganda, a district appeared in the top 6%. The model’s value is in communication and early detection, not precise timing. Local forest loss within 10 km raised spillover odds; two outbreaks occurred the following year, in DR Congo (highest-risk location) and in Uganda (top 1% year-to-year increase).

triage.headline_ja: 森林破壊はエボラ出血熱の流行を予測できるか？CDCのカーソン・テルフォードとのQ&A
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された流行であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）を2つ以上満たす。DRCとウガンダで現在も感染が続いており、少なくとも49人の死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCの東部での継続的な感染伝播が主体で、ウガンダは2022年の過去の流行事例として言及されている。現在の流行の主要な地域は「東部DRC」と述べられており、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。記事はエボラの流行予測モデルに関する解説記事だが、現在進行中の流行（Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak）が基盤になっており、シグナルとして識別すべき。

article.articleHeadline: El estadounidense tratado de ébola en Berlín recibe el alta médica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The American treated for Ebola in Berlin is discharged from hospital.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor treated for Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant in Berlin has been discharged from Charité University Hospital in good condition. He was admitted May 20 after contracting Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; initial symptoms were typical of Ebola and he presented a high viral load. By May 30 the virus was no longer detectable, allowing the isolation to end under international standards. His wife and four children were close contacts but remained asymptomatic and were quarantined separately. The patient received a combination of antiviral therapy and other measures, with early improvement in the first week and some experimental treatments being tested. At the request of the U.S. government, he had been transported from Uganda to Germany on a special flight under stringent security. He expressed gratitude to the hospital staff for the care received.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱で治療を受けていたアメリカ人患者がベルリンで退院
triage.triage_reason: 患者は既に完治し退院しており、濃厚接触者は無症状で隔離下にある。イベントは既に収束段階であり、新たなアウトブレイク発生を示唆する要素はない。
triage.notes: 患者の感染源はDRCで確認されているが、イベントは既に個別症例の治療結果報告であり、感染症危機のシグナルではない。ベルリンの医療施設は適切に対応し、患者は完治し、濃厚接触者は無症状で隔離管理下にある。対象国のうちDRCのみがイベント発生国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Elon Musk mobilise Starlink contre Ebola : 150 kits de connexion destinés aux régions affectées en Afrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elon Musk mobilizes Starlink against Ebola: 150 connectivity kits destined for the regions affected in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Starlink delivered 150 high-speed internet kits to Africa CDC to bolster Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, specifically Ituri and North Kivu. The kits target rural health zones lacking mobile networks, enabling real-time case reporting, patient transfers, and procurement of medical supplies. Africa CDC Director General Dr. Jean Kaseya called the donation opportune, saying epidemic control hinges on speed, coordination, and information. Kinshasa had authorized Starlink services in May 2025, amid long-standing digital gaps: in 2023 only about 30% of the DRC population had internet. In the short term, improved treatment center responsiveness and community surveillance are anticipated; however, questions remain about long-term funding and maintenance, given Starlink’s private, costly model. Africa CDC aims to push for systemic emergency connectivity across risk zones, not reliance on a single provider. Deploying in conflict areas raises security and sustainability concerns; connectivity cannot replace functional hospitals, trained staff, or resilient supply chains.

triage.headline_ja: イーロン・マスクがStarlinkでエボラ対策を支援：アフリカの影響地域に150の接続キットを配備
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生地域（DRC・イトゥリ地域）における実際の流行イベントであり、IHR基準で重症度・異常性・国際的関心が該当する。公開感染症対応支援というニュース価値も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は東DRC（イトゥリ地域）における活動的なエボラ流行に対し、Africa CDCが国際的支援を受けた感染症対応強化の事例。サマリーから実際の患者発生・死亡・流行継続の示唆があり、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当。Kinshasa、Ituri地域の記載から発生地域検証済み。情報源の信頼性（africapresse.com）には留意が必要だが、Africa CDC幹部引用があるため一定の信頼性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Infectious disease specialist warns of the risk of Ebola to the country
article.articleSummary: Dominican Republic's infectious disease specialist Héctor Balcácer warns Ebola could reach the country as the outbreak surfaces in the northwestern Democratic Republic of Congo. He notes rapid international reporting should alert authorities worldwide. The DRC has imposed movement restrictions and a quarantine; however, given Congo borders nine countries and high mobility, vigilance is essential. He states Ebola has no approved treatment, vaccine, or cure, with mortality of roughly 40–60% among the infected. Despite the outbreak's rapid spread, Balcácer argues it is not a pandemic due to prompt containment measures in DRC. He urges extreme precautions to prevent entry, while reminding that seasonal viruses—influenza, adenovirus, RSV, and even COVID—pose ongoing risks; and that early medical consultation reduces complications for flu-like illnesses, especially in people over 70. The remarks were made on Ahora TV’s Al Punto vespertino.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症専門家、エボラのリスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ発生は確認されているが、ドミニカ共和国への到着は未確認。IHR基準は2つ以上該当する可能性があるが、記事は警告・推測レベルであり、実際の発生地は対象国DRCのみ。情報の確実性が中程度のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIがDominican Republicを発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーではドミニカ共和国はエボラ発生地ではなく、警告対象国。実際のエボラ発生はDRC northwestern regionでのみ確認。ドミニカ共和国での発生は未報告のため、verified_locationsからは除外。DRCはWPRO対象外（アフリカ地域）だが、国際的拡大リスクとして重要。

article.articleHeadline: Medic american vindecat de Ebola în spitalul din Berlin. Mesajul transmis la externarea sa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor cured of Ebola in the hospital in Berlin. The message delivered at his discharge.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor treated for Ebola at Berlin's Charité University Hospital has been discharged after two weeks of care. The patient contracted the rare Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo and tested negative for Ebola as of May 30, 2026, allowing health authorities to lift the isolation order at noon. The hospital reported good health and progression under antiviral therapy and supportive care, with laboratory results normalizing in the first week. The physician expressed gratitude to the Charité team and noted that experimental therapies are being considered for this strain. His wife and four children, arriving as high-risk contacts, were quarantined in a separate hospital wing and remained asymptomatic. Separately, the WHO reported that about 500 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections have been treated in Central Africa to date.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリン病院でエボラから治癒したアメリカ人医師。退院時に伝えられたメッセージ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な症例が報告されており、IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクに該当する。中央アフリカでの500件以上の確認症例に加え、先進国での治療例が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な感染症イベントはDRCで発生したエボラ感染であり、患者がベルリンで治療されたもの。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。ドイツ・ベルリンでの治療報告は重大なシグナルだが、発生地はDRCが主体。中央アフリカでの500件以上の確認症例という集団発生の兆候がある。高リスク接触者（患者の家族）の隔離により、国際的な二次感染防止体制が機能している状況が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Casi di Ebola oltre quota 400, cresce l'allarme in Africa centrale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases exceed 400; alarm grows in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa: 471 cases and 84 deaths reported, with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and 19 confirmed cases with 2 deaths in Uganda. The current outbreak, linked to the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola, was declared May 15 in northeastern DRC and is spreading rapidly; no vaccines or treatments are approved for this variant. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and a US$518 million (€449.5 million) response plan has been launched by the WHO and Africa CDC to strengthen surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. Health officials warn the epidemic could become one of the largest on record, urging rapid action to contain it where it stands and to prepare neighboring countries for swift detection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が400例を超過、中央アフリカでの懸念が増大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当する。エボラの大規模流行で国際的な懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（発生地域に含まれているが対象国リストに該当なし）での19例の確認例も報告されている。DRCが主な流行地として記事に明記されており対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concernを宣言しており、国際的な対応が進行中。Bundibugyo亜種は初めての報告とされており異常性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Οι φόβοι και οι ενδείξεις ότι εξελίσσεται σε επιδημία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The fears and indications that it is evolving into an epidemic.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 452 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 82 deaths, after 71 new infections were recorded in the last 24 hours. The outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo strain. Official government figures indicate ongoing transmission in the DRC. These figures come from official government sources. U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) modeling suggests that, without strong public health interventions, this Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC could reach dimensions comparable to or larger than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. The 24-hour surge of 71 new cases underscores ongoing transmission pressure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：流行へと発展しているという懸念と兆候
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。DRC におけるエボラウイルス病の急速な感染拡大（452確定患者、82死亡、24時間で71新規感染）、CDC モデリングによる2014-2016年西アフリカ流行規模への拡大可能性、および国際的拡散リスクが明確に示されている。
triage.notes: DRC におけるエボラ・ブンディブギオ株の急速な感染拡大が確認されている。CDC のモデリングでは西アフリカ流行規模（2014-2016年）への進展可能性が示唆されており、極めて高いリスク評価が必要。24時間で71新規感染という急増は活発な地域内伝播を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Новая вспышка Эболы в Африке рискует стать масштабнее эпидемии 2014 года, - ВОЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Ebola outbreak in Africa risks becoming larger than the 2014 epidemic, WHO says.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports 471 confirmed Ebola infections in the outbreak region, with 82 deaths. Most cases are in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered on Kinshasa, while neighboring Uganda has 19 confirmed infections. Over the last 24 hours, case numbers have surged, signaling potential rapid deterioration. U.S. CDC projections warn that, if decisive measures are not taken immediately, this wave could be heavier than the 2014 West Africa outbreak. CDC Director Jason Asher stated that such a scale is possible, underscoring the urgency of containment. The article notes ongoing regional spread and the need for swift public health action to curb a potentially larger outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの新型エボラ出血熱感染症の流行は2014年の流行を上回る規模となるリスクがある、WHO発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。471確定患者、82死亡、24時間での急速な増加、DRC（キンシャサ）とウガンダへの地域拡大、2014年流行を上回る可能性という明示的な国際的懸念があるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで2026年6月6日時点の大規模エボラ流行の即時対応を呼びかけており、DRCキンシャサを中心に発生、ウガンダへの拡大も報告。アンゴラはサマリーに明記されていないため除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国CDCの警告記載は地域イベント自体の重大性を増幅するが、発生地は対象国内に限定。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة تحصي حوالى 500 إصابة مؤكدة بإيبولا في وسط إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization counts around 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Central Africa: As of 6 June 2026, the WHO reports ~500 confirmed cases. In the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, northeast), 452 cases with 82 deaths have been reported, with the outbreak having begun on May 15 in Ituri. In Uganda, 19 cases with 2 deaths are recorded. Overall, 471 cases and 84 deaths across both countries, up 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated; transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, and early symptoms can resemble influenza, malaria, or typhoid, delaying detection. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain, making prevention and infection control essential. A joint WHO/Africa CDC plan totaling $518 million for six months targets surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged rapid, coordinated action and readiness in neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラ出血熱の中央アフリカ地域での約500件の確定患者を集計
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多数の死亡者を伴う確定患者の急速な増加が報告されており、IHR基準4項目全てに該当。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明記されているウガンダ（19症例、2死亡）については、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのイトゥリ州で452症例82死亡が報告。Bundibugyo株であり、ワクチンなし。WHO/Africa CDC $518百万の対応計画が進行中。WHO事務局長による緊急呼びかけが記載されており、国際的な関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo ya suma 452 casos y 82 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 452 cases and 82 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has grown to 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, with the epicenter in Ituri province in the east, near Uganda and South Sudan. Debuted May 15, the outbreak has spread to 25 health zones. In 24 hours, 71 new cases were confirmed; 258 people remain hospitalized or in isolation, and recoveries total 8. About 58% of identified contacts have been traced to interrupt transmission. Of the total, 424 are in Ituri, with additional cases in Kivu Norte and Kivu Sur. Uganda reports 19 cases linked to this outbreak, including two deaths; all imported from DRC, prompting border closures to tighten controls. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus is involved, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved specific treatment. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; risk is high in sub-Saharan Africa, with risk low globally.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が452例82人の死亡に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境症例19例）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言があり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo EVDは対象地域（WPRO）の範囲外（DRCはAFRO管轄）だが、国際的な脅威として重要。ウガンダは記事で言及されているが、症例の発生地は「DRCからの輸入症例」と明記されているため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。SUDが記事に言及されているが、本文では症例報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Khoảng 500 ca mắc virus Ebola được xác nhận ở Trung Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Approximately 500 cases of Ebola virus infection have been confirmed in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: On 6 June 2026, the World Health Organization reported about 500 Ebola virus infections confirmed in the ongoing Central Africa outbreak, with 471 cases and 84 deaths across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (452 cases, 82 deaths) and Uganda (19 cases, 2 deaths), up from the previous day by about 100 cases and 20 deaths. The outbreak, declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, poses cross-border transmission risks. CDC experts warn that without strong public health interventions the scale could rival the 2014 West Africa outbreak (over 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths). Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids. The outbreak began 15 May in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with likely silent spread beforehand. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain involved. On 5 June, WHO and Africa CDC pledged $518 million over six months to boost surveillance, testing, and infection prevention, emphasizing control at the source and regional readiness.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカでエボラウイルス感染が約500例確認される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルスの中央アフリカでの大規模流行で、国際的な公衆衛生の危機が明らかである。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の確認症例は約500例、死亡数84例。DRCで452例82死亡、ウガンダで19例2死亡と報告されている。ただしウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は評価対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。WHOが2026年6月6日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言し、6ヶ月間で5億1800万ドルの支援を確約。2014年西アフリカ流行（28,000例以上、11,000死亡）との比較により、重大性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: RT-Duits: Ebola-Ausbruch in DR Kongo: mehr als 450 bestätigte Infizierte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RT German: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: more than 450 confirmed infections.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus continues in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province, near Uganda and South Sudan. As of mid-May 2026 (reported by INSP, Africa CDC), 452 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, 82 deaths, 258 people in quarantine, and 8 recoveries have been documented. Ituri remains the outbreak’s epicenter, with a rapid and sustained spread within the population. Cross-border transmission has reached Uganda, where 19 infections and two deaths have been reported; Uganda has temporarily closed the DR Congo border. Ebola symptoms include fever, muscle pain, diarrhea, internal bleeding, and organ failure; transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected person. There is currently no vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Historically, Bundibugyo outbreaks have a fatality rate of about 30–50%.

triage.headline_ja: RT独語：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行：450以上の確認感染者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多数の確認患者、死亡者、国際的拡大、ワクチン・治療法なし、高い致死率により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行。452確認患者、82死亡、致死率30-50%。ウガンダへの国境越え感染（19感染、2死亡）が報告され、国際的拡大が進行中。ワクチン・治療法なし。ウガンダはコンゴ民主共和国国境を一時閉鎖。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Recibe el alta el médico estadounidense que enfermó de ébola en RDC...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The American physician who contracted Ebola in the DRC is discharged.
