article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola during the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak has been discharged after two weeks of convalescence at Berlin's Charité hospital. A May 30 PCR test was negative, allowing the isolation order to be lifted. He was admitted May 20 after confirmation of the Bundibugyo strain; his wife and four children arrived in Berlin as high-risk contacts, asymptomatic and quarantined. The Congo outbreak has reached 82 deaths and 452 confirmed cases; in the latest update, 21 deaths and 71 new cases were recorded from samples processed in Mongbwalu, Ituri province. The Bundibugyo strain has spread to Kivu and Uganda, where two more deaths occurred. There is no vaccine for this strain, and the CDC warns the outbreak could exceed deaths seen in 2014-2016, potentially over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラに感染したアメリカ人医師がベルリンで退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症のアウトブレイク（DRC）で死亡数・確認患者数が多く、ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認され、IHR基準3つ以上該当。深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株、82死亡、452確認患者）を主題としている。ウガンダへの拡大も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。ドイツ・ベルリンは患者の治療地であり、発生地ではないため除外。DRCのみが実際の発生国として verified_locations に含まれる。CDC による警告（2014-2016年の死亡数11,000人超の可能性）により社会政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo eleva a 452 los casos de ébola y suma 82 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo raises Ebola case count to 452 and adds 82 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has climbed to 452 laboratory-confirmed cases and 82 deaths as of June 6, 2026, with rapid, sustained community transmission. The update from the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) notes 71 new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours. The outbreak began in Ituri province, which borders Uganda and South Sudan, and has spread to the eastern provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu, as well as across the border into Uganda, where 19 infections have been reported, including 2 deaths. The report highlights ongoing cross-border transmission and the need for continued surveillance and public health measures to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ患者数を452人に増加させ、死亡者82人を追加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイクで重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国境を越えた伝播、国際対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク主要事象で、ウガンダへの国境越境感染も報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。Ituri および South Kivu 州はDRC内の地理的詳細。2026年6月6日時点で452確定症例、82死亡、継続中の市中伝播により全5項目のWPRO基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: americano infectado no Congo recebe alta após 17 dias internado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: An American infected in the Congo is discharged after 17 days in hospital.
article.articleSummary: An American infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been discharged after 17 days of hospitalization in Berlin's Charité hospital. The outbreak, declared on May 15, has reached about 500 cases across Central Africa. The World Health Organization warns of the severity. The virus strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment, highlighting the urgency of effective measures to halt transmission. The case represents an imported case to Germany. Authorities stress continued surveillance, isolation of contacts, and adherence to public health interventions to limit further spread. This imported case underscores the ongoing international dimension of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：コンゴで感染したアメリカ人がベルリンで17日間の入院後に退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大が確認されている。DRCで約500例の流行が発生し、ドイツへの輸入症例が報告されており、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威である。
triage.notes: ドイツでの輸入症例が報告されているが、ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。記事ではBundibugyo株による約500例の流行がDRCで発生していることが明記されており、ワクチンや承認済み治療法がない点は重大なリスク要因である。WHO警告あり、国際的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Could Hit 20,000 Cases as WHO Seeks US$518 Million
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) comprises 452 confirmed infections and 82 deaths as of 5 June 2026; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, all linked to travel from the DRC with no Kampala community transmission. Ituri accounts for 90% of cases and 76% of deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. A six‑month WHO/Africa CDC response plan (June–November 2026) seeks to strengthen emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention, clinical care, and community engagement. CDC modelling in MMWR suggests that, at only 20% isolation, there is a 65% probability cases could exceed 20,000 within three months; stronger measures are needed to avoid that. Donors have pledged about $315.8 million, leaving a funding gap; the United States has added nearly $38 million, pushing direct Ebola response past $200 million. Context: the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak totaled >28,000 cases and >11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが20,000例に達する可能性、WHOが5億1,800万米ドルを要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を複数満たし（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大のリスク、予想外の高い死亡率と患者数増加予測）、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数満たす（高い重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染と渡航に関連した地域間拡大、国際支援の必要性）。現在の確認例452件から3ヶ月以内に20,000例に達する可能性があるという中程度から重度のリスク評価である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、主要な発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州）であり、ウガンダへの越境拡大も報告されている（19例、DRCからの渡航に関連）。Bluedot APIが検出したウガンダとアメリカの位置情報は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは対象国リスト内（ID: 203312）であるため含める。現在の流行は深刻な公衆衛生危機を示す明確な指標（確認例452件、死亡例82例、3ヶ月以内に20,000例達成の可能性、承認ワクチンなし）を備えている。

article.articleHeadline: Cómo la desinformación está agravando la epidemia de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Misinformation Is Worsening the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Three weeks into the latest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, there are 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, per Africa CDC/AU on 2026-06-06. The National Biomedical Research Institute (INRB) in Kinshasa confirmed Ebola after initial misidentification as malaria or diarrheal illness, marking the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. No vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo variant currently circulating. Widespread misinformation fuels panic: rumors blame caskets and suggest humanitarian workers’ vehicles spread the virus via antennas. At Mongbwalu General Hospital, residents set fire to a MSF tent and staff were withdrawn; 18 suspected patients in observation fled. Experts warn that misinformation undermines response and call for trusted community leadership and reliable information. International funding for emergency health measures has declined, hindering outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: デマが エボラ流行を悪化させている方法
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（452例・82死亡の深刻な影響、Bundibugyo変異体の予防接種なし、国際的感染リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。DRC内での社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC内のMongbwalu（Ituri州）およびKinshasaでの当該エボラ流行を主題としており、DRCのみがverified_locationsに該当。17番目のDRCエボラアウトブレイク。Bundibugyo変異体はワクチン未対応で懸念。デマによる医療施設への暴力的対応（MSFテント放火、患者逃亡）が対応を阻害。国際資金不足も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: No News Cases Recorded as Four Patients Recover, Sent Home
article.articleSummary: On 6 June 2026, Uganda reports no new Ebola cases; four patients recovered and were discharged, bringing total discharged to four, with 13 patients still under care. Since the outbreak was declared, Uganda has recorded 19 confirmed Ebola cases; 14 are imported and 5 are Ugandan nationals. The Ministry confirmed the death of a Congolese national receiving treatment, lifting the outbreak fatalities to two. The three most recently confirmed cases were identified among known contacts of previously confirmed patients; they were already in institutional quarantine under routine monitoring when they tested positive, highlighting the effectiveness of ongoing surveillance and contact-tracing. Response activities—case management, contact tracing, surveillance and monitoring of contacts—continue in affected areas. Authorities urge public cooperation with health guidance and prompt reporting of suspected cases. Uganda remains open to travel, business and tourism.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：新規患者が報告されず、4人の患者が回復し退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では少なくとも2つ以上の基準に該当（異常・予想外なエボラ出血熱の国家間拡大。ウガンダでの確認例とコンゴ民主共和国からの輸入例）。WPRO基準でも複数該当（エボラ出血熱の重症性、国境を超える流行性、管理可能性の課題）。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダの状況が詳述されているが、GeoNamesリストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、記事で確認患者がコンゴ民主共和国の国籍者（死亡）として言及されているため含める。エボラ出血熱は極めて高いスクリーニング優先度を持つ疾患であり、複数国への拡大（または輸入例）と2つの死亡例が確認されていることから、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Nhận diện nguy cơ mắc bệnh sốt xuất huyết để chủ động phòng ngừa cho mỗi gia đình
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Identifying the risk of dengue fever to proactively prevent it for every household.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is surging in Ho Chi Minh City (TPHCM). As of May 31, 2026, the city has recorded 17,718 dengue cases, up 64.6% from the same period in 2025 (10,373). In the week of May 25–31 (week 22), there were 397 new cases. With the monsoon season into June–November, hot, humid conditions favor Aedes aegypti breeding, elevating outbreak risk and healthcare strain. Dengue now affects adults as well as children. Public health officials urge proactive household measures: keep water containers sealed, regularly replace water in flower vases, manage waste, avoid leaving damp clothing where mosquitoes can rest, and sleep under bed nets; eradicate mosquitoes and larvae. Severe dengue can cause shock, multi-organ failure; delays in care or inappropriate self-medication worsen outcomes. Parents should seek medical evaluation for children with fever 2–3 days plus warning signs (nosebleeds, gum bleeding, petechiae, abdominal pain, vomiting).

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の感染リスクを認識し、各家庭で積極的に予防する
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ホーチミン市でのデング熱急増（前年同期比64.6%増）は異常/予想外であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・流行しやすさに該当。国内対応で管理可能だが、公開衛生への影響が深刻であるためフルRRA実施推奨。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市で17,718件のデング熱患者が記録され、前年同期比64.6%の増加。モンスーン期（6月～11月）の到来により、さらなる流行リスク高い。重症デング熱の可能性も言及されている。国内公衆衛生施設の対応は相応あるが、急速な患者増加による医療逼迫の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Four-year-old dies of shigellosis in Kozhikode
article.articleSummary: Four-year-old girl from Thalakkulathoor in Kozhikode district died of shigellosis at the Institute of Maternal and Child Health (IMCH) wing of Government Medical College Hospital on June 6, 2026. She had fever and diarrhoea starting May 31 after consuming outside food, received care at private clinics and then at Government Hospital for Women and Children at Kottaparamba on June 1 before transfer to IMCH and admission to intensive care. Health authorities chlorinated water sources in Thalakkulathoor and conducted community awareness sessions. A two-year-old from Pantheerankavu, treated for shigellosis at the same hospital, was discharged on June 2. A 10-year-old from Purameri remains under treatment, admitted in May. Lab results on June 6 confirmed the infection as a water-borne illness.

triage.headline_ja: コジコード（ケーラム州）で4歳児がシゲロー症で死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の異常性・予想外性、重症度（死亡例）に該当。水道感染の可能性が認識されており、公衆衛生への重大な影響あり。対象国インドでの確認事例。
triage.notes: シゲロー症による小児死亡例と複数の追加患者が同地域で確認。水道感染が疑われ、当局が水道塩素化と社会啓発活動を実施。複数患者の同時発生がクラスター可能性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: 31 AES cases reported this year; no deaths for fourth straight year | Patna News
article.articleSummary: AES cases in Bihar reached 31 by June 1, 2026, with zero AES deaths for the fourth consecutive year. Muzaffarpur leads with 17 cases, followed by Sheohar 5, East Champaran 4, Sitamarhi 2, and West Champaran, Saran, and Gopalganj with one each. All affected children aged 2–8 were discharged after treatment. The 2019 peak saw 431 AES cases and 111 deaths in north Bihar, especially Muzaffarpur; since then, cases and deaths declined, with 2022 reporting 49 cases and 1 death, and 2023–2025 reporting 41, 42, and 34 cases with zero deaths. Authorities urge vigilance during June–July, advising districts to prepare for seasonal upticks. Muzaffarpur DM Subrat Sen credited community awareness and faster care-seeking for the zero-fatality trend, noting the Chamki ko teen dhamki campaign, emphasising nutrition and rapid hospitalisation for warning signs; JE vaccination coverage in Muzaffarpur exceeds 90% alongside routine immunisations.

triage.headline_ja: 今年31件のAES（急性脳炎症候群）が報告；4年連続で死亡ゼロ
triage.triage_reason: インド北部ビハール州での日本脳炎シーズン到来に伴う定期的な発生報告であり、今年は死亡がなく対策が奏功している状況。予想される季節的パターンであり、国際的拡大リスクや深刻な公衆衛生影響は現在限定的だが、同地域は歴史的に季節性流行地域であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の日本脳炎発生を報告しており、患者数は過去数年と比較して管理下にある。ビハール州（特にムザッファルプル）は歴史的に高危険地域だが、ワクチン接種率90%超と対策が定着している。死亡者ゼロは好ましい指標だが、6月-7月の季節的上昇への警戒が続く。IHR基準は該当せず、WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、公開情報の範囲では深刻な逸脱や対応能力不足の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola desata emergencia en campamentos mineros del Congo: se extiende alerta sanitaria urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola triggers emergency in Congo's mining camps: urgent health alert spreads.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province’s mining camps, with high cross-border mobility to Uganda. The WHO declared an international emergency and unveiled a $518 million, six-month plan to halt spread in Congo and Uganda, focusing on treatment, surveillance, labs, and risk communication. The Bundibugyo variant has no licensed vaccine or specific approved therapies; management relies on isolation, PPE, strict hygiene, and early supportive care. Detection arrived late, with the WHO noting the outbreak may have begun in January 2026, enabling months of untracked transmission. Contact tracing around 45% remains suboptimal; models warn of up to 20,000 cases if measures fail. Ituri’s mining economy and cross-border movement complicate control, including urban spread. Vaccines exist for other Ebola species; Bundibugyo vaccines are in development. Past West Africa outbreaks highlighted the need for rapid operational response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴの鉱山キャンプで緊急事態を引き起こす：緊急保健警報が拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus(致命的、ワクチンなし)の国際的な宣言済み緊急事態で、WHO公式対応と多国間(DRC・ウガンダ)での展開が確認されている。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo ebolavirus(Bundibugyo型エボラ)の発生をDRCのIturi州鉱山キャンプを中心として記述。ウガンダへの越境リスクも言及されているが、記事の主題イベントはDRCでの発生であり、同国のみをverified_locationsに含めた。WHO公式の国際緊急事態宣言($518百万の6ヶ月対応計画)、ワクチン・特異的治療薬がない状況、最大20,000症例の予測モデル、接触者追跡不十分(45%)などから極めて高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox mantiene presencia en Angola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox remains present in Angola.
article.articleSummary: Mpox remains present in Angola with cases concentrated in Cabinda and suspected cases in Moxico East. As of 6 June 2026, Angola has 28 confirmed Mpox cases and one death. Cabinda province reported seven new Mpox cases, while Moxico East registered two suspected cases under laboratory testing. In Cabinda, provincial Health Secretary Rubén de Fátima Buco said since the first signs appeared, 16 Mpox patients have been certified: 13 in the Cabinda municipality and 3 in Liambo, with ongoing contact tracing and no Mpox deaths in the province. The region borders the Democratic Republic of Congo, and reinforced epidemiological surveillance and Ebola-prevention measures are in place to prevent cross-border introductions. In Moxico East, the health office director Benilde Miguel noted two suspected Mpox cases remain isolated awaiting lab results; health authorities urge calm and reinforce preventive measures. Vaccination campaigns targeting high-risk groups, including healthcare workers, have reached about 1,400 people.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxはアンゴラに継続して存在
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxは異常かつ予想外の発生を示し、確認された複数の死亡例と国際的な国境を超えた拡大リスク（DRCとの境界）があるため、IHR基準3つ以上該当。スクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例）、流行しやすさ（接触者追跡実施中）、管理可能性（予防措置強化）が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアンゴラでのMpox発生であるが、アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれていない。ただし、記事で明記されている「DRCとの国境接触」という国際的拡大リスクにより、DRC（対象国ID 203312）をverified_locationsに含める。Ebola併記は予防措置言及であり、確認事例ではない。2026年6月のデータ年号の妥当性は評価スコープ外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola avança na África e OMS alerta para risco de epidemia como a de 2014
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances in Africa, and WHO warns of the risk of an outbreak like the 2014 one.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Africa Central has 471 confirmed cases and 84 deaths as of June 6, 2026. The Democratic Republic of Congo bears the majority with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths since May 15, when the government declared an epidemic. U.S. authorities and the World Health Organization warn the current outbreak could reach the severity of the 2014 West Africa epidemic if rapid actions are not taken. The article emphasizes ongoing transmission within the DRC and notes the regional scope in Central Africa, with no other countries detailed. The situation underscores the need for swift public health measures to prevent escalation and possible international spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカで拡大、WHOが2014年のような流行リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラの確認事例471例、死亡84例という深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラ感染症イベントは中央アフリカ全域で報告されているが、確認事例・死亡例の詳細は民主共和国コンゴ（DRC）に集中している。発生地域にはAngola（対象国外）やUS（対象国外）も含まれているが、サマリーで具体的な感染例が報告されているのはDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。WHOおよび米国当局による警告から社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Американские врачи предупредили о катастрофической эпидемии Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctors warned of a catastrophic Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: CDC warns Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda could become the largest in history, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Modeling shows that with only 20% isolation of patients, three-month cases could exceed 20,000 with a 65% likelihood; increasing isolation to 70% lowers the risk to about 5%. The report emphasizes the critical role of public-health measures as the current outbreak is already described as the largest known Ebola outbreak to date. Africa CDC director Jean Kasaya said lab-confirmed Ebola infections in DRC and Uganda have reached 397, with at least 63 deaths. By contrast, the article notes total confirmed Ebola cases in DRC have reached 452, with 82 deaths. The information is reported via The Guardian, cited by Oxu.Az.

triage.headline_ja: 米国医師がエボラの大惨事的流行について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致命性を持つ病原体であり、DRCおよびウガンダでの複数国発生は国際的懸念を呼ぶ。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が記載されているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRC（203312）のみ対象。記事はCDCからの警告として信頼度が高く、具体的な症例数（397確認感染、63死亡）および建模型分析（患者隔離20%時に3か月で20,000例超の可能性65%）が示されており、極めて高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Faith, Fear and Trust - Inside DR Congo's Fight Against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in eastern DRC (Ituri province: Bunia, Mongbwalu) caused by Bundibugyo strain—no vaccine or treatment. As of 3 June, 381 infections and 64 deaths in DRC; cases also reported in Uganda. An incident where a family buried a victim after threats from armed rebels underscores containment challenges. Cross-border transmission noted: Uganda reports 15 confirmed, one probable; a Congolese national traveled via UAE to Uganda. WHO-led response expanded testing capacity from about 40 to 800 per day, with results in 24-48 hours. Contact tracing rose from ~25% to ~45% but remains below the 90-95% target. Community engagement with traditional healers and respectful messaging aims to counter beliefs such as witchcraft. Seven recoveries, including six healthcare workers. WHO warns misinformation is dangerous and stresses collaboration under International Health Regulations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルス感染症との戦いにおける信仰、恐怖、信頼
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な多国家拡大（DRC・ウガンダ・UAE経由）、高い致死率（381感染者64死亡）、国境を越えた感染例、WHO主導の国際的対応が展開されている重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づきDRCが主要な発生地域である。ウガンダでの症例報告およびUAE経由の国際感染も記載されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス感染症で、ワクチン・治療法なし、武装勢力による遺体埋葬脅迫など社会的・政治的な重大な阻害要因が存在する。WHO主導の国際的対応が展開されており、フルのRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, il piano della Regione inviato alle aziende sanitarie: linee guida, prevenzione e coordinamento della rete ospedaliera
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the Region's plan sent to healthcare providers: guidelines, prevention and coordination of the hospital network.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk in Italy remains officially low, but authorities moved preemptively to avoid past missteps. The Italian Ministry of Health issued an ordinance to standardize guidelines and rapid interventions for suspected cases, in response to a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to renewed Ebola flare-ups in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In Sicily, regional health authorities activated a concrete action plan, defining roles, territorial competencies, and the central hospital network. Travelers from Uganda or the DRC within the prior 21 days must self-report; the 21-day window aligns with Ebola’s incubation period. Data must be entered into the national Premal system within 24 hours. Isolation rooms and PPE stockpiles (FFP3 masks, visors, gowns) are prioritized, with remote epidemiological monitoring and protected ambulance activation if needed. Laboratory confirmation is exclusively at Sacco in Milan and Spallanzani in Rome; in Sicily, Prof. Antonio Cascio leads 24/7 infectious-diseases coordination, overseeing 236 beds region-wide.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、州が医療機関に送付した計画：ガイドライン、予防および病院ネットワークの調整
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（国際的な懸念、異常性、渡航制限のリスク）。WHOによる国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言に対応した公式な準備活動であり、複数国での発生に基づく予防的措置のため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: イタリアで準備措置が取られているが、実際のエボラ発生は記事サマリーではDRC（民主共和国）とウガンダが主要な発生国と記述されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Майже 500 випадків захворювання на лихоманку Ебола зафіксовано у Східній Африці -- online.ua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 500 cases of Ebola virus disease have been recorded in East Africa -- online.ua.
article.articleSummary: East Africa faces an Ebola virus disease outbreak, with 471 confirmed cases and 82 deaths reported to the WHO, per the latest update cited by Sweden Herald; authorities warn the tally could reach near 500 soon. The CDC cautions that, without decisive public health actions, the outbreak may be larger than the 2014 West Africa epidemic, which killed over 11,000 and had about 28,000 cases. The WHO has declared Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. The report notes a sharp rise in cases in the last 24 hours, signaling possible escalation. The article does not specify infection sources or laboratory details beyond the confirmed case counts.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカでエボラウイルス病の症例がほぼ500件報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスは最重要病原体であり、確認された多数の症例、死亡、および国際的な懸念の急速な増加が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東アフリカのエボラ感染症アウトブレイクについて述べており、WHO宣言によってDRCおよびウガンダが言及されている。しかし、対象国リストでは203312（DRC）のみが含まれている。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外された。アンゴラ、モザンビーク、スウェーデンも対象国リストに含まれていない。記事の日付が2026年6月6日となっており、未来日付である点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết tăng sớm tại TPHCM, cảnh báo nguy cơ với mọi lứa tuổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever on the rise in Ho Chi Minh City, warning of risks to all age groups.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is rising in Ho Chi Minh City as the rainy season begins, now affecting all age groups. From Jan 1 to May 31, 2026, the city recorded 17,718 dengue cases, up 64.6% year-on-year, with every ward reporting cases. More than half of patients are adults, with highest incidence among 11–15 and 16–30-year-olds, signaling broader risk beyond children. Rapid urbanization, dense populations, and climate variability are cited as drivers of the Aedes aegypti vector’s breeding. Severe dengue can occur during defervescence (days 3–7 after onset), with warning signs such as abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, cold limbs, bleeding, and reduced urine. A 12-year-old survivor required massive blood transfusion. Prevention emphasizes household action—about 10 minutes weekly to clean—and seven measures: overturn pots, empty plant trays, cover containers, change vase water, use larvivorous fish, remove debris, and unclog drains. A “double shield” strategy combines vector control with vaccination to reduce incidence and severity.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市でデング熱が急増、全年齢層へのリスク警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのホーチミン市でデング熱の大幅な増加（前年同期比64.6%増）が報告され、全年齢層への感染拡大、重症化リスク、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認識されている。IHR基準では3つ該当し、シグナル識別基準を満たす。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市における2026年初5ヶ月間のデング熱症例数17,718件は大幅増加を示唆。全ワード・全年齢層への拡大、市民レベルでの予防啓発キャンペーン実施中。雨季到来に伴うAedes aegypti蚊の繁殖加速が背景。重症デング（出血熱）のリスク警告も含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Sube a 452 número de casos de ébola confirmados en RD del Congo, con 82 decesos, según informes - La Nueva Radio YA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo rises to 452, with 82 deaths, according to reports.
article.articleSummary: As of the latest situation report from the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ministry of Health, Ebola totals reach 452 confirmed cases with 82 deaths. On June 4, authorities reported 71 new confirmed cases, including 21 fatalities, in Ituri and North Kivu, indicating rapid ongoing community transmission of the Bundibugyo strain. A total of 258 patients are in isolation or hospital care, and eight have recovered. Contact tracing remains a major deficiency: among 4,766 contacts under follow-up across three provinces, only 2,755 have been observed, for an overall follow-up rate of 57.8%. These figures come from the Ministry of Health of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri and North Kivu as focal provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認症例が452件に増加、82人の死亡者を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、進行中の流行、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の活動的な流行。452確認症例、82死亡、新規症例の急速な増加（6月4日に71件）、接触者追跡の不十分性（57.8%のみ）が報告されている。DRCはWHOの通知対象国。

article.articleHeadline: US doctor declared Ebola-free after treatment in German hospital
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, a United States doctor, Dr Peter Stafford, has been declared Ebola-free after treatment in Germany. Stafford contracted the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola while working as a medical missionary in the Democratic Republic of Congo, amid the outbreak there. He was airlifted to Berlin’s Charité University Hospital in May and admitted on May 20 to a high-containment facility, receiving specialised care and experimental therapies for the Bundibugyo variant. Authorities say there are no traces of the virus detected in his body since the end of May, and his isolation has been lifted as he no longer poses a transmission risk. His wife and four children, considered high-risk contacts, were brought to Berlin for observation; none developed symptoms. The recovery comes as hundreds of suspected cases continue to be reported in the DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 米国医師、ドイツの病院での治療後エボラ出血熱から完治を宣言
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定患者の完治例であり異常/予想外な情報ではあるが、患者は既に隔離解除され感染リスクはなく、DRC発生地での流行報告は継続中だが本記事の主題は個別治療事例。情報不足のため経過観察段階とする。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCでBundibugyo株に感染し、ドイツで治療を受けた。記事の主題はDRCでの治療事例であり、DRCの進行中の流行は言及されているものの、本記事自体は個別患者の完治報告。ドイツ及び米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta por expansión del brote de ébola en África | MÁSNOTICIAS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the expansion of the Ebola outbreak in Africa | MÁSNOTICIAS
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a severe Ebola outbreak as of 2026-06-06, with 82 deaths and more than 450 confirmed cases. Ebola virus disease causes hemorrhagic fever and has a high mortality rate. International health authorities, including the World Health Organization, warn of outbreak expansion. Response measures include outbreak containment, isolation of patients, and preventive vaccination campaigns in affected communities. The situation is especially critical in rural areas with limited access to health services, where international support is needed to ensure medical supplies, trained personnel, and effective public information campaigns. No details on infection source or exported/imported cases are provided in the report. Ongoing international humanitarian efforts are essential to control transmission and support health systems in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカのエボラ流行拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で肯定的。エボラ出血熱は国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、450以上の確認症例と82人の死亡、拡大警告、国際支援の必要性から、直ちにフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にコンゴ民主共和国での爆発的エボラ流行を記述。450以上の確認症例と82人の死亡は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示唆。WHO警告とアフリカでの拡大リスク、医療資源不足の農村部での国際支援必要性が明記されており、全WPROs基準を満たす。直ちにリスク評価チームへの引き渡しが必須。

article.articleHeadline: Sukelti trys su Ebolos aukomis susiję gaisrai, kodėl internautai kaltę verčia Billui Gatesui?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three fires linked to Ebola victims have been set; why are netizens blaming Bill Gates?
article.articleSummary: Three arson attacks on Ebola treatment centers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo occurred within a week as residents vented anger over burial practices and ongoing Ebola transmission after death. False claims circulated that Bill Gates incited the fires; fact-checkers say the fires are unrelated to Gates. On May 22, residents burned a tent at an Ebola treatment center, the second such attack in the region that week. No injuries were reported, but 18 people suspected of Ebola fled the facility and are now missing, according to Dr. Richard Lokudi, director of the local hospital. The incidents reflect frustration that families cannot retrieve bodies and bury loved ones promptly, since the virus can remain active post-mortem.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の犠牲者に関連した3件の放火事件、なぜネット利用者はビル・ゲイツを非難しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス病流行中に発生した治療施設への複数の放火事件により、18人の疑い患者が施設から脱出・行方不明となっており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とウイルス伝播リスク増加が生じている。IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性）を満たし、継続的な曝露リスクと管理可能性の課題が存在する。
triage.notes: エボラ治療施設への放火は社会不安・不信の表れであり、18人の疑い患者が施設から脱出したことで地域内での二次感染リスク増加。死後のウイルス活性や埋葬慣行をめぐる誤解・コミュニティ対立が公衆衛生措置の実施を困難にしている。社会政治的な背景がある複雑な事象であるが、感染症制御上の脅威は顕著。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Fast 500 bestätigte Ebola-Fälle in Zentralafrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Almost 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, nearly 500 confirmed Ebola cases are reported in Central Africa, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo recording 452 confirmed infections and 82 deaths, and Uganda reporting 19 confirmed cases with 2 deaths. The WHO noted an increase of about 100 cases and 20 deaths since Friday. In mid-May, the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, its second-highest alert level. Ebola, transmitted via body fluids and causing fever with bleeding, is linked to the Bundibugyo virus variant, for which there is no specific treatment or licensed vaccine. The report emphasizes confirmed case counts and ongoing need for surveillance and public health measures to contain spread and protect affected populations.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: 中央アフリカでエボラ確認患者がほぼ500例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてが該当し、エボラ出血熱の集団発生として深刻な公衆衛生脅威である。WHO既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しており、国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「19確認例、2死亡」と言及されており、主要な発生地はDRCである。DRCのみ対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。本イベントはWHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月中旬）済みであり、既に国際対応が進行中の高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 감염 미국 선교사, 독일 병원서 치료받고 퇴원
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-infected American missionary treated at a German hospital and discharged.
article.articleSummary: An American surgical medical missionary, Peter Stapford, contracted Ebola in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, and was treated at Berlin's Charité – Universitätsmedizin. Admitted April 20 with Ebola symptoms, he recovered and was discharged June 6, with five quarantined family members also released. Hospital officials said Stapford received intensive care, including an experimental therapy in clinical trials, and no virus has been detected since April 30. Stapford and his wife Rebecca and four children were brought to Germany as close contacts. Reports cited White House opposition to repatriation; the White House denied this, saying health and safety guided the decision and praising Charité's capabilities. WHO reports 471 cases and 84 deaths in DRC and neighboring Uganda, and has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; the CDC warns the outbreak could become the largest Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染したアメリカ人宣教師、ドイツの病院で治療を受けて退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱はWHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している疾患であり、既に471症例・84死亡が発生。患者の国際間移動とその治療経過は国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部イトゥリ州でのエボラ感染と、ドイツでの治療経過を報道。対象国はDRCのみ。ウガンダは隣国で症例が報告されているが、記事の主題は患者の治療経過であるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。エボラはPHEIC宣言済みであり、高リスク疾患。

article.articleHeadline: Новая вспышка Эболы в Африке: уже почти 500 случаев, ВОЗ опасается масштабной эпидемии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola outbreak in Africa: nearly 500 cases so far, WHO fears a large-scale epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in East Africa continues to grow rapidly. As of 2026-06-06, WHO confirms 471 confirmed Ebola infections and 82 deaths in the region, with Swedenherald noting nearly 500 cases overall. Most cases are registered in Kinshasa, DR Congo, while neighboring Uganda has 19 confirmed infections. Over the last 24 hours, medical teams recorded a sharp rise in cases, suggesting potential escalation of the outbreak. CDC warns that without immediate decisive action, this wave could be heavier than the West Africa epidemic that devastated the region more than a decade ago. The article notes ongoing regional spread and calls for urgent public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの新たなエボラ出血熱流行：既に約500件の症例、WHOが大規模流行を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準でも5項目中5項目すべてが該当。エボラウイルスの多国間流行であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、主流行地はキンシャサ（DRC）であり、ウガンダへの越境感染（19例）も記載されている。しかし、ウガンダ・モザンビーク・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。CDCからの警告およびWHOの懸念が公式に述べられており、社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。配信日時が2026年であるため、将来予測シナリオの可能性もあるが、イベント評価として進める。

article.articleHeadline: OMS regista cerca de 500 casos e mais de 80 mortos de ébola na RDC e no Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO records around 500 Ebola cases and more than 80 deaths in the DRC and Uganda
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, the WHO reports about 471 Ebola infections across the DRC and Uganda, with 84 deaths. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 452 cases are confirmed with 82 deaths; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases, including two deaths. Totals rise by 100 cases and 20 deaths in 24 hours. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, with case fatality potentially up to 50%. At least six people have survived, the latest American treated in Berlin discharged. A WHO-led plan totaling USD 518 million over the next six months targets enhanced surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids. The outbreak was declared in the DRC three weeks ago.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ感染者約500人、死者80人以上を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の発生、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。既に複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）に及び、ドイツへの症例輸入確認済み。フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ発生は主にDRCとウガンダで報告されているが、評価対象国リストに基づいてDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。既に国際的な広がり（ドイツへの患者搬送・治療）が確認されており、Bundibugyo strain（ワクチン・特異的治療なし）であることが重症リスク。24時間で100症例・20死亡の増加率から急速な流行の可能性が高い。WHO資金支援要請（5.18億USD/6ヶ月）が行われている。シグナルとしてフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Virginia Records Highest Measles Count on Record While Major World Cup Gateway Links to Mexico's Growing Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Virginia reports a record 77 confirmed measles cases as of June 2, 2026, making it a high-risk state amid a national outbreak (CDC: 1,983 cases across 40 jurisdictions as of May 28, 2026; 30 outbreaks; 93% linked to outbreak chains). Most infections occur in unvaccinated or under-vaccinated individuals, with chains anchored in low MMR-coverage communities. The outbreak overlaps with Dulles International Airport (IAD), designated for enhanced Ebola screening for travelers from DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days of arrival; travelers from measles-active countries like Mexico and Guatemala connect to flights bound for World Cup sites in Philadelphia and New York. Measles is airborne and can persist in enclosed spaces for about two hours (R0 12–18). Clinicians should elicit travel and event history, keep high suspicion for fever-plus-rash in unvaccinated patients, and report suspected cases promptly.

triage.headline_ja: バージニア州が過去最高の麻疹患者数を記録 メキシコの感染拡大に関連する主要ワールドカップゲートウェイ
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は全米40の管轄区で1,983例（IHR基準：異常性・国際的拡大リスク該当）、バージニア州単独で77例の過去最高記録。メキシコ・グアテマラから対象国への接続あり。ワールドカップ開催地（フィラデルフィア・ニューヨーク）への旅行関連リスクが顕著。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはSudan, Uganda等複数国が含まれるが、記事サマリーの主要イベント（麻疹爆発）はUS国内。国際接続はメキシコ・グアテマラ発ですが、対象国はDRCのみ該当（Ebola screening提及）。記事は2026年日付で時間的に遠い報告。Ebola とMeasles の併記も注目。

article.articleHeadline: Смертельний вірус виходить з-під контролю: ВООЗ б'є на сполох через новий спалах в Африці
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly virus is out of control: WHO sounds the alarm over a new outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in East Africa has reached 471 confirmed cases and 82 deaths as of 2026-06-06, with the Democratic Republic of Congo bearing the main burden and the virus already spreading to Uganda (at least 19 infections). A sharp rise in new cases over the past 24 hours heightens fears of a regional epidemic. The World Health Organization and national health services are strengthening controls, but experts warn that time is running out to contain transmission. CDC Director Jason Asher warned the situation poses serious regional risks and urged rapid, decisive action to prevent a repeat of one of the deadliest Ebola outbreaks in the 21st century. The report underscores the urgent need for coordinated international response to stop cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的ウイルスが制御不能に：WHOがアフリカでの新たな爆発について警告を発する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、高い死亡率、国際的な地域内拡大、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準全て該当。エボラウイルスの多国間拡大で国際的な対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで東アフリカのエボラ流行が言及されており、DRCが主要な影響国、ウガンダへの拡大（19例以上）が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。モザンビークも発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーに明示的な言及がないため除外。DRCのみ確実に該当する対象国。世界的な公衆衛生上の脅威として最優先事項。

article.articleHeadline: Смертельный вирус выходит из-под контроля: ВОЗ бьет тревогу из-за новой вспышки в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus spirals out of control: WHO warns of a new outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus is spreading rapidly in East Africa, with 471 laboratory-confirmed cases and 82 deaths as of June 6, 2026. The Democratic Republic of Congo bears the overwhelming burden of infections, while the disease has crossed borders into neighboring Uganda, where at least 19 cases have been reported. International media citing WHO data warn that the outbreak could worsen quickly if not contained. U.S. CDC Director Jason Asher expressed grave concern that, without urgent action, this resurgence could rival one of the deadliest Ebola epidemics in West Africa more than a decade ago. Health authorities and the WHO have intensified surveillance and control measures, but experts say time to curb transmission is shrinking. The article underscores regional risk and calls for rapid, coordinated international response to prevent a regional epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なウイルスが制御不能になりつつある：WHOがアフリカの新たな流行について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の急速な拡大、複数国への越境、高い死亡率、国際的な懸念表明があり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot発生地域にはAngola、Mozambique、USAも含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主としてDRCとウガンダでの発生のみ明記されている。対象国リスト内でサマリーに明示的に言及されているのはこの2か国のみ。エボラは高病原性、高致死率、人間-人間感染性があり、West Africa epidemicとの比較言及は国際的な深刻性認識を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola com 71 novos casos pode ser um dos maiores da história | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola outbreak with 71 new cases could be one of the largest in history | A TARDE
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province, centered on Mongbwalu, has 452 lab-confirmed cases and 82 deaths, after 71 new cases and 21 additional deaths were reported in one day. Health authorities expanded testing in Mongbwalu as the outbreak intensifies. The outbreak has spread across two dozen health zones in three eastern provinces and crossed into Uganda, where 19 cases are confirmed. A CDC modeling analysis warns the Bundibugyo strain could become one of the largest Ebola epidemics if control measures are not accelerated. Containment faces armed conflict, mass displacement, porous borders, and fragile health systems. WHO and Africa CDC launched a continental plan seeking about $319 million by November (final plan $518 million). Symptoms began between May 14–23, with a second wave May 25–June 3. No licensed vaccine or approved therapy specific to Bundibugyo; vaccines and treatments are under development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が新たに71例増加—過去最大規模の流行の一つになる可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（452確認例、82死亡）、国際的な拡大（ウガンダへの越境）、異常性、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）への越境例19例あり。CDCモデリングにより最大規模の流行になる可能性が警告されている。武力紛争、大規模避難民、多孔国境、脆弱な保健システムが制御困難な要因。WHOとアフリカCDCが319百万米ドルの資金を求めている。Bundibugyo株に対するライセンス取得ワクチン・承認治療法なし。

article.articleHeadline: Punjab (India): la doppia emergenza droghe-HIV, gli aghi condivisi alimentano il contagio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Punjab (India): the dual drug-use and HIV emergency, shared needles fuel transmission.
article.articleSummary: Punjab, India, faces a dual HIV and intravenous drug use emergency, with needle sharing driving transmission. Bathinda district recorded 10,100 HIV cases from 2019 to April 2026, with a rise since 2022. The main transmission factor is needle/syringe sharing among intravenous drug users (IDU); activists report reuse even where free supplies exist. At Ludhiana Civil Hospital's ART center, new HIV registrations show IDU share rising from 52.6% (2020–21) to 74.2% (2023–24), with new HIV cases up about 25% in recent years. Punjab has around 8,000 people living with HIV; adult prevalence 0.42%, with 21 of 23 districts prioritized. NACO head Rakesh Gupta, speaking in Zirakpur in April 2026, stressed IDU's central role and urged urgent action. Among IDU, Punjab's HIV seroprevalence is 21.2%, the highest statewise; national IDU average is 7.71%. Proximity to the Golden Triangle and Afghanistan drug routes facilitates access to injectables. Harm-reduction measures exist, but sharing persists.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ（インド）：薬物乱用とHIVの二重危機、共有針が感染を加速
triage.triage_reason: インドのパンジャブ州でHIV感染が急速に増加している公衆衛生上の深刻な危機であり、注射針共有による特異的な伝播パターンが報告されている。国家的な関心と対策が求められている。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのパンジャブ州における注射薬物使用者（IDU）間のHIV感染急増を主題としている。Bathinda地区では2019年〜2026年4月で10,100件のHIV症例が記録され、2022年以降増加傾向。IDU間のHIV血清有病率21.2%は全州で最高。NACO（National AIDS Control Organization）の責任者が2026年4月にZirakpurで緊急対策を呼びかけている。アフガニスタンはシルクロード経由の薬物ルート関連で言及されているが、アフガニスタン国内での感染イベントではなく、インドへの流入経路として記述されているため、verified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Tem alta cidadão americano que contraiu ebola na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Discharged: American citizen who contracted Ebola in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: An American citizen who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been discharged after 17 days of antiviral treatment, Charité University Hospital in Berlin announced on Saturday. The patient, who worked as a surgeon for a Christian missionary group in the DRC, is reported to be in good health. Five family members who were quarantined with him are also in good health and remain under quarantine. The report confirms recovery following antiviral therapy and discharge from hospital, with no additional clinical details provided by Charité. As of 2026-06-06, this discharge stands as the latest update on the case.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラに感染したアメリカ市民が退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認患者であり異常・予想外な事例だが、患者は既に完治して退院し、追加の臨床リスクは不明。濃厚接触者も健康状態にあるため、現時点ではピックアップに値する急切迫性は限定的。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC内での感染確認と患者の完治・退院である。ベルリン（ドイツ）での治療は二次的な情報であり、感染イベント発生地はDRC。患者の完治と濃厚接触者の健康状態から、現在の公衆衛生リスクは相対的に低いと判断される。しかし確認されたエボラ事例として要経過観察。

article.articleHeadline: Emirates issues Ebola travel advisory as UAE tightens entry and visa rules
article.articleSummary: Ebola travel advisory: Emirates and UAE tighten entry rules. From 2026-06-06 13:00 Dubai time, the UAE will deny entry to travelers who have recently been in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, or South Sudan unless they have spent at least 21 days outside these countries prior to arrival. The restriction applies to all passengers, including those on indirect or connecting flights; transit through the UAE must comply with the entry rules of the final destination. Emirates stated that entry and transit restrictions apply universally until further notice. The article centers on Ebola-related risk in the affected countries, but provides no case counts, laboratory confirmations, or explicit infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: エミレーツがエボラ出血熱の渡航勧告を発表、UAEが入国およびビザルールを厳格化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）からの入国制限が実施されており、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」と「渡航・貿易制限リスク」に該当。国家レベルの公式対応が行われている。
triage.notes: 記事は主にUAEの入国制限措置についてであるが、その背景はDRCでのエボラ出血熱の流行。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。DRCはシグナル検出対象国であり、国家レベルでの入国制限実施は国際対応の証拠であり、フルRRAへの進行が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Aumentan casos de ébola en África Central; suman casi 500 contagios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases rise in Central Africa; nearly 500 infections in total.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports nearly 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa. The Congo accounts for the majority with 452 cases and 82 deaths, while Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths. Specialists warn that without stricter control measures, the outbreak could reach dimensions similar to the 2014 epidemic, the most severe in history. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals. International health authorities have maintained a global alert for the spread of this current strain, which has no available vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカにおけるエボラ患者が増加；ほぼ500件の感染報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルスは最高リスク病原体であり、ワクチン未利用でヒト-ヒト感染のため即座にRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCで452例・82例の死亡、ウガンダで19例・2例の死亡が報告されている。ただし対象国リストではウガンダ（1269750でなく別ID）は含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ記載。エボラは最高リスク病原体（no available vaccine、high mortality）であり、2014年流行並みの拡大警告があるため早急なRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Los casos de ébola ya superan los 400 en África central
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases have already surpassed 400 in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa has surpassed 400 cases, with 471 confirmed cases and 84 deaths reported across the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as of 2026-06-06. The World Health Organization (WHO) reports 452 of the DRC cases are confirmed with 82 deaths, while Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The rapid rise in cases—an increase of about 100 cases and 20 deaths in 24 hours—follows an outbreak officially declared in northeastern DRC on May 15 and linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. There are no vaccines or approved treatments for this variant. The WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and a $518 million plan by the WHO and Africa CDC aims to strengthen surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. WHO Director-General Tedros emphasized rapid, coordinated action and preparedness of neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数が中央アフリカで400例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）し、WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。WHOが国際的保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの言及がありますが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙しました。エボラ感染症は Bundibugyo ebolavirus 株で、ワクチンと承認治療法がない重篤な病原体です。24時間で100例の急速な増加、WHOによる国際的保健上の緊急事態宣言、$518百万の対応計画により、フルRRA実施が急務です。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: почти 500 случаев Эболы зафиксированы в расширяющейся вспышке в Центральной Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Almost 500 Ebola cases recorded in an expanding outbreak in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports almost 500 confirmed Ebola cases in a expanding Central Africa outbreak, with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda most affected. Latest figures show 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in DRC, plus 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths in Uganda, totaling 471 cases and 84 deaths. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Officially declared on May 15 in northeastern DRC, transmission is believed to have begun earlier. WHO, alongside Africa CDC, unveiled a response plan worth $518 million to boost surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, and infection prevention. The surge prompted a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Authorities stress rapid, coordinated action to halt spread at current sites and to prepare neighboring states for quick detection and response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：中央アフリカで拡大するエボラ流行により約500例が記録される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス、高い致死率、複数国への拡大、PHEIC宣言により、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。DRCが主な発生地。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株（ワクチン・治療法なし）、PHEIC宣言済み、$518M対応計画が特記事項。

article.articleHeadline: Nearly 500 confirmed cases in Central Africa deadly Ebola outbreak, says WHO
article.articleSummary: Central Africa Ebola outbreak of Bundibugyo species: as of 2026-06-06, 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and 19 confirmed cases with 2 deaths in Uganda, totaling 471 cases and 84 deaths—up 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The outbreak, declared May 15 in northeastern DRC, is evolving toward potentially the largest on record; the WHO has declared an international public health emergency. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain. Ebola spreads through close contact and bodily fluids. The US CDC warned models suggest the outbreak could approach the scale of the 2014 West Africa epidemic if not contained. A $518-million plan by WHO and the African CDC aims for six months of enhanced surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention, with emphasis on rapid detection and readiness in neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカの致命的なエボラ出血熱の大流行で約500の確認症例、WHOが報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo種）の大規模流行で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際公衆衛生緊急事態宣言、複数国への拡大、国際支援の必要性が明白。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダは2番目の事例報告国として言及されており、主要な流行地はDRCの northeastern region。UgandaはWPRO対象国ではないため verified_locations から除外。流行は記録上最大規模に発展する可能性があり、2014年西アフリカエボラ出血熱流行との比較言及あり。WHOが国際公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Recibe el alta el médico estadounidense que enfermó de ébola en RDC tras 15 días de convalecencia en Alemania
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The American doctor who contracted Ebola in the DRC is discharged after 15 days of convalescence in Germany.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Ebola during the outbreak in northern and northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo was discharged from Berlin's Charité hospital after 15 days of convalescence. The infection is the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain identified in the DRC’s current outbreak; there is no vaccine yet. The patient was admitted May 20 after a PCR confirmed Bundibugyo; a May 30 test was negative, allowing release from isolation. His wife and four children, arriving in Berlin as high-risk contacts, were quarantined. The outbreak has caused 82 deaths and 452 confirmed cases, with the epicenter in Mongbwalu, Ituri province. The Bundibugyo strain has spread to the neighboring Kivu region and Uganda, where two additional deaths occurred. The CDC warned the outbreak could reach unprecedented levels, as authorities pursue ongoing testing and evaluate experimental therapies for this virus.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人医師、DRCで感染したエボラから回復しドイツで退院 15日間の療養後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の多国間拡大、死亡者・患者数が多く、ワクチン未開発で危機的状況。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株は対象国内（DRC）での発生であり確認。ウガンダでの2死亡やドイツでの患者受け入れは国際的拡大を示しているが、実際の流行地はDRC（Ituri州Mongbwalu）。対象国リストに基づき verified_locations は DRC のみとした。記事配信日時が2026年となっているが、タイムスタンプの誤りと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Загроза з Африки: спалах вірусу Ебола стрімко виходить з-під контролю
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Threat from Africa: the Ebola virus outbreak is rapidly getting out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Eastern Africa accelerates, with 471 laboratory-confirmed cases and 85 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of 06 June 2026; suspected cases exceed 1,000. The epicenter is Ituri Province, DRC, from which transmission has reached Uganda. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain currently has no licensed vaccines or approved antivirals. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, signaling international significance but not a pandemic. Earlier northeastern DRC outbreaks caused about 65 deaths. The situation has prompted flight cancellations, tightened international restrictions, and resource shortages in Congo’s health system. CDC Director Jason Asher warned the outbreak could scale beyond the region, while international authorities strengthen containment and surveillance to prevent spread to neighboring countries. Source cited: Swedenherald.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカからの脅威：エボラウイルスの流行が急速に制御不能になっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。DRC・ウガンダでエボラ確認症例471例・死亡85例、WHO PHEIC宣言、国際的な渡航制限と資源不足、制御不能化の懸念により高いリスク。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているがサマリーではDRCが主要な発生地。サマリー上の記述は『ウガンダに伝播した』という二次的言及のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。PHEIC宣言済み。パンデミックではないとの記述あるが、制御不能化と地域外への拡大リスクが明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | Ebola Spreads, Cholera Surges and New Gains Against Malaria in Africa
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) and Uganda totals 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths, with 233 hospitalized; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths (Kampala, Wakiso). WHO notes suspected cases reduced to 116 from over 1,000 after reclassification, but contact tracing remains about 45%. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Cholera resurges in southern Africa, with more than 68,000 cases in 2026; Angola records 2,120 new cases (late Apr–May) and Mozambique 413 (late May), driving southern Africa's burden; DRC reports 115 cholera deaths. HIV: South Africa launches lenacapavir PrEP on June 5, with 37,920 doses across 360 facilities, but U.S. funding cuts reduce new PrEP initiations by over 40%. Malaria: RTS,S/AS01 (Mosquirix) vaccines reduce child mortality in African programs; potential inclusion in immunization schedules; malaria kills over 600,000 annually, mostly African children.

triage.headline_ja: 週刊保健ニュース | アフリカでエボラが拡大、コレラが急増、マラリア対策で新たな進展
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak (381 confirmed cases, 64 deaths) in DRC and Uganda meets IHR criteria for serious public health impact, international spread risk, and unusual/unexpected events. Multiple concurrent outbreaks (cholera, malaria, HIV) across target countries warrant full RRA.
triage.notes: Article mentions Uganda and other African nations but focuses on DRC as primary Ebola outbreak epicenter. Cholera cases in Angola and Mozambique are noted but these countries are not target monitoring countries. DRC is the only verified target country for this multi-pathogen event. Ebola Bundibugyo strain lacks approved vaccine/treatment, representing heightened public health concern. Contact tracing coverage at only 45% indicates ongoing transmission risk.

article.articleHeadline: Americký lékař nakažený ebolou byl propuštěn z nemocnice
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American doctor infected with Ebola was discharged from the hospital.
article.articleSummary: An American physician, Peter Stafford, was discharged from Charité in Berlin on June 6, 2026 after successful treatment for Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. He contracted the virus while serving with a missionary group in the Democratic Republic of Congo. He was admitted to Charité’s isolation center on May 20, where tests confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus infection. His family, though not infected, remained in Berlin under a 21-day quarantine after their last contact; the quarantine was lifted on discharge day. Hospital officials called the outcome a significant therapeutic success; Stafford had been severely weakened on arrival but improved by the end of May. German Health Minister Nina Warken visited on May 27. He received experimental medicines. It remains unclear who will pay for care and whether he and his family will return to Congo, and he expressed concern for Congolese lacking access to advanced care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人医師がベルリンの病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において異常性と国際的拡大リスクが該当（2件以上）。エボラウイルス感染の国境越え（コンゴ→ドイツ）確認、治療成功例として公衆衛生インパクト高い。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、管理可能性が該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主要なイベントはコンゴでのエボラ感染であり、ドイツ・ベルリンはあくまで治療地点。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に記載。エボラウイルスの国際的移動（特に先進国への到達）、高リスク病原体の感染確認、政府高官の関与（ドイツ保健大臣訪問）により、シグナルとしてPickupの判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : près de 500 cas confirmés en Afrique centrale, selon un nouveau bilan de l'Organisation mondiale de la Santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: nearly 500 confirmed cases in Central Africa, according to a new WHO tally.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa as of 6 June 2026, per WHO. The Democratic Republic of Congo reports 452 cases and 82 deaths, with Uganda recording 19 cases and 2 deaths; total 471 cases and 84 deaths, up about 100 cases and 20 deaths from the prior day. The outbreak began in north‑east DRC on 15 May, with officials suspecting undetected circulation before declaration. Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment, underpins the current outbreak. The WHO has designated the event a public health emergency of international concern, amid warnings the epidemic could approach the 2014–2016 West Africa record of over 11,000 deaths. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids; ongoing surveillance and containment efforts are underway in DRC and Uganda, with attention to export risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：世界保健機関（WHO）の新しい統計によると、中央アフリカで約500件の確認症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4項目全て満たす。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の多国間での急速な拡大、高い死亡率、WHOによる国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）指定、西アフリカ流行との比較による深刻な警告により、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンおよび承認された治療法がない稀な株）による急速な拡大。2026年6月6日時点で471症例、84死亡。DRCで452症例82死亡、ウガンダで19症例2死亡。WHOがPHEIC指定。対象国リストにはウガンダとアンゴラが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただしWPRO基準は西太平洋地域が主要対象のため、本件はアフリカ地域のイベントとして別途の優先度評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Новий спалах Еболи в Африці: вже майже 500 випадків, ВООЗ побоюється масштабної епідемії
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola outbreak in Africa: almost 500 cases already, WHO fears a major epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in East Africa expands rapidly. As of today, WHO confirms 471 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths in the region, with Congo-Kinshasa bearing most infections and neighboring Uganda reporting 19 cases. Cumulative counts approach 500 infections. Over the past 24 hours, case numbers have surged, amplifying fears of a major epidemic. U.S. CDC warns that without decisive public health action, this wave could be heavier than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. The report emphasizes ongoing regional transmission, underscoring the urgent need for enhanced surveillance, case finding, isolation, and cross-border coordination. No treatment or vaccine details are provided in the article, and laboratory confirmation remains the basis for the counts.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの新しいエボラ感染症発生：既に約500症例、WHO は大規模流行を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。471の確定症例、82死亡、24時間での急増、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性との警告により、国際的対応が必須のシグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに DRC、ウガンダ、モザンビーク、アンゴラが列挙されているが、記事サマリーは DRC（Congo-Kinshasa）における主要発生とウガンダでの19症例を述べており、モザンビークとアンゴラについては言及がない。対象国リストに DRC のみ該当するため verified_locations は DRC のみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。国際的な死傷者規模、迅速な地域拡大、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の警告、CDC関与により、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : absence d'une communication appropriée, risque de propagation d'Ebola (Un député provincial) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: lack of adequate communication, risk of Ebola transmission (A provincial deputy) - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, North Kivu, DRC, faces the 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with five laboratory-confirmed cases and three deaths in the urban-rural health zone of Beni, spanning areas including Beni, Mangina, and Butembo. Provincial deputy Alain Siwako warns that inadequate risk communication significantly risks further transmission, urging decentralization of communication tasks to the health zone that endured the 2018 tenth Ebola outbreak (over 2,700 fatalities). He emphasizes consistent, population-focused messaging to counter ignorance and resistance. The deputy also advocates equitable deployment of partners across all affected provinces to strengthen containment and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：適切なコミュニケーション欠如、エボラ出血熱伝播のリスク（州議員）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の確認症例と死亡が報告され、IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際拡大のリスク、異常性が複数該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例）、流行しやすさ（不十分な対策）、管理可能性で該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年6月時点でDRC北キブ州のベニ地域を中心に第17回エボラ流行が発生。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による5例の確認症例と3例の死亡が報告。2018年第10回流行の影響地域であり、過去の教訓が活かされていない点が懸念。州議員による公開指摘は政治的関心の高さを示唆。リスクコミュニケーション不十分が拡大リスクを増加させている。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة تسجل 500 إصابة مؤكدة بـ"إيبولا" في وسط أفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization records 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports about 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa, with 452 cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (the outbreak began ~three weeks earlier) and 19 confirmed cases, including two deaths, in neighboring Uganda. Combined totals reach 471 cases and 84 deaths, up from the previous day by 100 and 20, respectively. The U.S. CDC warns the current outbreak could reach scales seen during 2014–2016 West Africa if strong public health measures are not implemented. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with the epicenter in Ituri province, northeastern DRC. There is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo, making containment rely on prevention and infection-control. A joint WHO-Africa CDC plan worth $518 million over six months targets surveillance, laboratory testing, and prevention, and urges neighboring countries to prepare for potential spillover.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、中央アフリカで500件のエボラ確認症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による大規模outbreak、複数国への拡大、ワクチン・治療法なし。緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（452例、82死亡）とウガンダ（19例、2死亡）での発生が明記されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めず。Bundibugyo株、Ituri province が震源地。既承認ワクチン・治療法なし。CDC警告により西アフリカ2014-2016年規模への拡大リスク懸念。6ヶ月間5.18億ドル規模の WHO-Africa CDC計画が進行中。複数国への溢出リスク指摘あり。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة تحصي حوالى 500 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا في وسط إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization records approximately 500 confirmed Ebola virus infections in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the World Health Organization reports roughly 500 confirmed Ebola infections in Central Africa, with 452 cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where the outbreak began in Ituri, northeastern DRC, about three weeks earlier. An additional 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths have been reported in neighboring Uganda, bringing totals to 471 infections and 84 fatalities across both countries. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, transmitted through direct contact with infected bodily fluids, with initial symptoms that can resemble influenza, malaria, or typhoid, delaying detection. There is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for this strain, making prevention and infection-control measures essential. A joint WHO-Africa CDC plan worth $518 million over six months focuses on surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention, with rapid cross-border readiness emphasized by Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がアフリカ中央部でエボラウイルスの確認感染者約500人を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、エボラ出血熱の多数の確認患者と死亡者、国際的な拡大、高い公衆衛生影響が確認される。フルリスク評価（RRA）に進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでの発生を記載しているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるためverified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラ出血熱の確認患者471人、死亡者84人という深刻な数値、Bundibugyo株による感染、ワクチン・承認治療なし、WHOによる$518百万の対応計画など、全てのスクリーニング基準に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Postmortem Report Reveals What Killed Laikipia Ebola Protest Victim
article.articleSummary: Postmortem findings show a 27-year-old Nanyuki resident died from a gunshot wound during protests against a proposed Ebola quarantine facility in Laikipia County, Kenya. The bullet entered the anterolateral left shoulder and exited through the right upper shoulder, indicating lethal force. VOCAL Africa sponsored the independent examination and called for accountability and prompt prosecution of those responsible. Protests erupted after the government and the U.S. proposed locating a quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base to house people exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The demonstrations in Nanyuki included running battles with police, leaving two dead and two others wounded by gunfire; 31 protesters were arrested for obstructing motor vehicles. Kenya’s High Court suspended the project pending legal review, even as authorities and the U.S. press ahead with planned preparedness; VOCAL Africa backs the family in seeking a transparent investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 検査報告書がラキピア州エボラ抗議デモ犠牲者の死因を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 本記事の主題は銃撃による死亡であり、エボラウイルス疾患の発症・流行ではない。エボラ検疫施設設置に対する社会政治的抗議であり、感染症危機管理の対象シグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事は検疫施設設置計画に関連する政治的紛争と銃撃死を報じており、実際のエボラウイルス感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。DRCでのエボラが背景として言及されているが、本記事の主題はケニアでの抗議デモと死亡事件である。感染症イベント監視の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: В Берлине вылечили американца после заражения Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Berlin, an American was cured after contracting Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An American surgeon, 39-year-old Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo while treating patients with the Christian missionary Serge, and was discharged from Charité in Berlin after 17 days of treatment. He and five family members quarantined as high-risk contacts were released in good condition. Stafford received experimental therapies; at admission he had severe symptoms and high viral load, which declined with antiviral and supportive care, and by May 30 no virus was detectable. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. The wife, also a physician, and their children were quarantined but released. The Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda has over 900 cases and 84 deaths by end May; the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, the second of three levels. The virus transmits via bodily fluids and close contact and causes hemorrhagic fever with about 50% fatality for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンでエボラに感染したアメリカ人が治癒
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な集団発生であり、WHOが国際的な保健上の緊急事態を宣言している。DRCとウガンダで900例以上の症例と84人の死亡が報告されており、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはベルリン、ドイツ、米国も含まれていますが、記事サマリーから実際のエボラ発生地はDRCとウガンダです。ベルリンはドイツの治療施設の場所であり、感染症の主な発生地ではありません。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）を宣言しており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations はDRCのみです。本イベントはフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が必須です。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : détails sur la procédure d'enterrements dignes et sécurisés des victimes d'Ebola (Croix-Rouge) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Details on the dignified and safe burial procedure for Ebola victims (Red Cross) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease burial procedures in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, were explained by a Red Cross team in Bunia on 6 June 2026. The dignified and safe burials (EDS) protocol begins with collecting a body sample using a buccal swab, followed by stabilizing the body and placing it in a mortuary bag and coffin, then transporting the coffin to the burial site. The approach aims to minimize contamination risks during body handling while preserving the dignity of the deceased. Red Cross teams work under health authorities’ protocols and partners’ guidelines, with families and communities urged to collaborate to facilitate the intervention and strengthen measures to prevent virus transmission. Authorities stress public trust in burial teams to protect families and communities from new infections in the Ebola response in Ituri’s northeastern region.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：エボラウイルス病の犠牲者の尊厳ある安全な埋葬手順の詳細（赤十字）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認イベントであり、IHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大リスク、WPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさに該当する可能性があるが、記事がエボラ対応の埋葬プロトコル説明に特化しており、新規患者数・死亡数・発生状況など重要な疫学情報が不足している。続報で新規患者の発生状況や疫学パラメータの確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はイトゥリ地域でのエボラ埋葬プロトコルの実施内容に焦点を当てており、進行中のエボラ対応の一環である。しかし記事は現在進行中の患者発生数、死亡者数、疾病パターン、流行動向などの重要な疫学情報を含んでいない。IHR基準の2つ以上に該当し、WPRO基準の複数項目にも該当するため、フルRRAの対象となるべきだが、情報の不完全性により現段階ではWATCH判定とし、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة تحذر: إيبولا يخرج عن السيطرة.. فهل نشهد وباءً مثل كورونا؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns: Ebola is out of control... Will we witness an epidemic like the coronavirus?
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports about 500 confirmed Ebola infections in Central Africa, fueling fears the outbreak could escalate beyond control. The latest tally shows 452 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo with 82 deaths, and 19 confirmed cases in Uganda with two deaths, bringing totals to 471 cases and 84 deaths in the two countries, a one-day rise of about 100 cases and 20 deaths. U.S. CDC warns the outbreak could expand to a West Africa 2014–2016-scale epidemic if strong public health interventions are not rapidly implemented. Ebola transmits through direct contact with bodily fluids and is not airborne like COVID-19, but case detection is challenging and fatality is high. The Bundibugyo strain currently lacks a vaccine or approved treatment; containment relies on prevention, isolation, testing, and contact tracing. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls for swift, coordinated action to halt spread and support affected and neighboring nations.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関が警告：エボラが制御不能に...新型コロナのような流行を目撃することになるのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの大規模流行の可能性、高い致死率、DRCとウガンダでの確認患者数の急速な増加、WHO事務局長による緊急呼びかけが報告されており、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからDRCが主要な発生地であることが明確。ウガンダも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に加えない。米国CDCの警告とWHO事務局長による声明が記載されているが、イベント発生地はDRCである。Bundibugyo strain（ブンディブギョ株）でワクチンがないことが高リスク要因として確認される。

article.articleHeadline: TP Hồ Chí Minh cảnh báo sốt xuất huyết Dengue gia tăng sớm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City warns of an early surge in Dengue Fever.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City reports an early surge of dengue fever. From January 1 to May 31, 2026, the city recorded 17,718 dengue cases, up 64.6% from the same period in 2025, with transmission detected across all 168 communes, wards, and special administrative units. More than half of current cases are adults, with the 11–15 and 16–30-year age groups showing high incidence, indicating dengue is no longer concentrated in children. Officials attribute the rise to ongoing transmission as the city enters the rainy season; persistent Aedes larvae habitats inside homes keep risk high. Dengue imposes a substantial burden on patients, families, and the health system. Dr. Lê Hồng Nga (HCDC) and Prof. Phạm Văn Quang (Children’s Hospital 1) warn against complacency and self-treatment, noting that inappropriate IV therapy can be dangerous. The briefing, organized with Takeda Vietnam, emphasizes proactive family-level prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市がデング熱の早期急増を警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるデング熱の大幅な増加報告（前年同期比64.6%増、1月から5月で17,718例）であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「長期曝露」に該当するが、死亡数や重症化率が明記されておらず、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「国際的拡大リスク」の判断に必要な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はホーチミン市における2026年上半期のデング熱の大幅な増加を報告しており、全168のコミューン/ワードで感染が検出されている。成人も含む多くの年齢層に影響しており、ベクター対策（蚊の幼虫の発生源除去）が強調されている。ただし、死亡者数、重症化率、ICU入院の必要性など、重症度を判定するための医療負荷に関する詳細データが不足しており、現段階ではWATCHとしての評価が適切。雨季の到来に伴う継続的な感染リスクが指摘されているため、続報の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حالات الإصابة بفيروس إيبولا إلى أكثر من 400 حالة مع تزايد المخاوف من تفشي المرض في وسط أفريقيا |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in Ebola virus infection cases to more than 400 as fears of an outbreak grow in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports a fast-spreading Ebola virus disease outbreak in Central Africa, with total confirmed cases reaching 471 and 84 deaths across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The latest update shows 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the DRC, and 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths in Uganda. The 24-hour increase adds about 100 cases and 20 deaths. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. The WHO and Africa CDC have launched a $518 million emergency response plan to bolster surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. The outbreak began May 15 in northeastern DRC, with authorities warning the virus may have circulated undetected prior to confirmation; WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染者が400例以上に増加、中央アフリカでの流行拡大への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、渡航制限リスク）。WHO による PHEIC 宣言済みであり、本格的なシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）とウガンダにおけるエボラウイルス病の発生を報告しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（治療法・ワクチン無）、5.18億ドルの緊急対応計画により、重要度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 미 '케냐 에볼라 센터' 건립...감염병 대응 외주화 논란
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. to Build 'Kenya Ebola Center'... Controversy over Outsourcing Infectious-Disease Response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts debate over US-led regional response. The United States plans to operate an Ebola isolation facility in Kenya for Americans exposed to the virus rather than repatriating them. After the outbreak, visa issuance was paused for foreigners who visited the affected area, and green-card holders who did so face reentry limits. Kenyan doctors’ association and courts push back, warning that abroad isolation could endanger Kenyan citizens and fail to curb domestic spread. US domestic officials and the CDC question whether Kenya can provide treatment on par with US standards and criticize outsourcing public health risk. The policy is framed as protecting Americans while raising concerns about local health risks in Kenya. Published 2026-06-07.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、'ケニア・エボラセンター'を建設...感染症対応の外注化論争
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。エボラ出血熱の地域的集中とそれに対する国際的な政策対応が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国を中心とするエボラ出血熱の集団発生とそれに対する米国の地域的対応政策である。ケニアは米国の医療施設配置予定地として言及されているが、アウトブレイクの実発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。米国は政策対応国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Depois de 17 dias, tem alta cidadão americano que contraiu ebola na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After 17 days, an American citizen who contracted Ebola in DR Congo is discharged.
article.articleSummary: American surgeon discharged in Germany after contracting Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Charité Berlin reported the patient, who worked with Christian missionaries in DRC, was released after 17 days of antiviral treatment. Five relatives in quarantine remain in good health. As of 2026-06-06, the WHO cites about 500 lab-confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa, as the outbreak declared on May 15 in northeastern DR Congo continues to unfold. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Ebola is transmitted via close contact and bodily fluids and has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past five decades. The case abroad highlights international movement related to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 17日後、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ国民が退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際移動、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。進行中の大規模エボラ流行（500件以上の確認例）と国際的な症例移動を示唆する。
triage.notes: ドイツ（ベルリン）での症例報告だが、アメリカ国民がDRコンゴで感染しドイツで治療されたケース。記事はDRコンゴでの進行中のエボラ流行（5月15日宣言、約500件の確認例、Bundibugyo株）に焦点を当てており、国際移動によるリスク増加を示す。対象国リストではDRコンゴのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ Mỹ nhiễm Ebola tại Congo xuất viện
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor infected with Ebola in Congo discharged from hospital.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has been discharged from Berlin's Charité hospital after 17 days of treatment. The patient, 39-year-old Dr. Peter Stafford, and five family members were released in good health. Stafford treated an Ebola patient in eastern DRC before the outbreak was officially announced on May 15. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and close contact. The Bundibugyo strain driving the current outbreak has no approved vaccine or therapy. At Charité, he received experimental therapies; by May 30 the viral load declined and no virus was detected thereafter. The wife, also a doctor, and their children were isolated as high-risk contacts. WHO data as of June 5 report 471 cases and 84 deaths in DRC and neighboring Uganda. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; the CDC warns the outbreak could become the largest Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人医師、コンゴでエボラ感染後、ベルリン病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルスは公衆衛生に対する深刻な影響を持ち、多国間での患者発生が確認され、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはBerlin(Germany)とUSが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRC内でのエボラ感染と国際的な患者輸送である。患者の治療地がベルリンであっても、感染発生地はDRCであり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、CDCの警告、471症例・84死亡の報告により、イベント自体の重要性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи в Африці може перевищити масштаб епідемії 2014 року - ВООЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Africa could exceed the scale of the 2014 epidemic — WHO.
article.articleSummary: East Africa Ebola outbreak: 471 confirmed cases and 82 deaths reported as of 2026-06-06, with the vast majority of infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 19 fatalities in Uganda. The total count could soon approach 500, potentially exceeding the scale of the 2014 West Africa epidemic, according to WHO data cited in the report. Despite improvements in testing and diagnostics, the outbreak in the DRC continues to outpace containment efforts.
