Uganda has 19 deaths; the Democratic Republic of the Congo accounts for most infections. The article does not provide details on the infection source or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行は2014年の流行規模を超える可能性がある - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ全て満たす。感染症危機管理として最優先対象。471例の確認患者と82人の死亡、複数国への拡大、WHO予測で歴史的規模に達する可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に言及されているのはDRCとウガンダの2国。Bluedot APIがモザンビークとアンゴラを発生地域として挙げているが、記事サマリーでは主たる流行地はDRCとウガンダとされており、モザンビーク・アンゴラへの実際の拡大は文中で記述されていない。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当するため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。本事象はWHOが2014年西アフリカ流行規模を超える可能性を示唆しており、国際的な緊急対応が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: Wayanad school food poisoning: Number of students seeking treatment crosses 120
article.articleSummary: On 6 June 2026, in Wayanad district, Kerala, Mar Baselios AUP School, Koliyadi, reported a suspected bacterial illness linked to midday meals. By Saturday evening, more than 120 students sought treatment at various hospitals; over 70 remained hospitalized, while the rest were observed and discharged. Symptoms include headache, fever, vomiting, and diarrhea; one teacher also fell ill. The district ordered a one-week school closure and scheduled inspections to determine the infection’s source. Water samples from the school and provisions used for midday meals have been collected and sent for laboratory testing. District Medical Officer K T Rekha says a suspected bacterial infection from contaminated water is the likely cause; biological samples have been collected and sent for chemical examination, with results expected in three days. Government Taluk Hospital, Sulthan Bathery, has deployed two paediatricians and five nurses in a dedicated ward; no student is in serious condition, per Agriculture Minister T Siddique.

triage.headline_ja: ワイアナド学校の食中毒事件：治療を受けた生徒数が120人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 既知の食中毒事件（細菌性疾患の疑い）で、患者数が100人を超え、複数の入院者がいるため重症度基準を満たすが、対象国内での局所的イベントであり国際拡大リスクは低い。情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 未確認の細菌感染症による食中毒イベント。患者120名以上、入院者70名以上。学校における限局的なイベントで、原因は汚染水の可能性が高い。地方当局による適切な対応（学校閉鎖、検査実施）が進行中。国際拡大リスクは低いが、確認検査結果の発表まで経過観察を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: فؤاد عودة: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا 100% خلال يوم واحد بسبب ضعف التشخيص المبكر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fuad Awda: Ebola infections increase by 100% in one day due to inadequate early diagnosis
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections have surged by 100% in the last 24 hours, with deaths up more than 20%, says Dr. Fuad Awda, head of the European Medical Association. He notes confirmed Ebola cases have surpassed 700, and daily infections today exceeded 20,000, signaling severity. He attributes the rise to inadequate early diagnosis of the new Ebola variant, arguing that diagnosing even 20% of patients early could have saved thousands of lives. The solution, he says, is stronger early diagnosis, advanced laboratories, and more specialized doctors in affected regions, especially in the Congo and Uganda. He warns WHO support covers only about half the needs and calls for full international assistance. He also urges accelerated research on rapid diagnostics, knowledge exchange among health ministers, and development of effective antivirals against the virus.

triage.headline_ja: フアド・アウダ：初期診断の不十分さにより、エボラ感染症が1日で100%増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、急速な増加で異常、DRC・ウガンダでのヒト-ヒト感染による国際拡大リスク、WHO支援の不足で渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス疾患の急速な感染拡大は最優先のシグナルとして扱うべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではコンゴとウガンダが並記され、主要な流行地はDRCと言及されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事の信憑性について：日々の新規感染者数が20,000を超えるという数字は通常のエボラアウトブレイク報告よりも極めて高く、報告源がEuropean Medical Associationという機関の長であることから検証が必要。ただしシグナルとしてはピックアップし、フルRRA段階で信憑性検証を実施すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Африке может превысить масштаб эпидемии 2014 года - ВОЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa could exceed the scale of the 2014 epidemic — WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Eastern Africa is expanding, with 471 confirmed cases and 82 deaths reported as of 2026-06-06. The Democratic Republic of the Congo accounts for the majority of cases, while neighboring Uganda has recorded 19 fatalities. The outbreak is approaching 500 cases, and officials warn it could be larger than the 2014 West Africa epidemic. The World Health Organization notes that the outbreak in eastern Africa continues to outpace containment despite improved testing and diagnostics. Most cases are concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's eastern provinces, with Uganda reporting fatalities, underscoring regional containment challenges. Containment remains a priority for public health authorities in East Africa.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行が2014年の流行規模を超える可能性 - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、複数国での発生、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクを伴う。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの複数州における感染確認、ウガンダでの死亡報告（19件）、モザンビーク・アンゴラについては言及されていない。地域検証により、確実に記述されている対象国はDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。2014年西アフリカエボラ流行との比較言及あり、規模拡大の警告が付与される。WHO通知相当かつWPRO基準5項目すべて該当することから、フルRRA進行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Carolina Dieckmann faz desabafo após diagnóstico de infecção grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carolina Dieckmann opens up after diagnosis of a serious infection.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian actress Carolina Dieckmann was hospitalized for more than four days last week and diagnosed with pyelonephritis, a bacterial kidney infection that originated from an asymptomatic urinary tract infection. She described fever up to 39°C and severe lower back pain that appeared shortly before a work trip to a remote region. Initially suspecting dengue or chikungunya, she sought hospital evaluation, where tests confirmed pyelonephritis at an advanced but controllable stage. Doctors warned that delaying the right antibiotics could allow the infection to progress to sepsis. Dieckmann emphasized the importance of investigating seemingly mild symptoms and seeking medical care early. She is now recovering, though not yet fully; the infection remains inflamed, and she continues to take care while healing.

triage.headline_ja: キャロリーナ・ディーマン、重い感染症の診断後に心境を語る
triage.triage_reason: 記事は著名人個人の腎盂腎炎（細菌性尿路感染症）の事例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生（アウトブレイク）ではなく、公開情報に対する個人的な関心の高い記事。スクリーニング基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルの著名女優の個人的な健康問題（腎盂腎炎）の報道であり、感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイク情報ではない。見出しで言及されているデング熱やチクングニア熱は患者が初期段階で疑った症状であり、実際の診断ではない。公衆衛生監視対象外の個人事例のためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية: 500 إصابة مؤكدة بإيبولا في وسط إفريقيا وتحذيرات من تفشٍ واسع - قناة المنار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa and warnings of a widespread outbreak - Al-Manar TV
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports ~500 confirmed Ebola infections in Central Africa: 452 cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (outbreak centered in Ituri, northeast DRC, began about three weeks ago) and 19 confirmed cases with 2 deaths in neighboring Uganda, totaling 471 cases and 84 deaths across both countries, up from 371 and 64 the day before. The U.S. CDC cautions the outbreak could reach the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic without strict public health measures. The current strain is Bundibugyo; no licensed vaccine or treatment exists for this lineage, so containment relies on infection prevention and transmission control through direct contact and body fluids. A joint WHO-African CDC plan worth $518 million over six months aims to enhance surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus notes rapid evolution of the outbreak and calls for accelerated, coordinated action.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：中央アフリカでエボラ確定患者500人、大流行の警告 - アルマナール・テレビ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の急速な拡大、高い致死率、複数国への拡大、国際的な感染リスク、および公開ワクチン・治療がない状況。WHOとCDCの高い警告レベルが示されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。USA、Angolaも記事に言及されているが、これらは実際の発生地ではなく参照情報のため除外。エボラ出血熱（特にBundibugyo株）で治療法・ワクチンが限定的であること、WHO-African CDC共同対応計画（5億1800万ドル・6ヶ月）が示唆する対応規模の大きさ、および2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較という国際的警告がすべてPICKUP判定を支持する。

article.articleHeadline: Американски лекар заразен со ебола пуштен од болница во Германија по закрепнување
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor infected with Ebola discharged from hospital in Germany after recovering.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor, Peter Stafford, infected with Ebola virus disease (EVD) during a humanitarian mission in the Congo, has been discharged from a hospital in Berlin, Germany after recovering. Stafford was evacuated to Berlin on May 20. His wife, also a physician volunteering with the same mission, and their four children were evacuated and placed in quarantine, CBS News reported. The article notes Stafford’s recovery and discharge from the German hospital and states the family was quarantined, but it does not specify whether any relatives were infected. The update is dated June 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラに感染したアメリカ人医師がドイツの病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確定患者発生であり異常性と重症度基準を満たす。ただし感染者は既に回復・退院済みであり、国際的拡大リスクは低いと判断される。情報が限定的なため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 患者は既に回復・退院済みであり、活動的な感染症の流行ではなく個別事例の報告である。発生地はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）。Berlin（ドイツ）での治療は輸送先であり、発生地ではない。WPROスクリーニング基準は2つ該当するが、IHR基準も2つ該当するため「PICKUP」の条件も満たしている。ただし、既に患者が回復済みで国際的拡大リスクが限定的であることを踏まえ、追加情報の確認が必要と判断し「WATCH」と評価した。

article.articleHeadline: بعد تسجيل 60 حالة وفاة.. هل يتفشى إيبولا في العالم؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After recording 60 deaths, will Ebola spread worldwide?
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, continues to challenge global health with active transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and regional preparedness across Uganda. As of 2026-06-06, DRC reports 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths across 24 health zones, including 34 healthcare-worker infections (7 deaths; 6 recoveries). WHO and Africa CDC are implementing a continental preparedness framework to bolster early detection, rapid isolation, community engagement, maintenance of essential health services, healthcare-worker protection, and cross-border infection prevention. About 200 metric tons of medical and protective supplies have been shipped to Uganda and the DRC, including 80 tons to Bunia. Three Bundibugyo Ebola vaccines are in development (Oxford/Serum Institute India; Moderna; NIAID), with trials expected in 2–3 months for the first two and 7–9 months for the third. Kenya plans 23 isolation/treatment centers, potentially one as a regional hub. A survivor follow-up program tracks recovered patients for 6–18 months to confirm clearance.

triage.headline_ja: 60人の死亡者が報告された後、エボラウイルスは世界規模で蔓延するのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の確認、複数国での地域的拡大の可能性、高い死亡率、国際的な対応体制整備が明記されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地（344確認症例、60死亡、24保健地域）として詳述されている。ウガンダはサマリー内で『地域的備戦』『医療供給配送』の文脈で言及されているが、確認症例数の記載がないため、実際の発生国はDRCに限定される。ケニアは隔離・治療センター計画が記載されているが、これも予防・準備段階であり、現在の確認症例は報告されていない。Bundibugyo株のワクチン開発が進行中（2-9ヶ月以内に試験開始予定）であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, Africa CDC Unveils $518 Million Plan To Contain Congo Ebola Outbreak - BW Healthcare World
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths. The WHO and Africa CDC launched a six-month emergency plan worth USD 518 million to run June–November 2026 to contain the outbreak, which is spreading faster than containment efforts. The virus circulated undetected for weeks before identification, and Bundibugyo currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Donors pledged about USD 315.8 million toward response efforts, revised downward from USD 498 million, though it remains unclear whether pledges will fully fund the plan. The outbreak is noted as the fourth-largest Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカCDC、コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行を封じ込めるための5億1,800万ドル計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（381確定例、62死亡）、国際的関心の高さ、WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言があり、即座にフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）による第17番目の流行。381確定例、62死亡、WHOが国際的公衆衛生緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。6ヶ月間（2026年6月～11月）の国際的対応計画が発動され、5億1,800万ドルの資金動員が進行中。感染拡大が封じ込め努力を上回る速度で進行中という高リスク状況。

article.articleHeadline: Después de dos semanas dan el alta a médico que se contagió con...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After two weeks they discharge the doctor who contracted the disease...
article.articleSummary: A US physician infected with Bundibugyo Ebola virus has been discharged after two weeks of convalescence at Berlin's Charité Hospital, following a negative test on May 30, amid the Ebola outbreak in northern and northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patient's last PCR clearance allowed authorities to lift isolation at noon. His wife and four children, arriving in Berlin, were designated high-risk contacts but asymptomatic and placed in quarantine. The outbreak has reached 82 deaths and 452 confirmed cases, with Mongbwalu in Ituri Province cited as the epicenter. The Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine exists, has spread to the neighboring region of Kivu and to Uganda, where two deaths have occurred. Ongoing violence and population displacement hinder surveillance. US CDC warned the outbreak could exceed numbers seen in West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic, which killed over 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: 2週間後、コンゴでエボラウイルスに感染した医師がベルリンで退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の多国間発生で、ワクチン未開発のブンディブギョ株、死亡率高い、国際的にも高い関心。
triage.notes: 記事は米国医師がベルリンで退院したことが主題だが、エボラ発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥーリ州モングワル地域）。ウガンダへの拡大も報告されているが、記事の主題のイベント発生地はDRCのみ。ベルリンとドイツは感染者の医療対応地であり、ウイルスの発生地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。ワクチン未開発のブンディブギョ株、452確認症例、82死亡、西アフリカ2014-2016流行（11,000人以上死亡）を上回る可能性との警告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Амерички лекар заражен еболом у Конгу, пуштен из болнице у Немачкој након опоравка
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor infected with Ebola in Congo, discharged from hospital in Germany after recovery.
article.articleSummary: American doctor Peter Stafford contracted Ebola while treating patients with the Serg mission in Congo's Bunia, exposed during surgery at Nyankunde Hospital in eastern Congo. He was evacuated to Berlin on May 20 and treated at Charité University Hospital with antiviral therapy and experimental treatments. By May 30, daily tests detected no virus; after more than 72 hours without symptoms and repeated negative PCRs, German authorities lifted the isolation at noon on June 6. Stafford's wife Rebecca, also a physician, and their four children were quarantined but remained asymptomatic. A third Serg physician, Patrick LaRoche, was an asymptomatic imported case quarantined at Prague's Bulovka Hospital. Stafford thanked the hospital and acknowledged Congo patients lacking such care.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人医師、コンゴでエボラ感染、ドイツの病院での回復後に退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な複数国での確認事例。IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的な拡大リスク、複数のWPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当し、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ（Bunia）での感染源および医療従事者の国際的な移動・隔離を中心に述べている。ベルリン、プラハは治療・隔離地点であり、感染発生地はコンゴに特定される。ドイツはWPRO対象国ではないため、verified_locationsにはコンゴのみを含める。複数国での患者追跡・隔離が進行中であり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US Doctor Discharged From Hospital In Germany After Surviving Ebola Contracted In Congo
article.articleSummary: Dr. Peter Stafford, a 39-year-old American surgeon working with a Christian missionary organization, contracted Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo while treating a patient before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, 2026. He was admitted to Charité - Universitätsmedizin Berlin on May 20 with pronounced Ebola symptoms and a high viral load, which decreased after antiviral treatment and supportive care. After 17 days, he was discharged; he and five quarantined family members were in good health and cleared to leave following final examinations, with no detectable virus since May 30. The Central African outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy and a fatality rate up to 50%. As of 6 June 2026, 471 infections and 84 deaths have been reported in the DRC and neighboring Uganda; WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The case underscores health worker risks and the role of experimental therapies.

triage.headline_ja: 米国医師がコンゴで感染したエボラから回復し、ドイツの病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。中央アフリカでのエボラ集団発生（DRC・ウガンダで471感染、84死亡）、WHOが国際的懸念事項として公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: ドイツでの患者報告は国際的な拡大の証拠だが、アクティブな集団発生地はDRCおよび隣接するウガンダ。対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCとした。Bundibugyo株、致死率最大50%、ワクチンなし、WHOによるPHEIC宣言により判定。

article.articleHeadline: ВООЗ підтвердила понад 470 випадків Еболи у Східній Африці
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirmed more than 470 Ebola cases in East Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization confirms 471 Ebola cases and 82 deaths in East Africa, with the Democratic Republic of Congo bearing the bulk of infections and Uganda reporting 19 cases. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no vaccine. In contrast, vaccines exist for the Ebola Zaïre strain, which have reduced case fatality from about 90% to around 40%. The CDC notes rapid spread in the last 24 hours, and estimates suggest the outbreak could exceed the 2014 West Africa epidemic that killed over 11,000. On 17 May 2026, WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC history, with all but one caused by the Zaïre lineage.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、東アフリカでエボラウイルス病患者470例以上を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、多数の死亡、ワクチン未対応株、急速な拡大傾向、2014年West Africa流行を上回る可能性。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主な発生地がDRC（大多数の感染）およびウガンダ（19例）と明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。モザンビークとアンゴラは「発生地域」に含まれるが、サマリー本文に直接の言及がないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）による高い国際的重要性。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未対応でリスク高。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: US doctor who contracted the Bundibugyo strain, discharged from Berlin hospital; here's what we know | Today News
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, exported to Germany where US doctor Peter Stafford recovered and was discharged from Charité Berlin after antiviral therapy and supportive care. He was evacuated on May 20; his wife and four children also quarantined but asymptomatic. Stafford’s viral load declined; since May 30 PCR tests have been negative, and isolation was lifted at 12:00 PM after more than 72 symptom-free hours. As of Thursday, Congo reported 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths; as of Friday, Uganda reported 19 cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak persists in a war-affected region with over five million displaced; travel restrictions affect Congo and Uganda and other nations. The US has considered a quarantine facility in Kenya (paused by court) and has implemented airport testing; Canada and others have imposed travel limits.

triage.headline_ja: エボラアウトブレイク：バンディブギョ株に感染した米国医師がベルリン病院から退院。ここまでの知見
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（致死率の高い感染症）がアフリカから先進国へ国際的に拡大し、複数国で渡航制限が発動されている。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題は、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイクがドイツに輸出され、米国医師が感染・治療・退院したケース。ドイツ・米国・ウガンダ・ケニア・カナダは記事で言及されているが、これらの国での一次的な発生地ではなく、対象国リストに含まれていない。したがって verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の両方で極めて高いリスク評価であり、確実なPICKUP対象。

article.articleHeadline: Four-year-old dies of Shigellosis in Kozhikode; two children under treatment
article.articleSummary: Shigellosis (Shigella) in Kozhikode, Kerala: Four-and-a-half-year-old Nila died after Shigella infection, confirmed Friday; admitted Tuesday to Kozhikode Medical College Hospital, died Saturday. Two more children— a 2-year-old from Pantheerankavu and a 10-year-old from Purameri— admitted to the Institute of Maternal and Child Health (IMCH) wing with laboratory-confirmed Shigella and severe diarrhoea. Earlier, in March, a 3-year-old girl died in a shigellosis outbreak in Kuttikkattoor where several other children were infected. Health authorities have intensified surveillance and issued a public alert stressing hygiene and sanitation. Symptoms include diarrhoea, fever, abdominal pain, vomiting, fatigue, and sometimes blood in stool. Transmission is via contaminated water/food and poor sanitation; parents are urged to seek immediate medical attention for early diagnosis and treatment to prevent complications.

triage.headline_ja: 4歳の子どもがコジコード州でシゲラ症で死亡；2人の子どもが治療中
triage.triage_reason: 小児死亡例を含む複数の確認症例、不衛生な環境での継続的暴露リスク、公衆衛生当局による対応強化があり、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・流行しやすさ・長期曝露を満たす。社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケーララ州コジコード地区で小児死亡例（4歳半）が確認され、同地区および周辺地域で追加の確認症例がある。過去にも同州内で3月にシゲラ症アウトブレイクあり。不衛生な環境と汚染された水・食物による継続的感染リスクが存在。保健当局による監視強化と公開警告が発出されている。シゲレラはヒト-ヒト感染能があり、特に衛生設備の不十分な地域での流行可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉疫情擴大 確診逼近500例84死 | 非洲中部 | 剛果
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak widens; confirmed cases near 500, 84 deaths | Central Africa | Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa widens. WHO data for June 6, 2026 show the DRC with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, while Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. Combined totals approach 471 cases and 84 fatalities. The outbreak has been declared a PHEIC (International Public Health Emergency). CDC models forecast 10,000–20,000 cases, potentially near the 2014–2016 West Africa toll of >11,000 deaths, though experts caution against over-interpreting numbers. There is currently no targeted treatment or vaccine for the core viral strain; some experts suggest spread may have started in February, with local testing initially detecting an earlier strain. Violence linked to armed conflict involving DRC and Rwanda-backed rebels, and ISIS-affiliated Allied Democratic Forces, complicates response and has caused mass displacement. The US has restricted entry for non-citizens and visa holders who recently traveled to Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, with health screening at four designated airports.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大 確認患者数は約500例に迫り、死亡数84例 | 中央アフリカ | コンゴ民主共和国
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、米国による渡航制限など、フルリスク評価の実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの感染が述べられているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国外であるため除外。PHEIC宣言済み、米国による渡航制限実施、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較言及あり、武力紛争による社会的複雑性も存在。

article.articleHeadline: Egy európai ország ebolajárványra készül, plakátok lepték el a repülőtereket
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A European country prepares for an Ebola outbreak, posters flood the airports.
article.articleSummary: June 6, 2026: UK Health Security Agency raises alert due to Ebola outbreaks in Central Africa, with WHO declaring it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. UK hospitals prepare, posters at airports warn of Ebola risks; NHS urged to review PPE stocks for potential cases. Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 452 infections and 82 deaths, with neighboring Uganda confirming cases for a combined total of 471 infections and 84 deaths, up 100 cases and 20 deaths from yesterday. UKHSA asks NHS to screen anyone who has been in DRC in the past 21 days and seeks care, focusing on fever or unexplained bleeding. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects; not airborne. Symptoms include fever, rash, malaise, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain; incubation up to 21 days. Isolation and limited contact are stressed.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパの某国がエボラアウトブレイクに備える、空港にポスターが氾濫
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の国際的な公衆衛生上の危機（WHO PHEIC宣言）であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRC及びウガンダでの確認症例と死亡が報告され、イギリスでの警戒態勢が取られている。国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限の可能性が存在する。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済みの重大な感染症イベント。記事ではDRCとウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみ記載。イギリスは警戒態勢段階であり、症例報告がないため除外。エボラウイルスの高致命率（約18%）と国際的な感染リスクは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Fast 500 bestätigte Ebola-Fälle im Kongo und in Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Nearly 500 confirmed Ebola cases in the Congo and in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 500 confirmed Ebola cases across the Congo and Uganda are reported, with Uganda alone counting 19 confirmed cases and two deaths. The WHO tallies show about 100 confirmed infections and 20 deaths, up from Friday. In mid-May, the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), its second-highest alert level, over the outbreak. Ebola presents with fever and bleeding and spreads through contact with body fluids. The current outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo virus variant, for which there is no specific treatment or approved vaccine. The report underscores ongoing transmission in the region as health authorities monitor the situation and respond with surveillance and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴとウガンダでほぼ500例の確認されたエボラ症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOによりPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が宣言されている高リスクイベント。Bundibugyo変異株による有効な治療法やワクチンがない状況での多発性出血熱の域外拡大。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames上は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月中旬）、約500例の確認症例と20死亡（DRC）、ウガンダで19例確認・2死亡。Bundibugyo変異株は特異的治療法・承認ワクチン両方欠如。域外拡大（ウガンダへの波及）とヒト-ヒト感染の継続的伝播が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 500 إصابة بإيبولا في دول وسط أفريقيا وتحذيرات من اتساع الوباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 500 Ebola cases in Central African countries and warnings of the epidemic's spread.
article.articleSummary: 471 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases with dozens of deaths have been reported as Central Africa faces a rapid outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The acceleration over a short period has prompted international health authorities to intensify field testing, surveillance, and preventive measures to halt transmission. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, urging urgent, coordinated action among countries and health organizations to contain the virus at its source and prevent spread to neighboring regions. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain, with indications of previously undetected transmission. Officials emphasize rapid mobilization, expanded monitoring, and readiness in bordering nations to detect and respond to any new cases.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ諸国でエボラ感染500件、流行拡大の警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。深刻な公衆衛生影響（確認症例471件、死亡多数）、異常/予想外の急速な流行、国際的拡大リスク、WHO緊急事態宣言。フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC・ウガンダで発生と明記されているが、対象国リストの確認結果、DRCのみが該当。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo株（稀な亜種）との報告あり。国境諸国への拡大リスク指摘。

article.articleHeadline: 13 مركزاً محلياً أمريكياً جاهزاً لمواجهة (إيبولا)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 13 local U.S. centers ready to face Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Thirteen US medical centers are ready to face Ebola, including University of Nebraska, Emory University, Bellevue Hospital, Cedars-Sinai Medical Center. Centers must care for at least two hemorrhagic-fever patients, train staff quarterly, and maintain lab testing capacity and PPE. One American with Ebola has been treated in Germany. The US State Department says asymptomatic Americans exposed to Ebola will be isolated at a Kenya facility under construction, and pledges to keep US free of Ebola-infected travelers. Protests at Kenya site killed at least two people and a Kenyan court halted construction. Critics warn that building in Kenya poses greater health risks than transporting patients to US facilities. US will add 38 million dollars in funding, bringing direct Ebola support above 200 million, in coordination with the CDC, DRC, and Uganda for a rapid response. The program runs under the National Center for Training and Education on Emerging Pathogen Etiologies.

triage.headline_ja: 13のアメリカの地域医療センターがエボラに対応する準備ができている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は極めて深刻な脅威であり、国際的な対応が行われているが、本記事は既知のDRC及びウガンダでの流行への準備態勢報告であり、新規の急速なアウトブレイク事象ではない。情報は不足している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際の新規エボラ患者発生はDRC及びウガンダで述べられている。ネブラスカやケニアの施設は準備態勢の記述であり、新規流行地ではない。ドイツで治療された1例は既治療例。ケニアでの隔離施設建設は計画段階。本記事は感染症対応の準備・資金確保に関する報告であり、新規シグナルの検知ではなく、既知の流行への対応状況報告と解釈される。

article.articleHeadline: US Ebola Funding Tops $200 Million | Sada Elbalad
article.articleSummary: US Ebola funding rises by nearly $38 million to exceed $200 million, announced 2026-06-06, as Washington coordinates with the CDC, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), and Uganda to strengthen containment efforts. The World Health Organization reports the current Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths. US officials did not detail allocation but said the funds will back a rapid, comprehensive response to the outbreak. The State Department also confirmed that US citizens exposed to Ebola but asymptomatic will be quarantined at a facility under construction in Kenya. triage.headline_ja: 米国のエボラウイルス感染症資金援助が2億ドルを超える | Sada Elbalad
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の確認事例344例、死亡60例の進行中の流行についてのシグナル。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的な拡大リスク、複数国間の協調対応が確認される。WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性、重症度、流行傾向、管理可能性が複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC、ウガンダ、ケニアでのエボラウイルス感染症流行に対する米国の資金援助について報道。DRCとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。無症候ながら曝露した米国市民のケニアでの隔離は、主要な流行地のDRC・ウガンダの国際的協調体制を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: У Берліні вилікували зараженого Еболою американця
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American infected with Ebola was cured in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An American surgeon, Peter Stafford, infected with Ebola while operating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, was discharged from Berlin’s Charité after 17 days of treatment with experimental therapies. Stafford, his wife (also a physician), and five quarantined relatives were monitored; all are in good condition. The infection involved the Bundibugyo strain, a rare, highly lethal variant with no approved vaccine or standard therapy. Symptoms began around May 20; antiviral therapy and experimental regimens markedly reduced the viral load, and the virus was undetectable by May 30. The case is set against the Congo–Uganda Ebola outbreak, with WHO reporting over 900 infections and 84 deaths by late May and declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern at the second level. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids during close contact; no routine vaccine exists for Bundibugyo. This is an imported case in Germany.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンでエボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人が治癒した
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は国際的に高い関心を集める公衆衛生上の重大事案であり、IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当。DRCでの流行が継続しており、輸入症例の報告も国際的な警戒を要する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、患者はDRCで感染し、ベルリンで治療を受けた輸入症例。Bluedot APIは Berlin、Germany、USA を発生地域に含めているが、実際の感染発生地はDRCのみ。現在 DRC～Uganda 国境地域での大規模流行が進行中（WHO報告：900超感染例、84死亡例）。Bundibugyo株は希少で高致命性の株であり、承認済みワクチンが存在しないことが懸念材料。患者の良好な転帰は報告されているが、基盤となる流行の継続により国際的警戒継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases surge over 400 as fears grow over central Africa outbreak
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in central Africa has surged, with nearly 500 cases confirmed. The World Health Organization reports 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak was declared on May 15 in the northeastern region. In Uganda, 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths have been recorded. The combined total is 471 cases and 84 deaths, up by about 100 cases and 20 deaths in 24 hours. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain; there are no approved vaccines or treatments for this strain. A WHO/Africa CDC response plan worth $518 million was launched to bolster surveillance, laboratory testing and infection prevention, and to help neighbouring countries detect and act quickly if cases appear. Officials warn the scale could rival the 2014 West Africa epidemic if not stopped quickly.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数が400人を超え、中央アフリカの流行への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラの大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、複数国への国際的拡大、予防接種・治療法がないBundibugyo株による異常な状況、および国際支援（WHO/Africa CDC $518M対応計画）が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（452確認例、82死亡）とウガンダ（19例、2死亡）が明記されているが、ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーでは言及されていないため除外。Bundibugyo株は稀でワクチン・治療法がなく、2014年西アフリカ流行に匹敵する規模のリスクが指摘されている。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当し、極めて重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國及烏干達單日共增約100宗伊波拉確診個案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda jointly report approximately 100 new Ebola cases in a single day
article.articleSummary: June 6, 2026 – The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda report ongoing Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks, with a combined total of 471 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 84 deaths across both countries. In the latest 24-hour period, approximately 100 new cases and 20 deaths were recorded between the two nations. U.S. CDC officials warn that models predict the outbreak could reach a scale similar to the 2014 West Africa epidemic if strong public health measures are not implemented. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC previously launched an Ebola outbreak control plan, aiming to raise $518 million for June–November to bolster preparedness, rapid detection, and response in African countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国及びウガンダが単日で約100件のエボラ確認症例を共同報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の多国間同時多発アウトブレイク。IHR基準4項目全て該当。死亡率の高さ、急速な増加ペース、国際的拡大リスク、CDC警告による予測的脅威が深刻。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWHO対象地域外のため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみが対象国に該当。記事では両国のアウトブレイクが報告されているが、対象国リストに基づき DRC のみを計上。複数国への拡大と高死亡率（84死亡/471確認症例＝約18%）、及び2014年西アフリカ流行規模への警告が極めて重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: В Берлине вылечили американского врача, заразившегося Эболой в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Berlin, an American doctor who contracted Ebola in Congo was cured.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor, 39-year-old Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola in Congo while working for Serge Christian mission. He was transported to Berlin and admitted May 20 after infection in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He spent 17 days hospitalized and received antiviral and supportive therapy, plus experimental treatments still in trials. On admission his condition was severe, but treatment markedly lowered viral load; by May 30 the Ebola virus was no longer detectable in his blood. He and five family members were discharged from the clinic; his wife and their children were quarantined as high-risk contacts, but showed no symptoms. Stafford was infected with the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or officially recognized therapy. By May end, DR Congo and Uganda reported over 900 cases and 84 deaths. WHO designated the outbreak at level 2 of 3 and declared a PHEIC; Bundibugyo mortality can reach 50%.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンでコンゴで感染したエボラ出血熱の米国医師が治癒
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な影響、予期しない事象、国際的拡大リスク）。ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱の多国間発生で、WHOがPHEIC宣言、死亡率50%の高リスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ感染はコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)およびウガンダで発生しており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCのみが対象国で主題となる。WHOがPHEIC(Public Health Emergency of International Concern)を宣言しており、ブンディブギョ株の高い致死率(50%)と治療法不在が重大なリスク要因。国際的な治療ニーズと流行拡大の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: Mauritius imposes entry ban for travellers from Congo, Uganda & South Sudan
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts Mauritius to impose a temporary entry ban on foreign nationals who have travelled to, transited through, or stayed in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days. Mauritian citizens and holders of valid work, residence, occupation, business, or student permits will still be allowed entry but must undergo a mandatory 21-day quarantine if they have visited any of the three countries in the preceding three weeks. Authorities will implement screening and risk assessment at points of entry for travellers arriving from affected countries, with immediate isolation and clinical assessment for anyone showing symptoms. The government also urged postponement of the 18th US-Africa Business Summit, initially planned for July in Mauritius, in light of the outbreak. Timing: June 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱発生：モーリシャスがコンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの旅行者に対する入国禁止令を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目が該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラ熱は国際的に最高リスク水準の感染症であり、複数国の渡航制限措置と国際的なビジネスイベント延期の検討が発生している。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ熱発生を扱っているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。モーリシャスはあくまで対応国（渡航制限実施国）であり、実際の発生地ではない。米国は対象国外のため除外。本イベントは重大な国際保健脅威であり、複数の高所得国も対応措置を実施していることから、フルRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: مراكز مكافحة الأمراض الأمريكية تحذر من احتمال تفشٍ لإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention warn of the possibility of an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: CDC warns that the ongoing Ebola outbreak detected in the Democratic Republic of Congo could reach scales similar to West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic if strong health measures are not implemented. CDC official Jason Asher cautioned that actions are necessary to slow transmission and prevent expansion beyond prior bounds. The World Health Organization notes the 2014–2016 outbreak began in Guinea and swept across West Africa, leaving more than 11,000 deaths. The CDC report presents several modeled outbreak trajectories, notably influenced by the proportion of cases placed in isolation; these scenarios aim to guide preparedness rather than induce panic. Authors urge readiness and a robust health response akin to measures deployed more than a decade ago to contain the West Africa outbreak. No current case counts are specified in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 米国疾病予防管理センターがエボラウイルスのアウトブレイク可能性について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの進行中の流行と、西アフリカ2014-2016年の大規模流行に匹敵する可能性についての公式警告により、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事は民主共和国コンゴで検出されたエボラウイルスの進行中の流行を扱っており、西アフリカの2014-2016年の流行に匹敵する規模に達する可能性についてCDCが警告している。ギニアとアンゴラは歴史的背景として言及されているが、現在の発生地はDRCであり、これが対象国リスト内の唯一の検証済みロケーションである。米国は参考資料の発行国であり、発生地ではない。現在の具体的な症例数は記事では指定されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Displacement complicates battle against Ebola in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is driven by ongoing conflict and mass displacement, with about seven million internally displaced people—second only to Sudan—straining surveillance and contact tracing. As of early May 2026, the 17th Ebola outbreak has health workers tracing more than half of identified contacts (up from 9% at the outset), but nearly 50% of suspected contacts remain unaccounted for. Displacement in crowded sites and repeated moves hinder locating exposed individuals, with about 500 contacts in eastern areas outside government control. In Ituri Province, authorities use community-based strategies; access challenges persist in M23-controlled zones, where withdrawal of troops could aid response. The crisis highlights a broader humanitarian emergency: funding reached only 27.4% of needs in 2025, with around 21 million in need and seven million displaced. The article notes no lab-confirmation details or case counts.

triage.headline_ja: 避難民の流出がコンゴ東部のエボラとの戦いを複雑化させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。進行中の紛争と大規模避難民による接触者追跡の困難性、資金不足により管理可能性が低い。
triage.notes: Sudan は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事の主題はコンゴ東部（Ituri州）のエボラ発生であり、DRCの深刻な人道危機と感染症制御の課題が中心。接触者追跡成功率の改善傾向（9%→50%以上）は認められるが、約50%の疑似接触者が未追跡のまま、政府統制外の地域では約500人の接触者がいるため、管理可能性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Suman casi 500 casos de ébola en África Central🎦
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 500 Ebola cases in Central Africa🎦
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa has 471 confirmed cases and 84 deaths. Democratic Republic of the Congo accounts for 452 infections and 82 fatalities, while Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. The World Health Organization says numbers are rising with a notable surge in recent hours. Health authorities emphasize that without strengthened prevention and control measures, the outbreak could continue expanding in the region. Ebola transmits through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals. Common symptoms include high fever, muscle pain, weakness, and, in severe cases, hemorrhaging. Authorities are conducting contact tracing, patient care, and other containment actions to limit spread and prevent escalation to larger dimensions. WHO continues to monitor the situation due to rapid case growth and regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ中部でエボラ患者がほぼ500人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。重症度の高いエボラウイルス感染症の多数症例と死亡が報告され、急速な拡大傾向が認められており、地域的流行から国際的拡大のリスクが明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に述べられているのはコンゴ民主共和国（452症例、82死亡）とウガンダ（19症例、2死亡）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを対象国として列挙。エボラの高い致死率（現在17.8%）、ヒト-ヒト感染能力、地域内での急速な症例増加、WHOの継続的モニタリングが必要との指摘により、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: تحذيرات من ارتفاع الإصابات بإيبولا وسط أفريقيا إلى 20 ألف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warnings of a rise in Ebola infections in Central Africa to 20,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: A new US CDC modeling warning suggests Ebola in Central Africa could reach 20,000+ cases, depending on how quickly infected individuals are isolated; scenarios range from 10,000 to over 20,000, with the worst case approaching the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (>28,000 cases, >11,000 deaths). In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, confirmed Ebola cases have risen to 452 (71 new in 24 hours) with 82 deaths; WHO data show 381 infections and 64 deaths. The outbreak spans three provinces, centered in Ituri, which accounts for about 90% of cases and 76% of deaths, and has crossed into Uganda (16 cases, 1 death). WHO Director-General Tedros announced a six-month, $518 million plan to combat Ebola in DRC and Uganda, expressing cautious optimism about containment. Separately, a US doctor infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus was discharged from Berlin’s Charité after ~two weeks; PCR-confirmed infection, with high-risk contacts quarantined.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカでエボラ感染者が2万件に増加する警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外の急速増加、渡航制限の可能性がある。DRCでの確認症例452例、ウガンダへの国境越え感染、米国での輸入症例、WHO事務局長による緊急資金計画発表など、複数の危機信号が存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に言及されているのはDRC内のイトゥリ州およびウガンダへの国境越え感染。BerlinおよびUnited Statesは輸入症例（米国医師がBerlinで治療を受けた）の言及であり、エボラ発生地ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。2014-2016西アフリカ流行との比較参照や、CDC前向きモデリング、WHO $518M資金計画発表など、高度な社会政治的関心と国際的対応態勢が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola avança na África e ameaça se tornar um dos maiores da história
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak advances in Africa and threatens to become one of the largest in history.
article.articleSummary: 71 new Ebola cases in a single day in the Democratic Republic of the Congo raise lab-confirmed infections to 452 and deaths to 82, with Mongbwalu in Ituri as the epicenter. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus has spread to more than two dozen health zones across three eastern provinces and into Uganda (19 confirmed cases). Symptoms clustered May 14–23, with a second wave May 25–June 3, indicating community transmission before recognition. CDC modeling warns of a large epidemic: a 65% chance of surpassing 20,000 cases in three months if only 20% are isolated; improving isolation to 70% lowers the risk to about 1 in 20. About 4,800 contacts are being followed, with tracing rising from 46% to 58%. A new diagnostic lab opened in Mongbwalu. Containment faces armed conflict and attacks on aid workers in Bunia. No licensed vaccine or approved therapy exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, though vaccines and treatments are under development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がアフリカで拡大し、歴史上最大規模の一つとなる脅威
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダで確認されたエボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の多地域流行。確認患者452名、死亡82名、CDC警告により3ヶ月で20,000症例超過の可能性65%。国際的拡大と渡航制限のリスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーでは「19確認患者」の報告に留まり、主要な流行地はコンゴ民主共和国のIturi州。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。武装紛争と支援者への攻撃により管理困難性が高い。Bundibugyo ebolavirus用の認可ワクチン・治療薬がないことが深刻な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: تحذير أميركي خطير من تحول إيبولا إلى كارثة إفريقية جديدة بآلاف الضحايا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dire American warning about Ebola turning into a new African catastrophe with thousands of victims.
article.articleSummary: US CDC officials warned that Ebola could expand in the Democratic Republic of Congo, urging stringent measures to slow transmission and prevent a scale-up beyond prior outbreaks. In the current flare-up, 381 cases have been confirmed in the DRC with 64 deaths; across the border in Uganda, 16 cases including one death have been reported. The outbreak began May 15 in northeast DRC, with Ituri Province as the epicenter, accounting for about 90% of confirmed cases and 76% of deaths, according to Africa CDC. The 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic, by comparison, killed more than 11,000 people. The report presents several modeled outbreak trajectories, based on the share of people put under quarantine, intended to guide action rather than sow panic. Health authorities urge preparedness and a strong response to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカの新たな大惨事に転化する可能性についての深刻なアメリカからの警告－数千人の犠牲者が予想される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全てに該当。DRCおよびウガンダでの確認事例と国際的関心の高さから、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも16例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めていない。DRC・Ituri州が主要な発生地域であり、2014-2016年西アフリカエボラ流行（11,000人以上死亡）との比較から、国際的な懸念は極めて高い。米国CDCおよびアフリカCDCからの正式警告により、社会的・政治的関心も顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Η επιδημία του Εμπολα μπορεί να προσλάβει ιστορικές διαστάσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic could take on historical dimensions.
article.articleSummary: US CDC warns that without aggressive, immediate measures, the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) could reach or exceed the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rarer strain with no specific treatment or vaccine. Declared in the northeastern DRC on May 15, it is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country. WHO’s latest bulletin confirms 381 laboratory-confirmed cases in the DRC with 64 deaths; across the border in Uganda there are 16 cases and 1 death, with 7 recoveries in the DRC and 2 in Uganda. The most lethal DRC outbreak occurred from 2018–2020, with about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases. The CDC models emphasize preparedness for the worst and strong containment to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は歴史的規模に達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による大規模流行が進行中で、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性があり、複数国への越境感染が確認されている。CDC警告により社会・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、発生地域にはDRC、ウガンダ、米国、アンゴラが記載されているが、実際のイベント発生国はDRCとウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（レアストレイン）による患者数381例、死亡64例（DRC）、ウガンダで16例1死亡。CDCが直接的な警告を発している点で社会政治的関心が高い。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Mùa hè, tăng nguy cơ mắc não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer, increased risk of contracting meningococcal disease.
article.articleSummary: June 6, 2026: A 13-year-old boy in Ho Chi Minh City hospital is in critical condition with meningococcal disease caused by Neisseria meningitidis; he had no known contact and was unvaccinated. Clinicians warn the disease can appear sporadically and progress rapidly, even in those without clear risk factors. Meningococcal disease can trigger meningitis and septicemia, with high mortality if untreated. WHO estimates roughly 1 in 6 die from meningococcal meningitis; 50–70% of hospitalized children die, and about 20% of survivors have long-term sequelae. Early symptoms are non-specific (sudden fever, severe headache, vomiting, neck stiffness, altered mental status), with some cases presenting as mild upper respiratory symptoms. Summer and crowded settings heighten transmission risk. Vaccination is the best prevention; vaccines include Menactra, MenQuadfi, Nimenrix (ACYW) and Bexsero, VA Mengoc BC (group B). In Vietnam, group B accounts for 98.1% of southern cases (2014–2025). Tiêm chủng Long Châu offers ACYW, BC, and B vaccines and emphasizes timely care.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季、髄膜炎菌感染症の罹患リスク増加
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市での散発例（1症例）の報告であり、異常性と重症度は認められるが、現時点では国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生への広範な影響の証拠が不足している。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は健康啓発的性質であり、ホーチミン市での1症例（13歳男児、重症）の報告。WHOの死亡率推定値（髄膜炎菌髄膜炎では約1/6、入院小児では50-70%）が引用されており、疾患の重症性は明確。ただし記事サマリーでは感染症流行の兆候ではなく、夏季における散発例の可能性が指摘されているのみ。ベトナムでは群B菌が南部症例の98.1%を占めている（2014-2025）との情報もある。IHR基準は2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準は3つ以上該当するが、単一散発例であり患者管理は可能と考えられるため、「WATCH」と判定。今後の集積事例に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: طيران الإمارات: قيود على القادمين من 3 دول بسبب الإيبولا - ستاد الأهلي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emirates Airlines: Restrictions on arrivals from three countries due to Ebola - Al Ahly Stadium
article.articleSummary: Emirates Airlines updated travelers about Ebola-related travel restrictions, effective June 6, 2026, until further notice. Entry to the United Arab Emirates will be denied for passengers who have recently been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan unless they have spent more than 21 days outside these countries before arriving. The rule applies to all travelers, including those transiting through UAE airports and those on indirect itineraries; transit passengers must comply with destination entry requirements. The measures reflect precautionary steps to limit Ebola spread, as global health and aviation authorities monitor the situation. Emirates urges travelers to verify entry requirements for their final destinations on official government channels before travel, as restrictions and screening practices may change.

triage.headline_ja: エミレーツ航空：エボラウイルスのため3ヶ国からの入国者に制限措置 - アルアハリースタジアム
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の多国間での発生と、国際的な渡航制限措置の実施という IHR 基準での複数該当、および重症度・管理可能性に関する WPRO 基準の該当により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主としてエボラ発生国からの渡航制限に関する航空会社による公式発表である。サマリー内で言及されているウガンダ、南スーダン、アラブ首長国連邦は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。DRC のみが対象国リストに該当する。エボラウイルスは極めて重篤で国際的懸念が高く、複数国での流行と渡航制限の実施は顕著な公衆衛生上の脅威を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تحذّر من انتشار سريع لإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo warns of rapid spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo confirmed 71 new Ebola cases in 24 hours, bringing the total to 452 cases and 82 deaths since the outbreak of the rare Bundibugyo strain was first reported on 15 May. The surge is concentrated in Ituri province in the northeast (65 cases) and North Kivu (6 cases), with additional confirmed cases in Uganda. This daily increase is the largest in the current wave, the seventh Ebola outbreak in DR Congo’s history, and indicates rapid, ongoing human-to-human transmission. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced a six-month plan totaling $518 million to combat Ebola, in a joint effort with the Africa CDC, aimed at supporting DRC and Uganda and helping other countries prepare through strengthened surveillance and border testing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラの急速な拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス疾患は公衆衛生的に深刻であり、24時間で71例の新規患者、高い死亡率、国際的拡大（ウガンダでも確認）、ヒト-ヒト感染の活発な継続、WHO事務局長による大規模支援計画の発表など、シグナルとしてフルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダで追加の確認症例あり」と記載されており、主要な流行地はDRC（Ituri州とNorth Kivu州）。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。2026年6月6日時点で累計452例、死亡82例、Bundibugyo株、7番目の流行、WHO事務局長による$518M支援計画発表など、極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en África Central supera los 360 casos y deja 62 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa surpasses 360 cases and leaves 62 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa has surpassed 360 cases and 62 confirmed deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Uganda reporting 15 cases and 1 death. The World Health Organization notes the virus has spread more than 160 kilometers from the initial cases. A six-month plan totaling $518 million was unveiled to fund the response in northeastern Congo, including safe and dignified burials, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, epidemiological investigation, logistics, and strengthened cross-border surveillance and information sharing with neighbors. Donors have provided funds, but authorities say more resources are needed to develop a broader regional response.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ発生が360例を超え、62人の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、大規模な死亡例を伴う深刻なエボラ株の多国間クラスタ発生。国際的拡大リスクが高く、地域的対応支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda（226074）も記載されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは15例1死亡の報告のみで、流行の主体はDRCである。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。360例以上の症例、62名の確認死亡、160km以上の地理的拡大、6ヶ月間で5.18億ドルの資金化計画が発表されており、すべてのIHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たす重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola avança na África e OMS alerta para risco de epidemia como a de 2014
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Advances in Africa and WHO Warns of the Risk of an Outbreak Similar to the 2014 Epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa escalates, with 471 confirmed cases and 84 deaths overall. The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) accounts for 452 cases and 82 deaths since May 15, when the outbreak was declared; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths at the Congo border. The surge is driven by the very rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which no vaccine or treatment is approved. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids. A joint six-month plan by the WHO and CDC Africa worth R$ 2.65 billion prioritizes laboratory testing, surveillance, and prevention to curb spread and prevent a catastrophe. The plan aims to avert a crisis similar to the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which caused over 11,000 deaths and more than 28,000 cases. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls for rapid, united action.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカで拡大、WHOが2014年と同様の流行リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス感染症は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、ワクチン・治療法のない稀少種の出現による異常性、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限リスクなど、すべての重大シグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCが主要な発生地で452例、82人の死亡が報告。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。アンゴラも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo Ebola virusという稀少種、ワクチン・治療法未開発という深刻な状況。WHO・CDCによる265億レアル規模の対応計画が発動。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（11,000人以上死亡）との比較により、社会・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana prepared to prevent Ebola outbreak despite no recorded case - Deputy Health Minister
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-06, Ghana shows readiness to prevent an Ebola outbreak despite no suspected or confirmed cases. Deputy Health Minister Dr Grace Ayensu-Dankwa, during a tour of the Elubo border in Jomoro Municipality, Western Region, affirmed preparedness to deter entry amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak in parts of Africa. Measures observed include border screening, public education campaigns, and trained health personnel. Officials noted monitoring of entrants and departures, visible education flyers, and ongoing public sensitisation. Gaps identified: need for additional PPE and improvements to laboratory capacity, with assurances that these will be provided to strengthen border management. Jomoro's Municipal Director, Gabriel Yengliereh, said surveillance is active at approved points, using thermometer guns, handwashing facilities, posters, and sanitizers; unapproved routes remain a surveillance challenge. Public urged to maintain hygiene and report suspected symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、確認患者なしも、エボラ流行防止の準備が整っていると副保健大臣が表明
triage.triage_reason: ガーナでエボラ確認患者がないため現在の深刻な公衆衛生影響はないが、アフリカにおける進行中のエボラ流行への対応準備・国境検疫措置が報道されており、地域的なリスク関心が存在。情報を継続監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ガーナに確認患者はないが、アフリカにおける進行中のエボラ流行に対応した国境検疫強化・公衆衛生対策の準備が報道されている。副保健大臣による正式な準備表明があり、政府関心は高い。ただし現段階では疑似患者も報告されておらず、直接的な深刻性は低い。PPE不足などの管理上の課題が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: کانگو میں ایبولا کی تباہ کاریاں جاری، مصدقہ متاثرین 452 اور ہلاکتیں 82 تک پہنچ گئیں
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola devastation continues in Congo, with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease devastation continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths. The Ministry of Health reports cases across Ituri and North Kivu, with 71 new confirmed cases and 21 deaths on June 4, signaling sustained community transmission of the Bundibugyo Ebola strain. Overall, 258 patients are in isolation or hospital monitoring, and 8 have recovered. Contact tracing remains weak: among 4,766 contacts in three provinces, only 2,755 have been followed up (57.8%). Post-mortem sampling faces resistance, and gaps in treatment capacity, essential medicines, and PPE persist, particularly in North Kivu. Uganda reported 3 new cases on June 5, bringing its total to 19. Africa CDC and WHO plan to raise US$518 million for June–November to bolster preparedness and rapid response; 34 health workers have been infected (7 deaths, 6 recoveries).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の被害が続く、確認患者数452人、死亡者数82人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の継続的な地域感染、国際的な拡大（ウガンダ）、および深刻な公衆衛生への影響が確認されている。フルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも3例の新規確認患者が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCの発生状況であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに未含有のため検証対象地域には含めない。エボラの高い致死率、接触者追跡の不十分さ（57.8%）、治療能力とPPEの不足、医療従事者への感染（34人）が重大な懸念。WHOおよびアフリカCDCが5億1800万米ドルの資金調達を計画中。

article.articleHeadline: África Central tem quase 500 casos confirmados de ebola, diz OMS | Mundo e Ciência | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Africa has nearly 500 confirmed Ebola cases, says WHO | World and Science | O Dia.
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, the World Health Organization reports about 471 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in Central Africa, with 84 deaths. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 452 cases and 82 deaths have been confirmed, the outbreak declared three weeks ago. In neighboring Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths are reported. The totals reflect an increase of 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The WHO has classified the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern, underscoring intensified global attention. Officials warn the epidemic could rival the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which killed more than 11,000 people. Jason Asher of CDC’s epidemic forecasting unit cautioned that this level remains possible without stronger public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカでエボラウイルス病の確認患者がほぼ500例、WHOが報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の国際的脅威であり、WHO緊急事態宣言済みで、国際支援が必要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ感染症発生を報告している。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当する。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。本イベントはWHOが公衆衛生上の国際的脅威として認定済み。短期間での急速な患者増加（前日比100例増）が報告されており、管理可能性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: The Darién is the Epicenter of the Oropouche Virus in Central America According to a Recent Study - Newsroom Panama
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus, transmitted by Culicoides paraensis sand flies and Culex mosquitoes, centers in Darién province, Panama, as the first major documented outbreak in Central America. The study identifies Darién as the epidemic epicenter and a key area to detect and anticipate future expansion to Panama’s Bocas del Toro and Los Santos. In 2024, the virus circulated across the Americas, with one of its highest peaks recorded in Brazil in January of that year. The Darién Gap migration corridor did not report outbreaks until almost twelve months later, a pattern that has raised questions among scientists about transmission dynamics and surveillance. Vector-borne transmission, cross-border implications, and Darién’s outbreak dynamics underscore the need for monitoring to anticipate spread and inform regional public health planning.

triage.headline_ja: ダリエン地域が中米のオロポーシェウイルスの震源地――最近の研究によると、パナマ発行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「国際拡大リスク」の2基準に該当。新興ベクター媒介性ウイルスの中米での初めての大規模アウトブレイク、パナマからの地域・大陸規模への拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: オロポーシェウイルスはアメリカ大陸で循環し、2024年ブラジルで記録されたピークから中米への拡大パターンを示している。記事はパナマのダリエン地域を中米の震源地と特定しているが、パナマは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ブラジルは2024年に高いピークを記録したと明記されているため included。ベクター媒介性感染症としての伝播動態、越境特性、継続的な曝露リスク、今後の地域的拡大の可能性があり、継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Suman 452 casos de ébola confirmados en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A total of 452 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 452 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths, with Ituri province accounting for 424 cases and acting as the epicenter; North Kivu has 25 cases and South Kivu 3. Uganda reports 19 imported cases and 2 deaths linked to the Congolese outbreak, and its border remains closed for containment. In the last 24 hours, 71 new positives were recorded; 258 patients are hospitalized or in isolation across 25 active health zones; eight have recovered. Contact tracing covers 57.8% of direct contacts; the provisional case-fatality rate is about 18%. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, with historical fatality ranging 30–50%. WHO notes low global risk but high regional risk in sub-Saharan Africa, with the virus likely circulating in Ituri about two months before the emergency declaration.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確認患者が452例に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、境界閉鎖による渡航制限）。致命率18%、ウガンダでの死亡者も報告されており、WPRO基準も複数該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国リスト外）への波及も報告されているが、主な流行はDRC内。Bundibugyo Ebola virusによる流行で、過去2ヶ月間の潜行期を考慮すると、早期段階での大規模化の懸念あり。ワクチン・特異的治療なし、致命率18%（既往30-50%）。WHOは地域リスク高と評価。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo eleva a 452 los casos de ébola confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo raises the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 452.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, with 258 patients hospitalized or in isolation and 8 recoveries across 25 health zones. The case fatality rate is about 18%. About 57.8% of contacts have been traced. Ituri remains the epicenter with 424 cases, followed by North Kivu (25) and South Kivu (3). The epidemic has spilled into Uganda, with 19 confirmed infections and two deaths, both imported from the DRC; Uganda closed its border with the DRC on May 27. In the DRC, 71 new confirmed cases were reported in the 24 hours before the latest bulletin. The information reflects counts up to June 4, 2026, as reported by the National Institute of Public Health (INSP).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、確認されたエボラ症例を452件に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、国境措置）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。進行中のエボラアウトブレイクで452例・82死亡、ウガンダへの越境感染確認。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）への越境感染（19例、2死亡）確認されるが、サマリーの主題はDRCのアウトブレイク。DRCは対象国リスト内。進行中の重大感染症イベント。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Τα κρούσματα ξεπέρασαν τα 400 - Πιθανή επιδημία στην κεντρική Αφρική
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Cases have surpassed 400 — Possible outbreak in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa surpasses 400 confirmed cases, with nearly 500 confirmed overall. The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, while nearby Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The combined total is 471 cases and 84 deaths, up about 100 cases and 20 deaths in the last 24 hours. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain and was declared in northeastern DRC on May 15; there are no approved vaccines or therapies for this strain. A WHO-Africa CDC response plan totaling $518 million aims to bolster surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged rapid action to contain transmission, support responding countries, and ready neighbors to detect and respond to new cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：症例数が400を超える — 中央アフリカでの流行の可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラ出血熱による大規模流行で、国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の発生が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの症例（19例）にも言及しているが、ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リスト（895949, 1694008, 1605651, 2300660, 203312, 3469034, 1643084, 1814991, 1327865, 1562822, 1269750）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。稀なBundibugyo株による初の大規模流行であり、ワクチン・治療法がないことが懸念される。WHO・アフリカCDCによる迅速な対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo registra 71 novos casos de ebola em um dia; total chega a 452
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo records 71 new Ebola cases in one day; total reaches 452.
article.articleSummary: Africa-focused Ebola update: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 71 new Bundibugyo-ebola cases in 24 hours, total 452 infections and 82 deaths. Novel emphasis on Bundibugyo strain, a rarer Ebola variant with lethality and scarce vaccines or treatments. Most cases in DRC, but Uganda reports over 15 confirmed infections, signaling regional transmission risk. In May, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). In response, WHO and Africa CDC launched an international appeal for $518 million to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, diagnostics, and fast response capabilities, aiming to curb spread and bolster health systems in hardest-hit areas. The outbreak is among the region's most significant in recent years; rapid identification of new cases is deemed critical to prevent wider regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが1日で71人の新規エボラ患者を報告；総患者数は452人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）のアウトブレイクで、DRCで452感染例・82死亡、ウガンダへの地域伝播も確認。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地であることが明確。ウガンダも15例以上の確認感染が報告されているが、評価対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo-ebolasはレアな株で、ワクチン・治療オプションが限定的との記述あり。WHOのPHEIC宣言、518百万ドルの国際アピール実施済みで対応が既に国際規模で展開中。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يعود بقوة إلى وسط إفريقيا.. ومخاوف من تفشٍ واسع النطاق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Makes a Strong Comeback to Central Africa... Fears of a Large-Scale Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has intensified in Central Africa, with 471 confirmed cases and 84 deaths across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda as of 2026-06-06. In the DRC’s Ituri region, authorities report 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, while neighboring Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; totals rose by about 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, began in northeastern Ituri; transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids, and illness often starts with influenza- or malaria-like symptoms, delaying diagnosis. There is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for this strain, making infection prevention and control essential. A joint WHO-Africa CDC plan worth $518 million over six months aims to bolster surveillance, laboratory testing, and preventive measures. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the outbreak is evolving rapidly and urges rapid, coordinated action to contain it at its source and prepare neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが中央アフリカで勢いを取り戻す...大規模流行の懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルスの急速な拡大、国際的な懸念表明、WHO による大規模対応計画がある。フルRRA が必要。
triage.notes: 記事でウガンダも提及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。エボラウイルスの確認症例 471 例、死亡 84 例という重大な規模、複数国への拡大（DRC とウガンダ）、WHO による $518 百万規模の対応計画、ワクチン・治療法の不在、急速な拡大という特性から PICKUP 判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: Aproape 500 de cazuri de Ebola confirmate. Specialiștii OMS trag un semnal de alarmă
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Almost 500 confirmed Ebola cases. WHO specialists issue a warning.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to Uganda, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. As of June 6, 2026, the World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Congo reports 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the latest update, with the outbreak declared within two weeks. Uganda has 19 confirmed infections and two deaths; totals across both countries reach 471 confirmed cases and 84 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccines or treatments. The outbreak was identified May 15 in northeast DRC, with transmission believed to begin earlier. A joint intervention plan worth $518 million by WHO and the Africa CDC aims to strengthen surveillance, lab testing, and infection prevention.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者ほぼ500人確認。WHO専門家が警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な死亡と感染者数、予想外の国際的拡大、PHEIC宣言済み、国際支援が進行中）。エボラウイルス病の確認患者数471人、死亡84人、複数国での発生、WHO PHEIC宣言により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Uganda（1605651）はWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ対象国として含める。記事サマリー上、2026年6月6日時点でWHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み、Bundibugyo株によるアウトブレイク、ワクチンおよび治療法未承認状況が記載されており、極めて高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: Berlin hospital discharges US doctor who contracted Ebola
article.articleSummary: A U.S. citizen treated in Germany after contracting Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo was discharged from Berlin's Charité hospital. No Ebola virus has been detected in the patient since May 30. The patient, identified as medical missionary Peter Stafford, was admitted May 20 after contracting Ebola while treating patients in the DRC. Ebola symptoms subsided significantly after treatment that included combined antiviral therapy and additional supportive medical measures. Charité official Leif Erik Sander called the outcome a significant therapeutic success. None of the patient’s five high-risk family contacts quarantined at Charité showed symptoms. There have been 82 confirmed Ebola deaths as of Friday since the outbreak started in the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリン病院、エボラに感染した米国医師を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、国際的拡大のリスクがある。DRCとウガンダでの複数国にまたがる感染例と死亡者（82例）の報告があり、IHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは、DRC（対象国）での感染発生と国際的な患者移動（DRC→ドイツ）を記述している。ウガンダはサマリーで言及されているが、同国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。エボラの国際的拡大とドイツへの持ち込みはDRCでの感染発生に起因するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。本事例は既に治療成功した個別症例だが、潜在的な国際的拡大リスク（特に対象地域への関連）からシグナルとしてピックアップする価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : près de 500 cas en Afrique centrale, un patient américain guéri... Le point sur l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: nearly 500 cases in Central Africa, an American patient has recovered... An update on the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa reaches nearly 500 cases. As of June 6, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where the outbreak was declared three weeks earlier, and 19 cases with 2 deaths in Uganda, for a total of 471 cases and 84 deaths. An American patient treated in Berlin after contracting Ebola in the DRC has recovered; his wife and four children, quarantined in the same high‑risk unit, were released in good health after testing negative. Since May 30 no virus has been detectable in follow‑up tests, and the isolation order was lifted. The outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; concerns persist that it could rival the 2014‑16 West Africa epidemic. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. A $518 million, six‑month plan by WHO and Africa CDC targets surveillance, labs, and infection prevention.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：中央アフリカで約500例、アメリカ人患者が回復...感染症の流行に関する最新情報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ出血熱流行であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは中央アフリカのDRC（452確認例、82死亡）とウガンダ（19例、2死亡）での発生が述べられている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外した。ドイツとアメリカでの患者移送・治療は記載されているが、これは流行発生地ではなく医療対応地であるため除外。PHEIC宣言、高い死亡率（約18%）、ワクチンなし、2014-16西アフリカ流行との比較言及により、国際的懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: US doctor recovers from Ebola after treatment in Germany
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Ebola during humanitarian work in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Nyankunde Hospital, Bunia) was evacuated to Berlin on May 20 and treated at Charité with antiviral therapy and supportive care. The initial high viral load declined, and since May 30 no virus was detected in daily follow-up PCR tests. Based on international criteria—complete absence of symptoms for more than 72 hours and negative PCR—the isolation was lifted at 12:00 p.m. local time. His wife Rebekah and their four children were quarantined as a precaution; none developed symptoms, and Stafford was discharged to reunite with his family. Serge noted exposure occurred during surgery in Congo. Stafford credited first-class care and experimental therapies currently trialed for this virus, calling the outcome a significant therapeutic success.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の医者がドイツでの治療後、エボラウイルス感染から回復
triage.triage_reason: 患者が既に回復し、感染拡大の継続的リスクがない。記事の主題は治療成功例であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 患者は既に回復し、隔離も解除されている。家族は症状なし。記事はコンゴでの感染事例であるが、発症地はコンゴ（Bunia）であり、治療はドイツで行われた。対象国に含まれるDRCでの発生であるが、既に完全に鎮静化した個別症例であるため、新たなシグナルとしての価値は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Un médecin américain guéri d'Ebola après un traitement en Allemagne, selon les autorités
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American doctor cured of Ebola after treatment in Germany, according to authorities.
article.articleSummary: An American missionary doctor infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has recovered and was released from Berlin's Charité hospital. Peter Stafford, affiliated with the Serge mission, was evacuated to Germany on May 20 after contracting Ebola during a humanitarian mission in the DRC. He received antiviral therapy and supportive care during the first week, with the initial viral load significantly decreasing under treatment. Since May 30, daily tests detected no virus. Following international criteria—72 hours without symptoms and repeated negative PCR tests—health authorities lifted his isolation at 12:00 on June 6. His wife (also a physician with Serge) and their four children were evacuated and quarantined as a precaution; none developed symptoms. Professor Leif Erik Sander of Charité described it as a significant therapeutic success. Stafford noted access inequities in the DRC and expressed gratitude for high-level care, including experimental therapies.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人医師がドイツでの治療後、エボラから治癒、当局が確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス患者の成功した治療例だが、発症地（DRC）での流行継続の直接的な証拠がなく、患者は既に治癒・隔離解除されているため、現在の感染症危機を示すシグナルとしては限定的。ただし、DRCでのエボラ流行の継続状況を確認する価値あり。
triage.notes: 患者は既に治癒し、隔leslie解除済みであり、現在の感染症危機を示すシグナルではない。ただし、DRCでのエボラ流行が継続していることを示す背景情報となる。国際的な患者移動と高度な治療成功の報告として社会的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bengal CM calls for coordinated efforts to make state tuberculosis-free
article.articleSummary: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari called for coordinated action to make the state tuberculosis-free, reviewing the Centre’s TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan during a Nabanna, Kolkata meeting. The discussion assessed district-wide progress of the TB elimination campaign, treatment outcomes, and strategies for early detection, treatment and prevention. Adhikari stressed sustained collective action by public representatives, doctors and government officials to ensure every patient is identified, treated and supported. A senior Health Department official said the review focused on strengthening surveillance, awareness and treatment adherence, with plans to accelerate interventions in districts with higher TB burden and to expand outreach to vulnerable populations. The meeting highlighted enhancing community participation and improving access to diagnosis and treatment, aligning with the national goal of eliminating tuberculosis.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルCMが州結核撲滅に向けた統合的取り組みを呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 結核は公衆衛生課題だが、本記事は政策会議・啓発活動の報道であり、新規感染症クラスタ、異常な流行、緊急事態を示す具体的データがない。
triage.notes: 記事は西ベンガル州における結核撲滅に向けた政策的・行政的活動（TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan）の進捗会議の報道。具体的な新規クラスタ、異常な患者数増加、死亡例、または管理不能な状況の報告はない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ameriškega zdravnika po zdravljenju ebole odpustili iz bolnišnice
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American doctor discharged from hospital after Ebola treatment.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Ebola while working in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been discharged from Berlin’s Charité hospital after two weeks of treatment. He was admitted May 20 following a confirmed Ebola infection amid a mid-May outbreak in DR Congo. By the end of May, tests showed no detectable virus, and he was released in early June in good health. His wife and four children were quarantined at the Berlin hospital but remained asymptomatic. The patient thanked the staff for top-tier care, noting the use of experimental therapies currently being evaluated for Ebola treatment. The case highlights international response to imported infections and the ongoing use of experimental options in Ebola management, with continued monitoring and laboratory confirmation of viral absence.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療後、アメリカ人医師がベルリンの病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染の国際的な移動事例であり、IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）が該当。DRコンゴでの流行背景とドイツへの輸入症例という国際的な公衆衛生上の意義がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはベルリン・ドイツ・米国が含まれているが、感染発生地はDRコンゴ。輸入症例はドイツ・米国内での事象であり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。エボラ感染の国際移動、実験的治療の使用、および中期的な流行対応といった国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Berlin Hospital Discharges US Doctor After Successful Ebola Treatment
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in a U.S. citizen treated in Berlin. The patient, identified as Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola while treating patients in the Democratic Republic of Congo and was admitted to Charité hospital in Berlin on May 20. No virus has been detected since May 30, and the patient was discharged after recovery. The hospital reported that symptoms subsided after combined antiviral therapy and additional supportive care, marking a significant therapeutic success. The case represents an imported Ebola infection from the DRC to Germany. Among the patient’s five high-risk contacts quarantined at Charité, none developed symptoms. As of Friday, 82 confirmed Ebola deaths had occurred in the ongoing outbreak that began in the DRC and Uganda. The story highlights cross-border transmission and ongoing public health vigilance for imported Ebola cases.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリン病院、エボラ治療に成功した米国医師を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定患者が国際的に移動・治療された事例であり、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。DRCでの継続的な流行（82人死亡）と輸入症例のあることから、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的な感染症監視対象として適切。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCで感染し、ドイツ（Berlin）で治療されたため、実イベント発生国はDRCのみを verified_locations に記載。DRCでのエボラ流行は継続中（82人死亡）で、輸入症例の発生は国際的な感染症監視の観点から重要。5名の高リスク接触者は隔離されており、現在までに症状発症なし。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis elimination in West Bengal reviewed under TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan
article.articleSummary: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari reviewed the Centre’s TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan at Nabanna, urging coordinated action by public representatives, healthcare professionals and officials to eliminate tuberculosis in the state. The June 2026 session assessed district‑wise progress, treatment outcomes and measures to strengthen early diagnosis, surveillance, awareness, treatment adherence and outreach in higher‑burden districts. Adhikari stressed sustained cooperation to ensure every patient is identified, treated and supported, with emphasis on finding cases early and maintaining treatment. Officials reviewed faster action in high‑burden districts, improved access to diagnosis and treatment services, and strategies to reach vulnerable populations. The review underscored intensified detection and timely treatment as central to West Bengal’s role in the national elimination goal, highlighting the importance of broader community participation and ongoing progress tracking.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州におけるTB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan下での結核排除の検討
triage.triage_reason: 結核排除プログラムの進捗レビューに関する行政会合の報道であり、新たな感染症の異常発生、重症事例の急増、または国際的拡大の懸念を示す要素がない。
