triage.notes: 本記事はインド西ベンガル州における既存の国家結核排除プログラム（TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan）の定期的なレビュー・監督に関する行政報道である。新規の異常発生や急性の流行状況ではなく、結核対策の進捗管理の枠組み内での会合報告であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定する。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Ebola: Uganda to deploy 40 Health Workers to DR Cong
article.articleSummary: Uganda will deploy at least 40 medical experts and a technical response team to the Democratic Republic of Congo in the first phase of a cross-border Ebola response. Uganda’s Ebola caseload rose to 19 confirmed infections on June 5, including 13 active cases, two deaths and four recoveries. Across the border, the DRC has 363 confirmed cases and 62 deaths from Bundibugyo Ebola, which causes fever, headache, fatigue, muscle and joint pain, sore throat, loss of appetite, with vomiting, diarrhea or bleeding. Transmission in eastern DRC is driving patients into Uganda seeking care, complicating surveillance and contact tracing. Uganda plans to establish a diagnostic laboratory inside eastern DRC to speed testing and cut confirmation delays. Funding details were not disclosed; the Finance Ministry will release funds as partners are engaged. Measures include partial border passenger suspensions, cargo screening, intensified surveillance, with WHO and Africa CDC assisting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダがDRコンゴに40名の医療従事者を派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な出来事、国際的拡大リスク、国境措置）。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で複数該当。エボラ出血熱の国境を越えた感染拡大は高度なリスク。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）でもエボラ患者が確認されているが、記事の主題はDRコンゴでの流行とウガンダの国境対応であり、DRコンゴが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC を列挙。Bundibugyo Ebola（ウイルス属 Ebolavirus）による現在進行中の複数国境流行。WHO・Africa CDCの関与確認。

article.articleHeadline: Berlin hospital discharges US doctor who contracted Ebola
article.articleSummary: Imported Ebola case in Germany: A U.S. citizen, identified by Serge Christian as medical missionary Peter Stafford, was treated for Ebola contracted in the Democratic Republic of Congo and discharged from Charité hospital in Berlin on June 6. He was admitted May 20 after exposure in the DRC; no virus has been detected since May 30. Symptoms subsided significantly after treatment that included combined antiviral therapy and additional supportive medical measures, Charité officials said, calling the outcome a significant therapeutic success. Five family members classified as high-risk contacts were quarantined at Charité but showed no symptoms. As of Friday, there were 82 confirmed Ebola deaths since the outbreak began in the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリン病院、エボラ感染の米国医師を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: 輸入型エボラ症例がドイツで確認され、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」および「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。また、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常性」「重症度」「流行可能性」に該当し、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認される実際の発生地はDRC（感染源）とドイツ（治療地）。対象国リストのうち実際に感染症イベントが発生している国はDRCのみ。ウガンダは別の流行との関連言及だが、主題の患者は DRC で感染。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Zaboravljeni znanstvenik o novoj epidemiji smrtonosne bolesti: 'Nešto je tamo pošlo po zlu...'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Forgotten Scientist on a New Epidemic of a Deadly Disease: 'Something Went Wrong There...'
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is battling an Ebola outbreak in the northeastern Ituri province near the Uganda and Sudan borders. As of 2026-06-06, the Ministry of Health reports more than 240 deaths and over 1,000 people suspected to be infected with the Bundibugyo strain, a form for which there is no vaccine or treatment. The outbreak has been described as notably ominous compared with the country’s previous 17 Ebola outbreaks, and was detected late. Bundibugyo circulated unnoticed for weeks in Ituri, amid widespread displacement of more than 250,000 people. The article notes ongoing efforts toward monoclonal antibody therapies and highlights community experiences and attitudes toward the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: 忘れられた科学者による新たな致命的疾患の流行について：『そこで何かが悪い方へ向かった...』
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行でIHR基準4つすべてに該当。ワクチン・治療法なし、240名以上の死亡、1,000名以上の感染疑い、国境地域での発生、地域不安定化との組み合わせにより国際的拡大リスクが顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国Ituri州での流行を主題としている。Uganda及びSudanは地理的な隣国として言及されているが、当該イベントの発生地は明確にDRC内に限定されている。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法が存在しないため管理難度が高く、広域変位人口（250,000名以上）との関連で長期曝露リスクが大きい。過去17件のエボラ流行との比較で『特に不吉』と評価されている点から異常性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Health dept issues advisory to prevent spread of communicable diseases
article.articleSummary: Kochi health department issued a monsoon advisory warning of diarrhoea, jaundice, and typhoid as waterborne risks rise. With higher chances of drinking-water contamination, the advisory urges only boiled water and chlorination of wells. Do not mix boiled and unboiled water. Boil water from public supply, RO, filters, canned water, and chlorinated water for 20 minutes before drinking, and for ice, drinks, pickles, and chutneys. Practice hygiene: wash hands with soap after toilet use and before handling food; use clean water to wash dishes; rinse mouth; wash vegetables and fruits. Infected individuals should not handle food, and shared utensils should be avoided. Seek medical attention if symptoms appear; for diarrhoea, rehydration therapy is advised—salted rice water, coconut water, lemon water with salt and sugar, or ORS.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局がコミュニケーション可能な疾患の拡大防止に関する勧告を発令
triage.triage_reason: チフス症例が報告されているが、記事サマリーは季節性水媒介疾患の一般的な予防勧告に焦点であり、アウトブレイク規模や重症度の詳細が不明。追加情報によってはPICKUP昇格の可能性あり。
triage.notes: 記事はケーララ州コーチン地域における季節的な水媒介疾患リスク低減に関する予防勧告が主眼。チフスは言及されているが、現在の患者数、死亡者数、アウトブレーク状況など具体的な疫学情報が欠落。モンスーン季節に関連した定期的な予防勧告の性質が強い。続報で患者数増加や重症化傾向が報告されればシグナル昇格の判断対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: City vets' gene research on blood parasite disease makes it to global science database
article.articleSummary: Babesia Gibsoni, a tick-borne protozoan parasite causing canine babesiosis, was sequenced and its GenBank accession PZ381575 published by the NCBI. In Kolkata, West Bengal, India, veterinary doctors Subhamoy Ghosh and Shamimdra Nath Sarkar generated the sequence from a clinical sample processed at Animal Health Pathology Lab (AHPL). The work, accepted by NCBI and placed in the global veterinary genomics database, aims to enable early, accurate molecular diagnosis and surveillance of tick-borne disease. Babesia Gibsoni infections in Bengal account for over 94% of canine babesiosis cases, with symptoms including anemia, fever, lethargy, enlarged spleen and liver, dark urine, and thrombocytopenia. By providing a genetic identity card for the parasite, the sequence supports future diagnostics and tracking of genetic changes, highlighting Bengal’s contribution to global veterinary research.

triage.headline_ja: 都市の獣医師による血液寄生虫病のゲノム研究がグローバル科学データベースに掲載される
triage.triage_reason: 本件はインドの獣医師による犬のバベシア症の遺伝子研究成果の発表であり、ヒトの感染症アウトブレイクではなく、公衆衛生危機ではない。学術的な進展報告に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は犬のバベシア症（Babesia Gibsoni）のゲノム配列がNCBIのGenBankに登録された学術的成果である。ヒトの感染症イベント、アウトブレイク、または公衆衛生上の危機ではなく、獣医学研究の進展を報告するもの。SFTS Virusは疾患名リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーに記載がなく、誤検出と考えられる。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи в Африці: 471 випадок, 82 смерті -- ВООЗ б'є на сполох
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa: 471 cases, 82 deaths — WHO sounds the alarm.
article.articleSummary: 471 Ebola Virus Disease cases have been confirmed in East Africa, with 82 deaths as of 6 June 2026, per the WHO. The outbreak centers in the Democratic Republic of Congo but has crossed borders, with lab-confirmed cases in neighboring Uganda. Two active Ebola strains are involved: Zaïre ebolavirus and Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the latter rarer and less studied, complicating diagnostics and treatment. Ongoing conflict and humanitarian crises in eastern DRC hinder access for relief workers. The WHO warns the outbreak could surpass the scale of the 2014 West Africa epidemic, which claimed over 11,000 lives. An emergency response plan is being prepared with at least $518 million to fund quarantine measures, PPE for health workers, mobile laboratories, and accelerated regional vaccination. International resource shortages and security challenges are delaying containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ流行: 471例、82人の死亡 — WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間での確認、高い致死率、国際的拡大リスク、および国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは東アフリカ地域での流行を述べ、DRCを中心地とし、ウガンダでの確認を記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。モザンビーク、アンゴラについては記事サマリーで具体的な言及がないため含めない。2つのエボラ株関与、国際的資源不足、セキュリティ上の課題が対応を遅延させている点が注目される。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تحذر من تسارع تفشي إيبولا في وسط إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of accelerating Ebola outbreak in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports 471 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 84 deaths in Central Africa. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 452 cases and 82 deaths; in Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths, bringing totals to 471 cases and 84 deaths. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri province, northeastern DRC, with evidence the virus circulated for weeks before official detection. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the epidemic is accelerating and urged urgent action to contain transmission and prevent spread to other countries. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic disease transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids and infected materials, and it has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa in the past five decades.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、中央アフリカにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行加速を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。複数国での確認、高い死亡率、WHO事務局長による警告、加速する流行により国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのItturi州で2026年5月15日に宣言されたエボラ流行。既知のウイルス流通期間あり、WHO事務局長による警告、加速的流行パターンという3つの重大要因が確認される。フルRRA実施を強く推奨する。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола возвращается: американские эксперты сравнили нынешнюю вспышку с катастрофой 2014 года
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is back: American experts compared the current outbreak to the 2014 catastrophe.
article.articleSummary: American health experts warn that the current Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, centered in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, could reach the scale of the 2014–2016 catastrophe, which killed over 11,000. CDC computer modeling projects 10,000 to 20,000 cases; the West Africa outbreak infected over 28,000. Dr. Satish Pillai of the CDC emphasizes rapid detection and isolation are critical. Jennifer Nuzzo of Brown University cautions forecasts are uncertain due to limited data. About 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths have been reported; true numbers may be higher due to undiagnosed infections. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a variant of Ebola, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission via contact with bodily fluids. WHO declared a global health emergency in May. Acknowledges that 50–70% isolation could greatly limit spread; past projections in 2014 were overly pessimistic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が戻る：米国の専門家が現在の流行を2014年の大惨事と比較
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。WHO緊急宣言済みの高リスクシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、CDCの予測やWHOの緊急宣言を引用。Bundibugyo ebolavirus変異株による感染で、ワクチンがない。Angolasはサマリー上で明記されていないため除外。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（28,000+例）との比較から国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Африке: 471 случай, 82 смерти -- ВОЗ бьет тревогу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa: 471 cases, 82 deaths — WHO sounds the alarm.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in East Africa: the World Health Organization confirms 471 cases and 82 deaths as of 6 June 2026, with the epicenter in the Democratic Republic of Congo and the virus now confirmed in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak threatens to surpass the 2014 West Africa epidemic, which killed more than 11,000. Two active Ebola strains are circulating—Zaire ebolavirus and Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the latter rarer and less studied, complicating diagnosis and treatment. Ongoing insecurity in eastern DRC hampers humanitarian access and aid delivery. The WHO is developing an emergency response plan estimated at at least $518 million to fund enhanced quarantine measures, PPE for health workers, mobile laboratories, and accelerated regional vaccination. International humanitarian partners warn of critical resource gaps amid conflict and a broader humanitarian crisis.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行：471例、82人死亡——WHOが警告を発します
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、致死率の高いエボラウイルス感染症の多国家間での多数死亡例の流行報告。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、重症度が高く管理可能性に課題があるため、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC がエピセンターとして明記され、ウガンダでの確認も述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。2つの流行中のエボラ株（ザイールエボラウイルスおよびブンディブギョエボラウイルス）の同時流行、東部 DRC の治安悪化による人道支援アクセスの困難、$518百万以上の緊急対応計画など、複数の懸念要因を含む。2014年西アフリカ流行（11,000人以上死亡）を超える可能性があると指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Саммит США - Африка на Маврикии перенесен из-за вспышки Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S.-Africa Summit in Mauritius has been postponed due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Mauritius postponed the U.S.-Africa Summit 2026, planned for July 26–29, due to the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The decision, announced after consultations with the Corporate Council on Africa, aims to await an improved epidemiological situation on the continent; a new date will be announced later. Mauritius also imposed a temporary entry ban on foreign nationals who, in the prior 21 days, visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan. The article notes a similar postponement in May of the India–Africa Summit in New Delhi for the same public health reason. No Ebola case counts or laboratory confirmations are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 米国アフリカ首脳会議、エボラ出血熱の流行のためモーリシャスでの開催が延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラ出血熱という高い病原性と、複数国での流行による国際的影響、及び外交的対応が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にモーリシャスでの首脳会議の延期を報じているが、実際のエボラ流行の発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンである。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCとインドのみ。インドについては、New Delhi での India-Africa Summit 延期が言及されており、これは公衆衛生上の理由による延期のため、シグナルとして該当。モーリシャスと米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة تحصي حوالي 500 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا في... - الوكيل الإخباري
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization tallies about 500 confirmed Ebola virus cases in...
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports about 500 confirmed Ebola virus cases in Central Africa in its daily update. The Democratic Republic of the Congo has 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, with the outbreak first reported roughly three weeks ago. Uganda records 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Together, the two countries total 471 cases and 84 deaths, up 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The update indicates a rapidly expanding outbreak in the DRC and neighboring Uganda, prompting ongoing surveillance and heightened regional concerns about transmission. This update underscores ongoing regional spread and the need for continued vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラウイルスの確認症例約500件を報告 - 中央アフリカにおける流行状況
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスは確認症例500件以上、死亡84件を計上し、DRCとウガンダで急速に拡大している重篤な流行。国際的拡大と渡航・貿易制限のリスクが顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダの両国で発生が明記されているが、対象国リストはDRCのみを含むため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。本イベントは複数の定義で重篤と判定され、直ちにRRA実施対象となる。1日単位での症例増加（100件）と死亡増加（20件）から急速な進行が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola cases jump as CDC warns outbreak could be among largest ever
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding, with 452 laboratory-confirmed cases and 82 deaths among confirmed patients as of June 6, 2026. The daily tally included 71 new cases and 21 deaths, following expanded testing in the mining town where the outbreak is believed to have begun. Congo's National Institute of Public Health reported that samples are now being processed in Mongbwalu, an artisanal gold-mining center in Ituri province, reducing delays in confirming suspected cases. The epicenter remains Mongbwalu, Ituri, raising concerns that the outbreak may be much larger than previously understood. The CDC has warned the outbreak could be among the largest ever, signaling a need for intensified surveillance, rapid testing, and public-health response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者数が急増、CDCは過去最大級の流行になる可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5基準該当。CDCが過去最大級の警告を発出し、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥリ州モングバル鉱山地域を中心としたエボラ流行について記載。452例の確認患者、82例の死亡、日々71例の新規患者と21例の死亡が報告されている。CDCによる過去最大級流行の警告は国際的な懸念を高めている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Stadig flere får påvist ebola i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More and more people are diagnosed with Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: 488 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the outbreak that began mid-May swelling by more than 100 cases since Thursday night. A total of 86 of the infected have died. At least 34 health workers have contracted the virus, with seven health worker deaths reported by the WHO. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, now spreading in Congo, is described as particularly deadly, and there are no approved medicines or vaccines for this variant. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood and bodily fluids of sick or deceased individuals. In neighboring Uganda, 18 Ebola cases have been reported with two deaths. The ongoing outbreak underscores high risk to frontline staff and the urgent need for containment and protective measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者の診断が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する重大な感染症危機。確認症例488例、死亡86例、医療従事者への感染拡大、治療法・ワクチンなし、隣国ウガンダへの拡大が報告されており、国際的な公衆衛生脅威と認識される。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国での確認症例488例（死亡86例）、Bundibugyo ebolavirus変異型は治療法・ワクチン未承認。医療従事者34名感染、うち7名死亡。隣国ウガンダでも18症例・2死亡が報告されているが、検証可能な対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations にはコンゴのみを記載。5月中旬開始の流行が継続中で急速に拡大している。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية.. حوالي 500 إصابة مؤكدة بإيبولا في وسط إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: About 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of June 6, 2026, the World Health Organization reports about 500 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in Central Africa. The latest update cites 452 confirmed cases with 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak began about three weeks ago, and 19 confirmed cases with 2 deaths in neighboring Uganda. Combined totals for the two countries rise to 471 cases and 84 deaths, up 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The CDC warns the current outbreak, declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, could reach a scale similar to the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic without strong public health measures. Ebola transmits through close contact and bodily fluids, and the disease has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa over five decades.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：中部アフリカでエボラの約500件の確定症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、エボラ発生の主体はDRC（452確定症例、82死亡）であり、ウガンダへの波及が19症例、2死亡と報告されている。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。2014-2016年西アフリカエボラ流行同等の規模への懸念が表明されており、WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число смертей от лихорадки Эбола превысило 80, пишут СМИ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the death toll from Ebola fever has exceeded 80, according to media reports.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 80, with 488 laboratory-confirmed cases and 86 deaths among them. Reuters cites authorities for these figures. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, noting a high regional risk of spread to neighboring countries. The report also states that combined Ebola cases in the DRC and Uganda have risen to 397, signaling ongoing cross-border transmission and significant international implications of the outbreak. As of 2026-06-06, these numbers reflect ongoing transmission and international concern. No details on transmission source or clinical symptoms are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱による死亡者数が80人を超える、メディアが報道
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の拡大、国際的蔓延リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、国境を越えた伝播が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ列挙。WHOによる国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、複数国への伝播確認、高い地域的拡大リスク指摘により、すべての評価基準で懸念水準に達している。

article.articleHeadline: في وسط إفريقيا.. تسجيل قرابة 500 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا | التلفزيون العربي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Central Africa... Nearly 500 confirmed Ebola virus infections | Al Arabiya TV
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease spreading in Africa, with 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and 19 confirmed cases with 2 deaths in neighboring Uganda, bringing the combined totals to 471 cases and 84 deaths as of 2026-06-06. The outbreak was first announced May 15 in Ituri province, in northeastern DRC. The strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus, which can present with fever and symptoms similar to influenza, malaria, or typhoid, contributing to a silent spread for weeks. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain, so containment relies on public health measures and infection control. WHO and Africa CDC launched a USD 518 million plan for six months, focusing on surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention. CDC described the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, warning it could reach sizes seen in 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak if unchecked.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカで...エボラウイルスの確定感染者数約500人 | アルアラビーヤTV
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模発生（471症例84死亡）、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的言及を検証した結果、DRC（イトゥリ州）とウガンダでの発生が述べられているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アンゴラはBluedot発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは具体的な言及なし。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行級への警告あり。ワクチン・治療法不在で、Bundibugyo Ebola virusという稀な株である点も注目。

article.articleHeadline: طيران الإمارات تصدر تحديثاً لإرشادات السفر بسبب إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emirates issues an update to travel guidelines due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Emirates updates travel guidelines due to Ebola, effective 2026-06-06 until further notice. The United Arab Emirates will impose entry restrictions on travelers who recently stayed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, unless they have spent more than 21 days outside these countries. Transit passengers must comply with entry requirements of their final destinations. The restrictions cover all travelers, including those arriving via indirect routes. Emirates notes that several countries have imposed entry restrictions or added health screening due to Ebola, and urges travelers to verify destination entry requirements via official government channels before travel. This reflects ongoing Ebola concerns in the region and among neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: エミレーツ航空、エボラの影響で渡航ガイドラインを更新
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たす（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率を持つ指定感染症で、複数国での確認と国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事はUAE、DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンで言及されている。対象国のうり、DRCが確実に確認される。UAEは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ウガンダと南スーダンも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事では複数国でエボラ関連の懸念が示されており、高い公衆衛生リスクが示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: जयपुर में इबोला संदिग्ध युवती की जांच रिपोर्ट निगेटिव, अस्पताल से मिली राहत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaipur: Ebola-suspected young woman's test report negative; relief from the hospital.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-like illness in Jaipur, India, involves a 19-year-old Ugandan woman who arrived from Sharjah. She was admitted to Rajasthan University of Health Sciences (RUHS) Hospital in Jaipur after airport health teams detected Ebola-like symptoms. A sample tested at a Pune laboratory returned negative for Ebola virus infection, ruling out the suspected case. The patient was placed in an isolation unit for special care. As of June 6, 2026, officials reported the negative result on Saturday night. The report highlights the travel link from Uganda and transit via Sharjah. No confirmed Ebola cases; only a suspected case that has now been ruled out. Health authorities continue routine surveillance. The incident underscores airport screening and isolation measures in managing suspected infectious diseases, with no further health threat in Jaipur at this time.

triage.headline_ja: ジャイプールのエボラ疑い患者の若い女性の検査結果は陰性、病院から安心感
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い症例が検査により陰性が確認され、確定症例なし。異常検出システム（空港スクリーニング）は機能し、感染症リスクは排除された。
triage.notes: ウガンダからの旅行者による疑い症例だが、実験室検査により陰性が確認され、感染症イベントとして成立していない。記事は空港検疫システムの有効性を示すニュース価値のみで、公衆衛生的リスクはなし。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Hausse des prix des produits à Kasindi après la fermeture de la frontière ougandaise
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola - Rising prices of goods in Kasindi after Ugandan border closure.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak prompts a temporary closure of the Uganda–DR Congo border at Mpondwe, triggering a sharp rise in prices for essentials in Kasindi-Lubirigha, North Kivu. Effective June 4, 2026, the border shutdown is linked to Ebola virus disease concerns, heightening economic insecurity for households and displaced people in Kasindi. Civil society urges authorities on both sides to prioritize strengthened health surveillance and safe cross-border trade rather than prolonged closures. Local traders from Kabarole, Masambo, Kotongo, Mumbiri and Lwandumbi rely on cross-border flows to move produce and purchase staples like bananas and cooking oil; Congolese buyers also need Ugandan goods. FEC/Kasindi asks traders not to raise prices while authorities assess the impact. The article provides no specific case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国: エボラ - ウガンダ国境閉鎖後のカシンディでの物価上昇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において異常性（予想外の国境閉鎖）、国際的拡大リスク（国境の両側での懸念）、渡航制限が該当。エボラウイルス病は重症度・流行可能性が極めて高く、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。確認されたエボラ事例がある地域での重大な対応が開始されており、シグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは価格上昇という経済的影響を主題としているが、根本的なドライバーはDRC北キブ州でのエボラウイルス病の発生と確認されたウガンダとの国境閉鎖である。ウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれない）での確認症例は記述されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただし国際的には両国間の対応調整が必要な段階であることが明らかである。具体的な患者数・死亡者数は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Four-year-old girl dies of Shigella infection in Kozhikode; two more children test positive
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026 in Kozhikode, Kerala, a four-year-old girl, Nila of Thalakkulathur, died after contracting shigella infection, admitted on 1 June to the Institute of Maternal and Child Health (IMCH) at Medical College Hospital in intensive care. Two additional children— a 10-year-old boy from Purameri and a two-year-old from Pantheeramkavu— tested positive for shigellosis and remain hospitalized with severe diarrhoea. Laboratory tests confirmed Shigella infection in all cases. Shigellosis is caused by Shigella bacteria, with diarrhoea the main symptom, often accompanied by fever, stomach pain, vomiting, fatigue, and blood in stool; illness typically lasts two to seven days. Transmission occurs via contaminated water or food, unwashed produce, close contact with an infected person, or food prepared by someone carrying the bacteria. Young children and immunocompromised individuals are at higher risk; rapid spread is possible without precautions.

triage.headline_ja: コジコデでシゲラ感染により4歳女児が死亡、2人の子どもが陽性判定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡例）と異常性が確認され、2基準以上該当。WPRO基準でも重症度（死亡・重症下痢）と流行しやすさ（接触感染リスク、若年層への高リスク）が該当。社会的関心も確認される。
triage.notes: インドのケーララ州コジコデで確認されたシゲラ感染症クラスター。死亡例1件、入院患者複数（重症下痢）。シゲラは水系感染病原体で衛生条件との相関が強く、小児や免疫不全患者での重症化リスクが高い。記事では伝播メカニズム（汚染水・食物、接触感染）と高リスク群が明記されており、適切な衛生管理・感染制御措置が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: وكالة سرايا : منظمة الصحة تحصي حوالى 500 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا في وسط إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saraya Agency: WHO counts about 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-06, the World Health Organization reports about 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak began about three weeks ago, 452 cases have been confirmed with 82 deaths. In neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed cases have been reported, including 2 deaths. The combined total for DRC and Uganda stands at 471 cases and 84 deaths, up by about 100 cases and 20 deaths from the previous day. The outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern designated by WHO. The U.S. CDC warns that, without stricter measures, the current outbreak could reach a scale similar to the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed over 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: サラヤ通信社：WHO、中央アフリカでエボラウイルスの確認患者数が約500人と集計
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染拡大イベント。IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクの全4基準に該当。WHOによるPHEIC指定状況も確認。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。アンゴラも地域的に言及されていないため除外。発生地域にUSが列挙されているが、サマリーではCDCの警告言及のみで米国での発生報告なし。エボラは高致命率（DRC約18%）、ヒト-ヒト感染の高い流行性を有し、管理困難な感染症であり、PHIEC指定によりフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число смертей от лихорадки Эбола превысило 80
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the death toll from Ebola fever has exceeded 80.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has exceeded 80 deaths, with 488 laboratory-confirmed cases reported as of June 6, 2026. Of the confirmed cases, 86 have resulted in death. The World Health Organization previously declared the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and neighboring Uganda an international public health emergency, with regional risk of cross-border spread deemed high. The report highlights ongoing activity and cross-border concerns but provides no details on symptoms, transmission sources, or vaccination. These figures reflect continued surveillance and international concern over the outbreak’s potential to spread beyond the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱の死者が80人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOによる国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言が既になされている。エボラ熱の国際的拡大リスク（隣国ウガンダでも確認）および越境感染の懸念が明記されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでも確認されたことが言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCに限定して評価。WHOによる国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)の宣言が既になされており、高リスク状況。

article.articleHeadline: Γερμανία: Εξιτήριο για τον Αμερικανό γιατρό που είχε προσβληθεί από Έμπολα στη Λαϊκή Δημοκρατία του Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany: American doctor who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo discharged.
article.articleSummary: An American physician who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been discharged from Berlin's Charité University Hospital after a two-week isolation in the Virchow Clinic. The 39-year-old doctor was flown to Berlin on May 20 under strict security; no Ebola virus was detectable in his blood as of May 30, enabling discharge per international protocols. The hospital’s federal health authorities stated there was no risk to the public or other patients, with appropriate protections for staff. His wife and four children, arriving a few days later as high-risk contacts, were quarantined in a separate ward and discharged on Saturday after remaining asymptomatic. The patient thanked the medical team for first-class care and experimental therapies under testing for this virus type, while expressing concern for Congo residents lacking access to similar treatment. DR Congo has recently experienced a new Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラに感染したアメリカ人医師が退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な移動に関わる事例であり、DRC国内での新規流行が進行中だが、本件は患者の回復・退院という落ち着きの局面であり、ドイツでの二次感染リスクは低いとされている。情報が限定的であり、DRC側の流行規模や国際的拡大の可能性についての詳細が不明。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な舞台はドイツ（ベルリンの病院）だが、感染源はDRC内のエボラ流行。ドイツはWPRO対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC内での「新規流行」が言及されているが、流行規模や死亡数などの詳細は不明。IHR基準2つ以上該当するため技術的にはPICKUP相当だが、患者が既に回復・退院済みで二次感染リスクは最小化されている点を考慮し、WATCH判定とした。DRC側の流行動向の続報により判定が変わる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: התפרצות האבולה בקונגו: 488 מקרים מאומתים ו-86 מקרי מוות
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo: 488 confirmed cases and 86 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 488 Ebola virus disease cases and 86 deaths. Ituri province remains epicenter with 359 cases across 17 health zones; North Kivu 19 cases in seven zones, and South Kivu three more. The outbreak began in Ituri and was officially confirmed May 15, 2026; the first case, a health worker, developed fever, bleeding, vomiting and severe fatigue after April 24. INRB confirms Bundibugyo virus, with 8 positives from 13 samples, complicating treatment. On May 17, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, followed by Africa CDC on May 18. Uganda reports 19 cases and two deaths by June 5; borders closed, Congo imports subject to a 21‑day isolation. An American treated in Congo tested positive and was moved to Germany. CEPI pledged $62 million to accelerate three vaccines, including Moderna. Outbreak persists amid insecurity and movement. Bundibugyo virus CFR 25–50%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行：488例の確認症例と86例の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行、国際的拡大、国境閉鎖等の措置）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。WHO及びアフリカCDCが既に公式宣言し、国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 本イベントは既にWHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言している進行中の大規模流行。DRC内でのIturi州が震源地（359例）、South Kivu州でも3例報告。ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認（19例、2死亡）。Bundibugyo virus（CFR 25-50%）の複雑化も懸念。ドイツへの患者輸送例も報告されているが、記事の主題発生地はDRCのため verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya to set up quarantine centres amid rising Ebola cases in region
article.articleSummary: Kenya will establish quarantine centres nationwide to bolster Ebola preparedness, with Health Principal Secretary Mary Muthoni stressing that isolating exposed individuals is key to limiting spread. Ebola activity in the region is underscored by the Democratic Republic of Congo reporting 452 cases after 71 new infections and 82 deaths. Uganda has 19 Ebola cases and two fatalities. The Center for Disease Control warns that the current outbreak could rival the West Africa epidemic a decade ago in severity. Kenya’s proactive quarantine strategy reflects a broader regional response to mounting Ebola activity, highlighting the importance of isolation, surveillance, and cross-border coordination to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、地域のエボラ熱患者数増加に対応し検疫センターを設置へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の多国間地域流行。DRC 452例・ウガンダ19例の報告、死亡例あり、国際拡大リスク高く、IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、Kenya、Angolaも含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。記事はDRCの452例を主焦点としており、ケニアの検疫体制整備は地域的対応。本イベントはエボラ出血熱の多国間地域流行であり、CDC警告による西アフリカ流行規模への言及も重要。WPROスクリーニング5基準すべてに該当し、高リスク判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaudbrud er nu historiens tredjestørste. Her er, hvad du skal vide
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is now the third largest in history. Here is what you need to know.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has become the third-largest in history as of 2026-06-06. The rapid rise in cases is unfolding in a region with a dense population and heavy traffic, where frequent movement increases opportunities for spread. The outbreak is driven by a rare Ebola variant, contributing to its unusual and accelerated growth. The article emphasizes the unprecedented scale of this Ebola incident and highlights its status as a major public health concern within the Democratic Republic of Congo. While the excerpt does not provide case or death counts, it signals ongoing transmission and a heightened risk profile due to the combination of the rare variant and the region’s connectivity. The situation is described as a notable escalation in Ebola activity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は現在、歴史上3番目の規模となっている。ここであなたが知っておくべきことがある。
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。歴史上3番目規模のエボラ流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀少変異株による異常性、高感染リスク地域での拡大、国際的拡大リスク。
triage.notes: 稀少なエボラ変異株による歴史上3番目規模の流行。人口密集地域での高い伝播リスク。全WPRO基準に該当し、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Reuters: число летальных случаев от Эболы в Конго достигло 86
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reuters: The number of Ebola-related fatalities in Congo has reached 86.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 June 2026, Ebola fatalities in the Democratic Republic of Congo have risen to 86, with 488 confirmed cases. Reuters, citing local authorities, reports the outbreak has expanded into newly affected areas in eastern DR Congo, as doctors struggle to trace contacts. The affected area now covers 22 medical zones across three provinces. The report underscores ongoing surveillance and containment challenges, including difficulties in tracking transmission chains among patients and their contacts. The uptick in cases and deaths signals persistent transmission in the DR Congo, with authorities continuing to monitor the situation and implement public health measures to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: Reuters: コンゴのエボラ関連死亡者数が86人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の確認された流行による深刻な公衆衛生危機。国際的な懸念と支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は致死率が高く、接触感染によるヒト-ヒト感染が可能。現在DRC東部の22医療地域・3州に拡大しており、接触者追跡の困難さが報告されている。国際的な感染症監視体制での注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Reuters: в Конго число смертей от лихорадки Эбола превысило 80
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reuters: In Congo, the death toll from Ebola fever has exceeded 80.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports an Ebola virus disease outbreak with 86 deaths among 488 confirmed cases, according to Reuters. The tally shows 488 confirmed infections and 86 fatalities within the confirmed cohort. By June 2, the World Health Organization had recorded 321 cases and 48 deaths in Congo, indicating growth since the earlier report. The article notes a previously reported suspected 'zero patient' linked to the outbreak. No laboratory confirmation details beyond 'confirmed' versus 'suspected' are provided, and no specific locations within the country are named. This underscores an ongoing Congo Ebola outbreak with rising case counts and mortality as of June 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ロイター通信：コンゴではエボラ熱による死亡者数が80人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを持つ。確認患者488人、死亡者86人の高い致死率は即座のフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は国際保健規則（IHR 2005）で報告義務対象疾患。高い致死率（17.6%）、確認患者数の増加傾向（WHO報告値から約67%増加）、原出典不明な'ゼロ患者'言及など、懸念点が複数存在。DRCのみが記事の実質的発生地であり、他地域への拡大記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة: نحو 500 إصابة مؤكدة بإيبولا في وسط أفريقيا - شفق نيوز | آخر الأخبار العاجلة في العراق وكوردستان والعالم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: About 500 confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa - Shafaq News | Latest breaking news in Iraq, Kurdistan, and the world.
article.articleSummary: 452 confirmed Ebola infections and 82 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths in neighboring Uganda, according to the World Health Organization's daily update. The outbreak has been centered in the DRC, with limited spread to Uganda. The WHO has described the event as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention warns the current outbreak could expand to levels seen in the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed more than 11,000, if stringent actions are not taken. Total confirmed Ebola cases in Central Africa are approaching about 500. The article does not detail symptoms, infection sources, laboratory confirmation specifics, or any exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：中央アフリカでのエボラ確定症例が約500件 - シャファク・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つとも満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。WHOが既にPHEIC(国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態)と宣言した大規模なエボラ流行事例であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているのはDRC(452確定例・82死亡)とウガンダ(19例・2死亡)。対象国リストではDRC(203312)のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため除外。既にWHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、2014-2016西アフリカエボラ流行(11,000人超死亡)の規模に拡大する可能性が警告されている。国際的な懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго подтвердили более 480 случаев заболевания Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, more than 480 Ebola cases have been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) has 488 confirmed cases and 86 deaths as of 2026-06-06, with the center of transmission in Ituri and cross-border spread to Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain is implicated; there are no vaccines or therapeutics specific to Bundibugyo available yet. By late May, authorities reported more than 200 deaths. Russian Health Minister Mikhail Murashko said a Russian vaccine against the new Ebola strain has been developed but must undergo trials; WHO estimates vaccine development for Bundibugyo could take 6–9 months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ病の確認症例が480例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する（深刻な公衆衛生影響：488確認例・86死亡、異常性：新規Bundibugyo株、国際的拡大：ウガンダへの越境感染、渡航制限リスク高）。さらにWHOがPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: サマリーはIturi州（DRC）での発生を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境感染も述べられているがDRCが主要な発生地。ロシア連邦は記事中でワクチン開発コメントの提供者として言及されるのみで、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みであり、Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法が未確立であること、および国際的な懸念が高いことを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Health officials warn Ebola outbreak in Congo could become largest on record
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could become the largest on record. CDC estimates suggest the outbreak could rival the 2014 epidemic if strong interventions are not implemented. New modeling projects cases could surpass 20,000 in the next three months. Officials have confirmed at least 60 deaths so far. The World Health Organization says it is working to catch up with the outbreak, with scale and timeline still under investigation. The report emphasizes the urgent need for intensified public health measures to avert explosive growth, including surveillance, vaccination where available, and community engagement. As authorities mobilize resources quickly.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱は記録上最大の流行となる可能性があると保健当局が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行リスクと死亡例の発生、国際支援体制の構築が急務である。
triage.notes: 2026年6月配信の記事であり、3ヶ月で20,000例超への増加が予測されている深刻な状況。WHO・CDCも対応中。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: German hospital discharges US man cured of Ebola infection
article.articleSummary: An American surgeon with a missionary group in the Democratic Republic of Congo recovered from Ebola (Bundibugyo strain) and was discharged from Charité hospital in Berlin after 17 days of treatment. He had Ebola symptoms on May 20; viral load declined under experimental therapies currently trialled for this virus and supportive care, and no virus was detectable by May 30. The patient, Dr. Peter Stafford, 39, contracted the illness while operating on a patient in eastern DRC. His wife and five children, quarantined as high‑risk contacts, were released in good health on June 6. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments. Outbreaks in DRC and Uganda have 471 infected and 84 deaths, according to WHO; the WHO has declared an international public health emergency and the CDC warns it could become the largest Ebola epidemic on record, with haemorrhagic fever and up to 50% fatality.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツの病院がエボラ感染から治癒した米国人男性を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の国際的拡大、WHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、複数国での同時流行、死亡例を含む重症度の高さから、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ感染事例を主題としており、DRCでの流行が実際に発生している場所。ウガンダも記事内で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ドイツ（ベルリン）は治療地点であり、発生地ではない。WHO緊急事態宣言済み、CDC警告あり、複数国での同時流行（DRC・ウガンダ）、致死率50%の懸念から国際的重大性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Более 85 смертей, 488 зараженных: вспышка Эбола в Африке стремится к рекорду
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 85 deaths, 488 infected: Ebola outbreak in Africa on track to set a record.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 488 laboratory-confirmed cases and 86 deaths; Ituri Province is the epicenter, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) for DRC and Uganda on May 17, and launched a six‑month response plan worth $518 million. The US CDC warns of a dangerous trajectory, projecting up to 20,000 cases if infected individuals are not rapidly isolated to slow transmission. This outbreak is the fourth largest on record, following the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (11,000 deaths). Date: 2026-06-06. Keywords: Ebola, outbreak, DRC, Uganda, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, PHEIC, CDC, WHO, outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 85人以上の死亡、488人の感染：アフリカのエボラ流行が記録を更新するペースで進行中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言済みの重大な多国間流行。DRCおよびウガンダでの急速な感染拡大、高い死亡率、国際的拡大の顕著なリスク、および20,000人までの症例増加予測によるWHO/CDC警告が存在する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaとAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な流行地域であり、ウガンダは19症例2死亡の報告のみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（5月17日）、複数州での流行、国際的支援体制確立済み。第4位の大規模流行との記述あり。

article.articleHeadline: 488 са потвърдените случаи на зараза с ебола в ДРКонго, съобщиха властите
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 488 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in DR Congo, authorities said.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-06, the Democratic Republic of Congo reported 488 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 86 deaths, according to a government statement cited by Reuters. The update signals an ongoing outbreak with a rising tally of confirmed infections within the country. The brief provides no details on symptoms, geographic distribution within DR Congo, laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, vaccination status, or any imported/exported cases, and it does not describe any public health measures or response actions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス病の確認症例488件と報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）。進行中の大規模アウトブレイク状況であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最重要な国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威。488確認症例・86死亡という数値は深刻な進行中アウトブレイクを示唆。地理的分布・感染源・公衆衛生対応に関する詳細情報が不足しているが、IHR基準4項目全て該当しWPRO基準も5項目全て該当するため、シグナルとして即座にピックアップし、詳細なRRAを実施すること。

article.articleHeadline: Вірус Ебола поширюється, вакцини немає: ВООЗ оголосила надзвичайну ситуацію
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is spreading; there is no vaccine: the WHO has declared an emergency.
article.articleSummary: As of early June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in East Africa has 471 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, concentrated in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) where three provinces are affected. Ituri Province in the northeast reports 359 cases across 17 health zones; North Kivu adds 19 cases; South Kivu 3 near the Rwanda border, bringing DRC totals to 381 cases and 64 deaths. Uganda counts 19 cases and 2 deaths, mostly in Kampala and Wakiso; three new patients on June 5 were contacts of known cases, suggesting partial containment. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with national risk rated very high and regional risk high. The current strain is Bundibugyo, for which no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists; candidates are under development but none completed. Kenya reports two deaths amid protests around a planned Laikipia airbase quarantine center related to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが拡散し、ワクチンがない：WHOが緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：公衆衛生への深刻な影響（471確認例、82死亡）、異常性（Bundibugyo系統の再出現）、国際的拡大リスク（DRC、ウガンダ、ケニアに拡散、ルワンダ国境近く）、渡航・貿易制限の懸念。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCが最大の流行地（381例）として明示されており、ウガンダ（19例）とケニア（2死亡）も言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo系統のワクチン・治療法がないという医学的重大性と、WHOによるPHEIC宣言により、即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Вирус Эбола распространяется, вакцины нет: ВОЗ объявила чрезвычайную ситуацию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is spreading, there is no vaccine: WHO has declared a public health emergency.
article.articleSummary: 471 confirmed Ebola cases and 82 deaths are reported in East Africa by early June 2026, with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) bearing the bulk of the outbreak across three provinces. DRC: Ituri has 359 cases in 17 health zones and 64 deaths; North Kivu 19 cases; South Kivu 3, totaling 381 cases and 64 deaths in the country. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths as of June 5, centered in Kampala and Wakiso, with three new cases linked to known patients, suggesting partial containment. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with national risk rated as very high and regional risk high; officials warn the scale could rival the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment yet; transmission is via direct contact with blood or body fluids, with fruit bats as the natural reservoir. Kenya protests over a planned quarantine facility linked to Uganda/DRC cases have resulted in two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが拡散、ワクチンなし：WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象(PHEIC)を宣言。複数国での急速な感染拡大と死亡例、ワクチン・治療法の欠如により、国際的拡大と制限措置のリスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus株で、承認済みワクチンや特異的治療がない状況。DRCで381例64死、ウガンダで19例2死を報告。WHOがPHEIC宣言。記事言語ロシア語のため、翻訳精度に基づく評価。ケニアの隔離施設抗議に伴う2死も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: US doctor recovers from Ebola in Germany as DRC cases surge to 488
article.articleSummary: An American surgeon, 39-year-old Peter Stafford, recovered from Bundibugyo Ebola after treatment at Berlin's Charité hospital, marking a resolution as the DRC outbreak expands. Stafford, who worked for a Christian missionary group in the DRC, was admitted May 20 after lab-confirmed Bundibugyo virus infection; he is believed to have contracted the disease while treating an Ebola patient in eastern DRC before the outbreak was declared on May 15. He was flown from Uganda to Berlin under strict safety precautions; his wife and four children, asymptomatic high-risk contacts, were quarantined in a separate ward and released on Saturday. There is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo; three vaccines are in trials. The DRC outbreak has reached 488 cases and 86 deaths; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. WHO has declared a public health emergency, and the CDC warns it could become the largest Ebola epidemic on record.

triage.headline_ja: 米国医師がドイツでエボラから回復、DRC症例数488件に急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による多国間感染（DRC 488例86死、ウガンダ19例2死）、WHO公式宣言、CDC警告による国際的懸念が存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主としてDRC発症例（488例、86死）とウガンダ報告例（19例、2死）の緊急事態を扱っている。ベルリンはケーススタディ（米国医師の回復事例）の治療地であり、発症地ではないため対象国から除外。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の発症地として該当。WHO公式宣言、CDC警告記載により国際的関心と管理の必要性が明確。
